entries.value: 一顆像來自深處的水晶般發光的燦爛紫色寶石。

entries.value: 一篇精采的論文，記錄了各種青蛙的外貌、牠們對周遭野生動物的影響，以及……超乎我們想像的現實裂縫？什麼？

entries.value: 一朵只在獨處時綻放的嬌嫩花朵，在屬於自己的寧靜空間裡茁壯成長。

entries.value: 一顆美味、鮮豔又圓滾滾的糖果，還帶著一點刺激。

entries.key: A delightful treat from the Factory. Its crisp taste sparks joy with every bite.
entries.value: 來自工廠的可口點心。爽脆的口感讓每一口都充滿喜悅。

entries.key: A dense testament to time, holding the chronicles of ancient figs.
entries.value: 時間的厚重見證，記載著遠古無花果的編年史。

entries.key: A disgusting ball of mushed shark matter.
entries.value: 一團噁心的鯊魚肉泥球。

entries.key: A distant relative of the {mob}, it's always scheming.
entries.value: {mob}的遠親，總是在打著壞主意。

entries.value: 一顆絕美的萊姆色寶石。讓你想起一片草地。

entries.value: 一位著名的{npc}曾用這些做成的法杖。

entries.value: 一位傳奇農夫，據說是受太陽恩典而生。他徒手耕作大地，並用收成烘烤樸實的麵包碗，只送給他心中最親近的人。

entries.key: A flower so soft and creamy, it could almost pass for milk. Just don't be tempted to try drinking it.
entries.value: 一朵柔軟又滑順的花，幾乎可以假裝成牛奶。只是千萬別想喝它。

entries.key: A forceful Gold Axe which can break a large amount of logs in a single hit! Only available for Stranded players.
entries.value: 一把強力的金斧，一擊就能砍斷大量原木！僅限 Stranded 玩家使用。

entries.key: A fragment of the core of {pet}.

entries.key: A fusion of vine resilience and sap vitality.

entries.value: 一朵像將熄餘燼般發光的朦朧花朵，困在火焰與生命之間。

entries.value: 一顆又大又美味的莓果。吃下它的小動物短時間內都不會餓。

entries.value: 一片長在地上的葉子。真是突破極限。

entries.value: 外表有點粗糙，但內在自有其美。

entries.value: 一塊捕捉了冬季慶典溫暖與歡樂的魔法碎片。

entries.value: 一株把水全部喝光、再像水球一樣膨脹的植物。

entries.key: A plant that hardens into a shining green gemstone as it matures, ready to be mined.
entries.value: 一株成熟時會硬化成閃亮綠色寶石的植物，可以開採。

entries.key: A plant that only thrives in the presence of decay, its petals growing strong where life once was. Only death thrives the living.
entries.value: 一株只在腐朽中茁壯的植物，花瓣在曾有生命之處盛開。唯有死亡能滋養生者。

entries.key: A plate forged from an assortment of the most durable materials found in this world.
entries.value: 用這個世界上最耐用的各種材料鍛造的板甲。

entries.key: A portion of {mob}'s Soul that can be used to craft items.
entries.value: {mob}靈魂的一部分，可用來合成物品。

entries.key: A powerful artifact ingrained with protective properties.
entries.value: 一件蘊含守護之力的強大神器。

entries.key: A powerful blade forged in the depths of the {area}.
entries.value: 一把在{area}深處鍛造的強大刀刃。

entries.key: A powerful charge, capable of damaging {pet}'s tentacles!
entries.value: §7一股強大的電荷，能夠傷害{pet}§c的§7觸手！

entries.key: A powerful tool that breaks after {0} uses.
entries.value: 一件使用 {0} 次後會損壞的強大工具。

entries.key: A powerful tool that doesn't seem to break.
entries.value: 一件似乎不會損壞的強大工具。

entries.key: A precious trinket from a powerful member of The Family who doesn't really need it anymore....
entries.value: 一件來自家族中某位大人物的珍貴小飾品，他其實已經不太需要了……

entries.key: A private joke amongst Wizards, but you wouldn't understand.
entries.value: 巫師之間的私房笑話，你不會懂的。

entries.key: A quaint box holding a trove of whimsy and woe: from {pet}'s cherished childhood memories to his most profound mysteries.
entries.value: 一個古雅的盒子，裝滿了奇思妙想與憂愁：從{pet}珍貴的童年回憶，到他最深奧的謎團。

entries.key: A quest NPC that sells the {item} and the {item2}
entries.value: 販售{item}與{item2}的任務 NPC

entries.key: A rare space helmet forged from shards of moon glass.
entries.value: 一頂用月光玻璃碎片打造的稀有太空頭盔。

entries.key: A razor-sharp shark fin designed to craft powerful items.
entries.value: 一片鋒利無比的鯊魚鰭，用來合成強大的物品。

entries.key: A recreation of a medal {npc} used to give out for his contests. They are too popular now to be given out.
entries.value: {npc}過去在競賽中頒發的獎牌複製品。現在太受歡迎，已經不再頒發了。

entries.key: A recreation of the coating found on {npc}'s tools from his greatest expeditions.
entries.value: 仿製{npc}在他最偉大的探險中所用工具上的塗層。

entries.key: A refined form of heavy rock from the darkest depths.
entries.value: 來自最黑暗深處的沉重岩石的精煉形態。

entries.key: A relentless plant that spreads its root far and wide, consuming and destroying everything in its path.
entries.value: 一株頑強的植物，根系蔓延四方，吞噬並摧毀路徑上的一切。

entries.key: A remnant of the core of {pet}!
entries.value: {pet}核心的殘骸！

entries.key: A research on how to preserve and enhance class abilities in death.
entries.value: 一份關於如何在死亡中保存並強化職業技能的研究。

entries.key: A ring that calls you towards the eternal flame of the pits of lava.
entries.value: 一枚呼喚你前往岩漿坑永恆火焰的戒指。

entries.key: A rose with thick vines and thorns sharper than they should be.
entries.value: 一朵藤蔓粗壯、尖刺異常銳利的玫瑰。

entries.key: A rusted hilt, dropped by the {mob}.
entries.value: 一個生鏽的劍柄，由{mob}掉落。

entries.key: A savory snack given to those who skillfully entertain and impress with their tricks!
entries.value: 一份美味的點心，送給以把戲巧妙娛樂、驚豔眾人的人！

entries.key: A scroll ingrained with an ancient symbol.
entries.value: 一張刻有古老符號的卷軸。

entries.key: A seed full of promise, but it thirsts for an odd, egg-shaped gift to awaken.
entries.value: 一顆充滿希望的種子，但它渴望一份奇特的蛋形禮物才能甦醒。

entries.key: A seed so powerful, it feels like it shouldn't exist. Its growth knows no limits.
entries.value: 一顆強大到彷彿不該存在的種子。它的成長沒有極限。

entries.key: A series of NPCs located in the trees of the {area} in the {island}.
entries.value: 位於{island}{area}樹上的一系列 NPC。

entries.key: A series of tales following a fellow named {npc} and his waterfowl best friend. Who would be so egregious as to thrust such a literary masterpiece into the sea?
entries.value: 一系列關於一位名叫{npc}的人和他最好的水鳥朋友的故事。是誰這麼過分，竟把這樣的文學傑作丟進海裡？

entries.key: A set of NPCs that sell the Wyld Armor set.
entries.value: §7販售§a荒野盔甲§7套裝的一組 NPC。

entries.key: A set of beautiful antlers adorn your head. Obtained from the {npc} {0} {month} Bundle.
entries.value: 一對美麗的鹿角裝飾你的頭頂。從{npc} {0} {month}組合包中獲得。

entries.key: A shard of a Dungeon {enchantment}, capable of being bestowed upon another player for a continuous buff, but draining mana.
entries.value: 一塊地下城{enchantment}的碎片，可以賦予另一名玩家持續增益，但會消耗魔力。

entries.key: A sharp rock with sturdy construction.
entries.value: 一塊結構堅固的尖銳石頭。

entries.key: A shell of their former self.
entries.value: 昔日風采不再，只剩空殼。

entries.key: A shiny orange gem that glows faintly.
entries.value: 一顆微微發光的亮橘色寶石。

entries.key: A short walk for you is a long walk for them.
entries.value: 對你來說的一小段路，對牠們來說是很長的一段路。

entries.key: A shy little fellow!
entries.value: 一個害羞的小傢伙！

entries.key: A single, all-seeing eye, forcefully removed from the {mob} Broodfather. Though expressionless, you can sense the rage that permeates throughout.
entries.value: 一隻從{mob}巢母身上強行挖下的全視之眼。雖然面無表情，你仍能感受到其中瀰漫的怒火。

entries.key: A single-page printout outlining why the candidate's application should be accepted. Why are these a thing? Just read the application itself...
entries.value: 一頁列印文件，說明為什麼應該接受該候選人的申請。這種東西為什麼存在？直接讀申請書就好了啊……

entries.key: A slightly better version of Amber, but it could still use some work.
entries.value: §7稍微好一點的§6琥珀§7，但還有改進空間。

entries.key: A small bag containing a large amount of birdseed.
entries.value: 一個裝滿大量鳥飼料的小袋子。

entries.key: A small but sharp claw once used for digging tunnels.
entries.value: 一隻小而鋒利的爪子，曾經用來挖隧道。

entries.key: A small coin depicting a wrinkly, bearded frog. Coins of this nature are said to bring good luck when thrown into small fountains or ponds.
entries.value: 一枚刻著滿臉皺紋、留著鬍子的青蛙的小硬幣。據說把這種硬幣丟進小噴泉或池塘能帶來好運。

entries.key: A small piece of a giant glacier. Doesn't ever melt.
entries.value: 巨大冰河的一小塊。永遠不會融化。

entries.key: A small piece of a prism. Obtained from {item} Sales.
entries.value: 稜鏡的一小塊碎片。從{item}特賣中獲得。

entries.key: A small piece of nature. Obtained from the {npc} {month} Bundle.
entries.value: 一小片大自然。從{npc}{month}組合包中獲得。

entries.key: A small piece of royalty. Obtained from {item} Sales.
entries.value: 一小片皇室風範。從{item}特賣中獲得。

entries.key: A smell so aromatic that even rodents can't resist.
entries.value: 香得連齧齒動物都無法抗拒。

entries.key: A smoldering root that oddly can also be used as fuel.
entries.value: 一根悶燒的樹根，奇怪的是也能當作燃料。

entries.key: A soggy journal that you retrieved from the {area}.
entries.value: 你從{area}撈回的一本濕透的日誌。

entries.key: A soul a day keeps the doctor away.
entries.value: 一天一個靈魂，醫生遠離我。

entries.key: A soul torn from its host and obliterated by a vacuum fan.
entries.value: 一個被從宿主身上撕下、再被吸蟲器風扇粉碎的靈魂。

entries.key: A special seed from {pet} himself! However it's missing something...
entries.value: 一顆來自{pet}本人的特殊種子！不過好像少了點什麼……

entries.key: A splendid handle belonging to a feared foe. In exchange for granting them immense power, it saps the life force from its wielder.
entries.value: 一個屬於可怕敵人的精美握柄。它賦予持有者強大的力量，代價是吸取他們的生命力。

entries.key: A splendid jewel, once thrown into the {collections_res} Eater's pond as tribute. It now serves as the centerpiece of the {mob}'s makeshift crown.
entries.value: 一顆精美的寶石，曾被當作貢品丟進{collections_res}食者的池塘。現在成了{mob}臨時王冠的核心裝飾。

entries.key: A splendid shard that was buried in the earth by someone a long, long time ago.
entries.value: 一塊很久很久以前被某人埋在地下的精美碎片。

entries.key: A splendid wool found nowhere else; it caresses your fingers and exudes a unique warmth the likes of which you have never experienced before, and likely never will again.
entries.value: 一種別處找不到的精美羊毛；它輕撫你的指尖，散發出你從未體驗過、也許再也不會體驗到的獨特溫暖。

entries.key: A splendid, yet tiny crown; just about the right size for your pet!
entries.value: 一頂精美又迷你的王冠，大小剛好適合你的寵物！

entries.key: A squishy moist mess.
entries.value: 一團軟爛潮濕的東西。

entries.key: A squishy trail to follow your arrows!
entries.value: 一道跟著你箭矢的軟綿綿軌跡！

entries.key: A step beyond zealotry.
entries.value: 比狂熱更進一步。

entries.key: A stick of a sweet-smelling incense. It makes you feel at ease.
entries.value: 一支散發甜香的線香。讓你感到放鬆。

entries.key: A strange bean that starts growing in unexpected ways, stretching higher and higher.
entries.value: 一顆奇怪的豆子，以意想不到的方式開始生長，越長越高。

entries.key: A suspiciously heavy gift given to you by Chuckleton.
entries.value: §c Chuckleton §7送你的一份重得可疑的禮物。

entries.key: A tail ending in a thick club that was used to fend off predators.
entries.value: 一條末端是粗大棍狀物的尾巴，用來抵禦掠食者。

entries.key: A terrifying sphere of extreme spookiness.
entries.value: 一顆極度驚悚的恐怖球體。

entries.key: A test subject to see if a sheep shrinks when it dries.
entries.value: 一個用來測試綿羊乾了會不會縮水的實驗對象。

entries.key: A thank you present from a grateful person in the {island}.
entries.value: {island}一位心懷感激的人送的謝禮。

entries.key: A ticking time bomb to new life. Acquired using {item}.
entries.value: 一顆即將迎來新生命的定時炸彈。使用{item}取得。

entries.key: A torn article of men's clothing, waterlogged and mossy. Probably too late to ask for a refund.
entries.value: 一件破損的男裝，泡過水又長滿青苔。現在要求退款大概太晚了。

entries.key: A toy brought to life.
entries.value: 一個活過來的玩具。

entries.key: A truly magnificent egg is nestled within - that much you can tell by weight alone.
entries.value: 裡面藏著一顆真正非凡的蛋——光是重量就能感覺得出來。

entries.key: A truly remarkable pencil. Refined, sharpened, and polished over time.
entries.value: 一支真正非凡的鉛筆。經過長時間的修整、削尖與打磨。

entries.key: A twisted version of the Venus flytrap, this plant thrives on feeding its insatiable hunger for flesh. It requires regular offerings to stay alive, or it withers away.
entries.value: 捕蠅草的扭曲版本，這株植物以滿足對血肉永不饜足的渴望為生。它需要定期供奉才能存活，否則就會枯萎。

entries.value: §7一種顯然經過細心處理的§6琥珀§7。

entries.key: A type of silk woven by the {mob}. It's so soft that it practically trickles through your fingers as you hold it.
entries.value: 一種由{mob}編織的絲。柔軟到拿在手上時幾乎會從指縫間流走。

entries.key: A very careful and aware wolf.
entries.value: 一隻非常謹慎又警覺的狼。

entries.key: A very shy.. thing...
entries.value: 一個非常害羞的……東西……

entries.key: A vial of particularly clear water, gathered from Torrhus {month} by {npc} herself. It exudes a faint warmth when pressed against your chest, reminding you of fond memories of days gone by.
entries.value: 一小瓶特別清澈的水，由{npc}親自從托赫斯{month}取得。貼在胸口時會散發淡淡的暖意，讓你想起過往的美好回憶。

entries.key: A waning shard of sunlight, as though torn from a forgotten age.
entries.value: 一道逐漸消逝的陽光碎片，彷彿是從被遺忘的時代撕下來的。

entries.key: A well-preserved fossil featuring a coiled shell.
entries.value: 一塊保存良好、帶有螺旋殼的化石。

entries.key: A well-preserved set of neural spines. Whatever possessed these was an adept swimmer.
entries.value: 一組保存良好的神經棘。擁有它的生物想必是個游泳高手。

entries.key: A well-wrapped present that's hot to the touch.
entries.value: 一份包裝得很好、摸起來很燙的禮物。

entries.key: A well-written paper, complete with labeled diagrams. It explores frog biodiversity and details key efforts made in the name of conservation.
entries.value: 一篇寫得很好的論文，附有標註完整的圖表。探討了青蛙的生物多樣性，並詳述以保育為名的重要行動。

entries.key: A withering husk of its former self.
entries.value: 昔日風采不再，只剩枯萎的空殼。

entries.key: A wonderful circle of flowers consumes you! Obtained from the {npc} {month} Bundle.
entries.value: 一圈美妙的花朵將你包圍！從{npc}{month}組合包中獲得。

entries.key: A wonderful enchanted plant!
entries.value: 一株美妙的附魔植物！

entries.key: A wonderful plant!
entries.value: 一株美妙的植物！

entries.key: A wooden barrel, stuffed to the brim with riches of all sorts. The lid won't even fit on it!
entries.value: 一個木桶，裡面塞滿了各式財寶，連蓋子都蓋不上！

entries.key: A {mob} forms from the depths.
entries.value: 一隻{mob}從深處成形。

entries.key: A {pet} {pet2} is attached to this bone. {pet3} Spirits always come back to their masters.
entries.value: 一隻{pet}{pet2}依附在這根骨頭上。{pet3}之靈總會回到主人身邊。

entries.key: ALL monsters have double {stats}!
entries.value: 所有怪物的{stats}都加倍！

entries.key: Abilities have {0}/{1} of the mana cost.
entries.value: 技能的魔力消耗變為 {0}/{1}。

entries.key: Absorption {roman} ({0}:{1}) Grants {2} of absorption.
Accessories have never tasted so sweet.
entries.value: 飾品從來沒有這麼甜過。

entries.key: Accessory Size {roman} Grants {0} extra Accessory Bag slots.
entries.value: §6飾品容量 {roman} §7額外獲得 {0} §7個§a飾品袋§7欄位。

entries.key: According to rumors, Shen himself has been crafting special items for sale to SkyBlock's richest players.
entries.value: 傳聞 Shen 本人一直在製作特殊物品，賣給 SkyBlock 最富有的玩家。

entries.key: According to {boss} Selta they are {0}V batteries and can supply about {1}mA of current. {boss2} Selta is currently in a mental asylum.
entries.value: 根據{boss} Selta 的說法，它們是 {0}V 電池，能提供約 {1}mA 的電流。{boss2} Selta 目前住在精神病院。

entries.key: Activate Glyphs to imbue them with a Warding Spell.
entries.value: §7啟動§5符文§7來為其注入§9防護法術§7。

entries.key: Activates all perks of another mayor every {0} Skyblock Days ({1} hours).
entries.value: 每 {0} 個 SkyBlock 日（{1} 小時）啟動另一位市長的所有天賦。

entries.key: Add some flair to your island with custom floating text!
entries.value: 用自訂浮空文字為你的島嶼增添風采！

entries.key: Added to Resistance potions.
entries.value: 加入抗性藥水中。

entries.key: Adds particles matching your + color to your pet and yourself, defaulting to red. Editable in Hypixel lobbies.
entries.value: §7為你的寵物和你自己加上與你§f + §7號顏色相符的粒子，預設為紅色。§8可在 Hypixel 大廳中編輯。

entries.key: Adds {0} Absorption {#} to potions with that stat.
entries.value: §7為具有該數值的藥水增加 {0}§6 吸收 {#}§7。

entries.key: Adds {0} Chums dropped on Sea Creatures fished with this bait.
entries.value: §7用此魚餌釣起的海怪會額外掉落 {0}§a 個魚餌碎屑§7。

entries.key: Adds {0} Level to your {enchantment}, {enchantment2}, and {enchantment3} enchantments.
entries.value: §7使你的{enchantment}§7、{enchantment2}§7與{enchantment3} §7附魔§d等級§7提升 {0}§7。

entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：不要訂閱 Technoblade。他是個危險人物。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: Due to safety concerns, dungeons have been outlawed, effective immediately. {roman} have your security in mind.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：基於安全考量，地下城即日起禁止進入。我是為了你們的安全著想。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: FREEDOM
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：自由

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: GOONS ASSEMBLE!!!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：手下們，集合！！！

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: GOONS, PUNISH THEM ALL!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：手下們，懲罰他們所有人！

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: HOW DID YOU GATHER THAT MUCH POWER?
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：你們怎麼聚集到那麼多力量的？

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: IT'S DOOM O'CLOCK
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：末日時刻到了

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: Island Transportation has been outlawed. Nowhere is safer than home.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：島嶼交通已被禁止。沒有地方比家裡更安全。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: JUSTICE
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：正義

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: LET THE DEATH MATCH BEGIN.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：死亡之戰開始吧。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: Leaders of the Resistance, meet me in the COMMUNITY CENTER - it's time we settle this.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：反抗軍的領袖們，到社區中心來見我——是時候做個了斷了。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: MY SKIN IS TOUGHER THAN A THOUSAND ARMORS
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我的皮膚比一千副盔甲還堅硬

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: MY SPEECH IS LAW
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我的話語就是法律

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: MY VOICE IS THUNDER
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我的聲音就是雷霆

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: Mining Islands have now been outlawed, effective immediately. We will be considering outlawing Mining in general too, but that's for another time. It's just too dangerous.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：挖礦島嶼即日起禁止進入。我們也會考慮全面禁止挖礦，不過那是之後的事了。實在太危險了。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: NO MORE AUCTIONS
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：不再有拍賣

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: NO MORE BANK
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：不再有銀行

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: ORDER
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：秩序

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: ORDER. SECURITY AND FREEDOM
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：秩序。安全與自由

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: PEACE IS TAKEN BY FORCE
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：和平是靠武力奪來的

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: PEACE ISN'T EARNED
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：和平不是贏來的

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: Pets have now been outlawed effective immediately. They were too distracting which is too dangerous to players.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：寵物即日起禁止。牠們太讓人分心了，這對玩家來說太危險。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: SECURITY
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：安全

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: STARTING WITH THE COMMUNITY CENTER
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：就從社區中心開始

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: THE COLOSSEUM WILL BE NO MORE
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：競技場將不復存在

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: THE SAVIOR OF THE WORLD
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：世界的救世主

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: THE WORLD WILL END
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：世界將會毀滅

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: THIS IS HOW AN ERA ENDS
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：一個時代就是這樣結束的

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: TIME TO REPENT
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：該懺悔了

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: The resistance ends now!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：反抗到此為止！

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: These Goons are utterly useless.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：這些手下根本毫無用處。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: They also won't stop sniffing the goons...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：而且牠們一直去聞那些手下……

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: Until further notice, we have ended our alliance with the sketchy Dwarves and will be preventing players from going to their mines.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：在另行通知之前，我們已經終止與那些可疑矮人的同盟，並將阻止玩家前往他們的礦坑。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: VALUES
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：價值

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: WATCH
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：看著

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: WORTHLESS
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：毫無價值

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: YOU HAD A CHOICE AND YOU CHOSE DEATH
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：你們有過選擇，而你們選擇了死亡

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: YOU VOTED FOR ME MY SWEET CHILDS
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：你們投給了我，我親愛的孩子們

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: You and your Generals have no chance against me, {roman} am no mere mortal.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：你和你的將軍們根本不是我的對手，我可不是普通的凡人。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {area} and Bazzar have now been outlawed. It is too dangerous to spend money in this day and age.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：{area}和市集現已被禁止。在這個時代花錢太危險了。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} AM BUILT DIFFERENT
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我與眾不同

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} AM DANTE
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我是 DANTE

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} AM DANTE AND THE WORLD QUAKES BENEATH ME
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我是 DANTE，世界在我腳下顫抖

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} AM DEFEATED
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我被打敗了

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} AM STRENGTH
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我就是力量

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} WILL NOW TAKE DOWN THIS USELESS WIZARD TOWER
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我現在要摧毀這座沒用的巫師塔

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} WILL TRANSFORM YOUR VILLAGE INTO DUST
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我要把你們的村莊化為塵土

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} am hearing rumblings of a resistance led by Technoblade. Anyone found to be assisting this futile attempt will be CRUSHED.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我聽說有一支由 Technoblade 領導的反抗軍正在醞釀。任何被發現協助這種徒勞嘗試的人都將被粉碎。

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} gave this world a chance at redemption, and this is all {roman2} get?
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我給了這個世界一個救贖的機會，結果我就只得到這個？

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman} see you have come to me with evil intentions, Technoblade!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我看你是懷著惡意來找我的，Technoblade！

entries.key: [BOSS] Dante: {roman}'{roman2} NOT DONE
entries.value: §c[BOSS] Dante§f：我還沒完

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Awakening me from my slumber, what a strange choice.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：把我從沉睡中喚醒，真是個奇怪的選擇。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Did you forget? {roman} am invincible!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：你們忘了嗎？我是無敵的！

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Does that mean {boss} is no more? {roman} have been a mediocre master.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：這是說{boss}§c已經不在了嗎？我真是個平庸的主人。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Futile.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：徒勞無功。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: In a way {roman} should thank you, {roman2} lost all hopes centuries ago that it would ever end.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：某種程度上我該謝謝你們，幾個世紀前我就已經放棄了它會有終結的希望。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Incredible. You did what {roman} couldn't do myself.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：不可思議。你們做到了我自己做不到的事。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Let's enjoy your final moments in silence.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：讓我們在沉默中享受你們最後的時刻吧。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Mortals fighting against supreme beings, what a moving spectacle.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：凡人對抗至高的存在，多麼動人的景象。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: My enemies are now my strongest allies!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我的敵人如今成了我最強大的盟友！

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: My soul is disposable.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我的靈魂是可以拋棄的。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: My strengths are depleting, this… this is it…
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我的力量正在耗盡，這……這就是終點了……

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Now {roman} will truly have peace.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：現在我終於能真正安息了。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Oh, this one hurts!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：喔，這下可真痛！

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Ohh?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：喔？

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: So long champions of this mad world!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：再會了，這個瘋狂世界的勇士們！

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Some of you do have some talent, {roman} can feel it, the other ones not so much.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：你們之中有些人確實有點天分，我感覺得到，其他人就沒那麼有了。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Thank you for coming all the way here.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：謝謝你們大老遠來到這裡。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: This world isn’t worth fighting for, how can you be so determined?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：這個世界不值得為之奮戰，你們怎麼能如此堅決？

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: We will decide it all, here, now.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我們將在此時此地決定一切。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: You are wasting your time.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：你們在浪費時間。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: You don't have your sword this time!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：這次你們可沒有劍了！

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: You just made a terrible mistake!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：你們剛剛犯了一個可怕的錯誤！

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: You... again?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：你……又來了？

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: Your skills have faded, humans.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：你們的技術退步了，人類。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: {boss} was my favorite sparring partner, you must have enjoyed fighting him!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：{boss}§c是我最喜歡的練習對手，你們跟他交手一定很享受吧！

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: {roman} am not impressed.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我不覺得有什麼了不起。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: {roman} enjoy your passion, if the circumstances had been different, we could have been friends.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我欣賞你們的熱情，如果情況不同，我們也許能成為朋友。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: {roman} have more of those.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我還有更多。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: {roman} have nothing left to fight for, {roman2} finally had peace.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我已經沒有什麼好爭的了，我終於得到了安寧。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: {roman} have worked on this spell for centuries.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我研究這個法術已經好幾個世紀了。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: {roman} hope you’ll become the Heroes {roman2} could never be.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：希望你們能成為我永遠成為不了的英雄。

entries.key: [BOSS] The Wither {npc}: {roman} no longer wish to fight, but {roman2} know that will not stop you.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] The Wither {npc}§c：我已經不想再戰鬥了，但我知道那阻止不了你們。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: ...
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: ARGH!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：啊啊！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: ARISE, MY CREATIONS!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：起來吧，我的造物！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Adventurers! Be careful of who you are messing with...
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：冒險者們！小心你們在招惹的是誰……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: All my Golems want is some peace and quiet! Can you not, {player}?!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的魔像只想要一點安寧！你就不能放過它們嗎，{player}？！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: All this, for nothing...
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：這一切，都白費了……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: All those memories will be lost in time, like tears in rain...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：所有的回憶都將消逝在時光中，就像雨中的淚水……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: All {roman} have are positive thoughts.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我腦中只有正面的想法。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Alright, maybe {roman}'m just weak after all..
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：好吧，也許我終究只是很弱……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Another flawless Giga Heal. You are making this too easy for me!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：又一次完美的巨量治療。你們讓我贏得太輕鬆了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: At least my son died by your hands.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：至少我的兒子是死在你們手上。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
[BOSS] {boss}: Back off!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：退後！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Bahahaha! Not a single intact pillar remains!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：哇哈哈哈！一根完好的柱子都不剩了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Before {roman} have to deal with you myself.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：免得我得親自對付你們。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Boulders, lasers, stomping, and giant swords! Oh my!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：巨石、雷射、踐踏，還有巨劍！天啊！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: But don't worry {roman}'ll add you to my collection.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：不過別擔心，我會把你加進我的收藏。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: But my masters are a lot stronger..
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：但我的主人們強多了……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: But you have nowhere to hide anymore!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：但你們已經無處可躲了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: CLOSER!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：再靠近一點！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Can you at least enjoy my science, pushing the boundaries of Necromancy!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：至少欣賞一下我的科學吧，這可是在突破死靈術的極限！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Can you hear the crowd?! The sound of death!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們聽到觀眾的聲音了嗎？！那是死亡的聲音！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Can't you see that there is no winning? This room will be your tomb.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們看不出來根本不可能贏嗎？這個房間將是你們的墳墓。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Cheater!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：作弊！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Check mate.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：將軍。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Closer to me!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：靠近我！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Come Closer!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：過來！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Congratulations humans, you may pass.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：恭喜你們，人類，你們可以通過了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Corpses are deficient, full of weaknesses. Statues are stronger, faster, and easier to repair.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：屍體有缺陷，滿是弱點。雕像更強、更快，也更容易修復。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Cringe.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：尷尬。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: DON'T DISAPPOINT ME, {roman} HAVEN'T HAD A GOOD FIGHT IN A WHILE.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：別讓我失望，我已經好一陣子沒打過一場好架了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Dance for me humans! Your Art will be remembered!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：為我跳舞吧，人類！你們的藝術將被銘記！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Dance! Dance with my {pet} animals! And may you perish in a delightful way!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：跳吧！跟我的{pet}動物們一起跳舞！願你們死得賞心悅目！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Did you forget? {roman} was taught by the best! Let's dance.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你忘了嗎？我可是名師出高徒！來跳支舞吧。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Do you really think we won’t repair everything? Your impact will be minuscule!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們真以為我們不會修好一切？你們造成的影響微不足道！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Do you want a balloon?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你要氣球嗎？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Dodge this!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：閃開這招！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Don't boast about beating this simple minded Wither.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：別因為打敗了這隻頭腦簡單的凋零就得意。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Don't get too excited though.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：不過別高興得太早。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Don't think you can hide from me {player}
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：別以為你能躲得過我，{player}

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Don't waste your energy on me, humans - {roman} am {boss2} the {pet}!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：人類，別在我身上浪費力氣——我是{pet}{boss2}！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Down to {0} Giant!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：只剩 {0} 個巨人了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: ENERGY HEED MY CALL!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：能量啊，聽從我的召喚！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: ENOUGH!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：夠了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Eat Wither Skulls, scum!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：吃凋零頭顱吧，人渣！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Even if you took my barrier down, {roman} can still fight.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：就算你們打破了我的屏障，我還是能戰鬥。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: FATHER, FORGIVE ME!!!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：父親，原諒我！！！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: FINALLY! This took way too long.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：終於！這花了太久了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Fight for your life!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：為你的性命而戰吧！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Fight my Undeads instead.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：去打我的不死軍團吧。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Finally, {roman} heard so much about you. The Eye likes you very much.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：終於見面了，我聽過很多關於你的事。那隻眼睛非常喜歡你。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Fine then! {roman}'ll take you myself!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：好吧！那我親自收拾你！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Fool, {roman}'d hide under something next time if {roman2} were you!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：蠢貨，換作是我，下次就會躲在什麼東西底下！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Give me {0} sec..
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：給我 {0} 秒……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Give up Adventurers, it only takes me a few seconds to revive my guardians.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：放棄吧，冒險者們，我只要幾秒就能復活我的守護者。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Go my Spirits, go! Unsullied souls!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：去吧，我的靈魂們，去吧！純潔的靈魂！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Goodbye.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：永別了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Gratz for making it this far, but {roman}’m basically unbeatable.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：恭喜你走到這一步，不過我基本上是無敵的。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: HASTA LA VISTA, BABY!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：後會無期，寶貝！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Hacker!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：外掛！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Here! Catch!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：來！接著！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Here's a curveball for you!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：送你一記變化球！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: His technique.. is too advanced..
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：他的技術……太高深了……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Hoho, looks like you killed me!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：吼吼，看來你殺了我！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: How about you taste some rapid fire Wither Skulls!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：嚐嚐快速連發的凋零頭顱吧！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: How could you... {roman} needed more power...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們怎麼可能……我需要更多力量……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: How did that {pet} wake up? Carelessness from you adventurers, no doubt.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：那個{pet}怎麼醒了？毫無疑問，是你們這些冒險者太粗心了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: How do you like the taste of {collections_res}?
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：{collections_res}的滋味如何？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: How many more of my Golems will you disturb, {player}?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你還要打擾我多少個魔像，{player}？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: How many players does it take to kill a Giant?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：要幾個玩家才能殺掉一個巨人？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: How one dies shows how one lived. And it was your masterpiece.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：一個人怎麼死，就說明了他怎麼活。而這是你們的傑作。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: IF YOU WANT TO STAY COOL, DON'T LOOK!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：想保持冷靜的話，就別看！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: If only you had become my disciples instead of this incompetent bunch.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：要是你們當初成為我的門徒，而不是這群無能的傢伙就好了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: If you can beat my Undeads, {roman}'ll personally grant you the privilege to replace them.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：如果你們能打敗我的不死軍團，我就親自賜予你們取代他們的榮幸。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: In a way, you'll live forever...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：某種意義上，你會永遠活下去……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Interesting strategy, waking up my Golems. Or was that unintentional, {player}?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：喚醒我的魔像，真是有趣的策略。還是說那是不小心的，{player}？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: It hurts...what a delicate feeling...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：好痛……多麼細膩的感覺……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: It was inevitable. You are fighting forces beyond your imagination.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：這是必然的。你們在對抗的是超乎你們想像的力量。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: It's about time we see what my Giants can do...
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：是時候看看我的巨人們有什麼能耐了……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Jump and laugh, scream and cry! Be passionate!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：跳吧笑吧，尖叫吧哭泣吧！拿出熱情來！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Just who do you think {roman} am!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你以為我是誰！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Just you wait...
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你就等著瞧吧……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Lame.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：遜。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Leave me alone!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：別煩我！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Little ants, plotting and scheming, thinking they are invincible…
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：小螞蟻們，策劃著、密謀著，以為自己無敵……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: MY MINIONS WILL HAVE TO WIPE THE FLOOR AFTER {roman}'{roman2} DONE WITH YOU ALL!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：等我收拾完你們，我的手下得來擦地板了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Maybe in another life. Until then, meet my ultimate corpse.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：也許在另一個人生吧。在那之前，見識一下我的終極屍體。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: More Spirits! Born of feathers and light!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：更多的靈魂！由羽毛與光芒所生！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My Arena is the most entertaining place in all the Catacombs!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的競技場是整個地下陵墓裡最有娛樂性的地方！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My Guardians!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的守護者們！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My Guardians! Show them your power!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的守護者們！讓他們見識你們的力量！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My abilities are unparalleled, in many ways {roman} am the last bastion.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我的能力無人能及，在很多方面，我都是最後的堡壘。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My barrier is weakening, but it still holds strong!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的屏障正在減弱，但依然牢固！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My barrier will hold as long as my Guardians are alive.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：只要我的守護者還活著，我的屏障就會一直存在。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My energy, it goes away...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的能量，正在流失……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My first time using them, extremely interesting!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我第一次使用它們，非常有趣！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My giants! Unleashed!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的巨人們！解放吧！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My master and {roman} spent centuries building this factory...and this army.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我和我的主人花了幾個世紀建造這座工廠……還有這支軍隊。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My most talented student...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我最有天分的學生……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My technique is much more advanced than {boss2}'s..
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的技術比{boss2}的高深多了……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My {mob} Army is using some of the finest souls - old warriors and wizards!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的{mob}軍團用的都是最優秀的靈魂——古老的戰士和巫師！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: My {mob} Army wasn't enough? You had to awaken a {pet} on top, {player}?!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的{mob}軍團還不夠嗎？你還得再喚醒一個{pet}，{player}？！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: NOOOOOOOOO!!! THIS IS IMPOSSIBLE!!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：不～～～～！！！這不可能！！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Necro no Jutsu!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：死靈之術！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: No adventurer can see what lays beyond this floor.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：沒有任何冒險者能看到這層樓之後的東西。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: No more adventurers, no more heroes, death and thunder!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：不再有冒險者，不再有英雄，只有死亡與雷霆！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: No more hiding!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：別再躲了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: No one matches me in close quarters.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：近身戰沒有人比得過我。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Not fair!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：不公平！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Not just your land, but every kingdom will soon be ruled by our army of undead!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：不只是你們的土地，每個王國很快都會被我們的不死大軍統治！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Not just your {area}, but the whole world will end!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：不只是你們的{area}，整個世界都將毀滅！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Now that you have fallen, my student has been avenged.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：既然你們已經倒下，我的學生也算報仇了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Now that you're a {mob}, can you help me clean up?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：既然你現在是{mob}了，能幫我打掃一下嗎？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: OUCH!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：好痛！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Oh my shadows! Perfect in every way!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：喔，我的影子們！每個方面都完美無缺！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Oh {roman}'m dead!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：喔，我死了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Oh? You found my Guardians' one weakness?
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：喔？你們發現了我守護者唯一的弱點？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Oof
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：唉唷

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Ouch, that hurt!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：好痛，那很痛耶！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Pathetic {boss2}, just like expected.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：可悲的{boss2}§c，跟預期的一樣。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Perfect offense and defense, {roman} am INVINCIBLE!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：完美的攻擊與防禦，我是無敵的！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Picking a fight with me and my experiments will only lead to your demise!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：跟我和我的實驗作對，只會讓你們走向滅亡！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Punishment served, nothing survives my reach.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：懲罰完畢，在我的攻擊範圍內沒有任何東西能存活。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Reckless humans! You should know by now my Golems do not want to be awoken, {player}!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：魯莽的人類！你們現在應該知道我的魔像不想被吵醒，{player}！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Rejoice, your last moments are with me and my lightning.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：歡呼吧，你們的最後時刻將與我和我的閃電共度。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Rest in peace.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：安息吧。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Round and round, another wound.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：轉呀轉，又一道傷。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Rumor has it those are dead Precursors, legendary civilization.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：傳聞那些是已逝的先驅者，一個傳奇的文明。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Run, run, run, RUN!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：跑，跑，跑，快跑！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Show me how you beat {boss2}!!!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：讓我看看你是怎麼打敗{boss2}的！！！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Sike!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：騙你的！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Slowing me down only prolongs your pain!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：拖慢我只會延長你們的痛苦！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Slowing me down will be your greatest accomplishment!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：拖慢我的速度將是你們最大的成就！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: So much effort, for what? You should have joined us instead, {boss2} will cure this world!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：費了這麼多力氣，為了什麼？你們應該加入我們才對，{boss2}將會治癒這個世界！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: So you made it all the way here... Now you wish to defy me? {boss2}?!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：所以你們一路來到了這裡……現在想要挑戰我？{boss2}？！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Sometimes when you have a problem, you just need to destroy it all and start again.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：有時候遇到問題，你只需要把一切都毀掉，然後重新開始。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Soon {roman}'ll be shooting your skull!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：很快我就會射穿你的頭骨！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Stop touching those terminals!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：別碰那些終端機！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Stop.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：住手。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Stronger than my subjects and more loyal...{roman} am invincible...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：比我的臣民更強，也更忠誠……我是無敵的……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: THAT BEAM! IT HURTS! IT HURTS!!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：那道光束！好痛！好痛！！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: THAT WAS ONLY IN MY WAY!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：那只是擋了我的路而已！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: THUNDER LET ME BE YOUR CATALYST!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：雷霆啊，讓我成為你的媒介！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Terrible...terrible...,
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：糟透了……糟透了……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Thanks to {player}, all of my Golems have been awoken! Quite the feat!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：多虧了{player}，我所有的魔像都被喚醒了！真是了不起的成就！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: That Giant was weak! {roman} clearly screwed up during the necromancy process.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：那個巨人太弱了！我在死靈術的過程中顯然搞砸了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: That is enough, fool!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：夠了，蠢貨！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: That was nothing my Priest can't heal!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：那點傷我的牧師治得好！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: That's a very impressive trick. {roman} guess {roman2}'ll have to handle this myself.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：真是令人印象深刻的把戲。看來我得親自處理了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: The Age of Men is over, we are creating tens, hundreds of withers!!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：人類的時代結束了，我們正在製造數十、數百隻凋零！！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: The audacity! {roman} have been the ruler of these floors for a hundred years!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：好大的膽子！我統治這幾層樓已經一百年了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: The days are numbered until {roman} am finally unleashed again on the world!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我終於再度降臨這個世界的日子不遠了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: The last few who tried fighting me are now in those {area}.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：最後幾個試圖挑戰我的人，現在都在那些{area}裡。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: The memory of your death will be your fondest, focus up!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們的死將是你們最美好的回憶，打起精神來！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: The power of lightning is quite phenomenal. A single strike can vaporize a person whole.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：閃電的力量相當驚人。一擊就能把一個人整個蒸發。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: The process is irreversible, but {roman}'ll be stronger than a Wither now!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：這個過程無法逆轉，但現在我會比凋零還強！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: There is no stopping me down there!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：在下面沒有什麼能阻止我！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: These Guardians aren't just for show {roman}'m afraid!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：恐怕這些守護者可不只是擺好看的！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: These wounds are nothing for my Giga Heal!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：這點傷對我的巨量治療來說根本不算什麼！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: This factory is too small for me!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：這座工廠對我來說太小了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: This is it...where shall {roman} go now?
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：就這樣了……我現在該去哪裡呢？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: This is what peak Necromancy looks like!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：這就是死靈術的巔峰！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: This is where the journey ends for you, Adventurers.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：冒險者們，你們的旅程就到此為止了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: This should be interesting.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：這應該會很有趣。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: This time {roman}'ll be your opponent!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：這次由我來當你們的對手！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Those Golems will be your undoing, {player}!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：那些魔像會讓你們自取滅亡，{player}！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Those toys are not strong enough {roman} see.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我看那些玩具還不夠強。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Tickle tickle, you are in a pickle!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：搔搔癢，你們要遭殃！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Time for me to blast you away for good!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：是時候把你們徹底轟飛了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Today you'll be our spectacle.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：今天你們就是我們的表演。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Trying to damage me like that...desperate...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：想那樣傷害我……真是絕望……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Two Guardians, impressive...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：兩位守護者，真了不起……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Uh oh! Half of my Giant creations have bit the dust! Whatever will {roman} do?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：糟了！我的巨人造物有一半都倒下了！我該怎麼辦才好？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: WELL WELL WELL LOOK WHO'S HERE!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：哎呀哎呀，看看誰來了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: WITNESS MY RAW NUCLEAR POWER!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：見識我純粹的核能吧！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Wait..
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：等等……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Weeeeeeeee
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：咻～～～～～

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Welcome Adventurers! {roman} am {boss2}, the {pet}! And host of the Vegan Trials!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：歡迎，冒險者們！我是{pet}{boss2}！也是素食者試煉的主持人！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Well fought humans, no longer you will disrupt the silence of the Catacombs.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：打得好，人類，你們再也不能打擾地下陵墓的寂靜了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: What do you think you are doing there!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們以為你們在那裡做什麼！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chicken!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你會變成什麼靈魂呢？對了！一隻雞！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A chihuahua!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你會變成什麼靈魂呢？對了！一隻吉娃娃！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A rabbit!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你會變成什麼靈魂呢？對了！一隻兔子！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: What spirit shall you become? Yes! A sheep!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你會變成什麼靈魂呢？對了！一隻羊！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: What?! My {pet} power is unbeatable!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：什麼？！我的{pet}之力是無敵的！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: What?! Nobody has managed to take three of my Guardians down before!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：什麼？！從來沒有人能打倒我三位守護者！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Whatever...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：隨便啦……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Where is my Priest!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的牧師在哪！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Which one is your favorite? Those laser eyes...beautiful!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你最喜歡哪一個？那雙雷射眼……真美！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Who dares trespass into my domain?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：是誰膽敢闖進我的領域？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Whoops! There goes my third Giant!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：糟糕！我的第三個巨人也倒了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Why are you running?
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你幹嘛跑？

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Wither Ultra!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：凋零終極技！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Wonderful performance humans, truly beautiful.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：精彩的表演，人類，真是美極了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Wonderous! Not one sleeping {pet} was left unperturbed by you reckless humans! Thanks, {player}!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：太神奇了！你們這些魯莽的人類沒讓任何一個沉睡的{pet}安穩！謝啦，{player}！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Wow, one Giant down already? You guys are good!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：哇，已經倒了一個巨人？你們真行！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: YOU ARE FACE TO FACE WITH GOLDOR!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們正面對的是 GOLDOR！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: YOU TRICKED ME!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們騙了我！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: YOUR MOBILITY TRICKS DON'T WORK IN MY DOMAIN!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們的移動把戲在我的領域裡沒用！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: YOUR WEAPONS CAN'T PIERCE THROUGH MY SHIELD!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們的武器刺不穿我的護盾！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: Yare yare daze...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：真是的……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You are breaking precious materials, unforgivable.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們在破壞珍貴的材料，不可原諒。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You can't damage me, you can barely slow me down!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們傷不了我，頂多讓我慢下來而已！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You did it. {roman} understand now, you have earned my respect.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們做到了。我明白了，你們贏得了我的尊重。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You fell victim to one of the classic blunders!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們中了最經典的圈套！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You fools!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們這些笨蛋！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You have done it, you destroyed the factory…
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你們做到了，你們摧毀了工廠……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You killed my weakest Giant!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們殺了我最弱的巨人！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You merely adopted the Catacombs! {roman} was molded by them!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你只是接受了地下陵墓！而我是被它塑造出來的！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You thought {roman}'d fall for the same tricks as those before me? Not today!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們以為我會中跟前人一樣的把戲？今天不會！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You took one of them down, but that won't be enough!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你打倒了其中一個，但那還不夠！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You went further than any human before, congratulations.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：你走得比之前任何人類都遠，恭喜你。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You weren't supposed to wake up that {pet}, {player}!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你不該喚醒那個{pet}的，{player}！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You will be humbled, reckless humans!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們會被挫挫銳氣的，魯莽的人類！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You'd make a great {mob} minion!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你會是個很棒的{mob}手下！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You'll never beat my teacher..
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：你永遠打不贏我的老師……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You're not funny.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你一點都不好笑。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: You've managed to kill a Giant! Good luck with the rest of them!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：你們成功殺了一個巨人！祝你們對付其他巨人時好運！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {0} of my Giants down?! No matter, these last two are tough!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我的巨人倒了 {0} 個？！沒關係，最後這兩個很難纏！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {boss2}, forgive me.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：{boss2}§c，原諒我。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {island} made you stronger, but can you beat me?!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：{island}讓你變得更強，但你打得贏我嗎？！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {island}... are no more.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：{island}……已經不復存在了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} - {boss2} - was destined to rule over Mankind! Dead or Alive!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我——{boss2}——注定要統治人類！不論生死！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} HOPE YOU LIKE EXPLOSIONS TOO!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：希望你們也喜歡爆炸！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} always knew {roman2} would win...{roman3}'m a genius.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我就知道我會贏……我是天才。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} am the bridge between this realm and the world below! You shall not pass!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我是這個領域與下方世界之間的橋樑！你們休想通過！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} am the death zone, you are smart to flee.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我就是死亡地帶，你們逃跑是明智的。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} can do this all day.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我可以奉陪一整天。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} can revive myself and become much stronger!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我可以復活自己，然後變得更強！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} can summon lots of undead! Check this out.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我可以召喚一大堆不死生物！看好了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} can't believe {boss2} lost to someone so weak!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我真不敢相信{boss2}會輸給這麼弱的人！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} can't let my Master hear about this.. he'll kill m-
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我不能讓我的主人聽到這件事……他會殺了我——

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} don't even need to fight, this is the life!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我根本不需要戰鬥，這才叫生活！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} ensure you, these blades are far sharper than {boss2}'s ever were.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我向你保證，這些刀刃比{boss2}的鋒利多了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} feel...dizzy...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我覺得……頭好暈……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} give you an F-!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我給你們 F-！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} love your fighting spirit, but {roman2} am immune to your tricks!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我很欣賞你們的鬥志，但你們的把戲對我無效！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} see. You have forced me to use my ultimate technique.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：原來如此。你們逼我使出了我的終極技術。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} should have known that {roman2} stood no chance.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我早該知道我毫無勝算。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} understand your words now, my master.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我現在明白您的話了，我的主人。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} was burdened with terrible news recently...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我最近聽到了一個可怕的消息……

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} won't allow you to destroy it all now.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我不會讓你現在把它全部摧毀。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman} won’t let you break the factory core, {roman2} gave my life to my Master.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我不會讓你們破壞工廠核心，我把生命獻給了我的主人。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'LL MAKE YOU REMEMBER MY DEATH!!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我會讓你們永遠記得我的死！！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'VE BEEN TOLD {roman2} COULD HAVE A BIT OF FUN WITH YOU.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：有人告訴我可以跟你們玩一玩。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'d be happy to show you what that's like!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我很樂意讓你們體驗一下那是什麼感覺！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'ll send you to the Wither Realm!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我要把你送進凋零領域！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'ll show you real power!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我讓你見識真正的力量！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'m afraid {roman2} can quickly revive any one of my Guardians!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：恐怕我能很快復活我的任何一位守護者！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'m afraid, your journey ends now.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：恐怕你的旅程到此為止了。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'m already dead adventurer! Earthly weapons won't affect me!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：冒險者，我早就死了！凡間的武器傷不了我！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'m going to be the Wither {npc}!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {boss}§f：我要成為凋零{npc}！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'m growing tired of this folly. My Giants are restless.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我已經厭倦這場鬧劇了。我的巨人們躁動不安。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'m sorry but {roman2} need to concentrate. {roman3} wish it didn't have to come to this.
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：抱歉，但我需要專心。真希望事情不必走到這一步。

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'m starting to sweat!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我開始冒汗了！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'ve never seen such carelessness in my years as a Necromancer! So little regard for my Golems, and even less regard for your own lives! Blame {player}!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§f：我當死靈法師這麼多年，從沒見過這麼粗心的人！一點都不顧我的魔像，更不顧你們自己的性命！都怪{player}！

entries.key: [BOSS] {boss}: {roman}'{roman2} TOO YOUNG TO DIE AGAIN!
entries.value: §4[BOSS] {boss}§c：我還太年輕，不能再死一次！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: A befitting welcome!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：真是合適的歡迎！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: A rough fight!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：真是場硬仗！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: Ahhhh...A calling...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：啊……一聲呼喚……

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: Arise my children!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：起來吧，我的孩子們！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: For me...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：是給我的……

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: Freah meat, raw and juicy.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：新鮮的肉，生的又多汁。

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: GaHahahahAAHAa, you are so annoying, you're not the only one with a trick up their sleeves!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：嘎哈哈哈啊啊哈啊，你真煩人，可不是只有你才藏著一手！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: Hahahahaha, YOU MORTAL FOOL! You dare to summon me at my full strength to this plane, you are seeking death. With this power, {roman} will not let a weakling survive here, this land will be a brilliant place to start a new invasion of my empire. Tremble beneath me if you wish to survive!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：哈哈哈哈哈，你這愚蠢的凡人！你竟敢把全盛時期的我召喚到這個位面，你這是在找死。有了這股力量，我不會讓任何弱者在這裡存活，這片土地將是我帝國展開新一輪入侵的絕佳起點。想活命的話，就在我腳下顫抖吧！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: How can this be...what a humiliation. This isn't end. You will learn how resourceful spiders are.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：怎麼會這樣……真是奇恥大辱。這還沒結束。你會見識到蜘蛛有多足智多謀。

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: If {roman} can't take over this land, then {roman2} don't have {0} Legs!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：如果我不能佔領這片土地，那我就不是有 {0} 條腿！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: No, this is impossible...
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：不，這不可能……

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: No, this is impossible... {roman} will be back, even stronger!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：不，這不可能……我會回來的，而且會更強！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: Spiders in my Den, can you count to ten?
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：我巢中的蜘蛛，你數得到十嗎？

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: That smell...human flesh...and blood.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：那股味道……人類的血肉……還有鮮血。

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: That's enough of this if {0} isn't enough, {roman} will swarm you with {1}!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：夠了，如果 {0} 隻不夠，我就用 {1} 隻淹沒你！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: This is getting interesting now, LETS SEE IF YOU CAN HANDLE MORE POWER!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：現在變得有趣了，讓我們看看你能不能承受更多力量！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: You dare call me, the queen of the dark, to accept you. {roman}'ll accept no excuses, you shall die!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：你竟敢召喚我，黑暗女王，來接納你。我不接受任何藉口，你必須死！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: You will be squashed like the WEAK BUG you are!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：你會像隻弱小的蟲子一樣被踩扁！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: {roman} have to stretch my legs.
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：我得伸展一下我的腿。

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: {roman} will be back, even stronger!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：我會回來的，而且會更強！

entries.key: [BOSS] {mob}: {roman}'ll give you a small taste of the swarms that will come to this world, HahAhaHA!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {mob}§f：我讓你先嚐嚐將要降臨這個世界的蟲海，哈哈啊哈哈！

entries.key: [BOSS] {pet}: AGGHHHHHHHHHHH!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {pet}§f：啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

entries.key: [BOSS] {pet}: Bah! Come forth my minions! {mob} above, take them out!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {pet}§f：哼！出來吧，我的手下們！上方的{mob}，幹掉他們！

entries.key: [BOSS] {pet}: Grrrr! You won't be able to hit my {item} Bats!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {pet}§f：吼～！你打不中我的{item}蝙蝠的！

entries.key: [BOSS] {pet}: You cannot best me!
entries.value: §c[BOSS] {pet}§f：你贏不了我！

entries.key: [Harp] Earned {0}{stats} from mastering a new Song!
entries.value: §d[豎琴] §f因精通一首新曲子而獲得 {0}{stats}§f！

entries.value: §d[豎琴] §a演奏完成！

entries.key: [NPC]  {npc}: If you haven't already, be sure to give your other Gifts away to others. Giving Gifts benefits both you and the receiver!
entries.value: §e[NPC]  {npc}§f：如果你還沒這麼做，記得把你其他的禮物送給別人。送禮對你和收禮的人都有好處！

entries.key: [NPC] &{npc}: His memory will soon be lost, like tears in rain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] &{npc}§f：他的記憶很快就會消逝，就像雨中的淚水。

entries.key: [NPC] &{npc}: My old buddy was a Wart Dealer...{roman} miss him, and his Wart.
entries.value: §e[NPC] &{npc}§f：我的老朋友是個疣商人……我好想他，還有他的疣。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: ...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：……

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Although he won't let the average adventurer pass, he might reconsider it if you're strong enough.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：雖然他不會讓普通冒險者通過，但如果你夠強，他也許會重新考慮。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Best of luck.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：祝你好運。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Good luck on your solo adventurers. {roman} look forward to hearing about your triumphs within {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：祝你單人冒險順利。我很期待聽到你在{island}裡的輝煌戰績！

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Have you noticed that it's not possible to enter {island} alone?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：你有沒有注意到，沒辦法一個人進入{island}？

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: If you can do that, {roman}'ll give you my personal recommendation!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：如果你辦得到，我就給你我的個人§6推薦§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Not the mention that {island} is extremenly dangerous to explore alone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：更別提一個人探索{island}§f是§4極度危險§f的。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: So, have you defeated {boss} yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：所以，你打敗{boss}了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Talk to me again when you have done that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：做到之後再來找我談。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Then take this letter to {npc} whenever you feel like entering {island} alone. Make sure that you're not in a party.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：那麼，當你想一個人進入{island}時，就把這封信交給{npc}。確定你不在隊伍裡。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Unfortunately, it seems you haven't yet defeated {boss}! Come back when you have done that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：可惜，看來你還沒打敗{boss}！做到之後再回來吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: Well, for {island}, {roman} reckon that if you have defeated {boss}, he'd probably let you in.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：嗯，以{island}來說，我想如果你打敗了{boss}，他大概就會讓你進去。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: You've already handed in my recommendation letter! You don't need another one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：你已經交出我的§6推薦信§f了！你不需要另一封。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: {npc}'s just really stubborn when it comes to {island}. He's seen so many adventurers get lost down there that he now refuses to let anyone in without a buddy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：{npc}對{island}就是特別固執。他看過太多冒險者在下面迷路，所以現在沒有夥伴的人一律不准進去。

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: {roman} can see that you already have my recommendation letter on you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：我看得出來你身上已經有我的§6推薦信§f了！

entries.key: [NPC] Adventurer Saul: {roman}'ve been thinking recently...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dAdventurer Saul§f：我最近一直在想……

entries.key: [NPC] Agent Kapsutin: Don't tell anyone, it's top secret!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cAgent Kapsutin§f：別告訴任何人，這是最高機密！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: Daddy's the kind of steady you need in a storm. If he was any more laid back, he'd be horizontal. But that's why we never tilt!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：爸爸就是暴風雨中你需要的那種穩重。他要是再放鬆一點，就要躺平了。但這正是我們從不動搖的原因！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: It's cool though, {roman} know they are grinding away without me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：沒關係啦，我知道他們沒有我也在拚命努力！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: It's not about the individual leaps; it's about how we hop together as a team.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：重點不是個人跳多遠，而是我們作為一個團隊怎麼一起跳。

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: It's not just a routine; it's a ritual.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：這不只是例行公事，這是儀式。

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: Legacy isn't just passing on what you've accomplished. It's inspiring the next generation to hop even further. That's what we're doing here every day!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：傳承不只是把你的成就傳下去，而是激勵下一代跳得更遠。這就是我們每天在這裡做的事！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: No bunny gets left behind in productivity! Remember, every hop is a step towards success!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：生產力方面，一隻兔子都不能落後！記住，每一跳都是邁向成功的一步！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: Rabbits, remember, the only time you should ever look back is to see how far you've hopped!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：兔子們，記住，你唯一該回頭看的時候，就是看看自己跳了多遠！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: Sis' spirit is so fiery, {roman} keep a bucket of water handy. Just in case her passion for change sets the place ablaze!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：妹妹的精神太火爆了，我隨時備著一桶水。以防她對改變的熱情把這裡燒起來！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: Sometimes {roman} check if he's still breathing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：有時候我還得確認他是不是還有呼吸！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: The Rabbits don't want me to enter their warren. They say {roman}'m toxic or something.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：兔子們不讓我進他們的兔窩。他們說我很§2有毒§f還什麼的。

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: Visualize the win, then chase it down like it's the last carrot on Earth. You've got this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：想像勝利的畫面，然後像追逐地球上最後一根紅蘿蔔那樣追上它。你做得到的！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: Wake up! It's another glorious day to excel. If you're not moving, you're not improving. Now, hop to it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：起床！又是追求卓越的美好一天。不動就不會進步。現在，給我跳起來！

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: When it comes to keeping calm, Daddy's cooler than a cucumber in a freezer.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：說到保持冷靜，爸爸比冷凍庫裡的小黃瓜還冷靜。

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: {roman} start my mornings with a protein shake, then {roman2} have a mid-morning protein shake, followed by an after-lunch shake, and finish with a pre-bed shake.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：我早上先來一杯高蛋白奶昔，上午中段再一杯，午餐後再一杯，睡前再一杯收尾。

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: {roman} tell {npc} - A dream without a plan is just a wish.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：我跟{npc}說——沒有計畫的夢想只是個願望。

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: {roman} tried showing Granny how to build muscle mass.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：我試著教§a奶奶§f怎麼增肌。

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: {roman}'m not welcome in the warren anymore.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：現在兔窩不歡迎我了。

entries.key: [NPC] Coach Jackrabbit: {roman}'m so jacked it's unreal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dCoach Jackrabbit§f：我壯到不可思議。

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: Careful! These spoons dig more than just soup.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cCorrupt Goon§f：小心！這些湯匙可不只能挖湯。

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: Comrade... need freedom? {roman} sell it by the spoonful. Heh.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cCorrupt Goon§f：同志……需要自由嗎？我按湯匙賣。嘿。

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: Digs fast, rusts even faster.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cCorrupt Goon§f：挖得快，生鏽得更快。

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: If {npc} asks? Well, that's your problem.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cCorrupt Goon§f：如果{npc}問起？嗯，那是你的問題。

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: May you loosen the shackles of the imprisoned, comrade.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cCorrupt Goon§f：願你鬆開囚犯的枷鎖，同志。

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: Officially {roman}'m on patrol. Unofficially {roman2}'ve got cutlery.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cCorrupt Goon§f：官方說法是我在巡邏。非官方說法是我有餐具。

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: Price is high, secrecy is... low.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cCorrupt Goon§f：價格很高，保密程度……很低。

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: Shh! {roman}'m loyal... totally. Now, what size spoon you need?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cCorrupt Goon§f：噓！我很忠誠的……絕對是。那麼，你需要多大的湯匙？

entries.key: [NPC] Corrupt Goon: The right tools for breaking out of prison.

entries.key: [NPC] Croesus: After completed a dungeon run, you get a selection of treasure chests.

entries.key: [NPC] Croesus: Did you know, {roman} used to live in the catacombs before they moved in all the zombies?

entries.key: [NPC] Croesus: If you don't open any, {roman} collect and hoard them for you!

entries.key: [NPC] Croesus: It's always best to keep a handle on things!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Croesus§f：凡事最好都能掌握好！

entries.key: [NPC] Croesus: The Wither {npc} now lives in the deepest floor of the Catacombs, but where is the Wither {mob}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Croesus§f：凋零{npc}現在住在地下陵墓的最深層，但凋零{mob}在哪裡呢？

entries.value: §e[NPC] Croesus§f：我在想他們會不會在這裡開更多的門。

entries.key: [NPC] Curator: The museum is almost complete! Your tireless efforts have brought us to the brink of greatness.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §bCurator§f：博物館快完成了！你不懈的努力讓我們站上了偉大的邊緣。

entries.key: [NPC] Curator: Welcome! The museum is just starting to take shape. Your first few contributions are the seeds of something magnificent!

entries.value: §d[NPC] Dante§f：他們根本沒有領導這片偉大土地所需的掌控力。

entries.key: [NPC] Dr {resource}: Looks like that odd fellow over by the campfire might know a thing or two about getting them...

entries.key: [NPC] Dr {resource}: Sometimes you'll find little treasures, and sometimes you'll find an entire fossil! If you do find a fossil, show it to me!
