entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: Feel free to go on ahead, but don't stray too far into the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：儘管往前走吧，但別在{area}裡走得太遠。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: From what {roman}'ve heard, they go very deep down. The legends speak of some dwarves finding Mineshafts when mining!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：據我所知，那裡非常深。傳說有些矮人在挖礦時發現了§b礦井§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: Go show that to the {npc}, and he'll let you travel to the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：去拿給{npc}§f看，他就會讓你前往{area}§b。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: If {roman} could sneak you in, would you be willing to help?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：如果我能把你§7偷偷帶進去§f，你願意幫忙嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: Potatoes are a dwarf's favorite food. They are like us in many ways, springing to life from the soil under even the harshest conditions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Dulin§f：馬鈴薯是矮人最愛的食物。它們在很多方面都跟我們很像，即使在最嚴苛的環境下也能從土裡冒出生機。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: Thank you. My people will remember your name for eons.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：謝謝你。我的子民將永世銘記你的名字。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: That resolve is what makes us who we are and keeps our flame alight.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Dulin§f：正是這份堅毅造就了我們，讓我們的火焰不滅。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: The team should arrive shortly! They should be here within {0}{1} business days, then we can set out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：隊伍應該很快就到了！他們應該會在 {0}{1}§d 個工作天§f內抵達，然後我們就能出發了！

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: The {npc} will only let you in if you have a {item} to show him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：{npc}只會讓持有{item}的人進去。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: They should be here within {0}{1} business days, then we can set out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：他們應該會在 {0}{1}§d 個工作天§f內抵達，然後我們就能出發了！

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: This doesn't change things between us - you are still needed as a member of the Expedition Team.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Dulin§f：這不會改變我們之間的關係——你仍是遠征隊不可或缺的一員。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: This is all that remains...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：這就是僅存的一切了……

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: Very well. But you and {roman}, our fates are entwined. You'll come back, and {roman2}'ll welcome you with open arms when you do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：好吧。但你和我的命運是緊緊相連的。你會回來的，到時候我會張開雙臂歡迎你。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: We will push beyond the tunnels and retake what is ours, no matter the cost.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Dulin§f：不管付出什麼代價，我們都要突破隧道，奪回屬於我們的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: You can put one together in the Dwarven Forge, if you can get the right materials.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：如果你能湊齊材料，就可以在§6矮人鍛造爐§f製作一張。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: {roman} am Dulin, descendant of {npc} and rightful {npc2} of the {island}. Those imbeciles in the palace took up their positions in my absence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：我是§6Dulin§f，{npc}§f的後裔，也是{island}§f真正的{npc2}§6§f。宮殿裡那些蠢貨趁我不在時篡奪了位子。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: {roman} am glad that {roman2} have your trust, but {roman3} will need you to prove yourself before entering the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：我很高興你信任我，但在進入{area}之前，我需要你先證明自己。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: {roman} am preparing an expedition into the area beyond the {area}, and need some adventurers to scout out the area for me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：我正在籌備一支遠征隊，要前往{area}的另一頭，需要一些冒險者幫我偵察那個區域。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: {roman} have heard of your triumphs in the {island}, and thought we should meet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：我聽說了你在{island}的輝煌戰績，覺得我們應該見個面。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: {roman} suppose this is your very own kingdom in a sense, {player}? Splendid.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Dulin§f：我想某種意義上，這是你自己的王國吧，{player}？好極了。

entries.key: [NPC] Dulin: {roman}'ll see you down there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Dulin§f：我們在下面見！

entries.key: [NPC] Emissary Lissandra: But, if you do, the current "{npc}" has some tasks he would appreciate your help with.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §bEmissary Lissandra§f：但如果你要去，現任的§6「{npc}§6」§f有些任務很需要§a你的幫忙§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Emissary Lissandra: {roman} say {npc}, but ever since Dulin returned, whispers are going around of him being the true king.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §bEmissary Lissandra§f：我說是{npc}§f，但自從§6 Dulin §f回來之後，就有傳言說他才是§6§o真正的§r§f國王。

entries.key: [NPC] Emissary Lissandra: {roman}'d advise against going ahead.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §bEmissary Lissandra§f：我建議你不要繼續往前走。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: And tell Gerald {roman} won't be home for dinner tonight! {roman2}'m tired of him making salmon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：還有告訴§9Gerald§f，我今晚不回家吃晚餐！我受夠他一直做§o鮭魚§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: And that's really how simple Fishing is!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：§a釣魚§f真的就是這麼簡單！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: Are you here to fish?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：你是來§b釣魚§f的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: Don't forget your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：別忘了你的{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: He thinks he's being sneaky, but everyone knows about it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：他以為自己很偷偷摸摸，但大家都知道。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: Hello, darling!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：你好啊，親愛的！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: If you follow the river that flows under the bridge downstream, you'll find your way to it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：順著橋下的河往§b下游§f走，你就能找到它。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: If you follow the river that flows under this bridge downstream, you'll find your way to it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：順著這座橋下的河往§b下游§f走，你就能找到它！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: If you like fishin', you'll love the {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：如果你喜歡釣魚，你一定會愛上{island}！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: Little does he know, {roman} use it too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：他不知道的是，我也在用！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: My favorite kind is {item} because {roman} prefer fishing at night.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：我最喜歡的是{item}，因為我比較喜歡在晚上釣魚。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: Perhaps he is both, perhaps neither.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：也許兩者都是，也許兩者都不是。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: Splendid!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：太好了！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: Take my spare {item} and stand near the water.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：拿著我備用的{item}，站到水邊吧。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: The {island} has all sorts of wild Sea Creatures native to the area.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：{island} §f有各式各樣當地特有的野生§3海洋生物§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: This part of the hub is a popular area for fishing because of the {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：大廳的這一帶因為有{area}，是很熱門的釣魚區域！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: This part of the {island} is a popular area for fishing because of the {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：{island}的這一帶因為有{area}，是很熱門的釣魚區域！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: This rod isn't that special, but it will get the job done for now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：這根釣竿沒什麼特別的，但目前夠用了！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: To fish, cast your rod into the water and wait for a fish to bite!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：要釣魚，就把釣竿拋進水裡，等魚§a上鉤§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: Using Bait is important to get better results!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：使用§6魚餌§f對獲得更好的成果很重要！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: You should go there sometime soon!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：你應該找個時間去一趟！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: {npc} knows a lot more about Bait than {roman} do. {roman2} think he's fishing somewhere along this river if you're interested in learning more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§d：{npc} §f對§6魚餌§f懂得比我多得多。如果你想了解更多，我想他正在這條河的某處釣魚。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: {npc} will be happy to help you on your Fishing journey. Just tell him his wife sent you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：{npc} §f會很樂意在你的§a釣魚§f之旅上幫忙。只要告訴他是他老婆叫你去的就好！

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: {roman} know that {npc} uses {command} instead of looking in his Fishing Skill menu.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：我知道{npc} §f都用{command} §f，而不是去看他的§a釣魚§f技能選單。

entries.key: [NPC] Enid: {roman}'ve heard stories of {mob}, but {roman2}'ve never quite worked out if he's a frog or a man.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Enid§f：我聽過{mob}的故事，但我一直搞不清楚他到底是青蛙還是人。

entries.key: [NPC] Felix: Maybe next time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aFelix§f：也許下次吧。

entries.key: [NPC] Felix: Store items in this chest and access them at any time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Felix§f：把物品存在這個箱子裡，隨時都能取用！

entries.key: [NPC] Felix: Until next time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aFelix§f：下次見！

entries.key: [NPC] Felix: You can access your {item} in your {item2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Felix§f：你可以在你的{item2}裡打開你的{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] Felix: You won't be able to store any items in the {island}, you should keep them on your {island2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aFelix§f：你不能在{island}存放任何物品，應該把它們放在你的{island2}！

entries.key: [NPC] Finance {pet}: Nothing to see here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Finance {pet}§f：這裡沒什麼好看的。

entries.key: [NPC] Finance {pet}: We went to school for this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Finance {pet}§f：我們可是為了這個去上過學的。

entries.key: [NPC] Finance {pet}: We're managing money!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Finance {pet}§f：我們在管理錢！

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: Ah, eager to know, are we?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：啊，很想知道是吧？

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: Ah, where are my manners?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：啊，我真是失禮了。

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: But {roman} must admit, the latter warms my feathers even more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：但我得承認，後者更能溫暖我的羽毛！

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: Check this out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：看看這個！

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: Click to claim your reward!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：點擊領取你的獎勵！

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: Gift enough different players, and you'll earn yourself something extraordinary!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：送禮給足夠多的§d不同§f玩家，你就能贏得一份非凡的獎勵！

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: It's all about spreading the cheer, you see.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：你看，重點就是散播歡樂。

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: Oh, hello there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：喔，你好啊！

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: The more players you gift, the better your reward.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：你送禮的玩家越多，獎勵就越好。

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: Well, you see, this December is special.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：嗯，你看，這個十二月很特別。

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: You look like someone who appreciates the finer points of gifting, am {roman} right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：你看起來像是懂得送禮精髓的人，我說對了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: {roman} live for two things: receiving gifts and gifting others.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：我為兩件事而活：收禮物和送禮物。

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: {roman}'m Generow, the coolest gift-loving penguin you'll ever meet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：我是 Generow，你這輩子會遇到最酷、最愛禮物的企鵝！

entries.key: [NPC] Generow: {roman}'ve come to reward those who share the joy of gifting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Generow§f：我是來獎勵那些分享送禮喜悅的人的！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: A {mob} has been scaring off all the good fish, {roman} need to deal with it before {roman2} lose more fish.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：有隻{mob}一直把好魚嚇跑，我得在失去更多魚之前處理掉牠。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Ah! The {item}! Perfect!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：啊！{item}！太完美了！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: All that's left is to add the {item}, but {roman} tripped and dropped it into the pond here...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：只剩下裝上{item}§f了，但我絆了一跤，把它掉進這裡的§b池塘§f了……

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Bring that to {npc} and he'll be able to help you set sail!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：把那個交給{npc}，他就能幫你出航！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Can you fish up the {item} for me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：你能幫我把{item}釣上來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Do you think you could fish it out for me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：你能幫我把它釣上來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Enid and {roman} are thrilled that our two children love it as much as we do!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：Enid 和我很高興我們的兩個孩子也跟我們一樣熱愛釣魚！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Fishing is the family business.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§a：釣魚是我們的家族事業。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Go talk to the Fish Merchant in the {area}, get geared up, and get fishin'!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：去{area}§f找§e魚商人§f，準備好裝備，然後開始釣魚吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: He saved my skin then, and {roman}'m forever grateful to him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：那時他救了我一命，我會永遠感激他。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: He's behind the {area}, waiting by the Ship.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：他在{area}§f後面，在§6船§f旁邊等著。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Hey there buddy, think you can help me out?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：嘿，朋友，你能幫我個忙嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Hmm, you're not quite ready yet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：嗯，你還沒準備好。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Holy Mackerel! You got me the whole nine yards.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：天啊！你把整套都幫我弄齊了。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: If you find it, bring it to {npc} so you can set sail!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：如果你找到了，就把它交給{npc}，你們就能出航了！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: If you want to learn about Fishing, go talk to my wife, {npc}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：如果你想學§a釣魚§f，就去找我太太{npc}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: It's somewhere in this pond here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：它就在這個§b池塘§f裡的某個地方。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Just leave out the part about me dropping it, would ya?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：只是別提我把它弄掉的那段，好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Keep the noise down, kid!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：小聲點，孩子！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: My buddy, {npc}, and {roman} are just about done building a ship that can set sail to the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：我和我的朋友{npc}快要造好一艘能航向{island}的船了。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Once you fish it out, you can set sail to the {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：等你把它釣上來，就能航向{island}了！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: S'alright, we are all busy some days.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：沒關係，大家總有忙的時候。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Safe travels!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：一路平安！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: She's fishing a bit upstream. Once she's shown you the ropes, come back and talk to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：她在§b上游§f一點的地方釣魚。等她教會你基本功，再回來找我！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: Thanks for helping me find the {item}, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：謝謝你幫我找到{item}，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: You can use the Ship Navigator to set sail to the {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：你可以使用§6船舶導航§f航向{island}§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: {roman} met {npc} when {roman2} was marooned on a distant pirate cove.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：我被困在一座遙遠的§a海盜灣§f時遇見了{npc}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: {roman} prefer the open water. More peaceful, less Ghasts!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：我比較喜歡開闊的水域。比較平靜，也比較少地獄幽靈！

entries.key: [NPC] Gerald: {roman}'ve only gone lava fishing a few times in my life.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Gerald§f：我這輩子只去§c岩漿釣魚§f過幾次。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: A fair society starts with a firm hand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：公平的社會始於鐵腕。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Aren't you happy? Go get your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你不開心嗎？去拿你的{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Between you and me... {npc} always wanted to surpass Dante.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：這話只在你我之間……{npc}一直想超越 Dante。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Bribery? No, no. {npc} calls them 'motivational perks.'
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：賄賂？不，不。{npc}稱之為「激勵性福利」。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Chat responsibly, our ears are everywhere.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：聊天請負責，我們的耳目無所不在。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Dante failed because he underestimated the people. {npc} won't.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：Dante 失敗是因為他低估了人民。{npc}不會。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Dante feared chaos. {npc} just organizes it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：Dante 害怕混亂。{npc}只是把它組織起來。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Dante lost control. {npc} studies control.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：Dante 失去了控制。{npc}研究控制。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Dante tried too hard. {npc} tries smarter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：Dante 太用力了。{npc}更聰明。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Dante would've fought. {npc} simply bows and walks away... gracefully.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：換作 Dante 一定會反抗。{npc}只是優雅地鞠躬離開……

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Did you know {npc} and Dante trained together? She actually learned from his mistakes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你知道{npc}和 Dante 是一起受訓的嗎？她確實從他的錯誤中學到了教訓。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Don't get any funny ideas...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：別打什麼歪主意……

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Don't question the plan, the plan questions you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：別質疑計畫，是計畫在質疑你。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Don't test me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：別挑戰我。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Enjoy your Universal Income. {npc} made that happen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：好好享受你的全民基本收入吧。這是{npc}促成的。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Every tax is a step towards equality!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：每一筆稅都是邁向平等的一步！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Everyone can vote, but {npc} counts the votes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：每個人都能投票，但計票的是{npc}。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Ey! Back off!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：欸！退後！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Fine. Just know those perks could have been yours...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：好吧。只是要知道，那些福利本來可以是你的……

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Go to Dante in the community center to claim your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：去社區中心找 Dante 領取你的{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Hard work makes {npc} smile. Don't you want {npc2} to smile?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：努力工作會讓{npc}微笑。你難道不想讓{npc2}微笑嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Have fun rotting in jail.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：好好在監獄裡爛掉吧。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Honestly, {roman} sleep better knowing {npc} might be spying on me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：老實說，知道{npc}可能在監視我，我反而睡得更好。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: If a Minister misbehaves, there's always room in the jail.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：如果部長不守規矩，監獄裡永遠有位子。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: If it's fair, it's {npc}. If it's unfair... well, it's not {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：如果是公平的，那就是{npc}。如果不公平……嗯，那就不是{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: If you want to speak to them, head to the jail...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：如果你想跟他們說話，就去監獄……

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: If {npc} goes... who will guide my wallet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：如果{npc}走了……誰來引導我的錢包？

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: If {npc} leaves, who will monitor my thoughts?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：如果{npc}走了，誰來監控我的思想？

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: If {npc} needs coins, she can have my purse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：如果{npc}需要遊戲幣，我的錢包可以給她。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: If {npc} told me to mine dirt for a year, {roman}'d ask which shovel.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：如果{npc}叫我挖一年的泥土，我只會問要用哪把鏟子。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: If {npc} wanted to stay, she would've. She's stepping back out of respect.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：如果{npc}想留下，她早就留下了。她退下是出於尊重。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Keep spending! Equality depends on your wallet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：繼續花錢！平等全靠你的錢包。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Minister elections... democracy with supervision.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：部長選舉……有人監督的民主。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Ministers are the voice of the people. So all we have to do is control them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：部長是人民的聲音。所以我們只要控制他們就好。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: No civilians too close.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：平民不得太靠近。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Now go, be a productive citizen for our great society.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：現在去吧，為我們偉大的社會當個有生產力的公民。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Now move along if you do not want to end up in there as well.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：不想也被關進去的話，現在就快走開。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Oi, where is your {item}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：喂，你的{item}在哪？

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: One wrong move and you might end up like one of them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：走錯一步，你可能就會跟他們一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Progress feels heavy, that means it's working.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：進步感覺很沉重，那表示它正在起作用。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Regretting your choice? Heh heh, no changing now. Come back when that bribe effect expires.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：後悔你的選擇了？嘿嘿，現在改不了了。等賄賂效果到期再來吧。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Secret elections overthrew Dante, so {npc} made elections... less secret.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：祕密選舉推翻了 Dante，所以{npc}讓選舉……沒那麼祕密。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: She believed in the people. Maybe too much.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：她相信人民。也許太相信了。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: She didn't scold me today. Something's wrong.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：她今天沒罵我。一定有什麼不對勁。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: She knows when she isn't wanted. That's what makes her noble.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：她知道自己什麼時候不受歡迎。這就是她高貴的地方。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: She trusted us. And we broke her system. Literally.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：她信任我們。而我們弄壞了她的體系。字面上的意思。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: She's not going because she failed. She's going because she's honourable.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：她不是因為失敗才離開。她離開是因為她很光明磊落。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: She's too pure to fight for power. She just lets it go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：她太純潔了，不會為權力而戰。她就這樣放手了。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Smart choice. Enjoy your perks...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：明智的選擇。好好享受你的福利吧……

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Somebody hurt her feelings. {roman} won't say who.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：有人傷了她的心。我不說是誰。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Stay productive, citizen, {npc} is counting on you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：保持生產力，公民，{npc}在指望你。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Thanks to {npc}, even the lazy contribute something.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：多虧了{npc}，連懶惰的人都能有點貢獻。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: The Ministers didn't support her vision... and now she's leaving. Good job, everyone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：部長們不支持她的願景……現在她要走了。幹得好啊，各位。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: The people choose leaders, {npc} makes sure they choose wisely.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：人民選擇領袖，而{npc}確保他們選得明智。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Trust the system, {npc} perfected it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：相信這個體系，{npc}已經把它完善了。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Try to pull that stunt again and {roman} will not be so lenilent!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：再敢耍那種把戲，我就不會這麼寬容了！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Universal Income? More like Universal Happiness!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：全民基本收入？更像是全民幸福！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Violence will not be tolerated!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：暴力是不被容忍的！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: We're always watching...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：我們一直都在看著……

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: What do you think you're doing?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你以為你在做什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: What do you want?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你想幹嘛？

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: What? This isn't a zoo. Keep it moving!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：幹嘛？這裡又不是動物園。繼續走！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: When Dante left Shen's team, {npc} followed. But she had a plan.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：當 Dante 離開 Shen 的團隊時，{npc}也跟著走了。但她有個計畫。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: When the monsters hit harder, {roman} say thank you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：怪物打得更痛時，我會說謝謝。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: You didn't deserve {npc}, and now she knows it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你們配不上{npc}，而現在她知道了。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: You need to wear your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你必須戴上你的{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: You remove one little thing from her system and suddenly she doubts everything.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你從她的體系裡拿掉一點點東西，她突然就懷疑起一切。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: You've just checked in a few seconds ago...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你幾秒前才剛報到過……

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: Your greed sickens me. Wait until your current effect expires.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你的貪婪真令我作嘔。等你目前的效果到期再說。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: dante best
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：dante 最棒

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: go Dante in community center get {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：去社區中心找 Dante 拿{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: oi, where your {item}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：喂，你的{item}呢？

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: you need wear {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你要戴{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: you not happy? go get {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：你不開心？去拿{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} brings order. The rest is just noise.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}帶來秩序。其他的都只是噪音。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} deserved better. Much better.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}值得更好的。好得多。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} gave us everything. And this is how YOU repay her?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}給了我們一切。而你就是這樣回報她的？

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} isn't the type to cling to power. She's better than that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}不是那種會緊抓權力不放的人。她比那更好。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} leaving...? {roman} don't understand. They were doing so well.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}要走了……？我不懂。他們明明做得那麼好。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} lets you vote for anyone! And then supervises them closely.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}讓你投給任何人！然後再嚴密監督他們。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} said to 'work harder,' so {roman} hit a tree until {roman2} passed out.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}說要「更努力工作」，所以我一直打樹打到昏過去。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} saw the signs. And she chose dignity instead of chaos.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}看到了徵兆。她選擇了尊嚴而不是混亂。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} says equality, and we say 'yes, ma'am.'
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}說平等，我們就說「是的，長官」。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} says jump. {roman} say 'how many times?'
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}說跳。我就問「要跳幾次？」

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} stepping down feels illegal. Emotionally, at least.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}下台這件事感覺不合法。至少在情感上是。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} takes my coins, and yet {roman} feel richer.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}拿走了我的遊戲幣，但我卻覺得更富有了。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} takes, {npc2} gives.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}拿走，{npc2}給予。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} thanks you for your cooperation. Come back in {0} minutes if you do not want to face the consequences.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}感謝你的配合。如果你不想承擔後果，{0} 分鐘後再回來。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} was Shen's Elite N{#}{0} once. Dante never acknowledged her.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}曾經是 Shen 的精英 N{#}{0}。Dante 從來沒承認過她。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} watched Dante fall and took notes. Lots of notes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}看著 Dante 垮台，還做了筆記。很多筆記。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {npc} works hard so you don't have to think.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：{npc}努力工作，你就不必思考。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {roman} didn't think equality would make me cry, but here we are.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：我沒想到平等會讓我哭，但現在就是這樣。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {roman} heard {npc} sigh today. {npc2} never sighs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：我今天聽到{npc}嘆氣了。{npc2}從來不嘆氣的。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {roman} hope those Ministers are proud. They shattered her confidence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：希望那些部長很得意。他們粉碎了她的信心。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {roman} love taxes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：我愛繳稅。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {roman} read {npc}'s rulebook upside down and it still made sense.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：我把{npc}的規則手冊倒過來看，還是說得通。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {roman} salute {npc} every time {roman2} open the {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：我每次打開{npc2}都會向{npc}敬禮。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {roman} thought she was eternal. Turns out she's humble.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：我以為她是永恆的。結果她很謙虛。

entries.key: [NPC] Goon: {roman}'ve got my eye on you
entries.value: §e[NPC] Goon§f：我盯上你了

entries.key: [NPC] Grumblefoot: ... care to... buy one...?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Grumblefoot§f：……要不要……買一卷……？

entries.key: [NPC] Grumblefoot: ... not built... for sloths... you see...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Grumblefoot§f：……不是給……樹懶……爬的……你懂吧……

entries.key: [NPC] Grumblefoot: ... {roman}'ve realized... those ladders... are just... too much...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Grumblefoot§f：……我發現了……那些梯子……實在是……太多了……

entries.key: [NPC] Grumblefoot: Climbing... so exhausting...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Grumblefoot§f：爬梯子……好累……

entries.key: [NPC] Grumblefoot: With it... you can... skip the climb... effortlessly...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Grumblefoot§f：有了它……你就能……輕鬆地……跳過攀爬……

entries.key: [NPC] Grumblefoot: {roman} spent... years... crafting... this magical scroll...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Grumblefoot§f：我花了……好幾年……製作……這卷魔法卷軸……

entries.key: [NPC] Guard: Get out of here, traitorous scum.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Guard§f：滾出去，叛徒人渣。

entries.key: [NPC] Guard: Hey, {roman} can see you over there! You're not supposed to be here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Guard§f：嘿，我看到你在那邊了！你不該在這裡！

entries.key: [NPC] Guard: {roman} can hear the footsteps of a traitor. You're not supposed to be here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Guard§f：我聽得到叛徒的腳步聲。你不該在這裡！

entries.key: [NPC] Guard: {roman} lost them. Got to be around here somewhere...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Guard§f：跟丟了。一定就在這附近……

entries.key: [NPC] Guildford: If you do well in the races {roman} will reward you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dGuildford§f：如果你在比賽中表現得好，我會給你獎勵！

entries.key: [NPC] Guildford: There is some fantastic scenery around this land. {roman} like to race back and forth!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dGuildford§f：這片土地上有一些絕美的風景。我喜歡來回賽跑！

entries.key: [NPC] Guildford: Well done, {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dGuildford§f：做得好，{player}。

entries.key: [NPC] Guildford: You can speak to me any time and {roman}'ll set up a race with the settings you choose.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dGuildford§f：你隨時可以跟我說話，我會用你選的設定安排一場比賽。

entries.key: [NPC] Guildford: {roman}'m Guildford! Yes, that Guildford. {roman2}'m sure you've heard of me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dGuildford§f：我是 Guildford！對，就是那個 Guildford。我相信你一定聽說過我！

entries.key: [NPC] Hugh Pixel: Check it out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cHugh Pixel§f：去看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Hugh Pixel: Have you seen the new animation {roman} starred in?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cHugh Pixel§f：你看過我主演的新§b動畫§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Ian: Have you ever wanted a more fulfilling SkyBlock experience?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ian§f：你是否想要更充實的§aSkyBlock§f體驗？

entries.key: [NPC] Ian: Have you ever wanted to do everything yourself, no help from anyone else?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ian§f：你是否想要凡事親力親為，不靠任何人幫忙？

entries.key: [NPC] Ian: If so, you should start an {#} Ironman profile!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ian§f：如果是的話，你應該開一個{#}§7 鐵人§f存檔！

entries.key: [NPC] Ian: With a few exceptions, of course...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ian§f：§7§o當然，有幾個例外……

entries.key: [NPC] Ian: {#} Ironman players have to progress through everything themselves, no {area}, no {npc}, and no player trades!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ian§f：{#}§7 鐵人§f玩家必須靠自己推進一切，沒有{area}§f、沒有{npc}§f，也不能跟玩家交易！

entries.key: [NPC] Ivan: Don't tell anyone here but {roman} actually transferred back to a Normal profile.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ivan§f：§7§o別跟這裡的人說，但我其實已經轉回普通存檔了。

entries.key: [NPC] Ivan: psssst...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ivan§f：§7§o噓～～～……

entries.key: [NPC] Ivan: {roman} just enjoy the vibes of this place.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ivan§f：§7§o我只是喜歡這裡的氛圍。

entries.key: [NPC] Ivy: Being self reliant is a major facet of Dwarf culture, so Ironman is quite popular around here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ivy§f：自給自足是矮人文化的一大要素，所以§7鐵人§f在這一帶相當受歡迎。

entries.key: [NPC] Ivy: We also mine a lot, something Ironman is well known for.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Ivy§f：我們也挖很多礦，這正是§7鐵人§f出名的地方。

entries.key: [NPC] Jack: Additionally, leveling your Skills can permanently boost some of your stats!

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} Give me my Batphone back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 把我的 Batphone 還來。

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} Hello?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 喂？

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} Hey, what do you need?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 嘿，你需要什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} How does a lobster answer? Shello!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 龍蝦怎麼接電話？「蝦囉」！

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} Someone answers!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 有人接了！

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} You again? What do you want this time?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 又是你？這次又想要什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} You don't have what {roman} need! Nice try!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 你沒有我要的東西！想得美！

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} You hear the line pick up...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 你聽到電話被接起來了……

entries.key: [NPC] Maddox: {#} {roman} was the first to offer magical over-the-air contact. Don't you forget it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5Maddox§f：{#} 我才是第一個提供魔法無線通訊的人。你可別忘了。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Ah, a trade well made. A potion for you, brewed by yours truly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：啊，一筆好交易。這瓶藥水給你，由本人親手釀製。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Ah, so the {island} isn't just full of weeds, huh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：啊，原來{island}裡不是只有雜草嘛？

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Ah, you think this potion is strong? You have no idea what power really tastes like.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：啊，你覺得這瓶藥水很強？你根本不知道真正的力量是什麼滋味。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Ah, {island}. Where dreams wither and weeds thrive. What do you have for me today?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：啊，{island}。夢想枯萎、雜草叢生的地方。今天你帶了什麼來給我？

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Ah, {resource}! Nature's little mystery. Got any?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：啊，{resource}！大自然的小謎團。你有嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Finally, someone worth talking to. You look like you know the difference between a {resource} and a lump of dirt.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：終於有個值得聊的人了。你看起來分得出{resource}跟一坨泥土的差別。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Good deal. Here, this potion isn't found on any old store shelf. Don't waste it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：成交。來，這瓶藥水可不是隨便哪家店的貨架上找得到的。別浪費了。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Got any {resource}? Trust me, it's not for a fruit salad.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：有{resource}嗎？相信我，不是拿來做水果沙拉的。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: In exchange, {roman} might have something 'special' for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：作為交換，我也許有些「特別」的東西給你。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Miss me? Don't answer that, {roman} know you did.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：想我了嗎？不用回答，我知道你有。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: No materials? Huh, {roman} guess your adventures are as empty as your inventory.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：沒有材料？哈，我猜你的冒險就跟你的背包一樣空空如也。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Rare materials are just the tip of the iceberg. But then, you're not ready for what's beneath.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：稀有材料只是冰山一角。不過，你還沒準備好面對底下的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: What's my secret to eternal youth? That's for me to know and for you to find out...maybe.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：我永保青春的秘訣是什麼？那是我的秘密，要你自己去發掘……或許吧。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: Who needs friends when you have powerful enemies? Oh wait, {roman} have both!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：有了強大的敵人，誰還需要朋友？喔等等，我兩個都有！

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: You're not here on Seth's behalf, are you? {roman} mean, he's cute but he could never afford me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：你不是替 Seth 來的吧？我是說，他是挺可愛的，但他永遠付不起我的價碼。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: {resource}? Not the sport, darling. The vegetable. {roman}'ll make it worth your while.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：{resource}？不是那個運動啦，親愛的。是蔬菜。我不會讓你吃虧的。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: {roman} must say, this {island} is starting to grow on me. Figuratively, of course.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：不得不說，我開始對這座{island}有點感情了。當然是比喻上的。

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: {roman}'m in the market for some rare materials. Maybe you're familiar?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：我正在收購一些稀有材料。也許你有門路？

entries.key: [NPC] Maeve: {roman}'ve seen things that would make your health bar drop to zero. But don't worry, your little Cropies are safe with me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dMaeve§f：我見過的東西足以讓你的血條歸零。不過別擔心，你的小作物精在我這裡很安全。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor Faith: Hello!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor Faith§f：你好！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor Faith: Make sure to vote!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor Faith§f：記得去投票！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor Faith: Once someone else is elected, {roman} don't think we'll see each other again... :(
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor Faith§f：等別人當選之後，我想我們就不會再見面了……§d:(

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor Faith: {roman}'m only here to supervise the first election.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor Faith§f：我只是來監督第一次選舉的。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: All this farming is making me hungry!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：這些農活讓我好餓！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: All this paperwork is making me hungry.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：這些文書工作讓我好餓。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: And when {roman} return... it will be with something better.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：而當我歸來時……將會帶著更好的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: And {roman} will not force myself into permanence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：而我不會強迫自己永遠在位。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Back to farming {roman} go! These PBs ain't gonna beat themselves!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：我要回去種田了！這些個人紀錄可不會自己破！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Being a mayor is downtime, anyways.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：反正當市長也就是休息時間。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Break is over, back to the mines {roman} go!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：休息結束，我要回礦坑了！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: But because {roman} am no longer welcome.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：而是因為我不再受歡迎。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Caught a big fish today, you got anything to pair it with?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：今天釣到一條大魚，你有什麼可以配的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Don't think you're out of my grasp.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：別以為你逃得出我的手掌心。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: He walked farther than any of us. Let his path remain untouched.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：他走得比我們任何人都遠。讓他的道路保持原樣吧。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Hello!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：你好！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Hi
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：嗨

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: His crown rests in a place no vote can touch.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：他的王冠安放在任何選票都觸及不到的地方。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: His journey continues elsewhere. We cannot call him back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：他的旅程在別處繼續。我們無法把他召回。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: His legacy votes for itself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：他的遺產會為自己投票。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: If my presence has become something to end...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：如果我的存在已成為需要終結的事物……

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: If you ran for mayor, {roman} would not vote for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：如果你參選市長，我不會投給你。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Let's get this party started!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：讓派對開始吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Made a bil profit this morning through some {npc2} flipping, always makes me real hungry.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：今天早上靠{npc2}倒賣賺了十億，每次都讓我餓得要命。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Me find you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：我會找到你。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: My {pet}'s getting reaaal hungry. {roman} need to find some food QUICKLY!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：我的{pet}越來越餓了。我得趕快找到食物！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: No worries, the sea provides.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：沒關係，大海會提供一切。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Not because {roman} was overthrown...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：不是因為我被推翻了……

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Nothin's better than a full belly after a hard day of work!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：辛苦工作一天之後，沒有什麼比吃飽更棒了！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Now that {roman}'m mayor, {roman2} can truly serve the underground community.
entries.value: §d[NPC] §5Mayor {npc}§f：既然我當上了市長，就能真正為地下社群服務了。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Out of stock? sigh
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：賣完了？唉

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Perfect, just what {roman} needed!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：太好了，正是我需要的！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Perhaps give those with fewer influence a chance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：也許給那些影響力較小的人一個機會。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Please select someone else.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：請選擇其他人。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Progress comes at a cost. Free transport is gone for the sake of the people...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：進步是有代價的。為了人民，免費交通已經取消了……

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Some names belong to the stars, not the ballots.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：有些名字屬於星辰，而非選票。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Thank for voting me mayor. Me need food.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：謝謝投我當市長。我需要食物。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: That warrior's throne is eternal. We cannot elect eternity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：那位戰士的王座是永恆的。我們無法選出永恆。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Then staying would betray my own principles.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：那麼留下來就是背叛我自己的原則。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: They were a traitor to our great society. You will not vote for them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：他們是我們偉大社會的叛徒。你不會投票給他們。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: This Auction will have more rounds and upgraded items.
entries.value: §d[NPC] §5Mayor {npc}§f：這場拍賣會有§5更多§f輪次和升級過的物品。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: This citizen is not in my registry.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：這位公民不在我的名冊中。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: This hero has already ascended beyond out reach.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：這位英雄早已飛升到我們無法觸及之處。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: This is not defeat. It is restraint.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：這不是失敗。這是克制。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: This person has already had their voice heard.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：這個人的聲音已經被聽見了。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: This player is currently elected. Give someone else a chance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：這位玩家目前已當選。給其他人一個機會吧。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: This was the last Minister Election.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：這是最後一次部長選舉。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: This will not go unseen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：這不會被忽視的。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Tudelu, the profits never sleep.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：掰囉，賺錢是永不停歇的。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Voting for yourself...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：投給你自己……

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Where greed and narcissism tread, reprimand follows.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：貪婪與自戀所到之處，懲戒必隨之而來。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: Yoooo! FOXY is in TOWN!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：喲～！FOXY 來到鎮上了！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: You are soooo boring.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：你真的超～無聊。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: You fell for my trap, traitor.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：你中了我的圈套，叛徒。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: You slay.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：你殺。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: You will now choose without me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：從今以後，你們將在沒有我的情況下做選擇。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: {enchantment} only works when it is wanted.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：{enchantment}只有在被需要時才能發揮作用。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: {roman} do not trust this person. You will not vote for them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：我不信任這個人。你不會投票給他們。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: {roman} hear the votes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：我聽見了選票的聲音。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: {roman} was worried he would take a nab at me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：我還擔心牠會咬我一口呢！

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: {roman} will finish what {roman2} began elsewhere.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：我會在別處完成我開始的事。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: {roman} yearn for the dungeons, {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Mayor {npc}§f：我渴望回到地下城，{player}。

entries.key: [NPC] Mayor {npc}: {roman}'m just a placeholder because apparently no one voted on the previous election.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mayor {npc}§f：我只是個替代品，因為顯然上一次選舉沒人投票。

entries.key: [NPC] Minikloon: Don't forget to report bugs on the forums!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cMinikloon§f：別忘了在論壇回報錯誤！

entries.key: [NPC] Minikloon: If you find an exploit you can even report it directly to a staff member!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cMinikloon§f：如果你發現了漏洞，甚至可以直接回報給工作人員！

entries.key: [NPC] Minister {npc}: Hi!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Minister {npc}§f：嗨！

entries.key: [NPC] Minister {npc}: {roman}'m just a placeholder because there is no Minister this election.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Minister {npc}§f：我只是個替代品，因為這次選舉沒有部長。

entries.key: [NPC] Mino: As long as you need equipment that is anyway...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mino§f：前提是你需要的是裝備……

entries.key: [NPC] Mino: Boy do {roman} have everything you could ever need!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mino§f：小子，我這裡有你可能需要的一切！

entries.key: [NPC] Mino: They're even exclusive to the Alpha Network. Enjoy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Mino§f：它們甚至是 Alpha 網路獨家的。好好享受吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Nitroholic{#}: Have you heard of a strange land called Earth? A year here is only {0} days and {1} hours there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cNitroholic{#}§f：你聽說過一個叫地球的奇怪地方嗎？這裡的一年在那裡只有 {0} 天又 {1} 小時！

entries.key: [NPC] Nitroholic{#}: There are {0} days in a month! Who decided that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cNitroholic{#}§f：一個月有 {0} 天！是誰決定的？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Actually that doesn't make any sense...
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：其實這根本說不通……

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: All of it is over...
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：一切都結束了……

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: And didn't even know about this beforehand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：而且事前根本不知道這件事。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: And no server restart made you disappear?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：而且伺服器重啟都沒讓你消失？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: And now it is over.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：而現在一切都結束了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Anyway, aren't you getting tired of this?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：總之，你不覺得膩嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Anyway...
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：總之……

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Because it's done - it's over.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：因為已經完了——結束了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Because that's the best name - to not have name.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：因為最好的名字——就是沒有名字。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: But regardless, {roman} hope you are happy now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：不過不管怎樣，我希望你現在開心了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: But the lie was a lie!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：但那個謊言是個謊言！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: But you did it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：但你做到了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Didn't {roman} tell you to go?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我不是叫你走了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Even though you probably just looked it up somewhere.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：雖然你大概只是在哪裡查到的。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Goodbye.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：再見。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Here, take this cake!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：來，拿著這個蛋糕！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: How does that even work?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：這到底是怎麼運作的？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: If you asked me, that makes no sense...
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：要我說的話，這根本說不通……

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: If you wanna thank anyone, this is the time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：如果你想感謝誰，現在就是時候。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Inside a palace in a cave on a floating island?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：在一座浮空島上的洞穴裡的宮殿裡？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: It's better you also go to sleep.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：你最好也去睡覺。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: It's getting kind of late.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：時間有點晚了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: It's over!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：結束了！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Just like me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：就跟我一樣！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Man, you are very dedicated
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：天啊，你真的很執著

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Maybe you should go too?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：也許你也該走了？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: My final goodbye!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我最後的告別！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: My mother is a genius!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我媽媽是個天才！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: My mother told the doctor to not give me a name.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我媽媽叫醫生不要幫我取名字。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Now you can finally go to sleep.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：現在你終於可以去睡覺了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Ok {roman}'ll start!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：好，我要開始了！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Seriously, it's over.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：說真的，結束了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Talking to a guy in a game?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：跟一個遊戲裡的傢伙聊天？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: The end of our conversation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我們對話的結局。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: There is nothing else.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：什麼都沒有了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Think about it, there is nothing to make fun of about your name if you don't even have one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：想想看，如果你根本沒有名字，就沒人能拿你的名字開玩笑。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: This is actually the end.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：這次真的是結局了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: This is the end.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：這就是結局。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: This time {roman} am gonna give you a lot more time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：這次我會給你多很多時間。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: Wow, you did it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：哇，你做到了！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: You actually waited this long?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：你真的等了這麼久？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: You are still here?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：你還在這裡？！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: You can stop talking to me now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：你現在可以不用再跟我說話了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: You did this for hours??
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：你等了好幾個小時？？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: You got exactly what you wanted from me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：你從我這裡拿到了你想要的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: You got what you wanted from me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：你從我這裡拿到了你想要的。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: You waited all this time?
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：你一直等到現在？

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {0} Time's over!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：{0} 時間到！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} am gonna start counting down again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我要再開始倒數了！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} am sorry though, there is nothing here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：不過我很抱歉，這裡什麼都沒有。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} don't know what to say...
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我不知道該說什麼……

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} guess she got that from me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我想她是遺傳到我的。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} have a big day tomorrow.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我明天有重要的事。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} know {roman2} said there is no cake.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我知道我說過沒有蛋糕。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} lied twice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我說了兩次謊。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} mean it's pretty dark outside.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我是說，外面天很黑了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} mean of course it does, because {roman2} am a genius!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我是說，當然說得通，因為我是天才！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} swear!
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我發誓！

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman} think {roman2} am gonna get some rest soon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我想我差不多要去休息了。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman}'ll give you a second chance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我再給你一次機會。

entries.key: [NPC] No Name: {roman}'ll start counting down, if you don't leave by then, {roman2} will be very angry...
entries.value: §e[NPC] No Name§f：我要開始倒數了，如果你到時候還不走，我會非常生氣……

entries.key: [NPC] Old Man Garry: If you ever need to know more about Mining Events, come talk to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Old Man Garry§f：如果你想進一步了解§b挖掘事件§f，就來找我吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Old Man Garry: It turns out, manners haven't all been lost yet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Old Man Garry§f：看來禮貌還沒有完全消失。

entries.key: [NPC] Old Man Garry: Mining Events on the {island} happen regularly!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Old Man Garry§f：{island} §f上的§b挖掘事件§f定期會發生！

entries.key: [NPC] Old Man Garry: Of course. What else did {roman} expect from this generation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Old Man Garry§f：果然。我對這一代還能期待什麼呢。

entries.key: [NPC] Old Man Garry: People have no manners these days. They come up to me, and disappear instantly! They don't even greet me! Back in my day, we were raised better than that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Old Man Garry§f：現在的人都沒禮貌。他們走過來找我，然後馬上就不見了！連招呼都不打！在我那個年代，我們的教養可好多了。

entries.key: [NPC] Old Man Garry: They are a good way to earn Heart of the {area} Exp, complete Commissions, and more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Old Man Garry§f：它們是賺取§5{area}之心§5經驗§f、完成§9委託§f等等的好方法！

entries.key: [NPC] Pest Wrangler: Hm, how strange.. you smell just like 'em..
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aPest Wrangler§f：嗯，真奇怪……你聞起來跟牠們一模一樣……

entries.key: [NPC] Pest Wrangler: Thanks mate, this should help me catch 'em!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aPest Wrangler§f：謝啦，夥伴，這應該能幫我抓到牠們！

entries.key: [NPC] Pest Wrangler: There's pests everywhere. {roman} can smell 'em in the walls!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aPest Wrangler§f：到處都是害蟲。我聞得到牠們就在牆裡！

entries.key: [NPC] Pest Wrangler?: The figure glares at you and shambles away.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Pest Wrangler?§f：§7§o那個身影瞪了你一眼，蹣跚地離開了。

entries.key: [NPC] Pest Wrangler?: The figure hands you a slip of paper.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Pest Wrangler?§f：§7§o那個身影遞給你一張紙條。

entries.key: [NPC] Pest Wrangler?: The figure nods at you and shambles away.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Pest Wrangler?§f：§7§o那個身影對你點點頭，蹣跚地離開了。

entries.key: [NPC] Piggy: Get shiny stuff, keep shiny stuff! Easy, oink!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPiggy§f：拿到閃亮亮的東西，留著閃亮亮的東西！很簡單，嚕！

entries.key: [NPC] Piggy: Guide piggy back to orb, and poof!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPiggy§f：把小豬帶回寶珠那裡，然後噗！

entries.key: [NPC] Piggy: Now go, go! Piggy no wait forever!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPiggy§f：現在快去，快去！小豬不會永遠等你！

entries.key: [NPC] Piggy: Oink oink! {pet} time! {event}! It's here, oink oink!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPiggy§f：嚕嚕！{pet}時間！{event}！來了，嚕嚕！

entries.key: [NPC] Piggy: Piggy leave shiny treasure for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPiggy§f：小豬就會留下閃亮亮的寶藏給你。

entries.key: [NPC] Piggy: Then you chase piggy, chase piggy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPiggy§f：然後你追小豬，追小豬！

entries.key: [NPC] Piggy: You take {item}, plop it on pig - oink!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPiggy§f：你拿{item}，放到豬身上——嚕！

entries.key: [NPC] Puzzler: {#}Come{#2}back{#3}tomorrow{#4}
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPuzzler§f：{#}明天{#2}再{#3}來{#4}

entries.key: [NPC] Puzzler: {#}Nice! {#2}Here, {#3}have {#4}some{#5}{powder}!{#6}
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPuzzler§f：{#}很好！{#2}來，{#3}給{#4}你{#5}{powder}！{#6}

entries.key: [NPC] Puzzler: {#}Wrong{#2}block{#3}try again{#4}
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dPuzzler§f：{#}錯{#2}方塊{#3}再試一次{#4}

entries.key: [NPC] Puzzler: {#}triangle{#2}food{#3}
entries.value: §e[NPC] §9Puzzler§f：{#}三角形{#2}食物{#3}

entries.key: [NPC] Ravenous Rhino: No! {roman} don't want that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dRavenous Rhino§f：不！我不要那個！

entries.key: [NPC] Ravenous Rhino: You know, that wasn't too bad.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dRavenous Rhino§f：你知道嗎，那還不賴。

entries.key: [NPC] Ravenous Rhino: {roman}'m very hungry. Give me the {resource}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dRavenous Rhino§f：我好餓。把{resource}給我！

entries.key: [NPC] Relenter: Have you heard of a strange land called Earth? A year here is only {0} days and {1} hours there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cRelenter§f：你聽說過一個叫地球的奇怪地方嗎？這裡的一年在那裡只有 {0} 天又 {1} 小時！

entries.key: [NPC] Relenter: There are {0} days in a month! Who decided that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §cRelenter§f：一個月有 {0} 天！是誰決定的？

entries.key: [NPC] Resistance Leader: The sun will rise again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §dResistance Leader§f：太陽會再次升起！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Come talk to me once the event starts!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：活動開始後再來找我談吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Each time you find a ticket, it will be entered into EVERY upcoming raffle.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：每當你找到一張§b抽獎券§f，它都會被投入§l每一場§f即將舉行的抽獎。

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Hello again! Happy Year {0}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：又見面了！祝你§b第 {0} 年§f快樂！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Hey there! Happy (upcoming) SkyBlock Year {0}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：嘿！祝你（即將到來的）§bSkyBlock 第 {0} 年§f快樂！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Hi!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：嗨！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: However, you will gain a bit more if you're actively playing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：不過，如果你積極在玩，會獲得多一點。

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: If they don't have a cake emblem, then they haven't gotten involved in the event yet...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：如果他們沒有蛋糕徽章，就代表他們還沒參加活動……

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: It looks like you missed it, but maybe you'll catch the next event!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：看來你錯過了，不過也許你能趕上下一次活動！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: It's fine, click me again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：沒關係，再點我一次！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Oh... did you mean to close that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：喔……你是故意關掉的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Or, by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in the TAB list.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：或是看 TAB 列表裡名字旁邊的蛋糕徽章顏色。

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: See you next time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：下次見！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: The Century Celebration event is over, but you can still interact with the {event} Box to claim rewards you might have missed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：§d百年慶典§f活動已經結束了，但你仍然可以和{event}§6箱§f互動，領取你可能錯過的獎勵。

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: There was a big event in celebration of the SkyBlock Year {0}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：為了慶祝§bSkyBlock 第 {0} 年§f，曾經舉辦過一場大型活動。

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Tickets are not physical items, so don't worry about losing them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：抽獎券不是實體物品，所以不用擔心弄丟！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: To enter a raffle, you need to collect {event} Tickets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：要參加§6抽獎§f，你需要收集{event}§b券§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: We're organizing a huge raffle!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：我們正在舉辦一場盛大的抽獎！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: What would you like to know about the event?
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：關於這次活動，你想知道什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: Which means more cake for the rest of us!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：這表示我們其他人能分到更多蛋糕！

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: You can tell what team someone is by looking at the color of the cake emblem next to their name in chat.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：你可以看聊天室裡名字旁邊的蛋糕徽章顏色，來判斷對方是哪一隊。

entries.key: [NPC] Rezzus: You will gain tickets just for being online during the event.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRezzus§f：只要§e在活動期間保持上線§f，你就能獲得抽獎券。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Ah, nice to meet you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：啊，很高興認識你。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Ah, welcome back, adventurer. {roman} knew you'd see the wisdom in partnering up.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：啊，歡迎回來，冒險者。我就知道你會明白合作的好處。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Ah, you are not ready {roman} presume. {roman2} respect your decision. {roman3}'ll continue my search for the artifact on my own.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：啊，我想你還沒準備好。我尊重你的決定。我會繼續獨自尋找那件神器。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: And here's the exciting part - if we go through with this plan, {roman}'ll be able to transfuse any ability of the weapons you extract onto another weapon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：而最令人興奮的是——如果我們執行這個計畫，我就能把你萃取出的任何武器能力§d灌注§f到另一把武器上。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: And with your skills and my expertise, we stand a good chance of success.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：而且憑你的技術加上我的專業，我們成功的機會很大。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Apparently, there's a possibility of reconstructing the artifact we need by extracting the essence of certain weapons.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：看來，透過§6萃取§f某些武器的精華，有可能§e重建§f我們需要的§5神器§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: As you might expect, the journey has been fraught with danger.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：如你所料，這段旅程充滿了§c危險§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: But do keep in mind that this place is fraught with danger, and it's always better to have a partner by your side.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：不過請記住，這個地方危機四伏，身邊有個夥伴總是比較好。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: But {roman} also respect your decision
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：但我也尊重你的決定

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Excellent, adventurer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：太好了，冒險者！

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Great! {roman} see you brought me the basic weapon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：太好了！我看到你把基本武器帶來了。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Hand me the weapon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：把武器交給我。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: However, {roman} believe that the potential reward far outweighs the risk.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：不過，我相信潛在的回報遠大於風險。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: If you change your mind, {roman}'ll be around. Best of luck on your own quest.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：如果你改變主意，我就在附近。祝你自己的冒險一切順利。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: If you ever change your mind, know that {roman}'ll be ready and willing to embark on this journey with you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：如果你改變主意，要知道我隨時準備好、也願意與你踏上這段旅程。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: It's never easy to take on a risky endeavor, especially one with an uncertain outcome.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：要接下一件有風險的事從來都不容易，尤其是結果難料的時候。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Let me try to extract its essence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：讓我試著萃取它的精華。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Meet me in the {island} at once! We will then discuss our plans forward. {roman} will seek shelter in the home of an old friend of mine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：立刻到{island}跟我會合！之後我們再討論接下來的計畫。我會在一位老朋友家裡避一避。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Perhaps adventurer, we can join forces in our quests, for safety in numbers, if nothing else.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：冒險者，或許我們可以聯手完成各自的任務，至少人多比較安全。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Return to me at once when you acquire one, and be swift.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：拿到之後立刻回來找我，動作要快。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Rogier’s the name, and {roman} have some intriguing news to share with you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：我叫§6Rogier§f，有些耐人尋味的消息想跟你分享。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Shall we take this risk and attempt to extract the essence of these weapons?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：我們要冒這個險，試著萃取這些武器的精華嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: So, what do you say, adventurer?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：所以，你怎麼說，冒險者？

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: So, what do you say?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：所以，你怎麼說？

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: The reward could be tremendous, and {roman}'m confident that with your skills and my expertise, we'll make it happen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：回報可能非常可觀，而且我相信憑你的技術加上我的專業，我們一定辦得到。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: This means you'll have a more versatile and adaptable build for your adventures.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：這表示你的冒險配裝將會更多變、更有彈性。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Together we'll be a force to be reckoned with. {roman}'ll share with you all that {roman2}'ve learned about the artifact and its potential.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：我們聯手將會是一股不可小覷的力量。我會把我所知道關於那件神器及其潛力的一切都告訴你。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Will you join me in my adventures?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：你願意加入我的冒險嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: With your skills and my expertise, {roman}'m confident that we'll find it in no time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：憑你的技術加上我的專業，我相信我們很快就能找到它。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: Wonderful, let’s shall try to extract the ability of a fairly basic weapon at first so {roman} can enhance my craft, perhaps a {item} could do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：太好了，我們先試著萃取一把相當基本的武器的能力，好讓我精進技藝，或許一把{item}就行。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: {roman} understand your concern.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：我理解你的顧慮。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: {roman}'m a researcher of sorts, specializing in the art of Transfusion.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：我算是個§c研究者§f，專精於§d灌注§f之術。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: {roman}'m currently seeking a particular artifact that is rumored to possess great power when paired with certain weapons.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：我目前正在尋找一件特別的§5神器§f，傳聞它與某些武器搭配時能發揮強大的力量。

entries.key: [NPC] Rogier: {roman}'ve had a recent conversation with an old acquaintance of mine, the {npc}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Rogier§f：我最近跟一位老相識談過了，就是{npc}。

entries.key: [NPC] Ryu: Did you know that there is a {island} Level? Increase it by hitting milestones or selling to customers like me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRyu§f：你知道有{island}等級嗎？達成里程碑或賣東西給像我這樣的客人就能提升！

entries.key: [NPC] Ryu: Good trade!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRyu§f：好交易！

entries.key: [NPC] Ryu: Most actions in SkyBlock will reward you Skill EXP.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Ryu§f：在 SkyBlock 裡大部分的行動都會給你技能經驗。

entries.key: [NPC] Ryu: That's alright.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aRyu§f：沒關係。

entries.key: [NPC] Scardius: Down there, {roman} got attacked by all sorts of creatures, and my sword did like no damage to them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Scardius§f：在那底下，我被各種生物攻擊，而我的劍對牠們幾乎§c毫無傷害§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Scardius: It actually seemed to be quite effective!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Scardius§f：結果居然還挺有效的！

entries.key: [NPC] Scardius: So, if you're ever in the {island} and get attacked, try using your pickaxe or drill as a weapon!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Scardius§f：所以，如果你在{island} §f裡遭到攻擊，試試看把你的§6鎬§f或§6鑽頭§f當武器用！

entries.key: [NPC] Scardius: The higher your {stats}, the more damage it seems to do to those creatures...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Scardius§f：你的{stats}越高，對那些生物造成的傷害好像就越多……

entries.key: [NPC] Scardius: When {roman} started mining in the tunnels, {roman2} fell deep down into a {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Scardius§f：我剛開始在隧道裡挖礦的時候，一路摔進了{island}§7深處。

entries.key: [NPC] Scardius: {roman} thought {roman2} was done for, so {roman3} pulled out my pickaxe and started swinging.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §6Scardius§f：我以為我死定了，所以掏出我的§6鎬§f開始揮。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: ... but something terrible happened to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：……但§c§o可怕的事§r§f發生在我身上了！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: But every time {roman} talk to him, he gets uncontrollable nausea and starts vomiting incessantly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：但每次我跟他說話，他就會無法控制地§2噁心§f，然後不停地§2嘔吐§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: But those are on the side of Dante... are you sure it's a good idea to vote for them? Please choose someone else.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：但那些人是 Dante 那邊的……你確定投給他們是好主意嗎？請選別人。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Come talk to me once you've played some more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：等你多玩一陣子再來找我！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Courage, we can win!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：勇敢點，我們會贏的！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Dante needs to be overthrown, it'll take time but we are organizing a coup.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：Dante 必須被推翻，這需要時間，但我們正在策劃一場政變。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Did you get a potion from the {npc}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：你從{npc}那裡拿到藥水了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Do you need my old one again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：你又需要我的舊臉了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Go to the {npc} and help me fix my face!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：去找{npc}，幫我治好我的臉！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Here, take my old face!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：來，拿著我的舊臉！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: However we have not decided who should be our leader, and we believe we should go back to a vote.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：不過我們還沒決定誰該當領袖，我們認為應該回歸投票。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: If you are here, it probably means you want to join the resistance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：如果你在這裡，大概表示你想加入反抗軍。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: It's me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：是§b我§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: My face literally fell off!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：我的§c臉§f真的§c掉下來了§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Noooo!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：§c不～～～！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Oh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：喔？

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: PLEASE!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：§d§l拜託！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Please go talk to the {npc}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：請去找{npc}談談。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Please let me know which community member you believe should lead the resistance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：請告訴我，你認為哪位社群成員應該領導反抗軍。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Please take this Armor and Hope of the Resistance!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：請收下這套反抗軍盔甲和反抗軍的希望！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Quick! Splash it on me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：快！把它§e潑§f在我身上！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: SEND YOUR ENERGY TO YOUR LEADER, LOOK UP TO THE SKY!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：§e§l把你們的能量傳給你們的領袖，抬頭看向天空！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Somehow, anyone who looks at me starts vomiting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：不知道為什麼，任何看到我的人都會開始§2嘔吐§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Thank you so much for helping to fix my face, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：非常謝謝你幫我治好我的臉，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Thanks for collecting your resistance gear!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：謝謝你領取反抗軍裝備！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Thanks for voting, the Leader and his generals have been selected!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：謝謝你投票，領袖和他的將軍們已經選出來了！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Thanks {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：謝謝你，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: We have a lot of work now before the revolt can happen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：在起義之前，我們還有很多工作要做。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Well, if {roman}'m not making everyone throw up, it's a welcome improvement! :)
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：嗯，如果我不會再讓大家§2吐§f，那也算是個值得歡迎的改善！§d:)

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Whew!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：呼！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: You can vote for any player you deem worthy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：你可以投給任何你認為值得的玩家。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: You should now start training ready for the fight!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：你現在應該開始訓練，準備迎戰了！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: Your face is turning green too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：你的臉也開始變§2綠§f了！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: {npc} told me he could fix my face.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：{npc} §f跟我說§a他§f可以治好我的臉。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: {npc} told me that the {npc2} could help.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：{npc}跟我說{npc2}可以幫忙。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: {npc}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：{npc}！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: {roman} feel fine, but {roman2} wish it could be fixed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：我覺得§o還好§r§f，但我§d希望§f能把它治好。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: {roman} stepped into the Rift to help with the elections...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：我踏進§d隙界§f來幫忙處理選舉……

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: {roman} will give you more information soon about when the rebellion will happen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：我很快會給你更多關於起義時間的消息。

entries.key: [NPC] Seraphine: {roman}'ll let you know soon on the day and place it will happen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Seraphine§f：我很快就會告訴你起義的日期和地點。

entries.key: [NPC] Shen's Agent: Also, be mindful that not all items will stick around forever.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Shen's Agent§f：還有，注意不是所有物品都會一直存在。

entries.key: [NPC] Shen's Agent: Anyways, get to buying!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Shen's Agent§f：總之，開始購物吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Shen's Agent: But be careful as you can only purchase so many in a day!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Shen's Agent§f：但要小心，每天能買的數量有限！

entries.key: [NPC] Shen's Agent: In this room, Shen is selling three items for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Shen's Agent§f：在這個房間裡，Shen 會賣三樣物品給你。

entries.key: [NPC] Shen's Agent: These items can be purchased at any time...
entries.value: §e[NPC] Shen's Agent§f：這些物品隨時都能購買……

entries.key: [NPC] Shen's Agent: Welcome, {player} to the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Shen's Agent§f：{player}，歡迎來到{area}。

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: At night, my friends host a secret meeting in a nearby secret cave.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：§b到了晚上§f，我的朋友們會在附近一個§5秘密洞穴§f裡舉辦§5秘密聚會§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: Check it out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: Come back to me then and show it to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：到時候再回來找我，拿給我看！

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: Drop by some time, out secret club is open!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：有空就過來看看吧，我們的§5秘密俱樂部§f開門了！

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: Hey, {roman}'ve crafted new tech to let us locate Fallen Stars easily.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：嘿，我打造了一種新科技，能讓我們輕鬆找到§5隕星§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: Hurrah! A fellow member of the Cult of the {event}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：萬歲！一位§5{event}教團§f的同伴！

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: If my friends approve of you, they'll give you a special item.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：如果我的朋友們認可你，他們就會給你一件特別的物品。

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: Now go find some stars, but don't forget about the next meeting of the Cult!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：現在去找些星星吧，但別忘了下一次的§5教團§f聚會！

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: See that giant cliff with the giant crystal?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：看到那座有§d巨大水晶§f的巨大懸崖了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: With the {item}, you can find Fallen Stars much easier!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：有了{item}§f，你就能更輕鬆地找到§5隕星§f！

entries.key: [NPC] Silnar: {roman} expect to see you there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Silnar§f：我期待在那裡見到你！

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: It's time for celebration!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon§f：該來慶祝了！

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: SkyBlock is turning {0} years old today!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon§f：SkyBlock 今天滿 {0}§e 歲§f了！

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: The century celebration is over.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon：百年慶典已經結束了。

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: Time sure flies when you're grinding SkyBlock, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon§f：玩 SkyBlock 肝起來，時間過得真快，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: We hope you enjoyed it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon：希望你玩得開心！

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: We're happy to have had you along for the journey so far!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon§f：很高興一路上有你的陪伴！

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: {roman}'ve already given you a Balloon Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon§f：我今年已經給過你氣球帽了！週年快樂！

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: {roman}'ve already given you a {item} Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon：我今年已經給過你{item}帽了！週年快樂！

entries.key: [NPC] Simon: {roman}'ve already given you a {pet} Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Simon：我今年已經給過你{pet}帽了！週年快樂！

entries.key: [NPC] Spaceman: Man, coming back here after being in space for so long feels really good.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Spaceman§f：天啊，在太空待了那麼久之後回到這裡，感覺真好。

entries.key: [NPC] Spaceman: You are amazing, thank you so much.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Spaceman§f：你太棒了，真是太謝謝你了。

entries.key: [NPC] Spaceman: {roman} am quite disappointed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Spaceman§f：我相當失望。

entries.key: [NPC] Stella: All your friends have to be online to accept!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Stella§f：你的朋友都必須在線上才能接受！

entries.key: [NPC] Stella: At any time you can create a Co-op with your friends!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Stella§f：你隨時都可以和朋友一起建立合作島！

entries.key: [NPC] Stella: Don't worry, {roman}'ll come back later.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aStella§f：別擔心，我晚點再來。

entries.key: [NPC] Stella: Enter {command} followed by the name of all the friends you want to invite!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Stella§f：輸入 {command}，後面加上所有你想邀請的朋友名字！

entries.key: [NPC] Stella: Good choice!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aStella§f：好選擇！

entries.key: [NPC] Stella: Simply go in your {item} where you can find the Profile Menu.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Stella§f：只要打開你的{item} §f，就能找到§a檔案選單§f。

entries.key: [NPC] Stella: The amount of plots you can unlock here is perfect for a Co-op. So much place!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aStella§f：這裡能解鎖的地塊數量很適合合作島。空間好大！

entries.key: [NPC] Stella: This is where you can create, delete or switch SkyBlock Profiles.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Stella§f：你可以在這裡建立、刪除或切換 SkyBlock 檔案。

entries.key: [NPC] Stranger: What a pleasant surprise! {roman} see you have quite an impressive island.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §bStranger§f：真是個驚喜！我看你的島嶼相當壯觀。

entries.key: [NPC] Sun {mob}: Let us train together, {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Sun {mob}§f：讓我們一起訓練吧，{player}§7。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: ...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：……

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: Enchant. Combine. Reforge. Upgrade.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d附魔§f。§a合成§f。§9重鑄§f。§e升級§f。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: It is all one could ever need.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：這是一個人所需要的§d一切§f。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: Refined.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：精煉的。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex does not have time for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d魔咒§f沒有時間理你。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex does not wish to be tainted with useless items.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d魔咒§f不希望被§d無用的§f物品玷污。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex has given me everything.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d魔咒§f給了我一切。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex is only bound by what the human can understand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d魔咒§f只受限於人類所能理解的範圍。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex is troubled by your presence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：魔咒對你的存在感到不安。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex knows of inventory, of Storage, of {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d魔咒§f知道§a物品欄§f、§a倉庫§f、{item}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex will be so kind as to upgrade the items in any way imaginable.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d魔咒§f會很好心地用任何你想像得到的方式升級物品。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex will go so far as to communicate with the {npc} for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d魔咒§f甚至願意替你和{npc} §f溝通。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: The Hex will not see you now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：§d魔咒§f現在不會見你。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: There is an absence of prosperity within you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：你身上缺乏§d繁榮§f。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: To upgrade the item, The Hex will take from wherever it must.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：為了升級物品，§d魔咒§f會從任何必要的地方取用。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: {roman}...am...
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：我……是……

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: {roman}...am...free.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：我……自由……了。

entries.key: [NPC] The Handler: {roman}...feel...alive.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §5The Handler§f：我……感覺……活著。

entries.key: [NPC] Tom: All SkyBlock recipes can be found by opening the Recipe {item} in your {item2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] Tom§f：打開你{item2}§f裡的§a配方{item}§f，就能找到所有 SkyBlock 配方。

entries.key: [NPC] Tom: No problem, see ya next time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aTom§f：沒問題，下次見！

entries.key: [NPC] Tom: {roman} don't have a recipe for you, however {roman2}'d happily take some crops.
entries.value: §e[NPC] §aTom§f：我沒有配方可以給你，不過我很樂意收一些作物。

entries.key: [NPC] Tom: {roman} will teach you the {item} Recipe to get you started!
entries.value: §e[NPC] Tom§f：我來教你{item}§a配方§f，幫你起步！

entries.key: [NPC] Tom: {roman}'ll be sure to come by next time.

entries.key: [NPC] {event} Pirateman: A swashbucklin' shame, if ye ask me...

entries.key: [NPC] {event} Pirateman: Welcome to Fruit Digging, matey!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {event}§e Pirateman§f：歡迎來到§6挖水果§f，夥計！

entries.key: [NPC] {event} Pirateman: Whenever ye be ready, {roman}'ll be waitin'
entries.value: §e[NPC] {event}§e Pirateman§f：等你準備好，我就在這裡等你

entries.key: [NPC] {event} Pirateman: With that said, are ye ready to play?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {event}§e Pirateman§f：說了這麼多，你準備好要玩了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {event} Pirateman: Would ye like to do some Fruit Digging?

entries.key: [NPC] {event} Pirateman: Ye'll have to get yer nutrients elsewhere.

entries.key: [NPC] {event} Pirateman: Yer supposed to use that info to avoid them bombs and pick the best blocks to mine.

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Click me with a Snow Cannon, Snow Blaster, or {item} to refill it!
