entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Fancy that, you're one of the chosen few, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：想不到，你是少數被選中的人之一，是吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Here the Jerrys make and deliver Gifts to all of SkyBlock!

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Hey, hold up there.

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: It is up to you, {player}, to help save the day. Take this Snow Cannon to aid you in your defense against the Magma Grinches.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：{player}§f，拯救這一天就靠你了。拿著這門§a雪砲§f，幫你抵禦§c岩漿格林奇§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Maybe you can punch me out.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：也許你可以把我打出去。

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Maybe {roman} feel such an intense connection with my other half because, it was literally my other half?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：也許我會跟我的另一半有這麼強烈的連結，是因為那真的是我的另一半？

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Take this offering in return!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：收下這份禮物作為回報！

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Thank you so much!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：真是太謝謝你了！

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Thank you so much, {roman} stayed there for weeks!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：非常謝謝你，我在那裡待了好幾個禮拜！

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Welcome to the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：歡迎來到{island}。

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Well, don't let it go to your head.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：嗯，別因此得意忘形。

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: When its time to deliver Gifts, {area} always erupts and the village is ravaged by heat-based enemies!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：每到送禮物的時候，{area}總會爆發，村莊就會被火熱的敵人蹂躪！

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: Wow {roman} wasn't expecting that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：哇，我沒料到會這樣！

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: You freed me, and helped me find the love of my life!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：你救了我，還幫我找到了我一生的摯愛！

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: You may pass.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {mob}§f：你可以通過了。

entries.key: [NPC] {mob}: You think you can just waltz through here without showing some credentials?

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: A farmer's life is a simple life.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：農夫的生活就是簡單的生活。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: Could you gather some {collections_res} from my farm and bring it back to me so that {roman} can feed her? Poor thing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：你能從我的農場收集一些{collections_res}帶回來給我餵她嗎？可憐的傢伙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: Great day to be on the {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：今天真是待在{area}的好日子！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: Have you been to {island} yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：你去過{island}了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: Howdy, friend!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：你好啊，朋友！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: My cow is getting worse! Hurry with that {collections_res}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：我的牛越來越虛弱了！快把{collections_res}帶來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: My cow is sick, she needs some food to replenish her strength.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：我的牛生病了，她需要吃點東西恢復體力。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: My {area} is yours to harvest! {collections_res} is a valuable resource to collect, you can unlock many cool things by collecting it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：我的{area}隨你收成！{collections_res}是很有價值的收集資源，收集它能解鎖很多很酷的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: Thank you so much!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：真是太感謝你了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Rigby: Travel to {island} to gain access to more crops like Carrots, Potatoes, Pumpkins, and Melons!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e Rigby§f：前往{island}就能取得更多作物，像是胡蘿蔔、馬鈴薯、南瓜和西瓜！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} Wanderer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f 流浪者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: Collect glowstone, nether quartz, and magma cream to become a true master of the Nether.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：收集螢光石、地獄石英和岩漿膏，成為真正的下界大師。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: Collect nether wart and defeat blaze to collect blaze rods!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：收集地獄疙瘩，打敗烈焰使者來收集烈焰棒！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: Go forth and conquer, {player}. And don't come crying to me when you fail.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：去征服吧，{player}。失敗了可別哭著來找我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: Many of the creatures on this island drop useful brewing ingredients. Use them in a {item} to brew strong potions that will aid to your journey.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：這座島上很多生物都會掉落實用的釀造材料。在{item}中用它們釀造強大的藥水，幫助你的旅程。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: There's something about you {roman} don't like. Perhaps it is your lack of fear for the great beast that is the Nether.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：你身上有什麼東西讓我不喜歡。也許是你對下界這頭巨獸毫無畏懼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: Use them in a {item} to brew strong potions that will aid in your journey.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：在{item}中用它們釀造強大的藥水，幫助你的旅程。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: {roman} am a conqueror. {roman2}'ve defeated everything from the Nether to the End and back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：我是征服者。我打敗過從下界到終界再回來的一切。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: {roman} don't know what would {roman2} do without my {item} Resistance Potions. Probably burn.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：我不知道沒有我的{item}抗性藥水該怎麼辦。大概會被燒死吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: {roman} have defeated the {mob} more times than {roman2} can count!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：我打敗{mob}的次數多到數不清！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} of the Nether: {roman} told you not to come crying to me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c of the Nether§f：我跟你說過別哭著來找我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} And we're chums too, you and {roman}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f我們也是夥伴，你跟我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} And who am {roman} to say which of my chums are the most important, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f我又憑什麼說哪個夥伴最重要，你懂吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Bring me {item} x{0} and {roman}'ll add you to my Abiphone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f帶{item} §8x{0} §f給我，我就把你加進我的§3 Abiphone§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} But {roman} only got so many contact slots, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f但我的聯絡人欄位就那麼多，你懂吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Come back when you've got enough.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f等你收集夠了再來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Here's my contact!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f這是我的聯絡方式！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Hey chum!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f嘿，夥伴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Hey chum, that's not it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f嘿，夥伴，不是這個。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Hey chum. Long time no see.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f嘿，夥伴。好久不見。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Mates rates!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f朋友價！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Not whatever this is.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f不是這個不知道什麼的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Of course it's chum, chum!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f當然是肉糊啊，夥伴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Ok, listen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f好，聽著。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} So, if you want your digits in my phone, imma need you to get me something...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f所以，如果你想把號碼放進我的手機，我需要你幫我弄點東西……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} This is the stuff. The good stuff.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f就是這個。好東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} What do you think it is?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f你覺得是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} What kind of chum would that make me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f那我算是什麼樣的夥伴？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} Wow ok, that's good.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f哇好，這很好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} You don't have enough {resource}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc} {#} §f你的{resource}§f不夠。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc} {#} You ever need chumming supplies just give me your chum {npc2} a call!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Allow me to introduce myself. {roman} am Special Agent Thomas Amog.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：容我自我介紹。我是特別探員 Thomas Amog。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Allow me to introduce you to this machine first.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我先跟你介紹一下這台機器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Already? But {roman} haven't finished yet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：已經到了？但我還沒跑完！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alri-
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好——

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright alright, how does {0} Million coins sound to you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好啦好啦，{0}§6 百萬§f遊戲幣聽起來怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright let's go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，我們走吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright show's over folks! Come back in {0} nights for the next auction.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好了各位，表演結束了！{0}§b 晚§f後再來參加下一場拍賣會吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright! Well, all around us in this room are the best auctions from the {area} upstairs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好的！嗯，這個房間裡到處都是樓上{area} §f的§e頂級拍賣品§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, both here and in the real world {roman}'ve placed this {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，我在這裡和現實世界都放了這個{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, come back later when you want to give the items!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，想交物品的時候再回來吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, deep breaths! Let's do this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，深呼吸！我們上吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, if you are struggling to find the Queen, she is usually in the throne room, or in her quarters.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，如果你找不到§c女王§f，她通常在§2王座廳§f或她的寢宮裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, next point of interest...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，下一個重點……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, not bad, not bad!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，不錯，不錯！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, pop a squat and listen up then, buddy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，那就坐下來好好聽著，夥伴。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, where did we finish off last time?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，我們上次講到哪裡了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, {roman} feel better now. First we need to gather some resources to build the Greenhouse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，我感覺好多了。首先我們需要收集§e一些資源§f來蓋§a溫室§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, {roman} guess we can end the meeting there. Same time next week!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，看來我們的聚會就到此為止了。下週同一時間見！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright, {roman} won't bother you anymore.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，我不會再打擾你了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alright. You're right, {npc2}. {roman}'ve been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧。你說得對，{npc2}。我一個人扛這個重擔太久了。如果我們要讓它成功，就一起做吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Alrighty!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好咧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Also it sounds crazy but, do you think we could exist without cubes?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有，聽起來很瘋狂，但你覺得我們能在沒有方塊的情況下存在嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Also make sure to check all sides of the box.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有記得檢查框架的每一面。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Also this guy, Crappox or something
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有這個傢伙，叫 Crappox 還是什麼的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Also, here take this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有，拿著這個。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Also, in my infinite generosity, {roman} have given this model an additional contact slot!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e還有，出於我無比的慷慨，我還幫這款機型多加了一個§a聯絡人欄位§e！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Also, remember those island we could place?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有，記得那些我們可以放置的島嶼嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Although since they're all half-eaten, you technically brought me half the amount!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過它們都被吃掉一半了，所以嚴格來說你只帶了一半的量！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Although {roman} adore this pristine piece of emerald, {roman2} don't need it yet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然我很喜歡這塊完美的綠寶石，但我現在還不需要。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Although, {roman} might not be too kind out there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，我在外面可能不會太友善。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Although... could you bring a more potent one?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過……你能帶一瓶§b更強效的來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Always anxious of laying out their own path.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總是對開拓§o自己的§r§f道路感到§4焦慮§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Always check the roof in the caves, there are holes behind the cobwebs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一定要檢查洞穴的頂部，蜘蛛網後面有洞。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Always people playing it, but terrible music
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總是有人在彈，但音樂超爛

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Always stay vigilant
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：永遠保持警覺

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Am
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a太

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Am {roman} a waste of time and space
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我是在浪費時間和空間嗎

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Am {roman} being investigated?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我是在被調查嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Am {roman} the tree?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我是那棵樹嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Amazing! Thanks for taking the time! Now, time to finish my {collections_res} {resource}...and hopefully it boosts my pelt earnings.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！謝謝你花時間幫忙！現在，該完成我的{collections_res}{resource}了……希望它能增加我的毛皮收入。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Amazing! Thanks for the Redstone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！謝謝你的§c紅石§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Amazing! Thanks for the help - those pesky Golden Goblins seem to appear all the time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a太棒了！§f謝謝你的幫忙——那些討厭的§6黃金哥布林§f好像隨時都會出現！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Amazing! That'll do just the trick!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！這樣就行了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Amazing! We've done it! Our very first harvest from the Greenhouse. You've really got the hang of this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！我們做到了！這是我們在§a溫室§f的第一次收成。你真的掌握訣竅了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Amazing! {roman} haven't eaten such chocolatey goodness in a long time...Maybe they should invest in that rusty old lift.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！我好久沒吃到這麼濃郁的巧克力了……也許他們該投資一下那部生鏽的老升降機。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！！！我們有一塊全新的地了！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: An alternative universe of sorts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：某種平行宇宙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: An awful sign that death's shadow grows near.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那是死亡陰影逼近的可怕徵兆。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: An entity we call {npc2} has decided to live at the base of the tower.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一個我們稱為{npc2}的存在決定住在塔的底部。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: An evil force took control of the graves.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一股§4邪惡的力量§f控制了這些墳墓。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: An excellent match!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一場精彩的比賽！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：投資知識能得到最好的利息。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: An unhinged clown once told me, if you're good at something, never do it for free!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一個§o瘋狂的小丑§f曾經告訴我，如果你擅長某件事，就§c永遠別§f免費做！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Analyzing these mutations will help us understand how we can improve existing crops which will help farmers everywhere!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：分析這些突變能幫助我們了解如何改良現有的作物，這對各地的農夫都有幫助！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And bask in thy sweet glow,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沐浴在汝甜美的光輝中，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And considering that Mary's time flows {0} and a half times faster than Jamie's...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：考慮到§d Mary §f的時間流動速度§d是§6 Jamie §f的 {0}§d 倍半§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And died...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後就死了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And don't forget to water them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有別忘了幫它們§9澆水§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And even he was probably born much later
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過就連他大概也是很久以後才出生的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And finally there are still very few people like me, who hold their faith in the Hero.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最後，還有極少數像我這樣的人，對§9英雄§f懷抱信仰。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And for that, you earned my respect.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也正因如此，你贏得了我的敬意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And from that burst, thousands of lava fishes fell from the sky onto {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而那次噴發中，數千條§2岩漿魚§f從天上掉落到{area}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And getting to them would take ages, even if you had a Travel Scroll?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就算你有§b傳送卷軸§f，要去找他們還是得花上老半天？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And guess what, {roman} know where to look!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你猜怎麼著，我知道該去哪裡找！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And if you come accross duplicates of the same Chip, don't worry, you'll be able to upgrade them to {rarity} and {rarity2} rarity, boosting their maximum level and effectiveness even further!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你遇到同一種§9晶片§f的§c重複品§f，別擔心，你可以把它們升級到{rarity} §f和{rarity2} §f稀有度，進一步提升它們的等級上限與效果！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And immediately after, dashed back inside the fire to save the rest of their litter
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：緊接著又衝回火裡，去救其餘的孩子

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And in every dimension {roman}'m his assistant.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而在每一個維度裡，我都是他的助手。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And listen, {roman}'ve never seen anybody down here, but you seem like a nice fellow.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽著，我從沒在這下面看過任何人，但你看起來是個好人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And now {roman} can't find it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我找不到牠了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And now {roman} don't want to break any more trees, in case {roman2} break any more axes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我不想再砍任何樹了，免得又弄壞更多斧頭！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And once again those Piglins stole our research.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而那些豬布林又一次偷走了我們的研究。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And only then can we move forward with the necklace.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只有這樣，我們才能繼續製作§d項鍊§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And potatoes look so yummy and juicy...but water...instantly evaporates around here...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：馬鈴薯看起來又好吃又多汁……但水……在這附近一下就蒸發了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And really, isn't that practically the next-best thing?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說真的，這不就幾乎是次好的事了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And she said they are the remains of dead fairies
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：她說那些是死去仙女的遺骸

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And some higher power would control everything about you...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而某個更高的力量控制著你的一切……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And stay away from water!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有，離水遠一點！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And the cleaning contract was badly negotiated.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而且清潔合約談得很糟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And the one before that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有前天的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And the people, sheep {roman} say
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而人民，我說是羊群

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And the price is still only {timer} coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e而且價格仍然只要 {timer}§6 遊戲幣§e！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And the sculk spread all over my body!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後§5幽匿§f就擴散到我全身！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And the world keeps spinning!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而世界繼續轉動！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And then it flew away.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後牠就飛走了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And then it happened
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後就發生了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And then once they have decided on a new king he gets bored and names another new king almost instantly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後等他們決定好新國王，他很快就會覺得無聊，幾乎馬上又指定另一位新國王。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And then you came on over here and trampled on my dreams.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後你就跑來這裡踐踏我的夢想。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And then, with the coins he gives me, {roman} can get a {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後用他給我的金幣，我就能買一個{item}了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And there's nothing here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：結果這裡什麼都沒有！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And they restart, just like that
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後就這樣重新開始

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And they told me to come back in {0} to {1} business days
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們叫我 {0} 到 {1} 個工作天後再來

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And they're sneakers!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而且是運動鞋！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And we got all the {collections_res} back!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而且我們把{collections_res}全拿回來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And we meet again!... {#}inhales{#2}... Seems the loch embrace is too strong?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們又見面了！……{#}吸氣{#2}……看來湖的擁抱太強烈了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那你沒告訴我的事呢？你還在這下面藏了什麼，{npc2}？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And what do YOU base your identity on?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那§c你§f又是拿什麼當作自我認同的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And when you're ready, use the Ship Navigator to travel to the Bayou!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：準備好之後，就用§6船隻導航器§f前往§2沼澤§f吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And with a little extra push, it becomes {item}, a grumpy old thing, complains about the 'good old days'.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再稍微推一把，它就會變成{item}，一個脾氣暴躁的老東西，整天抱怨「以前的好日子」。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And with the latest technology, you can add FIVE more music discs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e而且有了最新科技，你還能多放五張音樂唱片！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And you can access them through those displays!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以透過那些展示台參加！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And you can always resell them! Everyone is trading BZTs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而且你隨時都可以§6轉賣§f它們！大家都在交易§b BZT§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And you even got an Abiphone! Take my contact so we can stay in touch.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你甚至還拿到了 Abiphone！收下我的§a聯絡方式§f，我們保持聯絡吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And you two, what are your names?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有你們兩個，叫什麼名字？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And you will be taxed {0} on the next {1}, so {2} extra.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來的 {1} 要課 {0} 的稅，也就是額外 {2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And you yourself are capable of telepathy and telekinesis, which nobody knew were even possible recently!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而你自己就會心靈感應和心靈傳動，這在不久前還沒人知道是可能的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And you, {player}, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the Crop Analyzer. You've earned my trust.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有你，{player}§f，是你幫我們走到這一步的。你應該能使用§a作物分析儀§f。你贏得了我的信任。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And {roman} didn't! But {npc2} told me about it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我是沒看到！但{npc2}跟我說了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And {roman} don't know why!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而且我不知道為什麼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And {roman} don't see ANY DONUT!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：結果我§c一個甜甜圈都沒看到§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And {roman} have this really good tonic. It's a really good tonic, ok?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而且我有這個超棒的補藥。真的是超棒的補藥，好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: And, to predators below, their white underbelly blends in with the light shining down on the water from above!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Another gift from {npc2}?

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Another shark

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Any Piglin should have access to their share of the stash.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每個豬布林都應該能分到自己那份存貨。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Any breach has an extremely large impact on causality. This is why everything is so strange.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：任何§5裂縫§f都會對§d因果律§f造成極大的影響。所以這裡的一切才會這麼奇怪。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Any chance you can craft me a new {item} now?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在能幫我合成一把新的{item}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Any chance you could have it taste like coffee?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有沒有辦法讓它喝起來像§6咖啡§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Any longer than that and the animal will run away!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：超過時間的話，那隻動物就會跑掉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyhow, {roman} don't think {roman2} have anything left to teach you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，我想我已經沒有什麼可以教你的了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyone but {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：誰都好，就是不要{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anything is possible.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一切皆有可能。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anything to do with the Calamity or the Riftway at the top of the mountain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：任何跟§4大災難§f或山頂上的§d隙界通道§f有關的書。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway! That's about everything {roman} know.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之！我知道的差不多就這些了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, Shen is hosting auctions for Motes in here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，§6 Shen §f在這裡舉辦用§d微粒§f競標的拍賣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, do you want to see a magic trick?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，你想看魔術嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, do you want to see some of the special auctions we have in store?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，你想看看我們準備的一些§b特別拍賣§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, he seems to be hard at work now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，他現在似乎在努力工作了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, my name you ask?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，你問我叫什麼名字？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, see you around.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，下次見。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, splash this potion on whoever makes you want to vomit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，把這瓶藥水§e潑§f在讓你想§2吐§f的人身上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, wanna grab a coffee some day?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，哪天要不要一起喝杯咖啡？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, what's your name?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，你叫什麼名字？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, you can harvest the farm patches around the remnants of her decrepit lifework.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，你可以收成她那破敗遺產周圍的§a農地§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, you're right...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，你說得對……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway, {roman}'ve been prepping my super jump since {roman2} was a wee tot.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，我從小時候就開始準備我的超級跳躍了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyway...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, Abiphones are magical devices that allow you to send sounds towards another Abiphone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，Abiphone 是一種魔法裝置，可以把聲音傳送到另一支 Abiphone。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, he's expecting you over in the {area} by the {area2}. Better not keep him waiting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，他在{area2}旁的{area}等你。最好別讓他等太久！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, if you are done talking to a tool, let's get you geared up.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，如果你跟工具聊完了，我們來幫你配點裝備吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, if you ever want to see what {roman}'m currently painting, come speak to me again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，如果你想看看我目前在畫什麼，再來找我談吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, if you want to help with the cleaning effort, take this {item} and get fishin'!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，如果你想幫忙清理，就拿著這個{item}去釣魚吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, if you want to learn more about that, there are books in the Academy regarding the Dark Ages.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，如果你想了解更多，學院裡有關於黑暗時代的書。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, in my free time {roman} tell jokes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，我閒暇時會講笑話。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, maybe {roman} should give you my spare Huntrap...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，也許我該把我備用的§c狩獵陷阱§f給你……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, the Barbarians built their Bastion inside the skeleton, and {roman} suspect this is where the stolen object is guarded.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，野蠻人在骨骸裡蓋了他們的§c堡壘§f，我懷疑§2被偷的東西就藏在那裡§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, whenever you loot a {power} Corpse, {roman}'ll come soon after to retrieve it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，每當你搜刮一具{power}§b屍體§f，我很快就會跟過來把它取走。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, which faction did you choose?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，你選了哪個派系？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, {roman} was breaking this tree right here, right.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，我剛剛在砍這棵樹，對吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Anyways, {roman}'m hurt and {roman2} lost my bow in the chaos.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，我受傷了，還在混亂中弄丟了我的弓。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Apply that {item} in the Engine slot by clicking the engine in your inventory!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在背包裡點擊引擎，把那個{item} §f裝進§6引擎§f欄位！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Argofays have a set amount of time to hatch.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Aristocrat passage ey? Best of luck to you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：貴族通道嗎？祝你好運。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Around me were strange objects everywhere, but the strangest part was the giant.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我身邊到處都是奇怪的物體，但最奇怪的是那個巨人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As Sun {mob} unleashed deeper reserves of power, you carved a new mark of valor into the shifting sands of time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當§e太陽{mob} §f釋放出更深層的力量時，你在時間流沙上刻下了一道新的英勇印記。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As a cow, all {roman} want to do is eat, sleep and moo.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：身為一頭牛，我只想吃、睡、哞。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As a dwarf, {roman} spend considerable time exploring caves and mountains.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：身為矮人，我花了很多時間探索§3洞穴§f和§b山脈§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As a painter, {roman} prefer to use dyes as part of my work.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：身為畫家，我喜歡在作品中使用§c染§6料§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As a reward for your hard work, {roman} will train an extra pet for you in Slot {0}

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As a token of my gratitude, here's another {0} {resource} to get you started at my shop! It's not a lot, but a little goes a long way!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了表達謝意，這裡再給你 {0} {resource}，讓你在我的店裡起步！雖然不多，但積少成多！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As for the Precursors, they vanished without a trace, a puzzling paradox.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：至於先驅者，他們消失得無影無蹤，這是個令人費解的矛盾。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As long as {npc2} is Mayor, {roman}'ll let you bid on {item} to use in {npc3}'s shop!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要{npc2}還是鎮長，我就讓你競標{item}，拿去{npc3}的店裡用！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As promised, here is your reward.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如我所承諾，這是你的獎勵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As the Precursors' faith diminished, so too did the might of the Starborns, weakening them in this crucial confrontation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：隨著先驅者的信仰減弱，星裔的力量也跟著衰退，在這場關鍵的對峙中被削弱了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As the empty box stands revealed, consider your next move carefully.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：空箱子已經揭曉，仔細考慮你的下一步。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As the letter never reached the wizard, {roman} had {npc2} summon an exact copy of it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為那封信始終沒送到巫師手上，我請{npc2}召喚出它的完全副本。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As the {npc2}'s true favorite only {roman} know he secretly loves melon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：身為{npc2}真正的最愛，只有我知道他偷偷喜歡西瓜。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As you can see, the best way to hunt Combat creatures is with a Pocket Black Hole.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如你所見，狩獵§c戰鬥§f生物最好的方法就是用§5口袋黑洞§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As you can see, this item is quite powerful. It makes you incredibly fast!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看得出來，這個物品相當強大。它能讓你變得超級快！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As you do this, you'll unlock various crafts and useful stat boosts that will help in other areas of your adventure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這過程中，你會解鎖各種合成配方和實用的屬性加成，對你冒險的其他方面都有幫助。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As you helped greatly with this achievement, let me bestow upon you the first imbued book!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你在這項成就中幫了大忙，就讓我把第一本注入附魔的書送給你吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As you interact with more NPCs in the game, more kinds of customers will show up to buy stuff.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：隨著你在遊戲中跟更多 NPC 互動，會有更多種類的客人來買東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As you journey deeper into the Rift, things maybe become more challenging.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：隨著你深入§d隙界§f，事情可能會變得更有挑戰性。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As you saw, the best way to deal with monsters here is to use a Black Hole.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如你所見，對付這裡怪物最好的方法就是用§5黑洞§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As you see, {roman}'ve done all the legwork... all the research!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看，我已經做完所有的§d§o跑腿§r§f工作了……所有的研究！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: As your {island} Level increases from working on the farm, you'll be able to harvest more crops. Amazing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：隨著你在農場工作讓{island}等級提升，你就能收成更多作物。太棒了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ask away! {roman} got time...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：儘管問吧！我有的是時間……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ask me anything regarding Dragons!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：關於龍的事，儘管問我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Astounding foresight! You predicted a significantly low average and chose boldly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：驚人的遠見！你預測到平均值會非常低，並且大膽做出選擇。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: At first, the attributes may seem weak, but over time they will grow stronger.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一開始，§c屬性§f看起來可能很弱，但隨著時間會越來越強。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: At least he's a good listener
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：至少他是個好的傾聽者

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: At least he's an original
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：至少他很有原創性

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: At least now it's official.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：至少現在是正式的了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: At the apex of Sun {mob}'s power, when all seemed unattainable, you forged a moment of legend that will echo through ages.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在§e太陽{mob}§f力量的巔峰，當一切看似遙不可及時，你鑄就了一個將迴盪千古的傳奇時刻。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: At the auction house you can put your valuable items up for auction!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在拍賣場，你可以把你珍貴的物品拿出來拍賣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: At the end of each year {roman} bake cakes for everyone in town to celebrate the year.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e：每年年底，我都會烤蛋糕給鎮上的每個人，慶祝這一年。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: At this altitude, temporal distortions are most severe.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這個高度，時間扭曲最為嚴重。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Attend two more and {roman}'ll give you my Abiphone Contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再參加兩次，我就給你我的§3 Abiphone 聯絡方式§f。

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：某種程度上，屬性跟{item}能力非常相似。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bait is automatically consumed whenever you cast your rod, so it's easy to use!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每次拋竿時§6魚餌§f都會自動消耗，所以用起來很簡單！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bak bawk bakok!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：咕咕咯咯！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Barbarians, return our {collections_res} at once, or face the consequences of your actions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：野蠻人，立刻歸還我們的{collections_res}，否則就承擔你們行為的後果。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Barbarians, {roman} would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：野蠻人，我想為指控你們道歉。你們在外面打得很好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Basically, as the Rift is another dimension...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：基本上，因為§d隙界§f是另一個維度……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Basically, the mountain might seem close to you in three dimensions...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：基本上，這座§b山§f在三維空間裡看起來也許離你很近……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Be careful because they deal {#} damage and if you die around here...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要小心，因為牠們會造成 {#} 傷害，而如果你在這附近§4死掉§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Be careful not to fall down the shaft though, it's a long way down!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過小心別掉進礦井裡，那可是很深的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Be careful when using Ender Pearls on this island, their energy attracts Endermen!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這座島上使用§a終界珍珠§f時要小心，它們的能量會吸引終界使者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Be careful, though! The {mob} has made the summit home, and she's quite tenacious!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過要小心！{mob}把山頂當成了家，而且她非常難纏！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Be careful, you might be surprised what's on the other side!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：小心，另一邊的東西可能會讓你大吃一驚！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Be water my friend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：像水一樣吧，我的朋友。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Beats me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我也不知道。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because everyone there only ever suffers from miner injuries!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為那裡的人都只會受礦工傷（輕傷）！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because few words do trick.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為少少的話就夠用。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because he didn't want to be a hot dog!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為牠不想變成熱狗！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because if you don't... {roman} have exactly what you need!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為如果你沒有……我正好有你需要的東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. {roman} didn't want to involve anyone until {roman2} was sure it was ready.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為它還不完美。一個失誤可能會造成災難性的後果。在我確定它準備好之前，我不想牽扯任何人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because of you and those meddling kids...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：都是因為你和那些多管閒事的小鬼……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because of your help inside the Rift, once {roman} am done, {roman2} will let you use my services for free.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為你在§d隙界§f裡的幫忙，等我忙完，我會讓你§c免費§f使用我的服務。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because there is no reward.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為根本沒有獎勵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because they have tiny ant-bodies.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為牠們身上有小小的抗「蟻」體。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because they lactose.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為牠們缺腳趾（lack toes，聽起來像乳糖 lactose）。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because they're shellfish.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為牠們是「自私」的貝類（shellfish）。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because with the {pet} roaming around, that's what the state of mind uh... requires.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為有{pet}到處遊蕩，那種心態呃……需要這樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Because {roman} made the mistake of entering through a breach!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為我§c犯了錯§f，穿過一道§5裂縫§f進來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Becoming a sheep!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當一隻羊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Been out here for months without so much as a scrap to show for it...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這裡待了好幾個月，連一點點成果都拿不出來……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Been running low on my brewing supplies, Nether Warts are quite hard to come by these days.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的釀造材料快用完了，這年頭地獄疙瘩很難取得。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Beep boop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗶嗶啵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Before spraying on a wall, consider previewing it in the menu! Right-click on any spray of your choice and it'll magically appear in your hand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噴到牆上之前，可以先在選單裡預覽！對你想要的噴漆圖案按右鍵，它就會神奇地出現在你手上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Before that, {roman} used to compete in sugar cane contests.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在那之前，我常參加甘蔗競賽。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Before you can sail, you must prove you know how to fish.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在你能§a出航§f之前，你必須證明你懂得§b釣魚§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Before you go, let me show you how to add a contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在你離開之前，讓我教你怎麼新增聯絡人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Before you venture into {island} again, {roman} must thank you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在你再次深入{island}之前，我必須謝謝你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Before {roman} can get Fishing, {roman2} have to make sure {roman3} understand the fish themselves.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在我能§a釣魚§f之前，我得先確定自己了解魚本身。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Before {roman} knew it, she snatched something from my washin' line and leapt back into the Bayou.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我還沒反應過來，她就從我的曬衣繩上搶走了某樣東西，跳回了沼澤裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Before, me items, give Coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：以前，我物品，給§6遊戲幣§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Behind me is the Spiders Mound.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我身後是§4蜘蛛丘§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Behold a fellow holder of Heart of the {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看哪，又一位擁有{area}之心的同伴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Believe it or not, but that's a {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：信不信由你，那是{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Believe it or not, that once belonged to a {pet}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：信不信由你，那原本屬於一隻{pet}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Berries are pretty useful to craft Hunting items.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§d莓果§f很適合用來製作§a狩獵§f物品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Besides that, you can always go check the desk to find out what to do next!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：除此之外，你隨時都可以去辦公桌看看接下來要做什麼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Besides, would you really give it to me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：況且，你真的會把它給我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Best of luck battling the infection in the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：祝你在{area}§f對抗§a感染§f順利。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Better hurry, though because they're only available during Mayor {npc2}'s term.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過最好快一點，因為它們只在§6{npc2}鎮長§f任期內才買得到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Between you and me, if you ever want to upgrade it you should travel to the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：偷偷跟你說，如果你想升級它，應該去{island}一趟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bird eggs are grey and dirty, snake eggs are white and clean
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鳥蛋又灰又髒，蛇蛋又白又乾淨

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Books are mesmerizing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：書本真令人著迷。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Boooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo!
[NPC] {npc}: Both Grandiose Games and Vapor are closed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§cGrandiose Games§f 跟 §9Vapor§f 都關門了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Both Maddox and his brother are in fact from {area}, but contrary to the other inhabitants, the {0} brothers were born without any magical aptitudes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§cMaddox §f和他的兄弟其實都來自{area}§f，但跟其他居民不同，這 {0}§f 兄弟生來就沒有任何魔法天賦。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Both marvelous and dangerous at the same time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既§d奇妙§f又§c危險§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Break anything? It wasn't me, it was {npc2}! And, honestly, who stores plates like that anyways?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：打破東西？那不是我，是{npc2}！而且說真的，誰會那樣擺盤子啊？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Brilliant deduction! Next thing you'll tell me water's wet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：推理得真精闢！你接下來是不是要告訴我水是濕的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Brilliant!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring any Junk you find while fishing with your {item} to me, and {roman}'ll let ya trade it in for something more worth your time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用你的{item} §f釣魚時找到的任何§2垃圾§f都拿來給我，我就讓你換成更值得的東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring enough hunks back to me and {roman} will reforge your fishing rod with modifiers exclusive to me -  {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：帶足夠的冰塊回來給我，我就用只有我才有的修正幫你重鑄釣竿——{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring it over to {npc2} and he'll help you attach it to your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿去給{npc2}，他會幫你裝到你的{item}上！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring me a {item} and {roman}'ll show you how!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：帶一瓶{item}給我，我就教你怎麼做！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring me any type of {resource} and we can show the {pet} Queen what it's like to lose something she loves?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：帶任何種類的{resource}給我，我們就能讓{pet}女王知道失去心愛的東西是什麼感覺？！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring me back a {resource} of any type and we can teach her a lesson!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：帶一顆任何種類的{resource}回來，我們就能給她一點教訓！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring me some more {item} to help replenish my stock!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再帶一些{item}給我，幫我補貨吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring me this creature from beyond, and let's advance your taming prowess together!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把這隻來自彼方的生物帶給我，讓我們一起提升你的馴養實力吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring me {0} Spruce Logs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：帶 {0}§a 個雲杉原木§f給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring members of the Fish Family to me and {roman} will reward you greatly!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把§a魚之家族§f的成員帶來給我，我就會大大地§d獎勵§f你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring some back for me to, uh...study...and {roman}'ll reward you with {stats} for your troubles!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：帶一些回來讓我，呃……研究研究……我就用{stats}§6獎勵你的辛勞！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring the chunk to {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把那塊碎片帶給{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring the item {roman} gave you to {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把我給你的東西帶給{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring this to the {npc2} of the Academy in {area}, {roman}'m sure he will find it quite interesting.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把這個帶給{area}§f的§2學院§f{npc2}§f，我相信他會覺得很有意思。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bring trophy fish. To me. Reward.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：帶戰利品魚來。給我。有獎勵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bro {roman} would totally give you the pitch again but {roman2}'m busy picking my next car!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：兄弟，我完全可以再推銷一次，但我正忙著挑我的下一台車！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Brrrrr, {roman}'ve been stuck down here ever since {roman2} fell into the pond with Steve.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：呼呼呼，自從我跟 Steve 一起掉進池塘之後，我就一直被困在這下面。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: BuRRrP Burp!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗝嗝～ 嗝！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: BuUuUrRrPpP!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗝嗝嗝～～！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bubble blub
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：泡泡咕嚕

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Build yourself some reputation first, then we can talk again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：先建立一些聲望，然後我們再談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Buk bawk bakok Cluckpoint {0} puk pock {#} {timer}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：咕咕咯咯§e咯咯點 {0}§f 噗咯 {#} {timer}§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Bukawk. Coot Coot Cluck, Puk Puk Pukaaak.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：咕咕。咯咯咯，噗噗噗咯～

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Buried in loose rocks next to a bridge {roman} said.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我說它埋在橋旁邊的碎石裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Burp
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗝

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But among the other Shens, {roman}'ve finally found my place.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e：但在其他 Shen 之中，我終於找到了自己的歸屬。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But as you may have noticed, as you experience the Rift, you gain control over more and more time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但你可能已經注意到，隨著你體驗§d隙界§f，你能掌控的§a時間§f越來越多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But be careful, though, as each trial burns hotter than the last!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過要小心，每次試煉都會比上一次更燙！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But be my guest, a cat mayor is all {roman} need
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過請便，我只需要一位貓市長

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But be warned, she is strong, and {roman} have it set up to drag her back if she is not defeated in {0} minutes, for the safety of this whole world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過要小心，她很強，為了整個世界的安全，我設定好了，如果她在 {0} 分鐘內沒被打敗，就會把她拖回去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But beware, desperation lends me strength.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過要小心，絕望會給我力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But did you make the right decision?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但你做出正確的決定了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But do they really care about me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但他們真的在乎我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But don't underestimate a {npc2}'s last stand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但別小看{npc2}的最後一搏。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But don't worry! {roman}'m sure you could catch up in no time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過別擔心！我相信你很快就能趕上的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But even in my sleep, {roman} dream of talking
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但就算在睡夢中，我也夢見自己在說話

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But finding them?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但要找到牠們？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But first grab this fishing net.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過先拿著這張§9漁網§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But first {roman} need {0} Motes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但我首先需要 {0}§d 微粒§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But first, you must demonstrate your worth to the other Eleanors.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但首先，你必須向其他 Eleanor 證明你的價值。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But first, you should go talk to {npc2} and get proper gear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過首先，你應該去找{npc2}拿合適的裝備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But first, you should wear something nice!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過首先，你應該§6穿得體面一點§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But having said this story, {roman}'ll exceptionally need to take a break
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過說完這個故事，我得破例休息一下

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But he himself knows very well that his prime is over and that his next fight will be his last.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但他自己很清楚，他的巔峰已經過去，下一場戰鬥將是他的最後一戰。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But here's the catch - once it hits Level {0}, you'll need to upgrade it before it can keep growing. Same goes for Level {1}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過要注意——一旦到達§a等級 {0}§f，你就得先升級它才能繼續成長。§a等級 {1}§f也一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但在這裡呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But hey, did the breach cause the Rift?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但說真的，是裂縫造成了§d隙界§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But hold on... for that {roman} would need to make your Fish Co-op Soulbound.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過等等……要這麼做，我得把你的魚設為§d合作社靈魂綁定§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But honestly, the more {roman} get to know these guys...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過老實說，我越了解這些傢伙……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But how could we? We are all the same
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但怎麼可能呢？我們都一樣

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But how? {roman}'ve been trying for years, and you just did it so easily...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但怎麼會？我試了好幾年，你卻這麼輕鬆就做到了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But hunting lets you harness those powers independently of the creature.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但狩獵讓你能脫離那個生物，獨立駕馭那些力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But if he does, he won't remember me, and {roman} won't tell him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但如果他孵化了，他不會記得我，而我也不會告訴他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But if you are up to no good, {roman}'ll revoke this access immediately.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但如果你圖謀不軌，我會立刻撤銷你的權限。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But in reality, it is very very far away in five dimensions!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但實際上，在五維空間裡，§b它§f離你§o非常非常§f遠！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But intellect is not merely inherited; it is challenged, honed, and expanded.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但智力不只是與生俱來的；它需要被挑戰、磨練與擴展。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But is that the moral of the story?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但這真的是這個故事的寓意嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But it becomes a bit less scary when you realize it came from a {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過當你知道它來自{pet}之後，就沒那麼可怕了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But it makes no sense, {roman}'ve never even heard of such a treasure!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但這說不通啊，我從來沒聽說過這種寶藏！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But it suggests that the Precursors might reemerge one day, a thought both fascinating and daunting.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但這暗示先驅者也許有一天會再度現身，這個想法既迷人又令人生畏。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But it'll cost you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過你得付錢！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But it's Rift Transferable! That hand-stand {event} man in the {area} can help you get it back to the real world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過它是§5可跨隙界轉移§f的！{area}§f裡那個倒立的{event}§f男人可以幫你把它帶回現實世界。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But it's not finished. It's delicate work, {npc2}. Work that requires precision, and data.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但它還沒完成。這是很精細的工作，{npc2}。需要精準度和數據的工作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But let's not get discouraged just yet, we'll find something {roman}'m sure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過我們先別灰心，我相信一定會找到辦法的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But listen carefully.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但仔細聽好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But maybe you are more interested in our famous floating water fountain?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過也許你對我們著名的漂浮噴水池更有興趣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But most creatures cannot be tamed, so hunters extract what we call a Shard.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但大多數生物無法被馴服，所以獵人會萃取出我們所謂的§9碎片§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But mum insists {roman} finish my studies first.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但媽媽堅持要我先把功課做完。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But never again have {roman} gotten fooled
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但從此我再也沒被騙過

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But not everybody knows they stay big longer around here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但不是每個人都知道它們在這附近會大比較久。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But not from me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但不是從我這裡拿。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But not those who talk about their auctions, yuck
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但不包括那些在講自己拍賣品的人，噁

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But now, me eat items, give Motes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但現在，我吃物品，給§d微粒§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But once elected, he discovered he could make a positive impact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但當選之後，他發現自己能帶來正面的影響。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But one day he finds a strange character, and in their memories he sees things he should have never seen...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但有一天他遇到了一個奇怪的角色，在那人的記憶裡看到了他不該看到的東西……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But one of them is that Shen is ALWAYS the richest person.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但其中一個就是§6 Shen §f永遠都是§6最有錢§f的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But remember, every choice has consequences.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但記住，每個選擇都有後果。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But since we already broke the {0}th wall, maybe we can use this opportunity to break this other wall.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但既然我們已經打破了第 {0}§e 面牆§f，也許可以趁這個機會把這面牆也打破。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But since you've disturbed my geological meditation, perhaps we can make this interruption worthwhile.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過既然你打擾了我的地質冥想，也許我們可以讓這次打擾變得有價值。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But since {roman} never stepped into the portal...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但既然我從來沒踏進過那個§d傳送門§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But sometimes, when {roman}'m alone in the Gallery...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但有時候，當我獨自待在§d藝廊§f裡……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But such an aura...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但這股氣場……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But thank you for listening, {roman} appreciate it a lot
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過謝謝你聽我說，我真的很感激

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But that doesn't stop the player from creating their own stories and experiences within the game.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但這不會阻止玩家在遊戲裡創造自己的故事和體驗。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But that is still too early for you to learn.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過現在學這個對你來說還太早了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But the bee still stung me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但那隻蜜蜂還是螫了我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But the flames are never wrong...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但火焰從來不會錯……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But the job is pretty chill.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過這份工作挺輕鬆的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But the other two are empty.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但另外§c兩個§f是空的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But the truth is, {roman} really like it here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但事實是，我真的很喜歡這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But then {roman} broke my axe!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：結果我把斧頭弄壞了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But there are two things about it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但它有§e兩§f個特點！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But there are various types of monsters out there you can Hunt.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過外面還有各種你可以§a狩獵§f的怪物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But there is more...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過還有更多……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But there is no point arguing
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過吵也沒用

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But this time the inspector he framed escaped the justice system and hunts him down.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但這次被他陷害的警探逃過了司法制裁，反過來追捕他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But time does not flow in the Rift.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但§a時間§f在§d隙界§f裡不會流動。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But to which point in time...?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但是是哪個時間點……？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But we are right on his tail. {roman} can feel it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但我們已經緊追在他身後了。我感覺得到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But we need something stronger!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但我們需要更強的東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But what exactly was that monster?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但那隻怪物到底是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But who would vote for me
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但誰會投給我呢

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But why do you have this, are you interested in that kind of magical technology?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但你為什麼會有這個？你對這種魔法科技有興趣嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But why not retreat?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但為什麼不撤退呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But why would anyone do that? And who did it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但為什麼會有人做這種事？又是誰做的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But you already beat my game previously.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但你之前已經贏過我的遊戲了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But you can get a much quicker time if you use the items that {roman} do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但如果你用我用的那些物品，可以跑得快很多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But you can only open one of these boxes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但你只能打開其中一個箱子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: But you know what else is strange?

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back next time wearing our matching hat.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back to me when you reach Heart of the {area} Tier {0}.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back when you are Mining Level {roman}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你挖掘等級達到 {roman} 再來吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back when you are ready, hurry up!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back when you have enough for the tip.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back when you have unlocked the rest of {island} if you want to give it a try!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back when you're actually ready!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你真的準備好了再來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back when you're {area} Milestone {0}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你達到{area}§6里程碑 {0}§f 再來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back when {roman} am hungry again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等我又餓了再來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back with a caffeinated beverage, thanks!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：帶一杯§6含咖啡因的§f飲料回來，謝啦！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come back with the right amount of items!
