entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come on down to the basement, the auction is about to begin!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快下來地下室，拍賣會就要開始了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come on! Get it, you are gonna miss it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快啊！去抓牠，你要錯過了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come on, use the murder weapon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來吧，使用兇器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come see me in the hub anyway!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之還是來大廳找我吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come see me in the {island} to claim your reward!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來{island}找我領取你的獎勵吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come see me later and {roman}'ll tell you all about them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：晚點來找我，我會把牠們的事全都告訴你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come talk to me and {roman}'ll show you how many corpses we, the dream team, have gathered together!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來找我談，我就讓你看看我們這支夢幻隊伍一起收集了多少屍體！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come talk to me first!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：先來跟我談談！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come talk to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來跟我談談！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come to me if you want some Potion Effects to help you in your journey!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想要一些§d藥水效果§f幫助你的旅程，就來找我吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come, let us make haste to the {area} and apprehend him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來吧，我們趕快去{area}逮捕他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come, my brethren, and let us rejoice!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來吧，我的兄弟們，讓我們歡慶吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Come, see what {roman} have on offer for you today.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，看看我今天為你準備了什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Commissions inside the {island} are different from the ones in the {island2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{island}裡的委託跟{island2}裡的不一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Complete the Trial of Blue {resource} {roman}, and {roman2}'ll upgrade your badge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：完成§3藍色{resource}試煉 {roman}§f，我就幫你升級徽章！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Complete the Trial of {item} {roman} and {roman2}'ll upgrade your badge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：完成§6{item}試煉 {roman} §f，我就幫你升級徽章！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Confirm your identity for me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：向我證明你的身分。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congrats on completing tier {0}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§a：恭喜你完成第 {0}§a 階！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congrats on completing tier {roman}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a恭喜你完成第 {roman}§a 階！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations on beating every single Trial of Blue {resource}! You're the real fire guy, hotshot!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜你通過了每一場§3藍色{resource}試煉§f！你才是真正的火焰達人，高手！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations on becoming a proud owner of an Abiphone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜你成為§3Abiphone§f的驕傲擁有者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations on getting the first ever fairy soul!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜你找到人生第一個妖精之魂！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations on mastering the trials of my {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜你精通了我{area}的試煉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations on obtaining the mrahcemiT esrevrorriM!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜你取得了§c符護之時鏡反§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a恭喜！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations! You can now come and go as you please!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜！你現在可以自由進出了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations! You've mastered the art of ignoring obvious instructions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜！你已經精通了無視明顯指示的藝術。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations, you got the reward.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜，你得到獎勵了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations, you got the {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜，你得到了{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜你，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Congratulations, {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恭喜你，{player}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Contribute to community projects, upgrade your account, and more by talking to {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：找{npc2}談談，就能贊助社群計畫、升級你的帳戶等等！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Conveniently for you, {roman}'ve got just what you need!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真巧，我正好有你需要的東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Conversely, the New Starborns engaged actively with the Precursors, reveling in their advancements and guiding their progress.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：相反地，新生星裔則積極與先驅者互動，樂見他們的進步並引導他們的發展。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Cool! Anyways, there's just one thing you have to do before you can join.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：酷！總之，加入之前你只要做一件事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Cool, cool...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：酷，酷……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Cool.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：酷。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Coot Coot Cluck, Puk Puk Pukaaak!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：咯咯咯，噗噗噗咯～！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Corpses are raised into a powerful army fueled by pain, misery and anguish.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：屍體被喚醒，成為一支以痛苦、悲慘與煎熬為燃料的§a強大軍隊§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Corrupted Monsters rarely appear on the island, it usually means they consumed too much {collections_res}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§2腐化怪物§f很少出現在島上，這通常表示牠們吃了太多{collections_res}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you bring a stack of {item} to help replenish my stock?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能帶一組{item}來幫我補貨嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you bring me an animal? You can find them all over the island!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能帶一隻動物給我嗎？島上到處都找得到！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you bring me some emerald?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能帶一些§a綠寶石§f給我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you bring me some food until he gets here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在他來之前，你能帶點食物給我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you bring me {0} of this food?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能帶 {0} 個這種食物給我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you find my dear {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我找找我親愛的{npc2}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you find some gold for me, please?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我找些§6黃金§f嗎？拜託了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you give me a hand? If you help clear out some of these monsters, {roman}'ll pay you for it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我個忙嗎？如果你幫忙清掉一些怪物，我會付你錢的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you go check up on him?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能去看看他嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you help me and bring me some flowers? Most flowers cannot spawn on the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我帶一些花來嗎？{island}上大部分的花都長不出來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you help me fix it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我修好它嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you help me getting them back inside?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我把牠們弄回裡面嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you help me out with my farm?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我打理我的農場嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you help out and get some flowers?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫忙找一些花嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you lend me a hand here, {roman} can explain everything!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我一把嗎？我可以§a解釋一切§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you please bring me {0} {resource} and {1} {resource2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能幫我帶 {0} 條{resource}和 {1} 條{resource2}來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you please refrain from summoning the other Shens?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可以請你別再召喚其他 Shen 了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Could you shear all my sheep at once?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能一次幫我把所有的羊都剪毛嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Courage, {player}. {roman} know that you are more than capable to see this through to the end.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鼓起勇氣，{player}。我知道你絕對有能力把這件事堅持到最後。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Craft a {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：合成一個{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Craft one using enough {item}. Point it at an ore, and bam! You've aged it faster than cheese left in the sun.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用足夠的{item}製作一把。把它對準礦石，砰！你讓它老化得比放在太陽底下的起司還快。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Crazy stuff!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f:§c Crazy §fstuff：太瘋狂了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Crazy to think {roman} could improve so much in a week.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真難想像我能在一週內進步這麼多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Crossing through it is a daunting task, but not entirely impossible.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：穿越§5它§f是件艱鉅的任務，但並非完全不可能。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Cutting down enough Fig or Mangrove Trees will level up your milestones and grant extra {stats}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：砍倒足夠多的§a無花果樹§f或§a紅樹林樹§f，就能提升你的里程碑等級並獲得額外的{stats}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Cya losers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：掰啦，魯蛇們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: DID {roman} STUTTER?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c§l§o我有結巴嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: DIRT!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：泥土！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: DISGUSTING!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c§l太噁心了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: DO YOU WANT TO BE PULVERIZED?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你想被打成碎片嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Damaging {pet} directly is futile. His thick skin is impenetrable with conventional weapons!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：直接攻擊{pet}§f是沒用的。§c牠的厚皮是一般武器打不穿的§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dante made you obey. {roman}'ll make you thrive.
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：Dante 讓你服從。我會讓你茁壯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dante wanted order. {roman} want balance.
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：Dante 想要秩序。我想要平衡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dare you pay it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你敢付嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dark path, start once down the consume, it will.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：黑暗之路，一旦開始吞噬，它就會。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dark, right?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很黑暗吧？！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Darn humans, you don't understand how to use things...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惡的人類，你們根本不懂怎麼用東西……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Darn it, {roman}'ll have to find another farmer then.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惡，那我只好去找別的農夫了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Day, night, tenebrous void...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：白天、黑夜、§5陰暗的虛空§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dear, sorry for the inconvenience...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：親愛的，抱歉給你添麻煩了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Deep in these caves lays the nest of the Dragons, where you will find only peril.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這些洞穴深處是§5龍§f的巢穴，那裡只有危險在等著你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Democracy has never been this simple!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§b民主§f從來沒有這麼簡單過！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Depending on the timeline, this might be your fate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：取決於時間線，這可能就是你的命運。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Deposit your Coins before the Flaming Spiders get to you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在§c火焰蜘蛛§f找上你之前，先把你的§6遊戲幣§f存起來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Deposit your Coins before the {collections_res} Bulls get to you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在{collections_res}§c公牛§f找上你之前，先把你的§6遊戲幣§f存起來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Despite the name, it's not the best one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然名字這樣叫，但它並不是最好的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Despite the wars raging at the time, we were still able to unite and beat this common enemy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：儘管當時戰火連天，我們還是團結起來，打敗了這個共同的敵人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did he find Dante here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§6他§f是在這裡找到§c Dante §f的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did he have anything for me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他有東西要給我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did it fly over here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠是飛過來的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did it spend most of its time hunting on land, or was it more of an aquatic forager?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠大部分時間是在陸地上狩獵，還是比較像在水中覓食？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did ya hear that, {player}? That's the sound of an empty stomach.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽到了嗎，{player}？那是空肚子的聲音。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you check out the Cult over in the {area} yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你去看過{area}§f那邊的§c邪教§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you come to free us from the everlasting threat of the wizards?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是來把我們從巫師永無止境的威脅中解救出來的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you craft a {item} yet? Here's the recipe!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你合成{item}了嗎？這是配方！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you even agree to do this?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有答應要做這件事嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you find anything?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有找到什麼嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you forget the tip?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你忘了情報嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you get lost?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你迷路了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you get some flowers yet? You could pick {0} Poppies and turn them into {item} Dye in your crafting grid, then bring them back to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你摘到花了嗎？你可以摘 {0}§e 朵罌粟§f，在合成格裡把它們做成{item}§e染料§f，再帶回來給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you hear that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽到了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you just say "Gala-tee"?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你剛剛是說「Gala-tee」嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you just... fix the breach?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你剛剛……§5§o修好了裂縫§r§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you kill him to steal his ring of love?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你殺了他，是為了偷走他的§d愛之戒§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you know he likes photography?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道他喜歡§e攝影§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you know that chickens drop eggs and cows can be milked?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道雞會下蛋、牛可以擠奶嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you know that for the longest time...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道很長一段時間以來……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you know that the Forge is so big it has to have multiple forging stations.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，鍛造坊大到必須設好幾個鍛造站。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you know the Court is almost as old as the throne room, it's got some lovely flower beds too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道宮廷幾乎跟王座廳一樣古老嗎？那裡還有很漂亮的花圃！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you know you can access your {area} from {island}? Check out the {area2} in the center of the village!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道你可以在{island}使用你的{area}嗎？去村莊中央的{area2}看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you lose the first chicken ever?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你把史上第一隻雞弄丟了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you not listen to me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你沒在聽我說話嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Did you talk with my brothers?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你跟我的§a兄弟們§f聊過了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Didn't believe them one bit
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我一點都不相信

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Different animals also have unique abilities too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不同的動物也有各自獨特的能力！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Different tiers of animals have different sets of abilities.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不同階級的動物有不同的能力組合。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Difficult to predict.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很難預料。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dig through gravel and you should be able to find a relic.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：挖開礫石，你應該就能找到一個遺物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Directly to {npc2} at {area} shop? A judicious choice, indeed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：直接到{area}§a店裡§f找{npc2} §f？確實是明智的選擇。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dirty!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：髒髒！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Disappointing, maybe one day you will believe.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真令人失望，也許有一天你會相信的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Distracted people sometimes lose their {item} and he sells them back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：粗心的人有時會弄丟他們的{item}，他會把它們賣回去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Disturbing... the visions must have been wrong.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：令人不安……那些景象一定是錯的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do Golden Carrots taste different than normal ones? {roman}'ve actually never tried one before so {roman2} am pretty curious how they taste like.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：金胡蘿蔔吃起來跟普通的不一樣嗎？我其實從來沒吃過，所以很好奇是什麼味道。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do not attack our young, else we will put you down.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別攻擊我們的孩子，否則我們會解決你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do not eat the silk.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c不要§f吃那些絲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do not rush the almighty {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別催促全能的{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do not talk to me, we are not the same.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別跟我說話，我們不一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do that, and then we can talk!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做到了，我們再來談！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do things always have to get better? Spice is all that matters.
entries.value: §d[NPC] {npc}§f：事情總是要變得更好嗎？只有刺激才重要。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you even know what you are looking for? Maybe a book or a magical item?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道自己要找什麼嗎？也許是一本書或一件魔法物品？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you ever feel like we're just programmed to do certain things in life?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有沒有覺得我們好像只是被設定好去做人生中的某些事？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you have any idea how many {collections_res} Bulls {roman}'ll have to go through just to find a single high-quality mushroom?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道為了找到一顆高品質的蘑菇，我得解決多少隻{collections_res}公牛嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you have any pumpkins {roman} can wear as a mask while down in the {area}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有沒有南瓜能讓我在{area}底下當面具戴？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you have anymore questions?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還有其他問題嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you have no shame?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不覺得丟臉嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you have the faintest idea who you're talking to? {roman} won't forget this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有一點點概念你在跟誰說話嗎？我不會忘記這件事的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you have {item}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有{item}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you know the origin of the word utopia?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道「烏托邦」這個詞的由來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you know what this means??
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道這代表什麼嗎？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you know why we can see the future inside the flames?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道為什麼我們能在火焰中看到未來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you like my cats?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你喜歡我的貓嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you like my collection of Trophies?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你喜歡我的戰利品收藏嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you need anything else to solve your case?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還需要什麼來破案嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you need some items again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你又需要一些物品了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you need the help of {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你需要{npc2}的幫忙嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you need the ring again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你又需要那枚戒指了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you need to find {npc2}'s Ring again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你需要再找一次{npc2}的戒指嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you really have what it takes to fight {pet}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你真的有能耐挑戰{pet}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you recognize me? {roman} changed my armor!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你認得我嗎？我換了盔甲！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you think the Epic {pet} can dance?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得§5史詩{pet}§f會跳舞嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you think the Hero was a man or a woman? There is so little information that remains...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得英雄是男的還是女的？留下的資訊實在太少了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you think they were born that way, or became?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得他們是天生的，還是後天變成的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you think they'd let me bring snowballs in here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得他們會讓我把雪球帶進來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you want access?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你想進去嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you want me to tell the story?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你想要我說這個故事嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you want to change your Faction?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你想換派系嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you want to hear more about that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你想多聽一點嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Do you want to play another match?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你想再比一場嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dodging giant, triple-stacked, INSTAKILLING temporal pillars...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：閃避巨大的、三層疊起來的、§c一擊必殺§f的時間之柱……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dogen, Kirva, and Daydro perished and fell in the void, to my knowledge.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：據我所知，Dogen、Kirva 和 Daydro 都喪命並墜入了虛空。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dolphins... smart and slippery. They'll flee to their dolphin holes if you're not quick enough.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：海豚……聰明又滑溜。如果你不夠快，牠們就會逃回海豚洞。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't ask me why and let's keep it between us.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別問我為什麼，這件事就你知我知。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't be selfish! This {collections_res} is too good to waste. We've got enough to share with everyone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別這麼自私！這些{collections_res}太好了，不能浪費。我們的量夠分給每個人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't care!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：都無所謂！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't come asking me for help anytime soon...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別想我很快會幫你……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't disrespect your elders.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別對長輩無禮。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't feel pressured to give me any more... {roman} don't deserve this...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別覺得有壓力要再給我……我不配……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't feel too bad about killing those Magma Cubes, they will be born again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：殺那些岩漿立方怪別太難過，牠們會再生的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't forget to look down those caves, there are plenty down there lying around.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別忘了往那些洞穴裡面看看，下面散落著很多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't forget to refill your spray can with dye! You can pick some of the flowers in my garden if you want to.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別忘了幫你的噴漆罐補充染料！想要的話，可以摘我花園裡的花。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't forget you can RIGHT-CLICK Foraging axes to throw them into the air!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別忘了，你可以對伐木斧§e§l按右鍵§f，把它們§c丟到空中§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't forget your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別忘了你的{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't get caught by the guards!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別被守衛抓到！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't go easy on me, {roman}'m very bad but {roman2} only have a week to improve.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別對我手下留情，我很弱，但我只有一週的時間進步。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't kill me!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別殺我！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't know what equipment to aim for?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不知道該追求什麼裝備嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't let their cute looks fool you, those things were predators!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別被牠們可愛的外表騙了，那些傢伙可是掠食者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't remind me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別讓我想起來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't talk to strangers, little {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別跟陌生人說話，小{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't tell him {roman} said that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別告訴他是我說的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't tell mum this, but {roman} just use {command} to open it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別跟媽媽說，但我都直接用{command}打開它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't tell the wizard about me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別跟巫師提起我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't tell {npc2}. Maybe tell. No don't tell.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別告訴{npc2}。也許告訴。不，別告訴。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't touch that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別碰那個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't want to work on fish.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不想處理這條魚。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't worry about it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別在意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't worry, {roman} got you covered!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別擔心，交給我吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't worry, {roman}'ve got a stash ready.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別擔心，我已經準備好一批存貨了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Don't you think what you are doing is wrong?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不覺得你在做的事是錯的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dont ask me why, {roman} have no idea!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別問我為什麼，我也不知道！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Door or door not, there is no open.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：門或不門，沒有開這回事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Double order today. She's onto something big.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：今天加倍。她在搞大事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Down here we strive to provide you with the best value--
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這下面，我們努力為您提供最划算的——

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Down there, multiple rooms are blocked by cobwebs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在下面，有好幾個房間被蜘蛛網擋住了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Drills are like pickaxes, but better! They are powered with Drill Fuel, which comes in many different forms.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鑽頭就像鎬子，但更好！它們靠§2鑽頭燃料§f驅動，燃料有很多種形式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Drills are sweet! Too bad you don't have one. {roman} hear you can create them in the Forge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鑽頭很棒的！可惜你沒有。我聽說可以在§6鍛造坊§f做出來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Drop by his shop a little later and {roman}'m sure he will sell you one for cheap!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：晚點去他的店看看，我相信他會便宜賣你一把！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Drop by sometime, it gets pretty lonely out here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有空來坐坐，這裡挺寂寞的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dude, {roman}'m so bored out here. Mind showing me what you've been up to?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：老兄，我在這裡無聊死了。介意讓我看看你最近在忙什麼嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Due to the Rift's nature, we can never be sure if they hail from the past or from a time yet to come.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：由於§d隙界§f的特性，我們永遠無法確定他們是來自過去，還是來自尚未到來的時代。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: During the {event}, you can collect Candy by killing mobs or fishing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在{event}§f期間，你可以透過擊殺怪物或釣魚收集§5糖果§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dwarf Statue, bridge,, loose rocks, treasure...? What a strange dream...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：矮人雕像、橋、碎石、寶藏……？真是個奇怪的夢……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Dyes drop from a variety of different parts of SkyBlock and are extremely rare, so most artists just go with the flow and work with what they have.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：染料會從 SkyBlock 的各種地方掉落，而且§c極為稀有§f，所以大多數藝術家都隨遇而安，有什麼就用什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: ENOUGH!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：夠了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: EXCEPT... Could you enchant it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c只不過§f……你能幫它附魔嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each Mayor also has a {#} Minister Perk, which goes hand-in-hand with the Minister system!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每位§6市長§f也有一個{#}§6部長特權§f，跟§6部長§f制度息息相關！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each Mayor has a perk marked as a "{#} Minister Perk".
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每位§6市長§f都有一個標示為「{#}§6部長特權§f」的§a特權§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each SkyBlock year, {roman} place them throughout the village to spread joy and good tidings.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每個 SkyBlock 年，我都會把它們放在村莊各處，散播歡樂與祝福。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each harbors a unique strategy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們各自有獨特的策略。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each is designed to test your mettle in its own unique way.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每一個都以獨特的方式考驗你的勇氣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each one of them are unique and because they're unique, they're super rare!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每一個都是獨一無二的，而因為獨一無二，所以它們超級§9稀有§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each part - the {resource}, {resource2}, {resource3}, {resource4}, {resource5}, and a {resource6} plays a distinctive role in the creation of this behemoth.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每個零件——{resource}、{resource2}、{resource3}、{resource4}、{resource5}和{resource6}——在這個巨獸的打造中都扮演著獨特的角色。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each revolution of time, {roman} compile the answers from all participants.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每一個時間§5週期§f，我都會彙整所有參加者的答案。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each turn, we will choose a column to drop a colored token into the lowest open slot.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每一回合，我們選一行，把彩色的棋子投進最低的空位。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each with rates respectively, {0}, {1}, {2}, {3} and {4}.
[NPC] {npc}: Each {event}, the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每次{event}，收集最多糖果的玩家還能獲得更恐怖的獎勵！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Each {mob} had a unique domain and wielded immense power.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每一位{mob}都有獨特的領域，並掌握著強大的力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Eager to join our cult {roman} see?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我看你很想加入我們的邪教？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Easy peasy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：輕而易舉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Eating enough of these surely should bring back my taste memories. Thank you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：吃夠多這些，一定能喚回我對味道的記憶。謝謝你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeek!
[NPC] {npc}: Eek, you remind me of someone {roman} need to duel in a week! If you weren't in his faction, maybe you could help me...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：咿，你讓我想起一個我一週後要決鬥的人！如果你不是他§e派系§f的人，也許你能幫我……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Eggcellent!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：「蛋」級棒！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Eh, whatever.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：呃，算了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Either is fine! One has to experience the universe at their own pace.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：兩種都很好！每個人都得用自己的步調體驗這個宇宙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Either way, it's pretty funny. With every new discovery, the {pet} loses a bit more of its mystique.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不管怎樣，這還挺好笑的。每有一個新發現，{pet}的神秘感就少一點。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Either way, you're digging!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不管怎樣，你都得挖！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Embezzling, not this time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：侵吞公款，這次不會了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Emkam is funny at least. But that's about it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：至少 Emkam 很有趣。不過也就這樣了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Emmor is the {npc2} today... sigh.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：今天的{npc2}是 Emmor……唉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：空空的口袋從來不會拖累任何人。只有空洞的腦袋和空虛的心才會。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: En garde!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看招！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ended up with a cup of dust!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：結果變成了一杯灰塵！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ender Pearls are my favorite items
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：終界珍珠是我最喜歡的物品

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ender Pearls attract the attention of Endermen, but Silent Pearls don't! You can get them in my shop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：終界珍珠會吸引終界使者的注意，但§5無聲珍珠§f不會！你可以在我的商店買到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Enjoy our little slice of mining heaven!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好好享受我們這一小片挖礦天堂吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Enjoy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好好享受吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Enough jokes for now...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：笑話先說到這裡……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Enough talking!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別廢話了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Enough with the mages and their shenanigans.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些法師和他們的把戲夠了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Entry demands {0} Motes, a trivial sum for a taste of eternity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：入場需要 {0}§d 微粒§f，對於品嚐永恆而言微不足道。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ere long, {npc2} and {roman} shall pledge our troth and seek to populate our hearth with joyous offspring.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不久之後，{npc2}與吾將立下婚誓，並讓我們的家充滿歡樂的子嗣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Err, from water and other non-Vampire liquids that is.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：呃，我是說喝了水和其他非吸血鬼的液體解渴的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Err...vermin? Swine? Buggers? Y'know...Pests!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：呃……害獸？豬玀？小混蛋？你懂的……§6害蟲§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Erren keeps losing at {item}, but he loves the game. A brave man in a way.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Erren 玩{item}老是輸，但他很愛這個遊戲。某種程度上算是個勇敢的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Especially if it's after our {collections_res}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：尤其如果牠是衝著我們的{collections_res}來的話。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Especially one who is so ill-prepared!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：尤其是準備這麼§c不足§f的人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Especially stabilized by the aura of the nearby Fairy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：尤其是被附近§d仙女§f的氣場穩定住了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Especially those mayor candidates
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：尤其是那些市長候選人

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Especially when playing with others!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：尤其是跟其他人一起玩的時候！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Especially with all those strange machines and experiments. {roman} need your help again... let's meet back in the lab.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：尤其是那些奇怪的機器和實驗。我又需要你的幫忙了……我們在實驗室見吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Eureka!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我找到了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Even bad moments can be blessings in disguise
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就算是不好的時刻，也可能是塞翁失馬

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Even better, YOU choose what stats you get!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：更棒的是，你可以自己選擇要獲得哪些屬性！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Even if you possessed that power, {roman} doubt someone like you could read our texts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就算你擁有那種力量，我也懷疑像你這樣的人讀得懂我們的文獻。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Even the people who created the word knew it was a paradox
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就連創造這個詞的人都知道它是個悖論

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Even you {roman}'m sure
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我相信你也是

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Even {npc2}, a powerful wizard...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就連{npc2}，一個強大的巫師……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Evening, adventurer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：晚安，冒險者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ever been in one of these before? No?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你以前搭過這種東西嗎？沒有？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ever considered punching something? Say, a hologram?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有沒有考慮過打點別的東西？比如說，全像投影？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ever heard of {collections_res}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽說過{collections_res}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ever seen a faint glow in the dirt? Could be treasure... or a {mob}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有沒有看過泥土裡微微發光？可能是寶藏……也可能是{mob}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ever thought you'd see a Tier {0} Minion?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有想過會看到 {0} 級的工人嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every Shard you collect goes into your Hunting Box, located in the Hunting Skill Menu.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你收集的每一個碎片都會進入你的§a狩獵箱§f，它位於§a狩獵技能選單§f裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every coin you earn, every drop you sweat, will help everyone.
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：你賺的每一枚金幣、流的每一滴汗，都會幫助所有人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every crop you harvest gives your tool experience, leveling it up over time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你收成的每一株作物都會給你的工具§b經驗§f，讓它隨著時間升級。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every few months, a Special Mayor enters the running.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每隔幾個§b月§f，就會有一位§d特別市長§f參選。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every mob has at least one type, which you can see next to its name.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每隻生物至少有§a一種§f類型，你可以在牠的名字旁邊看到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every problem in life can be solved with a little redstone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：人生中的每個問題，都能用一點§c紅石§f解決。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every single book is imbued so that only true mages can pull them out.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每一本書都被施了法，只有真正的法師才能把它們抽出來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every time you syphon more of a Shard, that attribute will grow stronger.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每次你§c汲取§f更多同一種碎片，那個§c屬性§f就會變得更強。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every time {roman} look, it somehow gets worse!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每次我看，它都不知怎麼地變得更糟！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every word has reached my ears.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每一句話我都聽見了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every {0} years there is a global tournament to the death with all the strongest warriors in the world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每 {0} 年會舉辦一場全球性的死亡錦標賽，參賽的是世界上所有最強的戰士。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every {0} years there is a special battle royale tournament with the previous {1} winners.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每 {0} 年會舉辦一場特別的大逃殺錦標賽，參賽的是前 {1} 屆的冠軍。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every {0} {1}, your speed cap will be reduced by {2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每 {0} {1}，你的速度上限就會降低 {2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Every. Single. One.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每。一。隻。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Everybody knows mushrooms pop out when walking nearby.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大家都知道蘑菇會在有人走近時冒出來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Everyone has one around here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這附近每個人都有一個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Everyone is always a complete lack of surprise.
entries.value: §d[NPC] {npc}§f：每個人都永遠一點驚喜都沒有。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Everyone knows time travel is a myth!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大家都知道時間旅行是個神話！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Everyone votes for their favorite candidate...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每個人都投給自己§d最喜歡的§f候選人……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Everyone wants to do like everyone else
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每個人都想跟別人做一樣的事

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Everything has a value, and time is money
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼東西都有價值，時間就是金錢

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Everything makes sense now...{roman}'m sorry {roman2} yelled at you {npc2}. {roman3}'m so sorry.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在一切都說得通了……{npc2}，對不起我對你大吼。我真的很抱歉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ew! That's definitely an {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噁！那絕對是{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Exactly what {roman} needed. {roman2} think {roman3} will take the remainder of the day off.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：正是我需要的。我想今天剩下的時間就休息吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Exactly. It represents the creature's biological footprint, its core attribute.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒錯。它代表該生物的生物足跡，也就是牠的核心§c屬性§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Excellent work!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幹得好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Excellent!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Excellent! {roman}'m the Captain of this Ship, which means {roman2} oversee everything from repairs to navigation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了！我是這艘§6船§f的船長，從維修到航行，一切都由我負責。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Excellent. Let's find out if you are merely another echo, or if you are the one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好。讓我們看看你只是另一個回音，還是那個§d天選之人§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Except her, {roman} never liked her.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：除了她，我從來就不喜歡她。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Except that some Trees are tougher than others!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只不過有些樹比其他樹更硬！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Except {roman} need hotter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只是我需要§c更燙的§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Excuse me, can't you see we are trying to have a conversation here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不好意思，你沒看到我們正在談話嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Excuse me, {roman} was enjoying some peace and quiet, contemplating the sedimentary layers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不好意思，我剛剛正享受著寧靜，沉思著沉積岩層。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Excuse me. You really scared me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不好意思。你真的嚇到我了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Excuse my manners, my name is {npc2} and {roman} live next door... or should {roman2} rather say next "island".
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恕我失禮，我叫{npc2}，我住在隔壁……或者我該說隔壁「島」。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Exemplary! Your choice was among the closest {0} to half of the averages!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：堪稱典範！你的選擇是最接近平均值一半的前 {0} 之一！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Exhausted? me? No no no.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：累了？我？不不不。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Expecting a breach soon? Then we must gear up.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：預計很快就會被突破？那我們得做好準備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Exploring the whole wide world makes me hungry, {roman} could take some fresh potatoes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：走遍整個世界讓我肚子好餓，我想要一些新鮮的馬鈴薯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: FINE, YOU MAY PASS!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，你可以通過！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Fairies always stick together!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：妖精們總是團結在一起！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Fairies lived in the castle for a while, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§d：你知道嗎，妖精曾經在這座城堡裡住過一段時間喔？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Fairy Souls, of {roman}'ve never heard?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：仙女之魂，我從沒聽過？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Fancy seeing you here, friend! Today is a special day for me, as {roman} am seeing {npc2}! Think you can help me get her some flowers?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真巧在這裡碰到你，朋友！今天對我來說是個特別的日子，因為我要去見{npc2}！你能幫我弄些花給她嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Fantastic!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a太棒了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Fantastic, that's all {roman} needed to build the traps.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了，這就是我做§5陷阱§f所需的一切了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Fantastic, you've found the floor.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了，你找到地板了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Farewell dear friend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再會了，親愛的朋友。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Farming using one of these tools also gives you Sowdust, which will be essential in upgrading your Chips!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用這些工具耕作還會給你§2耕塵§f，這對升級你的§9晶片§f至關重要！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Feed 'em bamboo, and they might just love you for a second.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：餵牠們竹子，牠們說不定會愛你一下下。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Feel free to analyze any mutations you find!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到的任何突變都歡迎拿來分析！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Feel free to harvest any crops on the island, {roman}'m taking a break.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：島上的作物隨你收成，我要休息一下。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Feel free to look around!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：隨便看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Feel free to return if curiosity strikes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你好奇了，隨時歡迎回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Feel free to visit my laboratory.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎參觀我的實驗室。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Feel the surge of power coursing through your veins, a testament to your enduring spirit and the time spent within these walls.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：感受那股在你血管中奔騰的力量，那是你堅忍精神與在這些牆內度過之時光的證明。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Feels bad man, this is just terrible.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：感覺好糟，這真是太可怕了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Fertilized... precious!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Get up there!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Go

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Go find him!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：去找他吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Go find them North of the {area}!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Go find {npc2}, learn how to fish, and then we'll talk!

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：去吧，試著在融合機裡把碎片融合在一起。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Go out there and vacuum a Pest!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：出去用§a吸塵器§f吸一隻害蟲吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Go see for yourself. Take this {resource} and use the {item} to spray a plot.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你自己去看看吧。拿著這塊{resource}，用{item}噴灑一塊地塊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Go talk to him if you want to learn more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想了解更多就去找他談吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Go to the {area} to place it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：去{area}放置它！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Goblins are plentiful in other areas of the mines, but {roman}'m yet to find any down here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哥布林在礦坑其他區域到處都是，但我在這底下還沒找到過。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Goblins don't really think for themselves most of the time, and prefer to blindly follow the herd.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哥布林大多數時候不會自己思考，比較喜歡盲目跟隨群體。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Going to need a few more than that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還需要多一點！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Going to need someone wicked smart to solve it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：得找個超級§b聰明§f的人才解得開。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Golly gee - {roman} want to spread joy around the world, in the form of raw materials!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：天啊——我想用原物料的形式，把歡樂散播到全世界！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Good choice! You can equip that beauty by right-clicking it while it's in your hand.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Good initiative, my dear friend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很有主動精神，親愛的朋友。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Good job everyone. A hard fought battle come to an end. Let's get out of here before we run into any more trouble!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大家做得好。一場艱苦的戰鬥終於結束了。我們趁還沒遇上更多麻煩趕快離開這裡吧！

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好，夥伴。現在我們只需要§6等待§f那些害蟲出現的§a最佳時機§f。

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的天啊。

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：祝你好運！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Good luck.

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好！我最近做附魔書的紙快用完了，你能帶一些{collections_res}給我嗎？

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，冒險者！

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大家！！你們要集中攻擊觸手！

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：祝你找蛋愉快！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Happy growl Now... MUCH better.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：開心地咕嚕一聲 現在……好多了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hard times we are in. Take care!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們正處於艱難的時期。保重！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hardly skilled, but {roman}'ll let it pass. Come talk to me for your next challenge, and do better in the future.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幾乎稱不上有技巧，不過我就讓你過吧。來找我接受下一個挑戰，以後要做得更好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have a go at cutting down this Fig Tree behind me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試著把我身後這棵無花果樹砍倒吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have a good day! Make sure you come back later to check my stock!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：祝你有美好的一天！記得晚點再來看看我的存貨！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have a look and see if theres anything you like.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看有沒有你喜歡的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have a nice day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：祝你有美好的一天。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have fun with that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：祝你玩得開心！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have fun!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：玩得開心！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have fun.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：玩得開心。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have patience, {roman}'m getting you in right now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：耐心點，我現在就送你進去！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have this {item}! {roman} wear it sometimes to make me feel like an {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個{item}給你！我有時候會戴著它，假裝自己是{pet}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have ya ever needed to talk to or buy something from an NPC, but they're on a different island?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有沒有遇過需要跟某個 NPC 說話或買東西，但他們卻在另一座島上的情況？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you been to the {island}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你去過{island}了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you changed your mind?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你改變主意了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you confronted any of the Elites in your dimension yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你已經跟你維度裡的任何一位菁英交手過了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you dipped your toes into the world of Hunting?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你接觸過§a狩獵§f的世界了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you enchanted your axe with {enchantment} {roman}? It'll help ya break stuff a lot faster.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你幫你的斧頭附上{enchantment} {roman} 了嗎？它能讓你破壞東西快很多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you encountered any boosters?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你遇過§9強化器§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you encountered {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你遇過{npc2}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you even tried to understand them?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有試著去了解牠們嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you ever heard about {stats}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽說過{stats}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you ever heard tales of the Fish Family?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽過§a魚之家族§f的傳說嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you ever thought about that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有想過這個嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you ever tried eating a Glistening {collections_res}? It's not easy, let me tell you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有沒有試過吃閃爍的{collections_res}？告訴你，那可不容易！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you ever wanted to change fate?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有沒有想過改變命運？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you explored... {#}inhales{#2}... the depths of the lake yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你探索過……{#}吸氣{#2}……湖的深處了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you found the Epic {pet} yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到§5史詩{pet} §f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you found the Legendary {pet} yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到§6傳奇{pet} §f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you found the Mythic {pet} yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到§d神話{pet} §f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you found the Rare {pet} yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到§9稀有{pet} §f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you found the evil wizard machine?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到邪惡巫師的機器了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you found the full Ender Armor Set yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到整套§5終界盔甲了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you got the SkyBlock Citizen Timecharm?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你拿到§cSkyBlock 公民時之護符§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you got yourself a Huntrap yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你弄到§c狩獵陷阱§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you grasped all the details, little one?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你都了解了嗎，小傢伙？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you heard about the rare relics on this island?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽說過這座島上的稀有遺物嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you heard of the Cult of the {event}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽說過{event}邪教嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you met the Shen from your own dimension yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你見過你自己維度的 Shen 了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you met {npc2}? He's my brother. We're the {resource} Bros!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你見過{npc2}嗎？他是我兄弟。我們是{resource}兄弟！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you noticed how everyone around here kind of resembles a Vampire?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有沒有注意到這附近的每個人都有點像吸血鬼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you noticed how...never mind you wouldn't understand.
entries.value: §d[NPC] {npc}§f：你有沒有注意到……算了，你不會懂的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you picked up a Specialized Farming Tool yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你拿到§e專用農具§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you refuelled the Composter yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你幫堆肥機加燃料了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you saved {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你救了{npc2}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you seen moles wearing human clothes before?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你以前看過穿人類衣服的鼴鼠嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you seen the monster behind you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有看到你後面的怪物嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you spelunked the {island}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你探索過{island}了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you spoken to my mate {npc2} over in {island} yet? He could probably use your help.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你跟{island}那邊的夥伴{npc2}聊過了嗎？他大概用得上你的幫忙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you talked to {npc2}, she knows all about Fusions!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你跟{npc2}§f聊過了嗎？她對§5融合§f瞭若指掌！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you tried lava fishing before?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你試過§2岩漿釣魚§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you tried running {island} Race yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你試過{island}§d賽跑§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you uncovered more clues, my dear?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：親愛的，你找到更多線索了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have you yet noticed these {0} boxes next to me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你注意到我旁邊這 {0} 個箱子了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Have {roman} met you before? {roman2} am getting some dejavu.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們以前見過嗎？我有種似曾相識的感覺。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He REALLY wanted to become mayor again, to no avail.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他真的很想再當一次市長，卻沒能如願。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He always hated {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他一直都很恨{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He changed his name to {npc2} because it was better for business, he said
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他說他把名字改成{npc2}，因為這樣對生意比較好

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He doesn't usually sell them but he's my friend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他平常不賣這個，但他是我的朋友。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He doesn't want to face reality!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他不想面對現實！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He doesn't want to hear us out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他不想聽我們的心聲！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He hast retreated to his abode, consumed by fear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他已退回他的§c住所§f，被§6恐懼§f吞噬。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He invented the bank!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他發明了銀行！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He is out there in the wild looking for precious ingredients and he should have been back a long time ago.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他到荒野去找珍貴的材料，早就應該回來了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He just disappeared one day!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他有一天就這樣消失了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He keeps losing it...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他一直把它弄丟……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He left behind this {item}. {roman} want you to have it, as you have proven to be the best of the best!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他留下了這個{item}。我想把它送給你，因為你已經證明了自己是最強中的最強！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He lies in rest, rejuvenated and eager for your return.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他正在休息，恢復了精力，渴望你的歸來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He might be fighting the Mage Faction as we speak.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他現在可能正在跟法師派系戰鬥。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He might be nearby, let me know if you find anything.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他可能就在附近，找到什麼就告訴我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He must become stronger, in preparation for a hardship that has yet to come.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他必須變得更強，為一場尚未到來的磨難做好準備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He now uh... "studies" the Rift across.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他現在呃……在對面§6§o「研究」§f§d隙界§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He owns all the {resource} on the island, find him and you'll find the items.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：島上所有的{resource}都是他的，找到他就能找到那些物品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He propelled the Precursors far into the future, hoping that by then, others could stand against them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他把先驅者推進了遙遠的未來，希望到那時，有其他人能與他們抗衡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He regularly runs events at a nearby house, but only under the cover of night.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他固定在附近的一棟房子舉辦活動，但只在夜色的掩護下。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He said he was getting groceries at the downtown markets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他說他要去市中心的市場買菜。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He said {roman} had to pay him instead
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他說是我要付錢給他

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He says he can't leave his house but {roman}'ve seen him walking around all the time...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他說他不能離開家，但我一直看到他到處走來走去……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He says he's getting equipment for a duel.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他說他要去準備決鬥的裝備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He sells a whole bunch of high-end Abiphones with more features, you should check it out sometime!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他賣一大堆功能更多的高階 Abiphone，你應該找個時間去看看！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He told me he's in his home.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他跟我說他在§a他家§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He told me the moral of the story is that birds are stupid
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他告訴我，這個故事的寓意是鳥很笨

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He wanted me to have this? So sweet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他想把這個送給我？§d好貼心§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He was a very skillful farmer... not like me... {roman} have two left thumbs when it comes to farming.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他是個技術高超的農夫……不像我……說到種田，我簡直笨手笨腳。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He was in my promotion back then
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他那時候跟我同一屆

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He was tired of working for peanuts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為牠受夠了只領花生當薪水。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He wears glasses and blends well in a crowd!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他戴著眼鏡，很容易混在人群裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He went to where gold is smelted.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他去了熔煉§6黃金§f的地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He wouldn't let you leave so ill-prepared.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他不會讓你準備這麼§c不足§f就離開的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He'll be dead soon!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他很快就要§c死§f了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He's acting like he's the best
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他表現得好像自己是最強的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He's always selling information about treasure locations but {roman} always hear that no one finds treasure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他總是在賣寶藏位置的情報，但我老是聽說根本沒人找到寶藏。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He's an overgrown {pet} that keeps on growing infinitely.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他是一隻長得太大的{pet}，會無限地一直長大。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He's at some sort of emerald altar...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他在某個§a綠寶石§f祭壇那裡……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He's been spotted in the Rift on several occasions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人好幾次在§d隙界§f看到他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He's in a cave somewhere under the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他在{area}底下某個洞穴裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He's not that bad, you get used to it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他沒那麼壞啦，習慣就好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: He's so cute when he sleeps. Or she? {roman} don't even know.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他睡覺的時候好可愛。還是她？我甚至不知道。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Head over to the desk, there you can browse SkyMart to order some fuel.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：去辦公桌那邊，你可以在 SkyMart 上瀏覽並訂購燃料。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Head over to the main platform, {roman} will join you when {roman2} get a bite!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：到主平台去，等我釣到東西就去找你們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Head over to your unlocked plot and try to clean it up a bit and then come back to me once you've done so!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：去你解鎖的地塊，試著清理一下，清完再回來找我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Head over to {npc2}, they'll teach you the basics of hunting.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：去找{npc2}，他們會教你狩獵的基礎。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Heard of the Personal {area}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽說過§a個人{area}§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Heard you may got some mushrooms...{roman}'ve been looking for some...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽說你可能有一些蘑菇……我一直在找……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Heavy Pearls have many, many properties.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§2沉重珍珠§f有很多很多特性。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Heck, {roman}'m in trouble then.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：糟了，那我麻煩大了。

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，冒險者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello customers!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e各位顧客好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello fellow customer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e各位顧客好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello stranger. Are you looking to join our faction?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，陌生人。你想加入我們的派系嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello there stranger!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好啊，陌生人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello there! That's strange... you don't look like a dwarf, but you also don't look like a {pet}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好啊！真奇怪……你看起來不像矮人，可也不像{pet}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello there, adventurer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，冒險者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello there, {roman} seem to be stuck here with no good food to eat, could you bring me some square orange fruits?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，我好像被困在這裡，沒什麼好吃的，你能帶一些方形的橘色水果給我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello there. My name is {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好。我的名字是{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello traveler!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，旅行者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello traveler! Would you like to try my new recipe?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，旅行者！要試試我的新食譜嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello traveller!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello {player}! What brings you to my workshop? {roman} forge the newest and most powerful arrows in all of SkyBlock!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，{player}！是什麼風把你吹到我的工作坊來？我鍛造的是全 SkyBlock 最新、最強大的箭！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello {player}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，{player}？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello! Behind me lies the entrance to the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好！我身後就是{island}的入口。
