entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好！你聽說過寵物物品嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello! Welcome to SkyBlock!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好！歡迎來到§b SkyBlock§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello! {roman} am {npc2}, a prominent {enchantment} from lands afar.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好！我是{npc2}，一位來自遠方的著名{enchantment}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哈囉！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello, adventurer! {roman} am {npc2}! {roman2}'ve slain beasts of all sorts across SkyBlock!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，冒險者！我是{npc2}！我在 SkyBlock 各地斬殺過各種野獸！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello, aspiring forager!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，有志的伐木工！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello, {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，{player}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喂？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, {roman}'ll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喂？嗯？好。冷靜點。好，我會過去找，記得也看看門廊底下。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Help me with the disinfestation and {roman}'ll give you a key!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幫我完成§a除蟲§f，我就給你一把鑰匙！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Help spread our message! {collections_res} for all!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幫忙散播我們的訊息！人人都有{collections_res}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Help yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：請自便。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here are the Motes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是§d微粒§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here are your bottles, {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是你的瓶子，{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here goes nothing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：豁出去了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here in {island}, {roman}'ll reward your daily activities each SkyBlock day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在{island}這裡，我會在每個 SkyBlock 日獎勵你的每日活動。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here is a token of my gratitude for your actions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我對你的行動的一點謝意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here is the Necklace.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是§d項鍊§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here is the scanner.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是§9掃描器§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here it is!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here take this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here we go again...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：又來了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here we go!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：出發！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here ya go, if you put this on the alter, it will drag that retched creature to this world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿去吧，把這個放在祭壇上，就能把那隻可惡的生物拖到這個世界來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here you can prove your fighting skills to everyone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這裡，你可以向所有人證明你的戰鬥技巧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here you go!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here you go! Don't misplace it this time. It would've done just the same in my home.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿去吧！這次別再弄丟了。放在我家也是一樣積灰塵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here you go! Hopefully, you'll make better use of it than {roman} ever could.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿去吧！希望你能比我更好地利用它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's a rare piece of {item}. Maybe you can do something with it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一塊稀有的{item}。也許你能拿它做點什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's a rare piece of {resource}. Maybe you can do something with it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一塊稀有的{resource}。也許你能拿它做點什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's a weird item that {roman} have no use for. It won't help you beat my personal best, but it's your item now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一件我用不到的怪東西。它沒辦法幫你打破我的個人最佳紀錄，不過現在它是你的了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's a {item}. {roman} found it laying around...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一顆{item}。我在路邊撿到的……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's an trinket {roman}'ve found in the caverns behind the waterfall.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我在瀑布後面的洞穴裡找到的小玩意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's my contact, boss!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我的聯絡方式，老大！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's my theory: aware of their impending doom, the {mob} of Time, perhaps the most powerful due to universal belief, made a desperate move.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的理論是這樣的：察覺到自己即將滅亡，時間的{mob}——也許因為受到普世信仰而最為強大——採取了孤注一擲的行動。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's the recipe for the {item}. You can place it in your world and craft furniture that you've unlocked!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是{item}的配方。你可以把它放在你的世界裡，合成你已解鎖的傢俱！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's what you need to do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你需要做的是這樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's what {roman}'ve got.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我有的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's your Campfire Initiate Badge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是你的§a營火新人徽章§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here's your Soul Campfire Initiate Badge {roman}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是你的靈魂營火新人徽章 {roman}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, accept this offering.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，收下這份禮物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, accept this token for your journey to the summit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e：來，收下這個信物，作為你登頂之旅的紀念。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, could you do me a favor and bring this gift back to {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，能幫我個忙，把這份禮物帶回去給{npc2}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, go and cut a Fig Tree.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，去砍一棵無花果樹吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, have some of these cool looking stars we found.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，這些是我們找到的很酷的星星，分你一些。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, let me give you this legendary axe that has been passed down my whole family tree for {0} generations.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，我把這把在我們家族樹上傳了 {0} 代的傳奇斧頭送給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, let me share some of my ice with you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，我分一些冰給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, let me unlock the Foraging skill for you, and then you can get started!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，我幫你解鎖§a伐木§f技能，然後你就可以開始了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, read my notes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，讀讀我的§b筆記§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, some of the mobs are inside that building and some are on the outside if you follow the path. Piece of cake!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡，有些怪物在那棟建築裡，有些在外面，沿著小路走就會看到。小菜一碟！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take a look!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿去吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take these breadcrumbs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這些§e麵包屑§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this Obscure Ending!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這本§9晦澀的結局§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this as compensation for all the trouble {roman} made you go through.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，收下這個，當作我讓你經歷這些麻煩的§a補償§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this back. Let it... marinate. Yes, marinate! Then it be ready.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿回去。讓它……醃一下。對，醃一下！然後就好了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this diamathame!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這把魔法刀！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this example item.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這個範例物品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this to commemorate our meeting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這個紀念我們的相遇！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這個{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this, your first Chip. Go ahead and use the chip to unlock it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這個，你的第一個§9晶片§f。去使用晶片來解鎖它吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, take this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，拿著這個。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, you can join me in drinking away your sorrows.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，你可以跟我一起借酒澆愁。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, you keep it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，§a你留著吧§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, {roman} found this map when {roman2} first entered the dungeon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，這是我第一次進入地下城時找到的地圖。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, {roman} moved them to your stash for you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，我幫你把它們移到你的暫存區了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, {roman} want you to have another painting.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，我想再送你一幅畫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, {roman}'ve been marinating this potion.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，我一直在醃製這瓶藥水。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here, {roman}'ve got some spare {item} for ya!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，我這裡有些多的{item}給你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Here. Check them out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來，看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey Feller!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，老兄！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey are you following?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你有跟上嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey are you looking to get to the castle?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你是想去§c城堡§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey hey hey again! {roman}'ll trade you some copper for some carrots!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：又是嘿嘿嘿！我用一些銅換你一些胡蘿蔔！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey hey hey!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿嘿嘿！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey hey heyyy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿嘿嘿～！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey hey! Did {npc2} send you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿嘿！是{npc2}派你來的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey kid, {roman} haven't seen you in a while. {mob}'s powers are growing day by day. Soon she'll take over the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，孩子，好久不見。{mob}的力量一天比一天強。她很快就會佔領{island}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey pal! You lookin' for the contact, huh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，朋友！你在找聯絡方式，是吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey there adventurer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，冒險者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey there! My name's {npc2}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！我叫{npc2}……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey there! {roman}'m looking for a new type of flower to plant in my {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你好！我在找一種新的花種在我的{island}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey there, adventurer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，冒險者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey there, {roman}'m the {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，我是{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey there, {roman}'m {npc2} the {item} Sitter!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好，我是{item}保母{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey you can't click that yet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你還不能點那個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey you! Can you bring me the hardest block you can mine?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你！你能帶給我你能挖到的最硬的方塊嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey you! Over here! Come talk to me! {roman}'ll teach you about racing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你！這邊！過來跟我聊聊！我來教你賽跑！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey you! {roman} broke my {item} - do you think you could bring me another?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你！我把我的{item}弄壞了——你能再幫我帶一把來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey {player}!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey {player}, how are you doing?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}，你最近好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey {player}, the mayor elections are coming up and {roman}'ve ran out of ballot paper! Could you help me out?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}，市長選舉快到了，我的選票紙用完了！你能幫幫我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey {player}, welcome to {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}，歡迎來到{island}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey {player}, you're ready?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}，你準備好了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey {roman}'m an opportunist!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，我是個投機分子！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey {roman}'m just here cause {npc2} promised marshmallows.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，我只是因為{npc2}答應給棉花糖才來的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! Come talk to me over here! {roman}'ll tell you all about racing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！到這邊來跟我聊聊！我來告訴你賽跑的一切！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! Don't forget the first lever in this room!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！別忘了這個房間的第一根拉桿！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! Someone special has been asking to meet you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！有個§d特別的人§f一直想見你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! Stop it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！住手！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! That is mine!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！那是我的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! You should probably stick to Fig Trees!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！你大概還是乖乖砍§a無花果樹§f比較好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! {roman} am looking to make some Hot {collections_res} Books to enhance some of my weapons, do you have any potatoes to spare?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！我想做一些熱{collections_res}書來強化我的武器，你有多的馬鈴薯嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! {roman}'m the leader of the Soul Campfire Cult!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！我是§3靈魂營火教團§f的領袖！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey! {roman}'m {npc2}! {roman2} don't recall seeing you around these parts before...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿！我是{npc2}！我不記得以前在這一帶見過你……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, are you an adventurer?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你是冒險者嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, are you {npc2}'s new apprentice?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你是{npc2}的新學徒嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, how are you doing with the Greenhouse? That blueprint was very complex.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你的溫室進展得怎麼樣？那張藍圖非常複雜。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, if you find any {resource} down here let me know! {roman} wanted to buy some of that stuff for a new pickaxe.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，如果你在這下面找到任何{resource}，跟我說一聲！我想買一些來做新鎬子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, need a pen?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，需要筆嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, nice helmet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，頭盔不錯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, this is a restricted area. Leave now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，這是禁區。馬上離開！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, you again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，又是你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, you got some wheat for my pets by any chance? Gotta keep those little monsters fed, haha!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你剛好有小麥可以給我的寵物吃嗎？得餵飽那些小怪物才行，哈哈！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, you're not part of our Cult! Get out of here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，你不是我們§c邪教§f的人！給我出去！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, {player}! Glad you came to our cult meeting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}！很高興你來參加我們的邪教聚會！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, {player}, {roman}'ve been thinking a lot about that lab we found... {roman2} think there's more to it than just the plushies.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}，我一直在想我們找到的那間實驗室……我覺得那裡不只有絨毛玩偶。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, {player}. {roman} found this blueprint laying around in my house, just collecting dust. Thought it might catch your interest.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，{player}。我在家裡發現這張藍圖，一直放著積灰塵。我想你可能會有興趣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, {roman} could use some help! My {item} just broke, and {roman2} don't have the right ingredients to make a new one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，我需要幫忙！我的{item}剛壞掉了，我又沒有做新的需要的材料。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, {roman} know a few dungeon tricks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，我懂一些地下城的訣竅。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey, {roman} noticed you haven't used that blueprint {roman2} gave to you. Did you lose it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿，我注意到你還沒用我給你的那張藍圖。你弄丟了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hey.. uhm partner! {roman} swear it's not what you think!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘿……呃，夥伴！我發誓事情不是你想的那樣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi again, {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：又見面了，{player}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi friend!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨，朋友！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi {roman}'m {npc2}. {roman2}'ve been living on this island for {0} years.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨，我是{npc2}。我已經在這座島上住了 {0} 年。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi! {roman}'m looking for a very specific crop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨！我在找一種非常特定的作物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi, {player}! Welcome to the Furniture Shop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨，{player}§f！歡迎來到§a傢俱店§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi, {roman}'m the janitor of this mine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨，我是這座礦坑的清潔工。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hi.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hip-Hop!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跳跳嘻哈（Hip-Hop）！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hit 'em with the net to slow them down. Just don't blink, or you'll be left with water in your boots.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用網子打牠們讓牠們慢下來。只是別眨眼，不然你就只剩靴子裡的水了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm, maybe you're not ready then, yet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，那也許你還沒準備好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm, this corner... {roman} don't think {roman2}'ve noticed it before.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，這個角落……我好像之前都沒注意到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm, what's this?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，這是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm, {0}, huh? Sounds like a plan!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，{0} 下是吧？聽起來不錯！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm. {roman} don't know if you've been here long enough to appreciate my artistry.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯。我不確定你在這裡待得夠不夠久，能不能欣賞我的藝術。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm.. {roman} don't think this preview will fit here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a嗯……我想這個預覽在這裡放不下。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm...something appears to be broken. Give me {0} business hours to fix!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……好像有東西壞了。給我 {0} 個工作小時修理！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmm...something appears to be broken. Give me {0}{1} business days to fix!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……好像有東西壞了。給我 {0}{1} 個工作天修理！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmmm well, are you powerful? {roman} enjoy watching entities display their power... or die in a pit of fire trying!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……你很強嗎？我喜歡看各種存在展現他們的力量……或是在嘗試中死在火坑裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmmm, it seems we can't go to {island} right now. Let's try again later...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，看來我們現在去不了{island}。晚點再試試吧……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmmm, {0}, huh? Sounds like a plan!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，{0} 下是吧？聽起來不錯！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmmm... Something appears to be broken. Give me about {0} business hours to fix!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯嗯……好像有東西壞了。給我大約 {0} 個工作小時修理！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmmm... something missing. Needs... more! More flavor! More stink!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……少了點什麼。需要……更多！更多味道！更多臭味！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmmmm {roman} think that's right. {roman2} watered them too so they grow strong and healthy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……我想這樣是對的。我也幫它們澆水了，讓它們長得又壯又健康！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hmmmm, what can {roman} play to win?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……我下哪裡才能贏呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hola!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哈囉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hold it right there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：站住！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hold on...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等一下……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hold on... that was mine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等……那是我的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hold this triumph close, as many will look to challenge it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好好珍惜這份勝利，因為會有很多人想挑戰它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hold tight, it's going to be a bump ride!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抓緊了，這趟路會很顛簸！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hold up there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等一下！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等一下，各位。我老婆打來了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hold your horses! You don't even know how this machine works yet, you might break something if you don't pay attention!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：慢著！你根本還不知道這台機器怎麼運作，不注意的話可能會弄壞東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Holy Macaroni! That should boost my minion to at least Tier {0}! Thank you a lot!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的天啊！這應該能讓我的工人至少升到 {0} 級！非常感謝你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Holy crap this tastes terrible!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：天啊這也太難喝了吧！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Holy crap you are strong.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：天啊你也太強了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hone your skills until you reach Combat Skill Level {0}, and then travel to {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：磨練你的技能直到§a戰鬥技能等級 {0}§f，然後前往{island}§a！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Honestly, the nerve of some people. See something shiny and think it's theirs for the taking!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說真的，有些人臉皮可真厚。看到亮晶晶的東西就以為可以隨便拿！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Honestly, {roman}'ve made my peace with leaving all the meaning of my life to the past.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：老實說，我已經坦然接受把人生所有的意義留在過去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hook it until it relinquishes its SILK.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鉤住牠，直到牠交出牠的絲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hooks make you more likely to catch certain things.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：魚鉤能讓你更容易釣到特定的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hootie approves, trust me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：相信我，Hootie 也贊成！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hop in and we'll be off!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：上車，我們出發了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hope you feel real good about yourself, loudmouth.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：希望你對自己很滿意，大嘴巴。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hopefully our business has been very profitable for the both of us.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：希望我們的生意對雙方都很有利。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hopefully the Queen will grant you access to some parts of the city.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：希望§c女王§f會允許你進入城市的某些地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hopefully you didn't think too much about this choice, as it is quite irrelevant.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：希望你沒有為這個選擇想太多，因為它其實無關緊要。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hopefully {roman}'ll find the way tomorrow.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：希望我明天能找到路。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Horror stories are better when you have something to snack on y'know? If you help us gather some ingredients, we could roast some tasty marshmallows.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：恐怖故事配點心更好聽，你懂吧？如果你幫我們收集一些材料，我們就能烤些好吃的棉花糖。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How 'bout that payment?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那筆錢呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How are the experiments going?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：實驗進行得怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How are you doing little fellow?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好嗎，小傢伙？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How can someone just turn into a cow just from someone imagining it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：怎麼會有人因為別人的想像就變成一頭牛？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How cool is that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很酷吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How could we have been so blind?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們怎麼會這麼盲目？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How could you leave {area} without {collections_res} on you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你怎麼能身上沒帶{collections_res}就離開{area}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How dare you reject me, the {npc2}'s favorite emissary?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你竟敢拒絕我，{npc2}最喜歡的使者？！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How did you find me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是怎麼找到我的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How did you get this over the void? Incredible!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是怎麼把牠帶過虛空的？太不可思議了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How did you get this over the void? You must be really strong.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是怎麼把牠帶過虛空的？你一定很強壯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How did you lose my vacuum?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你怎麼會把我的吸塵器弄丟？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How did you manage to get in here???
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是怎麼進來這裡的？？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How did you manage to jump that high?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是怎麼跳那麼高的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How do you do! Are you from {island}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好！你是從{island}來的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How do you like your Faction?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你喜歡你的派系嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How do you suppose you'll beat {0} seconds by talking to me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你以為跟我說話就能跑進 {0} 秒嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How do you suppose you'll beat {timer} by talking to me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你以為跟我說話就能跑進 {timer} 嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How do {roman} explain...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我該怎麼解釋……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How does that even work??
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這到底是怎麼辦到的？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How is that a gift?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這算哪門子禮物？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How is {npc2} going to fix that? Uh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2} §f要怎麼解決這些？§c蛤？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How long have {roman} been gone?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我離開多久了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How many squats do you reckon {roman} need? Like {0}, {1}, or maybe {2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得我需要蹲幾下？{0}、{1}，還是 {2}？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How many times do {roman} have to go to the shop every day...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我每天到底得去店裡幾次……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How predictable.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真好預測。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How was the training? Not too bad?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：訓練怎麼樣？還好吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How you look, how you talk, even the core fundamentals of who you actually are...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你的外表、你說話的方式，甚至你真正是誰的核心本質……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How'd you get in here? The entrance is sealed off...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是怎麼進來的？入口已經封住了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How's it going, champ?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最近怎麼樣啊，冠軍？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: How? Someone flew up there?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：怎麼可能？有人飛上去了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Howdy
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好啊

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Howdy {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喲，{player}§7！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Howdy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好啊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Howdy! Fine barn ye got there eh? Good lad, you think ye could get me some wheat, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好啊！你的穀倉真不錯，對吧？好孩子，你覺得你能幫我弄些小麥嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Howdy! Fine day eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好啊！天氣真好，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Howdy! Yer a friend of {npc2}, are ya?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好啊！你是{npc2}的朋友，是吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Howdy, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喲，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However recently something strange has been happening to the fishes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過最近魚兒們發生了一些奇怪的事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However you are correct, it is likely nothing would have happened had {roman} not placed this blood on the ground.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過你說得對，如果我沒有把這些血放在地上，很可能什麼事都不會發生。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However {roman} do not respect your strategy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過我不認同你的策略。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, a pesky {mob} just came by and snatched a bunch of my {resource}! How can {roman} operate safely with thieves like that running around?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，剛剛有一隻討厭的{mob} §f跑來搶走了我一大堆{resource}§f！有那樣的§c§o小偷§f到處亂跑，我要怎麼安心做生意？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, changing factions usually means that you become unfriendly with your current faction.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，換派系通常意味著你會和目前的派系交惡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, if one steals while the other splits, the stealer takes {0} Motes, leaving the other with nothing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，如果一方§c偷取§f而另一方§a平分§f，偷取者拿走 {0}§5 微粒§f，另一方則§c§l一無所有§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, it looks like one of your co-op members already did that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過看起來你的合作島成員已經做好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, it won't be easy getting all the way up there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，要一路爬到那上面可不容易。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, let me give you an explicit final warning.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，讓我給你一個明確的§4最後警告§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, the location of {npc2} remains unknown.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，{npc2}的下落仍然不明。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, the question remains, where ought we to begin our investigation?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過問題仍在：我們該從哪裡開始§e調查§f呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, they have been extinct for eons - only leaving the remnants of the Automatons behind.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然而，他們已經滅絕了無數歲月——只留下§c自動機械§f的殘骸。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, your strategy does not garner my respect.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，你的策略沒有贏得我的敬意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, {roman} am here, and so are you, so let's begin!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e不過，我來了，你們也來了，那我們開始吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, {roman} doubt it will permit us to travel that far back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，我懷疑它能讓我們回到那麼久以前。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, {roman} feel like {roman2}'m... different. Depending on what {roman3}'m painting, {roman4} need different types of dyes, but {roman5} always find exactly what {roman6} need!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，我覺得我……與眾不同。依照我在畫的東西，我需要不同種類的染料，但我§6§l總是§f能找到§6§l剛好需要的那種§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, {roman} must see your Celestial Timecharm before allowing you to proceed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，在允許你繼續前進之前，我必須先看看你的§c天界時之護符§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, {roman} seem to have broken some key components in the structure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，我好像把結構裡一些關鍵零件弄壞了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: However, {roman} should probably give you some tips on how to get them...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，我大概該給你一些取得它們的訣竅……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Huh, what is that noise?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：咦，那是什麼聲音？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hum, let me think...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，讓我想想……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hum, so you chose the Mage Faction then.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，所以你選了§c法師派系§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hum, that can't be right...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，這不可能是對的……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hum, well that's awkward
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，這就尷尬了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Humm, the sound of fire...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，火的聲音……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Humph. This will do for now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哼。目前這樣就行了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hundreds of people bid on the items, then the few highest bids get the item!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：數百人會對物品出價，然後§a出價最高的幾位§f就能拿到物品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hunters continue to discover new Shards every year.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：獵人們每年都會持續發現新的碎片。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hunters these days... no patience. Go to the lake and look for Mossybits.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在的獵人……一點耐心都沒有。去湖邊找苔蘚蛙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hunting has been around for eons, perfected by advanced beings known as the Precursors.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：狩獵已經存在了好幾個紀元，由一群被稱為§5先驅者§f的高等存在加以完善。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hunting is incredible! You should talk to {npc2} in the {area} to learn about it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a狩獵§f超棒的！你應該去{area}§f找{npc2} §f了解一下！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hurry up, failure isn't an option.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快點，失敗不是選項。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hurry, find a hiding place before the murderer breaches the entrance!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快，在兇手突破入口之前§c找個地方躲起來§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hurry, take down the murderer now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快，現在就打倒兇手！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Hybridization? Mutation? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雜交？§c突變§f？這是什麼瘋狂的東西？他在拿某種東西做實驗……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：事情不是你們看到的那樣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If Mary is {0} years old and Jamie is {1}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果§d Mary §f今年 {0}§f 歲，§6Jamie §f今年 {1}§f 歲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If a Tree has a high Toughness, you will need more than {0}{stats} to cut {1} logs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果一棵樹的§c硬度§f很高，你需要超過 {0}{stats} §f才能砍 {1}§f 塊原木！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If anyone can do it, it's {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果有誰辦得到，那就是{npc2}了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If anything happened to {npc2} {roman} would go nuts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果{npc2}出了什麼事，我會發瘋的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If both players split, each player earns {0} Motes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果雙方都§a平分§f，每人各得 {0}§5 微粒§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If both steal, each player earns only {0} Motes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果雙方都§c偷取§f，每人只得 {0}§5 微粒§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If getting here was my purpose in life, then anything beyond that point would've been meaningless anyway.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果來到這裡就是我的人生目的，那之後的一切本來就沒有意義。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If he finds his way through the labyrinth of time to my domain, it will be my duty to enlighten him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果他能穿過時間的迷宮來到我的領域，啟迪他將是我的職責。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If it works, everyone will stay midair all the time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果成功了，大家就會一直待在半空中。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If it's too dangerous for you, tell me. If you leave the area, we'll assume you've abandoned the mission and find someone else instead.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果對你來說太危險，就告訴我。如果你離開這個區域，我們就會認為你放棄了任務，然後另外找人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If left unchecked, it is possible that the powers of this creature will grow.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果放任不管，這隻生物的力量可能會越來越強。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If me lose mayor, me find you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果我選輸，我會找到你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If not for me and my shop, people wouldn't even CARE about {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要不是有我和我的§a店§f，大家根本不會§c§o在乎§f{item}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If not, no worries! They each have their own unlock requirements, which you can see inside the SkyMart Shop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果還沒有，別擔心！每一種都有各自的解鎖條件，你可以在§aSkyMart 商店§f裡查看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If only {npc2} had been helping instead of engaging in a popularity contest...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要是{npc2}有來幫忙，而不是忙著搞人氣比賽就好了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If only {roman} had used my head fully, {roman2} wouldn't be stuck in a bunch of mirrors.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要是我當初好好動動腦，就不會被困在一堆鏡子裡了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If only {roman} were smarter...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要是我聰明一點就好了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If that's fine with you, {roman}'ll give you a couple of my missions, but they are quite tough.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你不介意，我可以給你幾個我的任務，不過它們相當難。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If the bird found dirty eggs pretty, he wouldn't have gotten in that situation
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果那隻鳥覺得髒的蛋很漂亮，他就不會落入那種處境

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If the principal objective of a leader isn't the well being of their population, there is a problem.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果領導者的首要目標不是人民的福祉，那就有問題了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If their time runs out they get stuck.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果他們的§a時間§f用完了，就會§c卡住§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If there's something to slay, {roman} show up no matter what.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要有東西可殺，不管怎樣我都會出現。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If they're trying to return to our world one day, shouldn't they come through here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果他們有一天想回到§a我們的世界§f，§4他們§f不應該會經過§d這裡§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If wool shrinks when you wash it...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果羊毛洗了會縮水……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you are here for business then it makes no difference to me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你是來做生意的，那對我來說都一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you are, why don't you offer up some coin to show your belief.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你相信，何不獻上一些遊戲幣來表示你的信仰。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you aspire to take my place, you must first defeat me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想取代我的位置，就必須先打敗我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you betray us you'll die.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你們背叛我們，就只有死路一條。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you bring me the right materials, and the proper fee, then {roman}'ll craft you a Pocket Black Hole.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你帶來正確的材料和適當的費用，我就幫你製作一個§5口袋黑洞§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you bring one to me {roman}'ll reward you handsomely.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你帶一顆給我，我會好好報答你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you build, they will come!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要你蓋了，他們就會來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you calm one of them down, {roman} will be able to teleport you to it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你讓其中一隻冷靜下來，我就能把你§a傳送§f到牠那裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can bring me {0} Redstone, {roman}'ll reward you with an extra slot for your Accessory Bag.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能帶給我 {0}§c 個紅石§f，我就會獎勵你一格額外的§a飾品袋§f欄位。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can bring me {0} Redstone, {roman}'ll reward you with another slot for your Accessory Bag.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能帶給我 {0}§c 個紅石§f，我就會再獎勵你§d一格§a飾品袋§f欄位。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can bring me {0} Spruce Logs, {roman}'ll give you a reward!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能帶給我 {0}§a 個雲杉原木§f，我就給你獎勵！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can bring me {0} {area} Logs, we can make some traps!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能帶給我 {0} {area}§a原木§f，我們就能做一些§5陷阱§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can bring them back a book or a piece of technology they have never seen before, {roman}'m sure they will take a liking to you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能帶給他們一本書或一件他們從沒見過的科技產品，我相信他們會對你有好感。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can defeat them, {roman}'m sure you'll obtain a {resource}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能打敗他們，我相信你會取得{resource}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can find these items, we'll be one step closer to building our very own Greenhouse!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能找到這些物品，我們就離蓋好自己的§a溫室§f又更近一步了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can gather {0} {mob}'s fragments, {1} enchanted spider eye's, and {2} enchanted string, {roman} can gather the rest of what {roman2} will need!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能收集 {0} 個{mob}的碎片、{1} 個附魔蜘蛛眼和 {2} 條附魔線，剩下需要的我可以自己收集！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can last for {0} seconds while standing in the campfire, {roman}'ll give you a reward!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能在營火裡撐 {0}§a 秒§f，我就給你獎勵！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you can prove to me you're a real archer {roman}'ll forge you arrows whenever you need them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能向我證明你是個真正的弓箭手，你需要箭的時候我隨時幫你鍛造。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you change your mind you can also go talk to {npc2} in the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你改變主意，也可以去{island}找{npc2}談談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you change your mind, you know where to find me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你改變主意，你知道去哪找我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you could get me a couple iron ingots, {roman} could make one for us both!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能帶幾個鐵錠給我，我就能做兩把，我們一人一把！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you don't have time to claim them, {roman} got your back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你沒時間領取，我來幫你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you don't know already, this is the only place where you can fish up {collections_res} Grubbers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你還不知道的話，這裡是唯一能釣到{collections_res}§2蛆蟲§f的地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you don't like the sea, don't vote for me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你不喜歡大海，就別投給我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you enter one, you'll fine {power} Corpses strewn throughout the place - they're all that's left of some unfortunate dwarves from long ago!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你進入其中一個，會發現到處散落著{power}§b屍體§f——那是很久以前一些不幸矮人僅存的遺骸！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you ever change your mind, you know where to find me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你改變主意，你知道去哪找我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you ever get a bit too {stats} you can always warm yourself up over at the Campfire!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你覺得有點太{stats}§f了，隨時可以到§6營火§f那邊取暖！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you ever removed an Abiphone Contact by accident and don't know how to reach them, maybe {roman} can hook you up!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你不小心刪掉了某個§3 Abiphone 聯絡人§f，又不知道怎麼聯絡上他們，也許我能幫你牽線！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you ever want to apply a Rod Part or have any questions about them, come see me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想安裝釣竿零件，或對它們有任何問題，就來找我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you feel like Foraging is the thing for you, continue down the path and head towards {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你覺得伐木很適合你，就沿著小路繼續往{island}走。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you find any more during your travels, please bring them back to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你在旅途中找到更多，請帶回來給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you find anymore mutations, {roman} have not yet categorized, please feel free to analyze them here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你找到更多我還沒分類的突變，歡迎拿來這裡分析！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you find gear inside, {roman} can upgrade it for you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你在裡面找到裝備，我可以幫你§e升級§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you find mi crystal, can you give it back to me lady
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你找到我的水晶，可以還給我嗎，小姐

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you find reforged accessories, {roman}'ll buy their reforges from you for coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你找到§a重鑄過的飾品§f，我會用§6遊戲幣§f跟你買它們的重鑄！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you go neutral, let me know!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你變成中立了，就跟我說！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you got in here, you probably know what you're doing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你進得來，大概也知道自己在做什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have an Abiphone you should add me to your contacts!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你有 Abiphone，應該把我加進你的聯絡人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have any energy left, {roman} have just one more task for you. Finally, {roman2} will need {0} Redstone. That's {1} stacks, if you didn't know.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你還有力氣，我還有最後一個任務要給你。最後，我需要 {0}§c 個紅石§f。告訴你，那是 {1}§f 組。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have any more questions, feel free to talk to me again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你還有問題，歡迎再來找我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have any more questions, you can talk to the {npc2} in the Greenhouse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你還有問題，可以去§a溫室§f找{npc2}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have any other pets you'd like to upgrade, you know where to find me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你有其他想升級的寵物，你知道去哪找我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have any pets which need a new home {roman}'d be happy to buy them off you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你有需要新家的寵物，我很樂意跟你買！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have any questions about Bait, you can view my Bait Guide at any time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你對§6魚餌§f有任何問題，隨時都可以查看我的§6魚餌指南§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have some time maybe you could help me with some tasks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你有空，也許可以幫我做一些任務。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you have someone's contact you can call them at any time, and they can also call you whenever.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要有某人的§a聯絡方式§f，你隨時都能打給他們，他們也隨時能打給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you help me find those Relics {roman} will tell you everything {roman2} know about the creature.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你幫我找到那些遺物，我就把我知道關於那隻生物的一切都告訴你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you join our faction {roman} might have some tasks for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你加入我們的派系，我可能會有一些任務給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you keep going down and down, you'll find another cave, which leads to The Matriarch.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你一直往下走，會找到另一個洞穴，通往§c女族長§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you know this keyword, it means there's a me out there who figured out how to power the necklace.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你知道這個關鍵字，就表示外面有一個§o我§r§f想出了怎麼為這條§d項鍊§f注入§5能量§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you know {npc2}, you may want to do business with us.
entries.value: §d[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你認識{npc2}，也許會想跟我們做生意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你活著是為了擁有一切，那你擁有的永遠都不夠。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you look at the mushrooms around the {area}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你看看{area}§f周圍的§e蘑菇§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you made it this far, it means yours is at least {0}, a notable intellect, perhaps not quantum, but commendable nonetheless.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能走到這裡，代表你的智商至少有 {0}，算是可觀的智力，也許稱不上量子級，但仍值得讚許。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you mine enough Ender Nodes you'll eventually find the Gauntlet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你挖夠多的§5終界節點§f，最後就會找到護手。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you place your Minions poorly, they will complain!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你把工人放得不好，它們會抱怨！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you run into them, tell them {roman} sent you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你遇到他們，就說是我叫你去的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you say "Help {npc2}!" {roman} am sure they will come save you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你說「§cHelp {npc2}§c!§f」，我相信他們會來救你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you say so.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你這麼說的話。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you set aside her unconsolable grief, she really looks FAN-TAS-TIC!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：撇開她那§9無法撫慰的悲傷§f不談，她看起來真是§e§o美、呆、了§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you still have attributes on items, you can use it to transfer them into your Hunting Box. Boop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果物品上還有屬性，你可以用它把屬性轉移到你的§a狩獵箱§f。§o啵§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you take down enough of those you'll end up getting the Cloak.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你打倒夠多隻，最後就會拿到斗篷。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you tell the same story to multiple people they might understand it differently
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：同一個故事說給好幾個人聽，他們可能會有不同的理解

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you truly love nature, you will find beauty everywhere. You, my friend, need to open your eyes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你真心熱愛大自然，你會在每個地方發現美。我的朋友，你需要睜開你的眼睛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you vote for me {roman}'ll teach you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你投給我，我就教你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the Endermen up here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你要我給點建議，你應該先從這上面的§c終界使者§f殺起。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want a {item} {roman}'ll give you one for free!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想要一把{item}，我可以免費送你一把！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want one, you should go talk to {npc2}, in the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想要一個，應該去{area}找{npc2}談談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to hunt animals too, go talk to {npc2} The Trapper!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你也想獵捕動物，就去找捕獸人{npc2}吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to keep moving, keep warm!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想繼續行動，就要保暖！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to learn more about Hunting, you should talk to {npc2} next door.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想多了解§a狩獵§f，接下來應該去隔壁找{npc2} §f談談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to make your father proud you will have to train more than it is expected of you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想讓你父親為你驕傲，你就得比別人期待的訓練得更多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to safely travel through the portal, you need a Dimensional Infusion.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想§a安全地§f穿越傳送門，你需要一次§d維度注入§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to support us, head over to the Hypixel Store at store.hypixel.net
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想支持我們，請前往 Hypixel 商店：§bstore.hypixel.net

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to swap Factions let me know, it really isn't that hard.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想換派系就跟我說，其實沒那麼難。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to take a look here is what it says.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想看看，上面是這樣寫的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want to take a picture of me, you'll have to pay {0} Coins.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想拍我的照片，得付 {0}§6 遊戲幣§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want {roman} can apply Telekinesis on any of your items for {0} coins.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想要，我可以幫你的任何物品附上心靈傳動，只要 {0}§6 遊戲幣§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want, {roman} can read your future. Are you interested?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想，我可以幫你預言未來。你有興趣嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you want. {roman} can help you get the strength of spiders!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想要。我可以幫你獲得蜘蛛的力量！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you work hard in school maybe you can wear a yellow suit like me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你在學校認真念書，也許你也能穿上像我這樣的黃色防護衣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you'd like one, you can purchase a Pocket Black Hole from {npc2} over in the village.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想要一個，可以去村子裡跟{npc2}§f買一個§5口袋黑洞§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you're a slow-moving animal on the sea floor, these guys would have been your enemies.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你是海床上行動緩慢的動物，這些傢伙就是你的天敵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you're having trouble finding any of those Crystals, go take a look at the Nucleus Vault over there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你找不到哪顆水晶，就去看看那邊的§5核心寶庫§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you're looking for better hardware, maybe try checking out the Forge. You could also visit the {area} to talk to the {npc2} about certain tasks!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你在找更好的裝備，可以去§6鍛造坊§f看看。你也可以去{area}找{npc2}接一些任務！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you're observant, you might be able to distract some of them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你夠細心，也許能§e引開§f他們其中一些人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you're searching for the Celestial Timecharm, you'll need to summon Shen's Citrinitas.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你在找§c天界時之護符§f，你得召喚§cShen's Citrinitas§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you're up for the challenge, both the {area} and the {island} beyond it are great training grounds for improving your Combat Skill.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你願意接受挑戰，{area} §f和它後面的{island} §f都是提升§a戰鬥技能§f的絕佳練功場。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you've made it this far, you're talented.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能走到這一步，你很有天分。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If you've reached this point, you truly are a once-in-a-generation talent.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你能走到這一步，你真的是百年一遇的天才。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If your {stats} is greater than the amount of {stats2} you have, you won't receive a {stats3} reduction!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你的{stats}大於你擁有的{stats2}，你的{stats3}就不會降低！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If {roman} can reach it, {roman2}'ll be able to exit this place- {roman3}'m sure of it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要我能碰到它，我就能離開這個地方——我很確定！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If {roman} could demote you any further {roman2} would, recruit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果我能把你降得更低，我一定會的，新兵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If {roman} could {roman2} would pay him double
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果可以的話，我願意付他雙倍

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If {roman} ever need your help, {roman2} will be sure to let you know!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果我需要你的幫忙，我一定會讓你知道！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If {roman} get elected {roman2} SWEAR you won't regret it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果我當選，我發誓你絕對不會後悔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If {roman} was to quantify it, {roman2}'d say you need {0} {1}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要我量化的話，我會說你需要 {0} {1}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If {roman} wasn't talking, what would people do instead
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果我不說話，大家會做些什麼

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: If {roman}'m feeling blue, {roman2} jump!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我§9心情低落§f的時候也會跳！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Imagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想像一下能在最惡劣環境下存活的作物，或是永遠不會生病的動物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Imagine that! After devoting my life to this project, {roman} cannot use it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想像一下！我把一生都奉獻給這個計畫，自己卻不能用！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Imagine {roman} was a cow, how funny would that be?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想像一下我是一頭牛，那該有多好笑？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Impressive! What a jump
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：厲害！好高的一跳

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In a way it is good that the Piglins were not behind this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：某種程度上，幕後黑手不是豬布林也算是件好事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In a way they are not so different than us.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：某種程度上，牠們跟我們也沒那麼不同。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In addition to my other pursuits, {roman} engage in novel writing during my leisure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：除了其他研究之外，我閒暇時也會寫小說。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In any case, if {npc2} is indeed dead, {roman} have a place to be right now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，如果{npc2}真的死了，我現在得去個地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In any case, without his help, we couldn't have fixed the portal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總之，沒有他的幫忙，我們沒辦法修好傳送門。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In any case, {roman} have no idea how to guarantee your entry in their faction!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不管怎樣，我完全不知道要怎麼保證你能加入他們的派系！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In any case, {roman}'ll read your future.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不管怎樣，我會預言你的未來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In any of his lives actually, never!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：其實在他的§o任何一§f輩子，§c從來沒有§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In every room {roman}'ve placed a button in case you want to back out.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在每個房間都放了一個§a按鈕§f，以防你想退出。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In every single dimension he's by FAR the wealthiest being.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在每一個維度裡，他都是遙遙領先的§6最富有§f的存在。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In exchange for your help in expanding my collection, {roman} offer a unique opportunity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：作為你幫我擴充收藏的回報，我提供一個獨特的機會。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In exchange for {0} {1}, {roman}'ve given you {2}{stats} for {timer}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我用 {0} {1} 換給你 {2}{stats}，持續 {timer}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In exchange, {roman} only ask for a few valuables.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：作為交換，我只要幾樣值錢的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In fact {roman} have one myself. Here take it, {roman2}'ll just request another one from Maddox. {roman3} keep losing them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：事實上我自己就有一支。拿去吧，我再跟§c Maddox §f要一支就好。我老是弄丟它們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In fact {roman}'m the exact opposite of you...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：事實上，我跟你正好相反……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In fact, do not reveal the answer just yet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：事實上，先別急著揭曉答案。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In fact, here's a little gift to encourage you to give it a try.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：事實上，這裡有個小禮物，鼓勵你試試看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In fact, they instead showed that they had immense strength, and a taste for violence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：相反地，他們展現出驚人的力量，還有暴力的傾向。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In fact, you'll have to choose a faction, but it's a little bit early for that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：事實上，你最後得§2選擇一個派系§f，不過現在還有點早。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In here, you need to water crops from time to time to keep them healthy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這裡，你需要不時§9幫作物澆水§f，讓它們保持健康。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In how long will Mary be the same age as Jamie?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要過多久§d Mary §f會跟§6 Jamie §f一樣大？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In my dream {roman} flew out of my body, went through some kind of screen barrier.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在夢裡，我飛出了自己的身體，穿過了某種螢幕屏障。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In my garden are some flowers. Could you pick {0} Poppies and turn them into {item} Dye, then bring them back to me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的花園裡有一些花。你能摘 {0}§e 朵罌粟§f，把它們做成{item}§e染料§f，再帶回來給我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In order to access the {area}, you must be closer to its entrance. Please move closer to the {area2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要進入{area}，你必須更靠近它的入口。請靠近{area2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In order to better understand the cold, sometimes you have to get warm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了更了解寒冷，有時候你得先暖和起來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In order to combine the magic, we will need to have the magic.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了§o結合§r§f§5魔法§f，我們得先§o擁有§r§f§5魔法§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In that case thanks for the gift, and have a great life.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那樣的話，謝謝你的禮物，祝你一生順遂。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In that case you better get off my property before {roman} call the guards!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那樣的話，你最好在我叫守衛之前離開我的地盤！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In that case, please show me your fighting moves.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那樣的話，請讓我看看你的戰鬥招式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In that case, would you like to help me out with something? In return, {roman} can give you some more slots for your Accessory Bag.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然如此，你願意幫我一個忙嗎？作為回報，我可以給你的§a飾品袋§f§d更多欄位§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In that case, {roman} have nothing against you. {roman2} wish you a sulphuric day sir.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那樣的話，我對你沒有任何意見。祝你有個硫磺般美好的一天，先生。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In the Fusion Machine, fusing shards with a Reptile often yields powerful results.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在§5融合機§f裡，把碎片和爬蟲類融合，常常能得到強大的結果。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In the distant future {roman}'ll let you create your very own sprays with this canvas...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在遙遠的未來，我會讓你用這塊畫布創作你自己的噴漆圖案……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In the future, the canvas room will let you save your drawings to sprays!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：將來，畫布室會讓你把你的畫存成噴漆圖案！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In the meantime, {roman} can make a boat for you using leftovers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在那之前，我可以用剩下的材料幫你做一艘§a船§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In their circle world, dreaming of a cubic world
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在他們的圓形世界裡，夢想著一個方塊世界

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In theory this should help refining {collections_res}, if {roman} can get it to work.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：理論上這應該能幫助提煉{collections_res}，前提是我能讓它運作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In these lands, the earth hides secrets and treasures older than any of us.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這片土地上，大地藏著比我們任何人都古老的§a秘密§f與寶藏。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In this place where time has no meaning, {roman} created a zone where time is everything.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這個時間§o毫無意義§f的地方，我創造了一個時間§6§o就是一切§f的區域。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: In this puzzle experiment, toggle which mirror is active by clicking on it.

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它需要機器燃料才能運作……幸好我們可以在網路上訂購燃料！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It seems like the first piece you brought me is only {0} of the magical power, could you get me the leggings?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來你帶給我的第一件只有 {0} 的魔法力，你能幫我拿護腿嗎？

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來你確實就是我的主人在找的人。

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真的讓人招架不住

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It was the largest eruption we have ever seen. As if the Volcano was talking to us.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那是我們見過最大的一次爆發。就好像§c火山§f在跟我們說話一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It was {roman} who was chosen, and thus {roman2} crafted this chamber so he could train against people such as yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：被選中的是我，因此我打造了這間密室，讓他能與你這樣的人對練。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It wasn't like that with the last Prime Minister!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：上一任首相的時候才不會這樣！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It will let you access your bank remotely.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它能讓你遠端使用你的銀行。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It will let you imbue Glyphs with Warding Spells.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它能讓你用§9防護咒語§f為§5符文§f注入力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It will take me some time to assemble them, so you should come back later.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：組裝它們需要一些時間，所以你應該§a晚點再來§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It would be a pretty convenient place for a Vampire to hide.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這會是吸血鬼躲藏的好地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It would be better if they were playable...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§7§o要是它們能播放就更好了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's Friday, my resting day! {roman} earned myself a little treat, maybe you could bring me some chocolate?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：今天是星期五，我的休息日！我想犒賞自己一下，你能帶點巧克力給我嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a bit cheesy, but you gotta make money sometimes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有點老套，但有時候總得賺錢嘛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a bit too hot for me down there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那下面對我來說有點太熱了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a bunch of magic nonsense, but what matters is, {roman} have the fix!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一堆§d魔法廢話§f，但重點是，我有解決辦法！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a great day to go for a run!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：今天真是跑步的好日子！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a joke... {roman} have infinite time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：開玩笑的……我有無限的時間！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a pretty weak engine, but it will be just powerful enough to reach the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是個相當弱的引擎，但剛好夠力抵達{island}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a relatively superhot concept in physics.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是物理學中一個§o相對§r§c超熱門§f的概念。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a simple story but it touches a lot of interesting subjects.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是個簡單的故事，但觸及了很多有趣的主題。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a skull that once belonged to a particularly deformed-looking {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一顆頭骨，原本屬於一隻長得特別畸形的{pet}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a small world!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：世界真小！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a thriller about a genius serial killer who's obsessed with framing police inspectors with his murders.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一部驚悚小說，講一個天才連續殺人犯，執著於用他的謀殺案陷害警探。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a tool {roman}'ve been developing. It analyzes mutations in crops, helps identify traits that can improve yield, resistance or even flavor.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我一直在開發的工具。它能分析作物的§c突變§f，幫助找出能提升§6產量§f、§9抗性§f甚至§d風味§f的特性。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a warzone in here, everyone fighting over ice!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡就像戰場，大家都在搶冰！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's a... business, auctioning sweet items.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那是一門……生意，專門拍賣§d好東西§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's about an old hero that everyone still considers as the strongest.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它講的是一位大家仍然認為是最強的老英雄。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's actually a well-preserved {pet} from long ago.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它其實是一隻很久以前保存良好的{pet}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's all that remains of whatever little {pet} once lived around here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是曾經住在這附近的某隻小{pet}僅存的遺骸。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's almost as if the dyes {roman} use become more common for everyone...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：簡直就像是我用的染料對大家來說都變得更常見了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's almost like the RING doesn't exist for you. How poetic.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對你來說，§e§lRING§f簡直就像不存在一樣。真有詩意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's alright now. {roman} was wrong to lie about it and {roman2} should have told you sooner.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒事了。是我不該說謊，我應該早點告訴你們的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's also great for knowing when a crop will finish growing or how much water it needs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它也很適合用來知道作物什麼時候會§a長好§f，或需要多少§9水§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's always a landslide
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每次都是壓倒性的勝利

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's always good to be well equipped for the job ahead!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為接下來的工作準備好裝備總是好的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's always so black and white with them
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們總是非黑即白

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's an incredible battle of wits between two brilliant minds.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是兩個聰明頭腦之間一場精彩的鬥智。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's be a sad story about how the expectations of others can force you to do things that hurt you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這會是個悲傷的故事，講別人的期待如何逼你做出傷害自己的事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's because fire is eternal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為§e火§f是永恆的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's been a blessing to our trade!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這對我們這行來說真是一大福音！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's better if you start Hunting yourself!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你最好自己開始§f狩獵！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's better if you start hunting to find out for yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你最好開始狩獵，親自去找答案。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's but a glimpse of what's buried beneath.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這只是埋在地底下之物的冰山一角。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's cold out here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：外面好冷！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's cold, isolated and utterly confounding.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那裡§b寒冷§f、孤立，而且讓人完全摸不著頭緒。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's coming!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's decided, this is the day!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：決定了，就是今天！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's definitely in their {area} though, {roman} know they reorganized a lot of it into an Academy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過肯定在他們的{area}裡，我知道他們把很大一部分改成了學院。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's essential for... {#}inhales{#2}... surviving down there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那是……{#}吸氣{#2}……在底下生存的必需品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's essential... {#}inhales{#2}... to equip yourself with ample... {#3}exhales{#4}... {stats} and {stats2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一定要……{#}吸氣{#2}……準備充足的……{#3}吐氣{#4}……{stats}和{stats2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's far less painful than using your fists to punch trees, {roman}'ll tell ya that much!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我可以告訴你，這比用拳頭打樹舒服多了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's from those Endermen up there, where we first met.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就是我們第一次見面的地方，上面那些§c終界使者§f掉的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's fully grown! You should be able to harvest it now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它完全長大了！你現在應該可以收成了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's great! Business has been booming here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！這裡的生意好得不得了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's important to experience the right things when you are young
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：年輕的時候經歷對的事情很重要

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's impossible for us to know, but we can theorize.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們不可能知道，但我們可以推論。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's just ahead of us, the Burning {pet}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠就在我們前面，是§2燃燒的{pet}§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's just from regular Endermen, like the rest of the armor!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它就是普通的§c終界使者§f掉落的，跟其他盔甲一樣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's just not true, {roman} never said anything like that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：根本不是真的，我從來沒說過那種話！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's kind of a big deal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這可是件大事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's me, {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是我，{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's much more quiet around here, {roman} can clear my head.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這附近安靜多了，我可以讓腦袋清醒一下。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's needed for taste, otherwise we'll just get more vomit!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是為了味道，不然我們只會得到更多§2嘔吐物§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not a big issue.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這不是什麼大問題。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not allowed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是不允許的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not going to be easy to join them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要加入他們可不容易。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not hard. Just aim, hold down the button, and don't stop until the bug's been squashed!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不難的。只要瞄準、按住按鍵，在蟲子被壓扁之前別停下來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not just about survival, it's about thriving.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這不只是為了生存，而是為了茁壯成長。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not much, but {npc2} and {roman} love it here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然不大，但{npc2}和我很喜歡這裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not pretty, but it works.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不怎麼好看，但有效。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not quite there yet...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還差一點……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not that bad after all!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：終究沒那麼糟嘛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's not the Steve who has too little, but the Steve who craves more, who is poor.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：貧窮的不是擁有太少的 Steve，而是渴望更多的 Steve。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's now my favorite number.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它現在是我最喜歡的數字了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's one of our {event} Helmets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我們的{event}§d頭盔§f之一。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's pretty tasty. But it seems like we still have some dozen {collections_res} left over and our Composter is already full...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真好吃。不過看起來我們還剩下幾十個{collections_res}，而堆肥機已經滿了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's probably down in the mine somewhere. Can you go find it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它大概在礦坑裡的某個地方。你能幫我找找嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's rare to meet new faces around these woods.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這片§a森林§f裡很少遇到新面孔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's reverse-chumming!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那就是反向撒餌！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's safer with it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有了它比較安全。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's so frustrating!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是§c氣死人了§f！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's so great you're here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你來了真是太好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's so refreshing to see some new faces in the town!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在鎮上看到一些新面孔真讓人耳目一新！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's so simple, but so true...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好簡單，但又好真實……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's so small, but it's a {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然很小，但它可是{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's so warm outside!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：外面好溫暖！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's special effects! Some pizzaz! Cinéma!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是特效！一點噱頭！電影感！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's the first of like {0} Timecharms.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它是大概 {0}§c 個時之護符§f中的第一個。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's the scary story about the big bad bear
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是關於大壞熊的恐怖故事

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's the smallest house in SkyBlock.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那是§a SkyBlock §f裡最小的房子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's time to build the Ballista again! Cover me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：該再把弩砲組裝起來了！§c掩護我§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's time we put the people first.
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：是時候以人民為優先了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's too dangerous for you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對你來說太危險了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's unclear whether the Precursors were creations of these Starborns, but they certainly revered them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：目前還不清楚先驅者是否是這些星裔的造物，但他們確實崇敬星裔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's useful to explain which Sea Creatures can be found where, and what treasures they drop!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它很實用，會說明哪些§3海洋生物§f在哪裡出沒，以及牠們會掉落什麼§6寶藏§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's usually recognized that TIME is the {0}th dimension.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一般認為§a時間§f是第 {0}§f 維度。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's very complicated! Only great enchanteresses may understand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這非常複雜！只有偉大的§3女附魔師§f才能理解。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡好暗，這地方的電燈開關在哪？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's very easy to find the {mob}, simply take any of the tunnels below the Volcano and descend until you reach the center.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要找到{mob}§f很簡單，只要走進任何一條§7火山底下的隧道§f，一直往下走到中心就到了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's very powerful, but sometimes... it fails.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它非常強大，但有時候……它會§c失靈§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's very scared and of course {roman} don't know how to deal with pets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠非常害怕，而我當然不知道怎麼對付寵物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's way to high.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太高了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's well known that good stews aren't made from brown mushrooms.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大家都知道，好燉菜不是用棕色蘑菇煮的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's you again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：又是你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's you, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是你，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's {npc2}! He has truly arrived!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是{npc2}！他真的來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both crops and animals adapt to new environments.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這……不是你看到的那樣。這間實驗室……是用來做研究的。為了改進農耕技術，幫助§a作物§f和§e動物§f適應新環境。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Its patented technology transforms organic matter into aromas that only Pests can smell.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它的專利技術能把§a有機物§f轉化成只有害蟲聞得到的氣味。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It’s a possibility we cannot ignore.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我們無法忽視的可能性。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: It’s hard to even describe how awful this view is.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這景色糟到我都很難形容。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Jerk.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§7§o混蛋§7。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Jobs may come and go, but the Cult of the {event} is eternal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：工作來來去去，但§5{event}邪教§f是永恆的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Joey ate {0} hot dogs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§cJoey §f吃了 {0}§c 根熱狗§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Joey is a world-class competitive pizza eater and is trying to break into the hot dog scene.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§cJoey §f是§a世界級§f的大胃王吃披薩選手，正試著打進§c熱狗§f界。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Joining a faction is an important choice, {roman} suggest you get to know the two factions first.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：加入派系是個重要的選擇，我建議你先認識這兩個派系。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Joining our faction is quite hard but {roman}'m sure an incredible individual like you will manage!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：加入我們的派系相當困難，但我相信像你這樣了不起的人一定能做到！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Jump in the portal now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在就跳進傳送門吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just a moment, let me gather my thoughts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等一下，讓我整理一下思緒。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just a week ago {roman} was feeling insecure, now {roman2}'m going to this duel with confidence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一週前我還很沒自信，現在我能滿懷信心地去決鬥了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just a week ago {roman} was stressed and scared, now {roman2} feel confident.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一週前我還緊張又害怕，現在我很有自信。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just aim the can at the crop you want to water and hold right-click!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要把澆水壺對準你要澆的作物，按住右鍵就好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just as {roman} promised, here's an extra Accessory Bag slot!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就像我承諾的，這是一格額外的§a飾品袋§f欄位！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just as {roman} thought...{roman2} am talking to a softie!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跟我想的一樣……我在跟一個軟腳蝦說話！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just ask {npc2}, he'll understand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：去問{npc2}就好，他會懂的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just because it worked before doesn't mean it will work again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：以前成功過，不代表這次也會成功。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just because you don't understand something doesn't mean it's not possible!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就因為你不懂某件事，不代表它不可能！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just because {roman} see {npc2} every day doesn't mean it's not a reason to celebrate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就算我每天都見到{npc2}，也不代表不值得慶祝。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just click me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：點我就好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just don't talk to anyone about it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只是別跟任何人說這件事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just for you {roman}'ll tell you it again at no charge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看在是你的份上，我免費再告訴你一次！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just get in the heckin {item} already.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快給我上那台該死的{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just how weak am {roman}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我到底有多弱？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just keep it! {roman} don't want this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你§a留著吧§f！我不要這個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just kidding, this axe is terrible, but it will do for now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：開玩笑的，這把斧頭爛透了，不過目前先湊合著用吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just listen to the fire with me, what a delightful melody.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跟我一起聽聽火的聲音吧，多麼美妙的旋律。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just looking at it is giving me the heebie-jeebies, let's move on!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：光是看著它就讓我起雞皮疙瘩，我們繼續吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just make sure you're Fishing Level {0} or you won't be able to catch 'em.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只是要確定你已達到§3釣魚等級 {0} §f，不然你是抓不到牠們的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just not quite genius enough to solve the Prism!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只是還沒§b聰明§f到能解開§b稜鏡§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just now, he went to take pictures of the old castle.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他剛剛去拍那座舊城堡了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just old wizard y'know
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只是個老巫師而已，你懂的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just one? That's not much of a bouquet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只有一朵？這可算不上花束！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just poke at 'em, and they'll jump like they've seen a ghost. Eventually, they'll tire out.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：戳戳牠們，牠們就會像見了鬼一樣跳起來。最後牠們就會累了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just set one up on any island, walk away, and when you come back, something's waiting for you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要在任何島上設一個，走開，等你回來就會有東西在等你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just tell us what you have to do and we'll do it for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：告訴我們你要做什麼，我們幫你做。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just thinking about it {roman} have a chill down my spine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：光是想到這件事，我就背脊發涼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just thinking about them makes me... Uhm, {roman} mean makes them come out of their hiding space.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：光是想到它們就讓我……呃，我是說讓牠們從藏身處跑出來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just thinking of that face makes me queasy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：光是想到那張臉就讓我§2想吐§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just wanted to make that clear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只是想把話說清楚。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just... tell him something smart!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就……跟他說點§a聰明的話§f吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Just... {#}inhales{#2}... saying.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我只是……{#}吸氣{#2}……說說而已。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Jythar knew there would be no path to victory against us for as long as we could unite.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Jythar 知道，只要我們能團結，他就沒有任何勝利的可能。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Keep at it! Can you finish the race in {0} seconds or less?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：堅持下去！你能在 {0} 秒以內跑完嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Keep checking back on them, {roman} am sure more people will visit our farm soon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記得常回來看看，我相信很快就會有更多人來我們的農場。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Keep in mind, the items may turn different between dimensions!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住，物品在不同維度之間可能會變得§d不一樣§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Keep it safe, for it is a piece of my power.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好好保管，因為它是我力量的一部分。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Keep it up!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：繼續加油！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Keep it up! Can you finish the race in {0} minute or less?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：繼續加油！你能在 {0} 分鐘以內跑完嗎？
