entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：繼續加油！你能在 {0} 分鐘以內跑完嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Keep the trapdoors closed!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把活板門關好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Killing enough mobs in a given Family unlocks rewards.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在一個§a族群§f中擊殺夠多的怪物就能解鎖§a獎勵§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Killing mobs in a Family enough times rewards you with {stats} towards that mob!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在一個族群中擊殺夠多次的怪物，就能獲得對該怪物的{stats}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Kind of like the people over in the {island} when it comes to voting for a Mayor...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有點像{island}那邊的人投票選鎮長的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Knowledge is the food of the soul.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：知識是靈魂的食糧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Land ho! We have arrived at the {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看到陸地了！我們抵達{island}了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Last guy who was in this cart didn't feel too well so watch out he might have left a surprise in there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：上一個搭這台礦車的傢伙不太舒服，所以小心點，他可能在裡面留了個驚喜。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Last night {roman} had another horrible nightmare. {roman2}'m afraid to fall asleep again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：昨晚我又做了一場可怕的惡夢。我不敢再睡著了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Last week they promoted me from guarding the exit to guarding the entrance! Still the same spot but {roman} gladly take that promotion!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：上週他們把我從看守出口升職成看守入口！還是同一個位置，但我很樂意接受這次升職！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Last {roman} heard, they are located near the Barbarian Faction.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我最後聽說的是，他們在野蠻人派系附近。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Later generations of Precursors, born into a world of accomplishments, yearned for purpose and legacy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：後來的先驅者世代誕生在一個充滿成就的世界，渴望著目標與傳承。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Later on {roman} buried the cat under my favorite tree, and adopted their cubs
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：後來我把那隻貓埋在我最喜歡的樹下，收養了牠的孩子們

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Lay out a Silkwire which crosses the Odonata.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拉一條穿過§9蜻蜓§f的§e絲線§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Learn more about this world before thinking of visiting other dimensions!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在考慮造訪§d其他§f維度之前，先多了解§o這個§r§f世界吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Leave me to my experiments, stranger!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我專心做實驗，陌生人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Left-right.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：左右。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Legend says they are infused with an evil deities strength, the truth is it is her power.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：傳說它們注入了邪惡神祇的力量，但事實上那是她的力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Lemme see... In {0} years they will both be {1} years old.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我看看……{0}§f 年後他們§a兩個都會是 {1}§f 歲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me ask you a question - have you ever heard of dyes?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我問你一個問題——你聽說過§c染§6料§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me count the final results eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我來統計最終結果吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me count the results eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我來統計結果吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me know if you need a house, {roman}'ll quote you a price!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你需要房子就告訴我，我會給你報價！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me know when you are ready.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：準備好了就告訴我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me know when you obtained the {0} Magma Chunks and {1} Burning Eyes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你取得 {0} 個岩漿塊和 {1} 個燃燒之眼再通知我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me know when you're done with your painting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：畫好了就跟我說一聲！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me present you my new game.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我向你介紹我的新遊戲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let me show you the {resource} Shop!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我帶你看看{resource}§6商店§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let us assemble at mine own house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我們在吾家會合吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let us hasten our steps to {area} shop without delay!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們立刻加快腳步前往{area}§a店裡§f吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let us keep this between us, and {roman} will generously reward you for your efforts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這件事就我們兩個知道，我會§a慷慨地獎勵§f你的付出。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let us make haste and go back to his house at once to see if we can uncover any new clues.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們趕快§c回到他家§f，看看能不能找到什麼新線索。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let us proceed to {npc2}'s house together.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們一起去{npc2}§b的家§f吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's AMP IT UP a bit! What do you say to {0}, {1}, or even {2} squats?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們來§c§l加大力道§f吧！{0}§f、{1}§f，還是乾脆 {2}§f 下，你覺得呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's a go!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：出發囉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's do a staring contest, {roman} always win!
entries.value: §d[NPC] {npc}§f：我們來比瞪眼吧，我每次都贏！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's do this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：開始吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's fight!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：開打吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's get inside.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們進去吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's go together now. For future trips, remember the {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們現在一起去吧。以後要去的話，記得找{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們走吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's have a match!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們來比一場吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's head right there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們馬上過去吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's head there! It is near the mines.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們過去吧！就在礦坑附近。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's hope you will succeed where others have not.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：希望你能在別人失敗的地方成功。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's hurry to {npc2} swift-ly!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們「迅速」去找{npc2}吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's leave her alone and go find {npc2} at his house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們別打擾她了，去{npc2}家找他吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's make SkyBlock fair again.
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：讓 SkyBlock 再次公平。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's make this jump legendary!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓這一跳成為§6傳奇§f吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's meet again there, and be prepared for combat.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們在那裡再碰頭，做好戰鬥的準備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's move quickly and help {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們快點去幫{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's not exaggerate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們別誇張了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's open the box.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們來打開箱子吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's play again, this time {roman} will try something a tad different.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們再玩一次吧，這次我會試點不太一樣的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's quickly make our way to {npc2}'s house to barricade it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們趕快去{npc2}§b的家§f把它封起來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's race! Good luck to you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：開始賽跑吧！祝你好運！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's see if you can succeed again this revolution.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看你這個週期能不能再次成功吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's see if your endurance matches your spirit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我們看看你的耐力是否配得上你的鬥志。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's separate. Take my contact and call me if you find anything.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們分頭找。拿著我的§a聯絡方式§f，找到什麼就打給我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's show it to my father.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們拿給我爸看吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's stick to NOT fairy...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們還是選§c不§f妖精吧……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's talk next time we meet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們下次見面再聊吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's talk to {npc2} again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們再去找{npc2}談談吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's taste...THIS IS DISGUSTING!!! Why would anyone waste such precious gold on this? Just like any other fancy food, expensive and gross...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我嚐嚐……這太噁心了！！！為什麼有人要把這麼珍貴的黃金浪費在這上面？就跟其他高級食物一樣，又貴又難吃……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's turn the heat up, it’s party time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們來炒熱氣氛吧，派對時間到了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Let's visualize it to help.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們來視覺化一下比較好懂。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Like Talcoins?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：像是 Tal 幣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Like an all-powerful entity created this world and everything that can exist in it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就像有一個全能的存在創造了這個世界，以及其中所有可能存在的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Like an inner voice telling me...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就像一個內在的聲音告訴我……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Like for example
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：舉例來說

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Like that time {roman} found a fairy soul
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：像是有一次我找到一個仙女之魂

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Like the sand one and forest one?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：像是沙子那座和森林那座？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Like they always say, one man's trash is another man's treasure!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就像大家常說的，一個人的§2垃圾§f是另一個人的§6寶藏§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Like {roman} said earlier, you can also fuse Shards.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就像我剛才說的，你也可以§5融合§f碎片。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Limited time only!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：限時供應！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Lines grant bonus stats, regardless of where you are!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：釣線不論你在哪裡都能提供額外屬性！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Listen, it's simple.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽著，很簡單的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Listen, it's very easy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽著，很簡單的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Listen, time is shorter with friends.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽著，有朋友在時間就過得快。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Listen. Glowing Mushrooms don't seem to be too good for my health. About time {roman} tried something else. You got anything, chum?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽著。發光蘑菇好像對我的健康不太好。我也該試試別的東西了。你有什麼嗎，夥伴？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Listen. {roman} also have some good items for your chumming.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽著。我也有一些撒餌用的好東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Literally!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是真的摘！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Literally, who cares?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說真的，誰在乎啊？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Long live the {event}!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{event}萬歲！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look around spider eggs too, and cobwebs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也找找蜘蛛卵附近，還有蜘蛛網！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look at that! It's already growing! It should be ready to harvest soon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看！它已經在長了！應該很快就能收成了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look at the time. You are late to your training.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看時間。你的訓練遲到了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look at you. Sweeping like a storm, hunting like a whisper. {roman} couldn't be prouder.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看你。掃蕩時如暴風，狩獵時如低語。我真為你驕傲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look buddy, {roman} don't know who you think you are, but back off okay?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽著，老兄，我不知道你以為你是誰，但退後，好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look for the glow, throw a lasso, and hope your aim's as sharp as mine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：找到那道光，丟出套索，祈禱你的準頭跟我一樣準。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look how awesome! The {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看多帥！{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look out, Magma Followers! Don't let them merge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：小心，§c岩漿追隨者§f！別讓牠們合體！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看那裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look up around the caves, some spiders have their nest behind some cobwebs up there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：往洞穴上方找找，有些蜘蛛把巢築在那上面的蜘蛛網後面。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look who it is... you made it to my {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看是誰來了……你來到我的{area}了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look! {roman} can paint with all the colors of the rainbow!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看！我能用彩虹的所有顏色作畫！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Look, we found one! A Corrupted Monster!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看，我們找到一隻了！一隻§2腐化怪物§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looking at the blueprint, it seems we need about {0} Enchanted Oak Logs and ...? {1} {resource}??
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看§9藍圖§f，我們好像需要大約 {0}§a 個附魔橡木原木§f和……？{1} {resource}§f？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looking for wool? Try the {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在找羊毛嗎？去{island}試試！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looking slick!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a看起來真帥氣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looking to buy something fancy?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想買點高級的東西嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looking to protect yourself or light up some tunnels?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想保護自己，還是想照亮隧道？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like it belonged to an especially ugly {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看起來它原本屬於一隻特別醜的{pet}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like the horde is coming! Cover me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來大軍要來了！§c掩護我§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like there isn't enough Magic left in this universe to complete my project.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來這個宇宙裡剩下的§5魔法§f不夠完成我的計畫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like we found him just in time, he will live, but he needs medical attention.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來我們及時找到他了，他會活下來，但需要醫療照顧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like you could use some help with your Greenhouse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來你的§a溫室§f需要一點幫助。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like {npc2} barricaded himself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來{npc2}把自己封在裡面了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like {pet} has re-emerged! It's time to shoot him with the Ballista!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來{pet}§f又冒出來了！該§c用弩砲射牠§f了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like {roman}'ll have to catch it the old fashioned way.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來我只好用老方法抓牠了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Looks like {roman}'m lost.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來我迷路了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Lost something?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：弄丟什麼了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Lost your belt?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你的腰帶弄丟了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Lots of people think they understand the market
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很多人以為自己懂市場

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Luckily for you, {roman} made a copy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：算你運氣好，我做了一份副本！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Luckily your coins are safe with me! Store them here before venturing deep into the depths of the {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幸好你的§6遊戲幣§f在我這裡很安全！深入{island}§f之前先存在這裡吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Luckily {roman} have a handy guide right here for you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幸好我這裡有一份§e實用指南§f給你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Lumisquids hide in awkward places… but that's half the fun, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：光魷躲在奇怪的地方……不過這正是一半的樂趣，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Lying there?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：躺在那裡？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maddox always hiding. Me know why.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Maddox 總是在躲。我知道為什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maddox is brain. Me slay. If you vote me, you slay too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Maddox 是腦袋。我負責殺。投我，你也一起殺！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maddox older brother.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Maddox 的哥哥。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mage Outlaws often attack Piglins, the Wizards don't really want to deal with them so we have to do it ourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：法師亡命之徒經常攻擊豬布林，巫師們不太想處理他們，所以我們只好自己來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Magic is very dangerous.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§d魔法§f非常§c危險。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Magma Chunks and Burning Eyes, perfect!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：岩漿塊和燃燒之眼，太完美了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Magnificent, you have vanquished Sun {mob}, not a feat to be understated.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：了不起，你擊敗了§e太陽{mob}§f，這可不是小成就。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Magnificent. You have vanquished Sun {mob}, not a feat to be understated.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：了不起。你擊敗了§e太陽{mob}§f，這可不是小成就。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make haste, for the villain may arrive forthwith.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快點，惡徒隨時可能到來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make sure to empty the vacuum in the Vermin Bin!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記得把吸塵器倒進§a害蟲垃圾桶§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make sure to share every gripping detail of your epic conquest with him next.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來記得把你史詩般征服的每一個精彩細節都分享給他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make sure you also talk to villagers from the other faction before you make your choice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做選擇之前，記得也跟另一個派系的村民聊聊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make sure you check all the mushrooms, sometimes there are tiny holes behind them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記得檢查所有的蘑菇，有時候它們後面有小洞。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make sure you empty your inventory entirely before you enter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：進去之前，記得把物品欄完全清空。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make sure you're keeping yourself warm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記得保暖喔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make sure your composter has enough resources! It won't start making more compost if it doesn't have the full materials to do it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記得確保你的堆肥機有足夠的資源！如果材料不齊全，它就不會開始製造更多堆肥。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make yourself at home!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把這裡當自己家吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Make yourself at home.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把這裡當自己家吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Makes no sense to me
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我完全搞不懂

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mama {pet} always said, "To reach great heights, you must take a leap of faith!".
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a{pet}媽媽§f總是說：§o「要達到高處，你必須信心一躍！」§r§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mammoths had two of these, and used them to fend off predators.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a猛瑪象§f有兩根這種東西，用來抵禦掠食者。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mangrove Trees are too tough for you yet, try getting at least {0}{stats}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a紅樹林樹§f對你來說還太硬了，至少先拿到 {0}{stats}§2吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Many Thanks! {roman}'ll be sure to let you have the first taste as soon as it's done... at a discounted price of course.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：非常感謝！等酒釀好，我一定讓你第一個品嚐……當然是打折價。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Many objects around here have become sentient. We're just living our lives now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這附近很多物品都有了自我意識。我們現在只是在過自己的生活。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Many treasures await you blah, blah, blah... Get in the {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：無數寶藏在等著你，諸如此類的……快上{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Many, many, many years ago, it would have belonged to one {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很多很多很多年以前，它應該屬於一隻{pet}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Marvelous!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Marvelous! The Fish looks even better than {roman} remembered!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！這條魚看起來比我記得的還要好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Marvelous! We have discovered the instrument of the crime.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a太好了！§f我們找到了犯案工具。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Marvelous, another footprint for my collection!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了，我的收藏又多了一個腳印！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: May fortune smile upon thy path and grace thy life with prosperity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：願好運眷顧汝的道路，讓汝一生富足。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: May our united efforts grant me victory against the dire fate that shadows my path.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：願我們同心協力，助吾戰勝籠罩吾路的悲慘命運。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: May you lead a fulfilling life!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：願你過著充實的人生！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: May your adventures continue to be as fruitful and exciting as this quest has been!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：願你的冒險一直像這次任務一樣豐碩又精彩！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: May your destiny be ridded with fortune.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：願你的命運充滿好運。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: May your next choice reflect deeper insights.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：願你下一次的選擇能展現更深的洞察。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: May {roman} quickly grab some {item}, please? {roman2} left the {resource} Shop unattended!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我可以趕快拿一些{item}§f嗎？我把{resource}§6商店§f丟著沒人顧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: May {roman} see his body?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我可以看看他的遺體嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe come back when you are more experienced for more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你更有經驗了再來，也許會有更多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe come back when you have SkyBlock Level {0}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你達到§aSkyBlock 等級 {0}§f再來吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe don't disturb me when {roman}'m trying to save the multiverse!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在拯救多重宇宙的時候，最好別打擾我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe equip yourself a bit better, and {roman} can retire my rescue hat... {#}exhales{#2}... just a suggestion.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許把自己裝備得好一點，我就能讓我的救援帽退休了……{#}吐氣{#2}……只是個建議。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe if we met in the past {roman} would have something for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果我們早點遇見，也許我會有東西給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe if {roman} continue buying his tips {roman2}'ll hit the jackpot soon. Just gotta spend a little bit more...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許只要我繼續買他的情報，很快就會中大獎。只要再多花一點……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe instead {roman} should stay there and keep talking
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許我應該待在那裡繼續說話就好

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe it got lost many years ago and ended up down here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許它很多年前迷了路，最後跑到這底下來了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe it won't ever return...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許牠永遠不會回來了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe it's about appearances being deceiving
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許是說外表會騙人

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe it's about beauty being subjective
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許是說美是主觀的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe it's about planning ahead
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許是說要未雨綢繆

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe it's about trusting your family more than others
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許是說要更信任家人而不是外人

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe it's time {roman} do something with my life
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許是時候讓我的人生做點什麼了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe next time!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下次吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe not so young, but my point still stands
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許沒那麼年輕了，但我的論點依然成立

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe one day {roman}'ll go back down there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許哪天我會再下去吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe one day {roman}’ll show you my place
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許有一天我會帶你去看看我住的地方

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe one of the {pet} Riders out there will have his toy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許外面其中一個{pet}§c騎士§f會有他的玩具。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe some of these items are yours? In which case {roman}'ll let you buy them back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說不定其中有些是你的？如果是的話，我可以讓你買回去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe that's better than becoming a magician?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許這比當魔術師還好？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe the {npc2} will even announce me as his favorite at the feast!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說不定{npc2}甚至會在宴會上宣布我是他的最愛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe there is a circle world somewhere, with someone just like me
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許某個地方真的有一個圓形世界，有一個跟我一模一樣的人

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe they are using a VPN, or downloading something, or just on a bad proxy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許他們在用 VPN、在下載東西，或只是用了爛代理伺服器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe we already had this conversation in the future.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許我們在§b未來§f已經§a進行過§f這段對話了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe we'll find more together in the future, but for now my work here is done!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許將來我們能一起找到更多，不過目前我在這裡的工作已經完成了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe you could sneak in and recover the item. Without getting seen and creating a major diplomatic incident, of course.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許你可以偷偷潛進去把東西拿回來。當然，別被看到，免得引發重大外交事件。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe you should go there and find out for yourself.

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許{pet}會眷顧你。

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許我應該賣我自己的貨幣，讓大家相信它值很多遊戲幣

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe {roman} should try to get my old job back...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許我該試著把我以前的工作找回來……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe {roman} was a cow in my past life?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許我上輩子是一頭牛？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe {roman} was wrong to trust you...

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Maybe {roman}'m just...that bad...{roman2}'m worthless...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：也許我就是……那麼差……我一文不值……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mayor become, again {roman} will.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a市長§f，我將再次成為。

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我和我的夥伴們各自收集一種木頭，然後平分，這樣大家的各種收藏都能提升！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Me eat items, give Motes.

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我？

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：需要幫忙就到你自己的島嶼來找我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Meet my lovable owl, Hootie!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來認識我可愛的貓頭鷹 Hootie！

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：事實上見過他好幾次，他總是在附近

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我{npc2}，我弄丟我的水晶球

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Might you assist me in solving this case?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你能協助我破這個案子嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mining gravel is hard work, but the flint is worth it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：挖礫石很辛苦，但燧石值得。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mining, fishing, they never mix
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：挖礦、釣魚，從來不混在一起

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Minions always have {0} Upgrade Slots where you can place Fuel or other items.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：工人一定有 {0} 個升級欄位，可以放燃料或其他物品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mmh! Tastes great!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a嗯！§f好好吃！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mmh! This is really good! {roman}'ll be sure to come back again when {roman2}'m no longer busy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯！這真好吃！等我不忙了一定會再來的！

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……看起來你有一些……奇怪的物品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mmh... maybe call a friend over and let's try again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……也許找個朋友來，我們再試一次！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Moles loooove carrots, they are just too good to resist.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鼴鼠超～愛§6紅蘿蔔§f的，實在太難抗拒了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Moles, you see. They have been burrowing everywhere, their tunnels are disrupting the landscape, they ruined the beauty of this place. It's gotten hard to ignore.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看，是§6鼴鼠§f。牠們到處挖洞，牠們的隧道破壞了地景，毀了這個地方的§5§o美麗§f。這已經難以忽視了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Monsters here only take damage from axes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡的怪物只會受到§a斧頭§f的傷害！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Moo!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哞！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: More Bottles, please. sigh
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：請再給我一些瓶子。唉

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: More importantly, {roman} am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：更重要的是，我很高興他終於遇到一個能當作朋友的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Morning, adventurer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：早安，冒險者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mortal, the time of reckoning is near. The Past will light the future.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：凡人，審判的時刻近了。過去將照亮未來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most bird species evolve with hollow bones, to help them stay light when flying.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大多數鳥類演化出中空的骨頭，好讓牠們飛行時保持輕盈。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most intriguing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是耐人尋味。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most mobs have one type, but some have more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大部分生物只有§a一種§f類型，但有些有§c更多§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most monsters around drop valuable items, you can make a living killing them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：附近的怪物大多會掉落值錢的物品，你可以靠獵殺牠們維生。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most of their time is spent trying to decide who's going to be the next king.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們大部分的時間都在決定誰要當下一任國王。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most of them are Crafting materials used to upgrade various Coin-related pieces of gear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大部分都是§a合成材料§f，用來升級各種跟§6金幣§f相關的裝備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most people always talk about coins around here
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡大部分的人總是在談遊戲幣

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most people and things have a reflection in other universes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大多數的人和事物在其他宇宙中都有一個倒影。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most people around here have an Abiphone, and some of them might let you add them to your contacts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這附近大部分的人都有 Abiphone，有些人可能會讓你把他們加進§a聯絡人§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most people know {boss} as the Wither {npc2}, but {roman} think it's important to remind people that he once was a human.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大部分的人都知道{boss}是凋零{npc2}，但我認為提醒大家他曾經是個人類很重要。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Most people survive it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大多數人都能活下來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Motes particles, pickup.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§d微粒§f粒子，撿起來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Much appreciated.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：非常感謝。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Much like time, the game will always be here, testing the limits of your ingenuity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就像時間一樣，遊戲永遠都會在這裡，考驗你聰明才智的極限。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mudworms? You've gotta watch the ground closely... and {roman} mean closely.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：泥蟲？你得仔細盯著地面……我是說非常仔細。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Mum's making us read, but {roman}'d rather be out fishing with pa.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：媽媽要我們讀書，但我比較想跟爸爸出去釣魚。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Music to my ears.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對我來說就是音樂。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My Chocolate is the finest chocolate in the entire world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的§6巧克力§f是全§9世界§f最棒的巧克力。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My IQ is above {0}, my mind is a crucible of infinite possibilities.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的智商超過 {0}，我的心智是無限可能的熔爐。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My advice? Gather as much ф {stats} as possible before proceeding further.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的建議？在繼續前進之前，盡可能收集越多§aф {stats} §f越好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My assistant is feeling off, and {roman} think we could do with a hearty meal. Do you think you can help us out?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的助手身體不太舒服，我想我們需要一頓豐盛的大餐。你能幫幫我們嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My beliefs prevent me from fishing, but {roman} cannot investigate without seeing some specimens myself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的信仰不允許我釣魚，但我不親眼看看一些標本就沒辦法調查。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My best time is pretty fast, you probably will never beat me. But you can try!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的最佳紀錄很快，你大概永遠贏不了我。不過你可以試試！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My brother is mining the gravel from the {island}. We are the {resource} Bros!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我兄弟在{island}§f挖礫石。我們是{resource}§7兄弟§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My chickens can't be that far, {roman} have {0} of them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的雞不可能跑太遠，我有 {0} 隻。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My contest has started!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的競賽開始了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My cousin {npc2} leads an... organization.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的表哥{npc2}領導一個……組織。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My dear Leo is on his {0}th life, {roman} give him all the care in the world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我親愛的 Leo 正在過他的第 {0} 條命，我給他全世界最好的照顧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My dear {npc2}, whom fortune hath forsaken, is nigh unto his final breath!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：吾親愛的{npc2}已被命運遺棄，就快要嚥下最後一口氣了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My disappointment is immeasurable. What a waste of my valuable time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我失望到無法衡量。真是浪費我寶貴的時間。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My dream? To pen a comprehensive tome about them, but the pieces are still falling into place.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的夢想？寫一部關於他們的完整巨著，但拼圖還在一片一片湊齊中。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My father believes that the Mage Faction is working on some kind of powerful war instrument.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我爸認為§c法師派系§f正在研發某種強大的§2戰爭兵器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My father invented piggy banks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我父親發明了撲滿。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My father wants me to become the next Chief one day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我爸希望我有一天能成為下一任酋長。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My favorite Minion Upgrade is the {item}, soooo useful!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我最喜歡的工人升級是{item}，超～好用的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My favorite cat? {roman} love them all.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我最喜歡的貓？我每一隻都愛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My favorite one is the cat one
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我最喜歡的是貓的那個

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My fishing rod is quite amazing but {roman}'m still saving up for a better one, {roman2} can't wait!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的釣竿相當厲害，但我還在存錢買一支更好的，好期待！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My friend should be here any minute now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的朋友隨時都會到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My friend told me about you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我朋友跟我提過你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My friend {npc2} can be found there. {roman}'m sure he'll have some work for you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的朋友{npc2}就在那裡。我相信他會有工作給你的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My friend {npc2} said he would come get me but he hasn't arrived yet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的朋友{npc2}說他會來接我，但他還沒到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My garden seems to miss having one around!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的花園好像很想念有牠在的日子！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My government cannot afford this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的政府負擔不起！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My gratitude for thy aid is boundless, for thy labors were crucial, and alone {roman} stood no chance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：吾對你的幫助感激不盡，你的付出至關重要，若只有吾一人，必定毫無勝算。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My heart, once frail, now beats anew, by thy noble hand restored.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：吾那曾經脆弱的心，因你高尚之手而重新跳動。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My helmet is constantly breaking. Could you provide me with some Pumpkins to help with maintenance?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的頭盔老是壞掉。你能給我一些南瓜來維修嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My hiking buddy still hasn't returned. {roman}'m afraid the worst has happened and he's starved to death...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的健行夥伴還沒回來。我擔心最壞的情況發生了，他已經餓死了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My home is clean and beautiful
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的家又乾淨又漂亮

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My homework asks...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的作業問……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My husband works all the time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我老公一直在工作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My job here is done.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在這裡的工作完成了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在這裡的工作是確保岩漿持續流動，鈦閃閃發亮。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My job is to infiltrate their {area} and steal their war machine so we can study it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的任務是潛入他們的{area} §f，偷走他們的§2戰爭機器§f好讓我們研究。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My kid has been crying for hours.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的孩子已經哭了好幾個小時了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My kids are a handful, but {roman} love them so.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的孩子們很難帶，但我好愛他們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My lab doesn't feel very secret anymore.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的實驗室感覺已經不怎麼祕密了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My last hiking buddy didn't make it out of the gorge...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我上一個健行夥伴沒能走出峽谷……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My le-
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的腿——

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My leg got hurt and {roman} had to hide here, the rest is blurry...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的腿受了傷，只好躲在這裡，其他的都很模糊……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My leg really hurts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的腿真的好痛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My little {npc2} has such a lovely voice, {roman} don't mind hearing him cry.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的小{npc2}聲音好可愛，聽他哭我也不介意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My lord...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的天啊……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My love for thee is unending.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：吾對汝的§d愛§f永無止境。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My lover?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的戀人？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My magic will grant you tremendous power.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的魔法將賜予你巨大的力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My mate {npc2} has a {item}! With it, he can break down entire trees in a single swipe!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的夥伴{npc2}有一把{item}！有了它，他一下就能砍倒整棵樹！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My mate {npc2} knows which types all the different symbols represent.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的夥伴{npc2}知道所有不同符號各代表哪種類型。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My math homework is way too hard!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的數學作業§c§o太難了§r§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My mind is at peace knowing you are by his side.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：知道你在他身邊，我就安心了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My mother was a wizard, while my father crafted beautiful jewelry.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我母親是一位§d巫師§f，而我父親會打造§b美麗的珠寶§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My name is {npc2}! {roman} have quite the reputation around here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我叫{npc2}！我在這一帶可是很有名的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My name is {npc2}, {roman} don't come here very often.
entries.value: §d[NPC] {npc}§f：我叫{npc2}，我不常來這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My neighbor is the most narcissistic guy {roman} have ever seen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的鄰居是我見過最自戀的傢伙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My neighbor told me to get off his property, but he doesn't even own this place!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的鄰居叫我滾出他的土地，但這地方根本就不是他的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My new book is a different take on the battle royale stories.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的新書是對大逃殺故事的另一種詮釋。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My new hiking buddy went there a couple days ago to explore but he hasn't come back!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的新健行夥伴幾天前去那裡探險，但他還沒回來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My new novel is about someone who has a strange power that allows him to inspect the memories of others.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的新小說講的是一個擁有奇怪能力的人，他能查看別人的記憶。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My new novel?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的新小說？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My next work will be even more grandiose!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的下一個作品會更加宏偉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My opinion is that it's a little bit of both
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的看法是兩者都有一點

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My other brother should have a spare weapon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我另一個兄弟應該有多的武器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My parents always told me to focus on my studies
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我爸媽總是叫我專心念書

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My partner, Sun {mob}, and {roman} discovered the {enchantment} of Time together.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我和我的夥伴§e太陽{mob}§f一同發現了時間的{enchantment}§9§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My plan is to assemble the greatest bouquet ever!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的計畫是做出史上最棒的§c花束§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My poor {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我可憐的{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My poor {npc2}, it is my vault, {roman} shouldn't send him on difficult missions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我可憐的{npc2}，這是我的錯，我不該派他去執行困難的任務。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My private island is a Zoo, you should come by and visit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的私人島嶼就是一座動物園，你應該來參觀看看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My scouts told me they sighted Barbarian activities in the North, near the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的斥候告訴我，他們在§c北方的{area}§f附近發現了野蠻人的活動。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My second favorite activity is sleeping
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我第二喜歡的活動是睡覺

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My services aren't for everyone young traveler!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：年輕的旅人，我的服務可不是人人都能用的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My sheep are some of the best in the world!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的羊是全世界最好的羊之一！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My shinning light is you, a beam of hope in this dark cave
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的那道光就是你，這黑暗洞穴中的一束希望

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My specialites are ores, stone, and mining equipment!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的專長是礦石、石頭和挖礦裝備！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My standing as the {npc2}'s favorite emissary is secured as soon as {roman} bring these back home!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要我把這些帶回家，我身為{npc2}最喜歡的使者的地位就穩固了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My studies led me to distinguish two categories: Old and New Starborns.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的研究讓我將他們分為兩類：古老星裔與新生星裔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My thirst is quenched!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我解渴了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My time here is over, {roman} think {roman2}'ll go down in the {area} very soon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在這裡的時間結束了，我想我很快就會下到{area}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My tongue is hurting for some reason...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不知道為什麼我的舌頭好痛……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My trick? {roman} make coins from the others' greed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的訣竅？我靠別人的貪婪賺§6遊戲幣§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My wheat minion has been slacking recently, {roman} am thinking about giving it an upgrade. He hasn't produced any wheat in years! Every time {roman2} check on him, he's empty.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的小麥工人最近很偷懶，我在考慮幫它升級。它已經好幾年沒產出任何小麥了！每次我去看它，它都是空的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我老婆說只要你保證這次不打破東西，我們就可以辦過夜聚會。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My wife said {roman}'m free to come to the sleepover if {roman2} do the dishes first.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我老婆說只要我先洗好碗，就可以去參加過夜聚會。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My wife's not gonna be happy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我老婆不會高興的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My wisdom knows no bounds, only {roman} can bring balance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的智慧無邊無際，只有我能帶來平衡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My woodcutting assistant has fallen quite ill! Do you think you could take over for him?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的伐木助手病得很重！你能幫他代班嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My wool is so fluffy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的羊毛好蓬鬆！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My {collections_res} Minions produce the finest flour around, but they can't keep up with today's demand...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的{collections_res}§9工人§f做出這一帶§a最好的麵粉§f，但它們跟不上現在的需求……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My {item} might not mine the fastest, but it gives me a lot of experience!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的{item}挖得也許不是最快的，但它能給我很多經驗！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: My {npc2} breathes still, thanks to thy valor!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：多虧汝的英勇，吾的{npc2}仍有一息尚存！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: NO MORE NIGHTMARES!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再也沒有惡夢了！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nada!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼都沒有！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nah, that would be CRAZY.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不，那也太瘋狂了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Name's {npc2}, and before ye ask, no, {roman}'m not here for the camaraderie.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我叫{npc2}，在你開口之前先說清楚，不，我不是來交朋友的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Naturally, this is where the investigation leads.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：理所當然，調查就是指向這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Naturally, {roman} decided to combine their talents!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以我自然決定把他們的才能結合起來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Navigating around here is really tough...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這附近找路真的好難……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Need a {item}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：需要{item}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Need another potion?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還需要一瓶藥水嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nether Warts have some...unique properties, that make them especially useful to me
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：地獄疙瘩有一些……獨特的特性，讓它們對我特別有用

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Never.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：絕對不會。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Newest member of the Faction!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：派系的最新成員！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Next step is the Trial of Blue {resource} {roman}! ({0} damage)
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下一步是§3藍色{resource}試煉 {roman}§f！§7（{0}§7 傷害）

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Next time, things will be different, you will see.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下一次，事情會不一樣的，你等著看吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Next up you should add {0} {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來你應該加入 {0} 個{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Next {roman} need some flat gold to test how reflective gold is, could you try forging gold into {0} gold plates?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來我需要一些扁平的黃金，來測試黃金的反光程度，你能試著把黃金鍛造成 {0} 塊金板嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Next {roman}'m going to need a vegetable that is made out of solid gold. {roman2} want to experiment with how gold interacts with organics, maybe you could find some, like a half stack?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來我需要一種純金做的蔬菜。我想實驗黃金和有機物的交互作用，也許你能找一些，大概半組？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice day to go fishing, isn't it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：今天真是釣魚的好日子，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice doin' business with ya! Here's some copper in return.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很高興跟你做生意！這些銅給你當回報。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice doing business with you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很高興跟你做生意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice job getting all the timecharms.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：收集到所有時之護符，做得好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice job kiddo!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幹得好，小子！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice job! In return for those logs, {roman}'ll give ya this {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好！作為那些原木的回報，這把{item}給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice job, hotshot! {roman}'d give you the Campfire Initiate Badge {roman2} right now, but {roman3}'m out of wood to make one with...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幹得好，火熱的傢伙！我本來想現在就給你營火新人徽章 {roman2}，但我沒有木頭可以做了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice seeing you! It gets a bit lonely down in the Hollows.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很高興見到你！在空洞底下待久了有點寂寞。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice to meet you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很高興認識你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice to meet you. {roman}'m {npc2}, a Dwarven Scout.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很高興認識你。我是{npc2}，一名矮人斥候。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice try, bruh! Pay the toll to get the soul!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想得美，兄弟！付過路費才能拿靈魂！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice! But crops need water to grow. Use this watering can to water the plot.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好！但作物需要水才能生長。用這個澆水壺幫地塊澆水。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice! Now that both plants are growing, take this {item} to learn how crops are affected by each other.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好！既然兩株植物都在長了，拿著這個{item}來了解作物之間如何互相影響。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice! Put it in the cauldron!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好！把它放進大鍋！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice! So what are you up to?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不錯！那你最近在忙什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice! Well, take this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了！嗯，拿著這個。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice! {roman} have a Tier {roman2} {item} of my own, maybe one day you can be like me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不錯！我自己也有一個 {roman2} 級的{item}，也許哪天你也能跟我一樣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice! {roman}'ve added the Chip Menu to your {item} while you are on the {island}, so you'll have easier access to them from now on.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好！我已經在你待在{island}§f時，把§9晶片選單§f加進你的{item}§f裡了，以後你就能更方便地使用它們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice, only {0} Carrots to go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，只差 {0}§6 根胡蘿蔔§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice, only {0} Chocolate Bars to go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，只差 {0}§6 條巧克力棒§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice, only {0} Fine Flours to go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，只差 {0}§6 份精製麵粉§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice, only {0} Mushrooms to go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，只差 {0}§6 朵蘑菇§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice, only {0} Prickly Kisses to go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，只差 {0}§6 個多刺之吻§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice, only {0} Pumpkins to go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，只差 {0}§6 個南瓜§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nice, only {0} Wartys to go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，只差 {0}§6 個疣疣§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nicely done! {roman} didn't see that coming.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好！我沒料到這一招。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nicely done, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No biggie! It's right here
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒什麼大不了！牠就在這裡

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No but-
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不，但是——

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No hard feelings, {roman} also judged you too quickly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不用放在心上，我也太快下定論了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不知道，這種巨獸憑空出現可不是好兆頭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No matter what, {roman} always stay classy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不管怎樣，我永遠都§e保持優雅§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No more false promises. No more slacking. No more monarchs...
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：不再有空頭承諾。不再有怠惰。不再有君主……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No more greed. No more chaos. Only fair progress for all.
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：不再有貪婪。不再有混亂。只有所有人公平的進步。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No more {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不要再有{item}了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No more {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再也沒有{npc2}了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No need to choose just one - you can stack multiple boosters on the same item!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不必只選一個——你可以在同一件物品上疊加多個強化器！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No one can match these raw skillz!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有人比得上這純粹的技術！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No one knows for sure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有人確切知道。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No one made any bids! Let's move on to the next item!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有人出價！我們繼續下一件拍賣品吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No one made any bids! Let's move on to the next item.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有人出價！我們繼續下一件拍賣品吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No pets allowed in the dojo! Get off of your pet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：道場裡禁止寵物！從你的寵物身上下來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No point in hiding it, {roman} suppose.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我想也沒什麼好隱瞞的了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No problem! Allow me to explain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒問題！讓我來解釋。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No real tricks here. Just chuck your net until they give up.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡沒什麼技巧。就一直丟網子，直到牠們放棄。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No sense of festive spirit in you, is there?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你一點節日氣氛都沒有，是吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No supplies? You wouldn't want to experience what the lil' bear did, would you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有材料？你可不想經歷小熊遇到的事吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No vampires here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡沒有吸血鬼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No worries, {roman}'ll come back later.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒關係，我晚點再來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No worries, {roman}'ll hang on to it for now. {roman2}'ll come back later.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒關係，我先幫你保管。我晚點再來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No {roman} didn't.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我才沒有。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, forget what {roman} just said.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不，忘了我剛剛說的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, it's magic!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不，這是§6魔法§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, no! It's Gala-té-à!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不不不！是 Gala-té-à！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, not {npc2}, my other assistant {npc3}, right next to the Fusion Machine in the back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不，不是{npc2}§f，是我的另一位助手{npc3}§f，就在後面的§5融合機§f旁邊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, please, press me again. It's not like {roman} had any plans today besides being your personal toy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不不，請再按我一次。反正我今天除了當你的私人玩具之外，也沒別的計畫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, really, {roman} don't believe it at all.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不，真的，我完全不相信。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, that really doesn't work.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c不§f，這真的不對。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, unfortunately {roman} do not have it in me to do the deed myself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不，可惜我沒膽自己下手。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, {npc2}. {roman}'ve come this far, and {roman2} won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, {roman3}'ll find it myself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不，{npc2}。我已經走到這一步了，不會就此停下。如果你不告訴我真相，我就自己去找。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No, {roman}'m lagging even with my VPN turned off.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有，我連 VPN 關掉都還是在卡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No? Ok ok how about {0} coins then?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不要？好好好，那 {0} 遊戲幣呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: No? {roman} guess that's just me then...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不是嗎？看來只有我這樣想……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nobody seems to know why
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好像沒有人知道為什麼

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nom nom nom.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嚼嚼嚼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: None of the animals here have eaten since they started existing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡的動物從存在以來就沒吃過東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: None.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼都沒有。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nonetheless, we should call upon his help.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：儘管如此，我們還是該請他幫忙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nonsense...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：胡說八道……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nope! Nothing... Nothing at all!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有！什麼都沒有……完全沒有！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nope, that's just a {collections_res}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不對，那只是一隻{collections_res}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Normally {roman}'d send somebody else to do my bidding for me, but this is an urgent matter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：平常我會派別人替我辦事，但這件事很緊急。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Norry, Brammor zbells too bad.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱千，Brammor 太臭了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not a problem, thanks for your time anyways.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒關係，還是謝謝你抽空。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not a problem. {roman} hear that {resource} is worse anyways.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒問題。反正我聽說{resource}比較差。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：又來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not as token of despair, but as a sign that even the broken may yet be saved, as {roman} have been by thee.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不是作為絕望的信物，而是作為一個象徵：即使是破碎之物也仍能被拯救，就像吾被你拯救一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not bad for a human!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：以人類來說不錯嘛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not bad!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不錯嘛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not bad, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不錯嘛，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not because of what they do, but because they are circles
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不是因為它們的功能，而是因為它們是圓的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not cool. That's very low, even for {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真不酷。就算對{item}來說也太低級了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not enough people are doing them so {roman} usually have to do most requests myself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做的人不夠多，所以大部分的請求通常都是我自己做。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not even a century ago teleportation was thought to be impossible!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不到一個世紀前，大家還認為傳送是不可能的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not even anywhere in the Rift!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：連在§d隙界§f裡都沒有！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not even in death.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：即使在§c死後§f亦然。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not everyone wants to see their future, but they should.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不是每個人都想看到自己的未來，但他們應該要看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not going to give someone like you coins.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：才不會給你這種人遊戲幣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not gonna be able to wear this anymore, bud. But a deal's a deal, {roman} guess!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個再也不能穿了，夥伴。不過說好的就是說好的，我想！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not many people are left, who can tell the story of that day
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：能說出那天發生什麼事的人已經不多了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not me, {roman}'m a free spirit
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我不一樣，我是個自由的靈魂

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not much was happening back then
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那時候沒什麼事發生

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not really, that can't be.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不太可能，不會是那樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not sure what's the point of their cult but it worries me a bit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我不確定他們的邪教有什麼目的，但這讓我有點擔心。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not that {roman}'m a Vampire of course - {roman2} am definitely not.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當然，我不是吸血鬼——我絕對不是。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not the best for conversations but
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不是最好的聊天對象，但

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not to flex, but {roman}'ve watched enough films to know about every mob type in existence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不是我要炫耀，但我看過的電影多到我知道世上§d每一種生物類型§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Not too loud!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別太大聲！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nothin' is more satisfying, than a full inventory after a day of work!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：工作一整天後，沒有什麼比塞滿的物品欄更讓人滿足了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nothing... {roman} just wanted to have more Motes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼都不買……我只是想要更多§d微粒§f而已。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now bring this gift to {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在把這份禮物帶給{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now go and bring back {0} {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在去帶 {0} 條{item}回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now go one, make those ores feel their age. Time's a-wastin'!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在去吧，讓那些礦石感受一下歲月的痕跡。時間可不等人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now go, and enjoy our great city, new Faction member!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在去吧，好好享受我們偉大的城市，新的派系成員！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now if you will excuse me, it's time for me to take care of my leg.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在，如果你不介意的話，我得去照顧我的腿了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now if you wish to retrieve your {collections_res}, follow me inside.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你們想拿回{collections_res}，就跟我進去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now is flying time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在是§b飛行§f時間。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now let's get down to business.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我們來談正事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now let's hit the Queen where it hurts - by stealing her Amber Crystal!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我們去打擊女王的痛處——偷走她的§6琥珀水晶§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now normally, {roman} run a humble little shop that allows you to upgrade some useful perks in exchange for {resource}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：平常我經營一家小店，讓你用{resource}升級一些實用的強化！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now please bring back {0} {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在請帶 {0} 瓶{item}回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now please deal with the infestation problem.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在請處理§a害蟲§f的問題。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now set a path for yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在為自己鋪一條路吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now talk to Bugshopper and show me an Odonata Bottle.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在去找§a Bugshopper §f談談，然後給我看一個§a蜻蜓瓶§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now that my windmill is up and running, {roman}'ll open my shop to you so you don't have to go back to the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然我的風車已經能運作了，我就為你開放我的商店，這樣你就不必回{area}了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now that you are armed with accounting knowledge, go help {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你已經掌握了會計知識，去幫{npc2}吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now that you are familiar with the basics, let's move on to the more advanced techniques.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你已經熟悉§a基礎§f了，我們來學更§9進階的§f技巧吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now that you have your Heart of the {area}, you have access to all of the deeper areas of the mines!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你有了§5{area}之心，你就能進入礦坑所有更深的區域了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now that you know the rules, let's begin.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你知道規則了，我們開始吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now that you mention it, {roman} remember how to escape the belly of the Matriarch!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你這麼一說，我想起怎麼從§c女族長§f的肚子裡逃出來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now that you played against them, {roman} want to see how much you have learned.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你已經跟他們玩過了，我想看看你學到了多少。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now that you've laid out a path, you have at least one thing to do if you follow it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你已經鋪好了一條路，只要順著走，至少就有§a一件事可做§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now the Brew needs {0} {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在§5藥水§f需要 {0} 條{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now then, time is of the essence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好了，時間緊迫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now to the dirty part... the plot has to be cleaned up before it can be used...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來是髒活了……這塊地得先清理乾淨才能使用……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now use the hook.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在用§a鉤子§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now we'll be havin' reserves for all o' winter!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這下整個冬天都有存糧啦！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now we're cooking! You're getting close to my record!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這才對嘛！你快接近我的紀錄了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now we're talking! You're getting close to my record!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這才像話！你快接近我的紀錄了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now you can grow crops you've unlocked there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在你可以在那裡種你已解鎖的作物了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now you probably understand why the village in front is called {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在你大概明白為什麼前面的村莊叫做{area}了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now you should finally learn what Shards are for.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在你終於該了解碎片是做什麼用的了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now {roman} can finally produce some {resource}... let's head inside!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我終於能生產一些{resource}了……我們進去吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now {roman} can take this all back to {npc2}, and say {roman2} did it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我可以把這些全帶回去給{npc2}，然後說是我做的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now {roman} just have to wait for the pretendent.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我只要等那個追求者出現了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now {roman} just need enough heat to melt it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我只需要§c足夠的熱度§f來熔化它！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now {roman} need a lot of compacted gold, it has to be extremely dense. A half stack should do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我需要很多壓縮過的黃金，必須非常緊密。半組應該就夠了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now {roman} regret saying {roman2} wouldn't reward you
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我後悔說了不會給你獎勵

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now's the time! Defend {npc2} with all you've got!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就是現在！全力保護{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, as {roman} promised, take another slot!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在，就像我承諾的，再拿一格§d欄位§f吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, before we set off, you should make sure you've bought some starter equipment from the {npc2} in the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在出發之前，你應該先確定已經在{area}跟{npc2}買了一些新手裝備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, it's time to teach you the true purpose of hunting.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在，是時候教你§a狩獵§f的真正目的了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, let's get to work. It's time to plant our first crop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，開始工作吧。是時候種下我們的§e第一株作物§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, please climb aboard before your cart leaves without you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好了，請在你的礦車丟下你之前上車。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，聚會開始了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, wear it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在，穿上它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, what's yer business here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那麼，你來這裡做什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, why don't you go and find a {island} or two, and then come talk to me again when you're ready for us to partner up?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那麼，何不先去找一兩個{island}，等你準備好跟我搭檔時再來找我談？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, {roman} am be delighted to see a Rare {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在，我很高興能看到一隻§9稀有{pet}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Now, {roman} must return to my studies.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在，我必須回去繼續研究了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nowadays this place is only used for expeditions and adventures!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在這個地方只用來探險和冒險！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Nowadays {roman} live as a recluse, focusing on my work.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在我過著隱居的生活，專心工作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Numerous wizards have ventured into the Rift, but not all are from the world you and {roman} come from.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：已經有很多巫師冒險進入§d隙界§f，但不是所有人都來自你和我所在的世界。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: OH well, maybe next time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喔好吧，也許下次吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: OMG
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：天啊

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: OMG! Great work collecting my supplies!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：天啊！補給品收集得太好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: OMG! {roman}'m having a panic attack!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c§l天啊！§f我的§c恐慌症§f發作了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: ONE SECOND {roman}'{roman2} PRETTY BUSY RIGHT NOW!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等一下，我現在超忙的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Observe the bloodstains on the ground, my dear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：親愛的，看看地上的血跡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Occasionally the signal falters, and we have to recalibrate it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：訊號偶爾會不穩，我們就得重新校準。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Of course {player}, but {roman} can't!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當然，{player}，但我做不到！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Of course {roman} do! {roman2}'m sharp in more ways than one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當然有！我可不只一方面很鋒利。
