entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：除了它們本身的能力之外，每個飾品都會讓你的§a飾品袋§f更強大！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once a Mayor is elected, the runner-up with the most votes is selected to act as their Minister.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當一位§6市長§f當選後，得票最多的§b次高票者§f會被選為他們的§6部長§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once access is granted, you can always come here by using the Fast Travel menu in your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：取得進入權後，你隨時都可以使用你{item}§f裡的§b快速移動§f選單來到這裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once again, victory eludes you in the face of {npc2}, as it has for your countless predecessors.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你又一次在{npc2}面前與勝利擦身而過，就像你無數的前輩一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once again, {roman} had the same recurring nightmare, a little different this time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我又做了同樣的惡夢，這次有點不同。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once more you have triumphed over Sun {mob}. Such perseverance is rare, even in Tales of old.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你再一次戰勝了§e太陽{mob}§f。如此的毅力，即使在古老的傳說中也很罕見。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once my hammer delivery is here, {roman}'ll let you use my services!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等我的錘子送到，我就讓你使用我的服務！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once that's done, go visit my cousin {npc2} in his shop in the plaza.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：完成之後，去廣場的店裡找我的表弟{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once there, test yourself against the {mob}, if you're up to the challenge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：到了那裡，如果你願意接受挑戰，就去和{mob}較量一下吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once they wake up from their coma we will know what happened to them, but {roman} have my suspicions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等他們從昏迷中醒來，我們就會知道發生了什麼事，不過我心裡有底了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once upon a time, it belonged to a ferocious {pet}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很久很久以前，它屬於一隻兇猛的{pet}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once upon a time, on an island far away
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很久很久以前，在一座遙遠的島上

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once upon a time, there were thousands of different species of {pet}, and they were plentiful in numbers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很久很久以前，{pet}有成千上萬個不同物種，數量也非常多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once you are inside its stomach, you can steal a few pearls.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一旦你進了牠的胃，就可以§2偷幾顆珍珠§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once you complete them, come back to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：完成之後，再回來找我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once you find the large room below the Volcano, you'll be able to see it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一旦你找到火山底下的大房間，就能看到牠了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once you get your hands on one, swing by and see me and {roman}'ll teach you about Chips!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你拿到一把之後，就過來找我，我會教你關於§9晶片§f的事！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once you unlock a Minion, you also unlock all their Level up recipes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一旦你解鎖了一個工人，也會解鎖它所有的升級配方！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once you've explored an area {roman} can give you a safe ride back there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你探索過一個區域，我就能安全地載你回到那裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once {roman} found this Fairy Soul {roman2} decided to build my house around it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我一找到這個仙女之魂，就決定圍著它蓋我的房子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Once {roman} have enough {roman2} will craft myself better Huntraps!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等我收集夠了，我就要幫自己做更好的狩獵陷阱！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One can hope you won't have to investigate my own reverse murder.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但願你永遠不必調查我自己的逆向謀殺案。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One cannot investigate a reverse murder without first creating a murder scenario, dear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：親愛的，要調查逆向謀殺案，總得先製造一個謀殺現場。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One cannot sleep well, love well, think well, if one has not dined well.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒吃好的人，睡不好、愛不好，也想不好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One day after sundown, a fire started spreading in our house
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有一天日落之後，我們家開始起火了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One day hordes of people appeared out of nowhere
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有一天，大批的人憑空出現

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One day the cat gave birth to {0} little devils, and decided to hide them in our attic
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有一天，那隻貓生了 {0} 隻小惡魔，還決定把牠們藏在我們的閣樓裡

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One day will come when the world will be cured from lag.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總有一天，這個世界會擺脫延遲的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One day {roman} will be useful.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總有一天我會派上用場的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One day {roman}'ll build the {npc2} tower.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總有一天我要蓋{npc2}大樓。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One doesn't reach his rank without crossing a few lines.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要爬到§2他§f那個地位，不可能沒§c越過一些界線§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One for each bunny aroun'!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這附近每隻兔子一根！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One indeed reaps what they sow.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：種什麼因，得什麼果。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One last flail before admitting defeat, huh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：認輸前最後再掙扎一下，是吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One more test before {roman} let you go. The Test of Mastery.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在我放你走之前還有一個試煉。§2精通試煉§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One of my chickens mutated into an abomination.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的一隻雞突變成了怪物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One of the Relics is inside a tiny hole inside the caves.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：其中一個遺物在洞穴裡的一個小洞裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One of the boxes holds an {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：其中§a一個§f箱子裝著{item}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One of the {pet} Riders out there did it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是外面其中一個{pet}§c騎士§f幹的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One of them yaps and {roman} say, "ever tried my tonic"?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：其中一個在嘰嘰喳喳，我就說：「你試過我的補藥嗎？」

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One rather peculiar discovery is the {mob} Prime - the giant robot towering above me. The exact purpose of it is unknown, although it appears to be guarding something.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有個相當奇特的發現是{mob}§b首領§f——就是聳立在我上方的巨大機器人。它的確切用途不明，不過它似乎在守護著什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One second everything is fine and the next, the world is ending.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：前一秒一切都好好的，下一秒世界就要毀滅了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One small step for frog, one giant leap for frogkind.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是青蛙的一小步，卻是蛙類的一大步。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: One thing is certain, dropping breadcrumbs everywhere would take too long!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有件事是肯定的，到處撒麵包屑會花太多時間！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Only affected by powers like {stats}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只會受到{stats}這類力量影響。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Only one contains something invaluable; an {item}, a testament to wisdom.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只有§a一個§f裝著無價之物：一個{item}§f，智慧的證明。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Only some items can have Gemstones applied, and you can remove them at any time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只有部分物品能鑲嵌寶石，而且你隨時都能取下來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Only the strongest of Blazes can create those, and there is a terrifying {pet} in the North West.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只有最強的烈焰使者才能製造那種東西，而在§c西北方§f有一隻可怕的{pet}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Only {0} days left to train, are you ready?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只剩 {0} 天可以訓練了，你準備好了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Only {0} more training sessions, are you ready?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只剩 {0} 次訓練了，你準備好了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Onto the next Test, Stamina this time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：進入下一個試煉，這次是§2耐力§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Oof! Why did you bring this all the way here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§d唉唷！§f你幹嘛把這個大老遠帶過來？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ooh yes! {roman} can make some hot chocolate with this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喔太好了！我可以用這個做熱可可！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ooh! Look! {roman} think {roman2} just caught something!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喔！你看！我好像剛剛抓到東西了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ooh! One of my favorites! The {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喔！我最喜歡的之一！{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ooh, this is exactly what {roman} wanted!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喔，這正是我想要的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ooh, you like the look of the {item}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喔，你喜歡{item}的樣子嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ooooh, what's this? You bring {npc2} funny little seed and strange crop?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喔～這是什麼？你帶給{npc2}好笑的小種子和奇怪的作物？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ooooh... this seed... needs dirt.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：喔～～……這顆種子……需要泥土。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Oops!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哎呀！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Oops! That elixir is sold out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哎呀！那種靈藥§c賣完了§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Open their Menu and look for their Perfect Layout!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：打開它們的選單，看看它們的最佳擺放方式！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Open up a shop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：開一家店吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Open your Hunting Box, inside the Hunting Skill Menu, and syphon it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：打開§a狩獵技能選單§f裡的§a狩獵箱§f，然後§c汲取§f它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Operating that lift all day takes a lot outta ya, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：整天操作那部升降機很累人的，你懂嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Or did Shen find a way into the Rift before us?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還是說§6 Shen §f比我們更早找到進入§d隙界§f的方法？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Or not.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：或是不轉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Or pay {0} Motes and experience despair.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：或是付 {0}§d 微粒§f，然後體驗§9絕望§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Or the Statue of the Hero?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：或是§9英雄雕像§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Or was the Rift just hanging around before we even had a way in?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還是說在我們有辦法進去之前，隙界就一直存在了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Or, you can type {command} to access your equipment menu.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：或者，你也可以輸入 {command} 開啟裝備選單。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Oruo isn't even here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§eOruo §f甚至不在這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Oruo's {area} demands more than just fleeting moments.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§9Oruo 的{area} §f要求的不只是轉瞬即逝的片刻。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Otherwise they'll completely dry out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不然它們會完全乾掉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Otherwise you cannot fly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不然你就不能§b飛§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Otherwise you will be much less efficient.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不然你的效率會差很多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Otherwise {roman} cannot let you in.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不然我不能讓你進去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Otherwise, you won't be that efficient at cutting them down.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不然你砍倒它們的效率就不會那麼好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ouch!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好痛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ouch! Did you miss the READY sign or do you just enjoy causing pain?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噢！你是沒看到§6§lREADY§f的牌子，還是就是喜歡讓人痛苦？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ouch, that was a bit too much oomph.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哎喲，那一下力道有點太猛了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our boat is finally repaired!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們的§a船§f終於修好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our entire stash of {collections_res} got stolen. {roman} have no idea how "they" did it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們所有的{collections_res}存貨都被偷了。我完全不知道「他們」是怎麼辦到的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our forces are made of rotting adventurers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§4我們的軍隊§f是由腐爛的冒險者組成的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our knowledge of that era is minimal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們對那個時代的了解非常少。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our latest addition to the Abiphone line has space for an extra contact!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e我們 Abiphone 系列的最新成員多了一個聯絡人欄位！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our love is stronger than theirs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們的§c愛§f比他們的更堅定！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our love, steadfast and true, seeks to defy the caprice of fate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們的愛堅定而真誠，誓要違抗命運的反覆無常。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our new model comes in {0} atunning colors!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e我們的新機型有 {0}§e 種驚豔的顏色！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Our relations with the Piglins is getting worse, things are spiraling out of control.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們和豬布林的關係越來越糟，事情正在失控。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Over the years {roman}'ve acquired a variety of Talismans and Artifact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些年來，我收集了各式各樣的護身符和神器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Over, and over, and over again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一次又一次，又一次。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Overtaken by dread, {roman} thought to flee, yet how to save myself {roman2} know not.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：吾被恐懼吞沒，想要逃離，卻不知該如何自救。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ow! That doth smart!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噢！好痛啊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ow! That's my face you're stepping on!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噢！你踩的是我的臉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Oy there ain't no nothing to worry about hehe!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：欸，沒啥好擔心的啦，嘿嘿！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: PLUS!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：PLUS！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: POW! SURELY THAT'S IT! {roman} don't think he has any more in him!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：砰！這下總該結束了吧！我想牠已經撐不下去了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: PRECIOUS!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：寶貝！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Pal, you seem a lil' lost over there,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：朋友，你看起來有點迷路，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Pandas? Oh, now we're talking real game!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：熊貓？喔，這才是真正的獵物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Pay me, please. {roman} need this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拜託付錢給我。我需要這筆錢。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Penguins, however, have solid bones, which help them float when in the water.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過企鵝的骨頭是實心的，能幫助牠們在水中浮起來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: People always empty the storage of my Minion when {roman}'m not looking!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每次我一沒注意，就有人把我工人的倉庫清空！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: People always seem to take {npc2} away from me, but they always come back!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大家好像總是把{npc2}從我身邊帶走，但牠總是會回來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: People are remembered by their greatest work, so everything else doesn't matter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：人們會因為他們最偉大的作品而被記住，其他的都不重要。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: People don't take their time to enjoy the little things
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大家都不花時間享受生活中的小事

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: People have told me {roman}'m very photogenic.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大家都說我很上鏡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: People who play that harp
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些彈豎琴的人

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Perfect!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Perfect! Go see our {npc2} at the {area} area in Barbarian territory to get started.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了！去§c野蠻人§f領地的{area} §f區找我們的{npc2} §f開始吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Perfect! Go see our {npc2} at the {area} area in Mage territory to get started.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Reach Milestones in your Bestiary by unlocking unique Family tiers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：解鎖獨特的族群階級，達成圖鑑中的§a里程碑§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Reach Mining Level {roman} to gain access!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：挖掘等級達到 {roman} 就能進入！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Reach Redstone Collection {roman} to unlock the Small Accessory Bag upgrade, then talk to me again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：達到§a紅石收藏 {roman} §f來解鎖§a小型飾品袋§f升級，然後再來找我談！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Reaching Milestones rewards {stats}, Combat Exp, and more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：達成里程碑能獲得{stats}§f、§a戰鬥經驗§f等等獎勵！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ready to test your skills? Step on the pressure plate and all the targets will light up, if you can shoot them all in {0} seconds, {roman}'ll know you're the real deal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：準備好測試你的技術了嗎？踩上壓力板，所有的靶子都會亮起來，如果你能在 {0} 秒內全部射中，我就知道你是真材實料。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ready?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：準備好了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Real challenge! Can you finish the race in {0} seconds or less and beat my personal record?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真正的挑戰！你能在 {0} 秒以內跑完，打破我的個人紀錄嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Real challenge! Can you finish the race in {timer} or less?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真正的挑戰！你能在 {timer} 以內跑完嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Really appreciate the help with all this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真的很感謝你幫忙這一切。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Really makes you think
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真的讓人想很多

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Really, you disappoint me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說真的，你讓我很失望。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Really?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Really? {npc2} is about to die?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真的嗎？{npc2} §f就快§c死了§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Recently {roman} fished a magnificent {resource} from a secret spot {roman2} won't reveal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最近我在一個不能透露的祕密地點釣到了一條很棒的{resource}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Recruit, please scavenge the island for any food you can find.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：新兵，請在島上搜刮任何你能找到的食物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Redstone is such an amazing resource that can be used for so many different purposes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c紅石§f是一種很棒的資源，可以用在許多不同的用途上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Reflect, learn, and try once more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：反省、學習，然後再試一次。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Reflected in this mirror... could that be you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：映照在這面鏡子裡的……會是你嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Regrettably you were not among the {0} closest to half the average, and you will receive nothing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很遺憾，你§c不在§f最接近平均值一半的前 {0}§f 之中，你什麼也得不到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remarkable resolve!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：了不起的決心！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remarkably, they lived under the watch of multiple entities called Starborns!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：值得注意的是，他們生活在多個被稱為§9星裔§f的存在的注視之下！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remember {npc2}, {roman} can show you the path but {roman2} can not walk it for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住，{npc2}，我能為你指路，但無法替你走。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remember, never let your guard down. Defeat me in battle!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住，永遠別放鬆戒備。在戰鬥中打敗我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remember, the world of taming is vast and ever-changing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住，馴養的世界廣闊而且不斷變化。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remember, we race when you signal readiness.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住，你示意準備好了我們就開始賽跑。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remember, you can order fuel from the {item} nearby.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住，你可以從附近的{item}訂購燃料。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remember, you need to DIG to find the treasure!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住，你得用「挖」的才能找到寶藏！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remember, you should go to the {item} and select one of your plots.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住，你應該去{item}選擇你的其中一塊地。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Remember.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：記住。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Research? This doesn't look like research, {npc2}! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§b研究§f？這看起來不像研究，{npc2}§f！這看起來像是你在玩弄生命本身。那些水槽、那些動物，你到底對牠們做了什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... {npc2}, what have you done?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：強韌的牲畜……加速的生長速度……{npc2}，你做了什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Respect your training and you will respect yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：尊重你的訓練，你就會尊重你自己。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Rest assured, this game's integrity is as solid as quantum mechanics.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：請放心，這個遊戲的公正性就跟量子力學一樣可靠。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Rest now, for you have earned it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在休息吧，這是你應得的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Restocking, restocking!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：補貨中，補貨中！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Return when the fogs of ignorance have lifted.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等無知的迷霧散去再回來吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Return when the gaps in your skill are filled.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你補足技術上的缺口再回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Revolutionary!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：革命性的發明！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ridiculous! How could {roman} be a mole if {roman2} am wearing human clothes, huh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c§l荒謬！§f如果我§b穿著人類的衣服§f，我怎麼可能是鼴鼠，嗯？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Right click the Orb for spells, and Left click (or Drop) to use your Ultimate!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：右鍵點擊寶珠施放法術，左鍵點擊（或丟出）使用你的終極技能！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Right now, it's under construction.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：目前還在施工中。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Right now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就是現在。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Right, the master plan. {npc2}, care to update us?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對，總體計畫。{npc2}，你來更新一下進度？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Right-click any wall on your private island to spray it. If you ever lose your {item}, you can craft another one using the recipe in your Recipe {item2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在你的私人島嶼上對任何牆壁按右鍵就能噴漆。如果你弄丟了{item}§f，可以用§a配方{item2}§f裡的配方再合成一個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Rise and shine! Pray from dusk til dawn!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：起床囉！從黃昏祈禱到黎明！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Rude.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真沒禮貌。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Rumor has it that there are rare stones and other valuable bounty hidden in the ground all over the island.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：傳說這座島的地底下到處埋著稀有的石頭和其他珍貴的寶物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Run across {island} to the opposite side of the island to complete the race!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跑過{island}§f到§e島嶼的另一端§f就能完成比賽！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Run over the pressure plate to start racing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跑過壓力板就能開始比賽！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Run over the pressure plate to start racing! Run up to the opposite side of the island AND back to complete the race. Can you finish it in {0} minutes?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跑過壓力板就能開始比賽！跑到§e島嶼的另一端§f再跑回來就能完成比賽。你能在 {0}§e 分鐘§f內跑完嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Run over the pressure plate to start racing! Try to finish within {timer}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跑過壓力板就能開始比賽！試著在 {timer} 內跑完！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Running for Mayor office, {roman} have many times.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：參選§a市長§f，我已經很多次了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: STAND BACK!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：退後！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: SULPHUR! My father is going to KILL ME!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：硫磺！我爸會殺了我！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: SULPHUR! This is catastrophic!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：硫磺啊！這太慘了！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sadly, my memory is now my worst enemy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜，我的記憶現在是我最大的敵人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sadly, she passed when her brain melted in an unrelated incident.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜，她在一場無關的意外中腦袋§d融化§f而過世了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sadly, their history is shrouded in mystery, with scarce records surviving.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜的是，他們的歷史籠罩在謎團之中，留存下來的紀錄寥寥無幾。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sales are too good right now, {roman} can't keep up with the demand!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在生意太好了，我跟不上需求！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Salt is immensely important, this is quite the revolution for us!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鹽非常重要，這對我們來說是一場革命！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Same order as always. Thanks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跟平常一樣的訂單。謝謝。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Satisfactory job, recruit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：表現令人滿意，新兵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Save your own skin, seek challenge elsewhere first.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：保住你的小命，先去別的地方找挑戰吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Say no more, that's a perfect job for {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不用說了，這正是{player}最適合的工作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Screw {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：去他的{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Second, the real power is OUTSIDE, in the "real" universe.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§e第二§f，真正的力量在§a外面§f，在「真實」的宇宙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Secure Timecharms here every time you find one!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每次找到§c時之護符§f，就把它收存在這裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See for yourself! Look, a berry just appeared, simply punch the bush to collect it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你自己看！瞧，剛冒出一顆§d莓果§f，只要§c打§f灌木就能收集它！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See how this barricade holds firm; it is a fortress in its own right.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看這路障多麼堅固，簡直自成一座堡壘。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See how this universe is filled with randomness?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看到這個§a宇宙§f充滿了§e隨機性§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See if you can beat {0} seconds!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看你能不能跑進 {0} 秒！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See if you can find anything extra in the house!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看看你能不能在屋子裡找到其他東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See that empty, weak metal box? Good! That's your cart, hop in!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看到那個空蕩蕩、單薄的金屬箱子了嗎？很好！那就是你的礦車，上去吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See those statues? They are the former Kings, Bunumir Ironbeard and Skordous Pebblebeard, guarding the entrance to the mines.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看到那些雕像了嗎？他們是前任國王 Bunumir 鐵鬍和 Skordous 礫鬍，守護著礦坑的入口。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See ya later!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：待會見！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See ya!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再見啦！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See you around {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下次見，{player}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See you around!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下次見！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See you around.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下次見。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: See? So it's clear now, there is no cake.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看到了吧？現在很清楚了，沒有蛋糕。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Seek out the breach and fulfill your purpose.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：找到裂口，完成你的使命。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Seraphine gets to look like something again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Seraphine 又能看起來像§e個東西§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Seriously though, {roman} accept Coins.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說真的，我收遊戲幣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shall we pursue that avenue then?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那我們要循著這條線追查下去嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shall you challenge him again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你要再次挑戰他嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sharing is caring!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：分享就是關懷！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: She also said that all those fairies didn't die a peaceful death.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：她還說那些仙女都不是安詳地死去的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: She falls in love quickly but he doesn't and for the first time in her life she has to deal with that emotional pain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：她很快就墜入愛河，但他沒有，她這輩子第一次必須面對那種情感上的痛苦。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: She knows the Rift Herald is a newspaper owned by the family, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：她知道§d隙界先驅報§f是§5§o那個家族§f旗下的報紙吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: She lives in a house not far from here - it's over by the water fountain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：她住在離這裡不遠的房子裡——就在噴水池旁邊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: She should really just wholesale at this rate. Cut out the middle mage.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：照這樣下去，她真的應該直接批發。省掉中間的法師。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: She started growing {collections_res} in the farm plots and operated the {area} {item} & Breakfast.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：她開始在§a農地§f種{collections_res}§f，並經營{area}{item}§e加早餐§f民宿。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: She's apprehensive at first but when she meets him they end up surpassing all expectations.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：她一開始很不安，但見到他之後，兩人的相處超乎所有人的預期。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shen is auctioning off one more special item every SkyBlock year.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§6Shen§f每個 SkyBlock 年還會再拍賣一件特別物品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shen is holding {0} special auctions each SkyBlock year...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§6Shen §f每個 SkyBlock 年舉辦 {0}§b 場特別拍賣§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shen's Citrinitas currently holds it, you'll find him beyond the third sequence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§cShen's Citrinitas§f目前持有它，你會在第三序列之後找到他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shh!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§7噓！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shh, keep it down!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噓，小聲點！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shhhh!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噓～！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shhhh. Don't disturb the Legendary {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噓～別吵醒§6傳奇{pet}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shikshrishrikts...you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘶嘶唰唰嘶……你懂吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Short term comfort can lead to troubles in the future
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：短期的舒適可能會導致未來的麻煩

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Show me a Specialized Farming Tool and {roman}'ll teach you about Chips!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿一把§e專用農具§f給我看，我就教你關於§9晶片§f的事！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Show me that you know your way around. Bring back all five Crystals found throughout the {island} and complete the {area}, {roman}'ll let you use my shop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：證明你熟悉這裡的路吧。把散落在{island}各處的五顆水晶都帶回來，並完成{area}，我就讓你使用我的店。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Show some respect and punch the "READY" hologram, please.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：尊重一點，請去打那個「§6§lREADY§f」全像投影。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Shulkers are sneaky. They're like shadows that play tricks on you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：界伏蚌很狡猾。牠們就像會捉弄你的影子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sigh
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：唉

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sigh, the things {roman} endure... Youth these days indeed!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：唉，我得忍受這些事……現在的年輕人真是的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sigh... What a beautiful view...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：唉……多美的景色啊……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Silkwire.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f:§e Silkwire§f：絲線。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Simply add an NPC as a Contact and you can call them anytime, anywhere!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要把 NPC 加為§3聯絡人§f，你就能隨時隨地打給他們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Simply collect them from top to bottom!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要§a從上往下§f收集就好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Simply exquisite! {roman} don't think {roman2}'ll ever get tired of chocolate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是太美味了！我想我永遠不會吃膩巧克力。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Simply hold the Abiphone in your hand, and click on an NPC!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要把§3Abiphone§f拿在手上，然後點擊 NPC 就行了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Simply rude!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真沒禮貌！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Simply select a number from {0} to {1}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要從 {0} 到 {1} 中選一個數字。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Simply stand in the campfire whenever you think you're ready!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：覺得準備好了就站進§6營火§f裡吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Simply tell my outside self the keyword CARAMEL and {roman} should understand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要對§a外面的我§f說出關鍵字§6§lCARAMEL§r§f，我應該就會明白。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Since my previous keynote, my minions and {roman} have been even harder at work trying to find something even more innovative than the Abiphone Flip.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e自從上次主題演講以來，我和我的工人們更加努力，試圖找出比§6 Abiphone Flip§e 更創新的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Since they can already fly, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：畢竟牠們本來就會飛，你懂吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Since you brought this to me, {roman}'ll give you something to show my appreciation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你把這個帶來給我，我就送你一樣東西表達我的謝意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Since you're here already... would you like to draw something?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你都來了……要不要畫點什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Since you're here, can you find {npc2} again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然你在這裡，能再幫我找找{npc2}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Since {0} {1} is the most you can have before dying, a {stats} stat of {2} or more will be enough to ensure you never receive a {stats2} Penalty.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：由於 {0} {1} §f是死亡前能累積的上限，只要{stats} §f達到 {2} §f以上，就能確保你§o永遠§f不會受到{stats2}§c懲罰§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sinkers also grant bonuses, but only in certain areas!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鉛墜也能提供加成，但只在特定區域有效！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Slay a few vampires, then craft and show me your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：殺幾隻吸血鬼，然後合成你的{item}給我看！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Slimes seem to spawn on the hills when it rains. They're a bit more dangerous during a thunderstorm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§b下雨§f時，史萊姆好像會在山丘上生成。§6雷雨§f時牠們會更危險一點。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Small. Rare. Damaged.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：小。稀有。壞掉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Smart choice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聰明的選擇。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Smart guy, he's going places
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聰明的傢伙，他前途無量

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Smells... weird. But not bad weird! Good weird! Like stew left in sun for three days.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聞起來……好怪。但不是壞的怪！是好的怪！就像在太陽下放了三天的燉菜。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Smuggling items is easy, but transferring people has its dangers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：走私物品很容易，但轉移人就有風險了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So close...so close...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就差一點……就差一點……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So cold! {roman} wish {roman2} had coffee right now...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§b§o好冷！§f真希望我現在有杯§6咖啡§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So crazy it might just work!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：瘋狂到說不定行得通！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So do you know if they got the new Abiphones?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以你知道他們有沒有新的 Abiphone 嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So for example if you earn {0}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：舉例來說，如果你賺了 {0}……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So get mushrooms, fill chum buckets, trade tonics! Easy chums!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以去拿蘑菇、裝滿肉糊桶、換補藥！輕鬆撒餌！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So good.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So how much will {roman} be taxed? Considering {roman2} earn {0}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那我會被課多少稅？考慮到我賺 {0}？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So how's life? Good?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那最近過得怎樣？還好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So if you interact with everything in here, it might lead you to the mountain!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以如果你跟§d這裡§f的一切互動，也許就能帶你到§b山§f上！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So just bring me {0} Glowing Mushrooms and {roman}'ll show you how to chum, alright buddy?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以只要帶 {0}§a 個發光蘑菇§f給我，我就教你怎麼撒餌，好嗎，朋友？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So let us revel in thy glee,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：讓我們沉浸在汝的歡欣裡，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So listen, take me {item} and have it eatin' {0} Hay Bales and come back hey?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽好，拿著俺的{item}§f，讓牠吃掉 {0}§e 個乾草捆§f，再回來找俺，懂嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So listen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So many people lying and trying to be your friend
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好多人在說謊，想跟你當朋友

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So many questions left unanswered...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有好多問題沒有答案……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So much wood to chop, such little time...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要砍的木頭這麼多，時間卻這麼少……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So now that's out of the way, wanna hear a joke?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好，既然說清楚了，想聽個笑話嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So one day, a bold claim arose: the Precursors had surpassed the Starborns.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：於是有一天，一個大膽的主張出現了：先驅者已經超越了星裔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So really, {roman} am not harming them at all!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以真的，我完全沒有傷害牠們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So stick around, and please, avoid wandering into my sisters' territories.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以留在這裡吧，還有，請避免闖進我姊姊們的地盤。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So the next time {roman} tried with a chameleon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以下一次我試著養變色龍。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So today you'll have to do three lessons.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以今天你得上§7三§f堂課。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So weird, it looked promising
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好奇怪，看起來明明很有前景

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So weird, so weird.... {roman} need time to think.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好奇怪，好奇怪……我需要時間想一想。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So what?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c那又怎樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So where is his body?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那他的屍體在哪裡？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So why don't we make a deal?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以我們何不做個交易？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So why would he give up his life to guarantee a potential victory in the future?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那他為什麼要犧牲自己的性命，來換取未來可能的勝利呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So yeah, {roman} come back to my crib, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以呢，我就回到我的窩了，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So you gonna pay me, or?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以你要付錢了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So you need to heal!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以你需要§a治療§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So you probably know that {stats} allows you to cut multiple logs at once.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那你大概知道{stats}能讓你一次砍好幾塊原木。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So you talked to a few villagers from both factions? Nice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以你跟兩個派系的幾位村民都聊過了？很好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So you want to join the Barbarian Faction then...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以你想加入野蠻人派系……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So you want to join the Mage Faction then...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以你想加入法師派系……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So you want to visit the {island}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以你想去{island}？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So {roman} asked her, what are fairy souls?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以我問她，仙女之魂是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So {roman} suggest you use an axe with at least {0}{stats}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以我建議你用至少有 {0}{stats}的斧頭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So, Mob Types.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以，§c生物類型§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So, if you have {0} {1} and {2} {stats}, your {stats2} will be reduced by {3}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以，如果你有 {0} {1}和 {2} {stats}，你的{stats2}就會降低 {3}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So, if you have {0} {stats}, {stats2} will take {1} as long to build up!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以，如果你有 {0} {stats}，{stats2}的累積時間就會變成 {1}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So, interested in leaving your pet with us for a bit?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以，有興趣把你的寵物寄放在我們這裡一陣子嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So, it was an easy meal... if you could roll it over first, and that thing weighed more than a dwarven forge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以牠是一頓簡單的大餐……前提是你能先把牠翻過來，而那東西比一座矮人鍛造爐還重！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So, without further ado, {roman} am proud to present:
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e所以，廢話不多說，我很驕傲地為您呈現：

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So, without further ado...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e所以，廢話不多說……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: So, you believe you can outpace me in a Temporal Race?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：所以，你以為你能在§9時間賽跑§f中贏過我？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sofishticated.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：「魚」眾不同的紳士。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some Sea Creatures can only be caught in Hotspots!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些§3海洋生物§f只能在§d熱點§f釣到！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some SkyBlock dwellers feel lost here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些§a SkyBlock §f居民在這裡會感到§5迷失§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some call us the campfire cult!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人叫我們營火邪教！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some creatures can be tamed, granting you their full power, as you may have seen with Pets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些生物可以被§d馴服§f，讓你獲得牠們完整的力量，就像你在§2寵物§f身上看到的那樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some even believe it's a Precursor relic!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些人甚至認為它是§5先驅者§f的遺物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some fishes can only be caught under specific conditions, and it requires great focus.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些魚只有在特定條件下才釣得到，而且需要高度專注。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some furniture is available exclusively in the Furniture Shop downstairs. Check it out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些傢俱只在樓下的傢俱店販售。去看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some items in SkyBlock can only be crafted when you reach a certain collection requirement.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：SkyBlock 裡有些物品要達到特定的收藏條件才能合成。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some matters cannot be solved peacefully.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些事情無法和平解決。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some nasty spill happened a while ago, and ever since people 'ave been dumping their trash in the river.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不久前發生了一次嚴重的洩漏，從那之後大家就一直把垃圾倒進河裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some of the experiments have harder difficulty challenges with unique rewards.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些實驗有§c更高難度§f的挑戰，附帶獨特的獎勵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some of us prefer a clear path ahead, while others would rather explore on their own.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們有些人喜歡§e前方清楚的道路§f，有些人則寧願§a自己探索§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some of us still believe that the Hero will come back one day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們之中有些人仍然相信，英雄總有一天會回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some other carnivores also had even stubbier little arms, so {roman} guess there's that...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些其他肉食動物的小手臂甚至更短，所以我想也算有點安慰吧……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some others can only be found in Hotspots on the {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有一些只能在{island}§f的§d熱點§f找到！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some others still believe that it was our prayers that gave us our powers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：另一些人仍然相信，是我們的祈禱賜予了我們力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some people are smarter than hundreds of other combined
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些人比好幾百個人加起來還聰明

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some people do that all the time in the community
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：社群裡有些人一直在這麼做

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some people don't see it the same way
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些人不這麼看

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some people mine to forget, {roman} mine to remember.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些人挖礦是為了忘記，我挖礦是為了記住。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some researchers believe it was smart enough to set traps for its prey, and actually functioned as an ambush predator.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些研究人員認為牠聰明到會為獵物設陷阱，其實是一種伏擊型掠食者。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some speculate that we are in the past, some say in the future, perhaps we're always in the present.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人推測我們在過去，有人說在§b未來§f，也許我們永遠都在§e現在§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Some spider eggs look a bit different, check behind those.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些蜘蛛卵看起來有點不一樣，去那些後面看看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Somehow it inspires me...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不知怎麼的，它給了我靈感……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone already brought me an animal!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：已經有人帶動物給我了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone already brought me this animal recently, but since you put in all the effort {roman}'ll open my store for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最近已經有人帶這種動物給我了，不過既然你這麼努力，我就為你開放我的商店。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone called me an "Ender noob" the other day, that was pretty rude.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：前幾天有人叫我「終界菜鳥」，真沒禮貌。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone came and took {npc2} away from me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人來把{npc2}從我身邊帶走了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone is going to die here, it is inevitable.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人將會在這裡死去，這是無可避免的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone is going to die here, right now, it is inevitable.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人將會在這裡死去，就是現在，這是無可避免的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone is going to die right here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人將會在這裡死去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone is listening to us!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人在偷聽我們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone promised donuts when coming to this protest.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有人說來參加這場抗議就有甜甜圈。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone scammed me a very valuable thing one day
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有一天有人騙走了我一樣非常珍貴的東西

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone told me a story one day
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有一天有人跟我說了一個故事

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Someone told me {roman} was interesting once
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：曾經有人說我很有趣

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Something had to happen, the wheel of progress had to keep turning.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：必須發生些什麼，進步的齒輪必須繼續轉動。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Something just feels special about the {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{item}就是給人一種特別的感覺。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Something smart?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聰明的話？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometime this week {roman}'ll let you check out the coolest player islands in SkyBlock!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這週的某個時候，我會讓你看看 SkyBlock 裡最酷的玩家島嶼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes at night we tell spooky stores.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候晚上我們會講鬼故事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes look behind leaves too, there are many hidden caves on this island!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候也要看看樹葉後面，這座島上有很多隱藏的洞穴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes silence speaks louder than words.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候沉默勝於千言萬語。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes they even stop in the middle of the song
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候他們甚至在歌彈到一半就停了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes we eat Odonatas.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候我們吃§9蜻蜓§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes you just have to take matters into your own hands, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候你就是得自己動手，你懂吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes {roman} dream that {roman2}'m talking to myself
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候我夢見我在跟自己說話

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes {roman} get carried away too much and tell personal stories
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候我太投入了，就會講起私事

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes {roman} sleep and dream about touching grass, what about you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候我睡覺會夢到摸草，那你呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes {roman} wonder
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候我會想

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes, after a long day of fighting incomprehensible horrors in the {island}, you just want to kick back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候，在{island}跟難以理解的恐怖怪物戰鬥了一整天之後，你只想好好放鬆一下。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes, some things have to remain a mystery.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候，有些事就該保持神祕。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sometimes, when you grow certain crops next to each other, a mutation will eventually sprout nearby. This doesn't always need to be on dirt!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候，當你把特定的作物種在一起，最後會在附近§9長出§f一株§c突變§f。不一定要長在泥土上！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Somewhere else, not exactly the same, but better in some way
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在別的地方，不完全一樣，但在某些方面更好

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Soon after, the flames were engulfing the house
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不久之後，火焰吞噬了整棟房子

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Soon enough {roman}'ll barricade myself in my basement.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我很快就會§2把自己關在地下室裡§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Soon, our destinies will intertwine once more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很快，我們的命運將再次交織。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Soon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry about that...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真抱歉……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry folks we are going to have to cancel the show for tonight, please come back in {0} days for the next auction!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：各位抱歉，今晚的表演得取消了，請在 {0}§b 天§f後再來參加下一場拍賣會！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry for the intrusion, but {roman} got a report of a Pest outbreak around here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉打擾了，不過我接到通報說這附近爆發了§6害蟲§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry if {roman}'m boring you, {roman2} like history
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果我讓你覺得無聊，抱歉，我喜歡歷史

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry little fellow, {roman}'m busy right now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，小傢伙，我現在很忙！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry young companion, someone needs me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，年輕的夥伴，有人需要我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry {roman} don't have any animals for you to hunt.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我沒有動物可以讓你獵捕。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry {roman} dont have any more info.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我沒有更多情報了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry {roman} mean a more powerful version of the Abiphone for the same price.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我是說同樣價格、功能更強的 Abiphone。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, but that's mine!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，那是我的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, but there's... not much to see here right now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，不過這裡……目前沒什麼好看的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, but {roman} need to concentrate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我需要專心。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, we only tell her if she didn't pay enough!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我們只在她繳不夠的時候才通知她！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, {roman} can't talk right now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我現在不能說話。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, {roman} can't talk to you right now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我現在不能跟你說話。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, {roman} only work with Mages...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我只跟法師合作……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, {roman}'m a terrible host.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我是個很糟的主人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, {roman}'m busy right now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我現在很忙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sorry, {roman}'m busy tinkering.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抱歉，我正忙著改造東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sounds amazing, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽起來很棒，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sounds more like a metaphor, like...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：聽起來比較像是個比喻，就像……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Space is only a construct...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：空間只不過是一種建構……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Speak for yourself, {roman} almost got it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那是你，我差點就跳到了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Speak to me again after killing a {mob} and {roman}'ll show you my shop! {roman2} heard Golden Goblins have a small chance to spawn when mining ores or throwing {pet} Eggs in the {island} or {island2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§6：§f殺死一隻{mob} §f之後再來找我，我就讓你看看我的店！我聽說在{island} §f或{island2}§f§b挖礦§f或丟{pet}§b蛋§f時，有小機率會生成§6黃金哥布林§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Speak to me again after killing a-
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§6：殺死一隻……之後再來找我——

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Special items for a special currency just for you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：專屬於你的特別貨幣，換特別的物品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Spiders often dig up mushrooms and create tiny rooms below, make sure to check those!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：蜘蛛常常挖開蘑菇，在下面造出小房間，記得去看看！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Spin 'em too much, though, and... well, you'll see.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過轉太多的話……嗯，你就知道了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Spin 'em with a fishing net; they'll twirl like a clumsy dancer.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用漁網讓牠們轉圈；牠們會像笨拙的舞者一樣旋轉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Splash...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嘩啦……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Splendid! Now that we have our sample, place it inside the machine to analyze the mutation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了！現在我們有了樣本，把它放進機器裡分析突變吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Splendid.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太好了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Splish...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噗通……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sploosh!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：撲通！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Spot an Odonata out there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在外面找一隻§9蜻蜓§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Squelch-squish-gurgle blob-blob-splort slurp-slop-squidge.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：啪嘰噗滋咕嚕 啵啵噗啪 呼嚕嚕噗啾。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Squish-squorp-plop Globulate Timecharm gloop-glop-blurp?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§o噗滋噗啾啵 §c團塊時之護符 §f§o咕嚕咕嚕啵？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stand back, {roman}'m tinkering with a new necklace.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：退後，我正在改造一條新的§d項鍊§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stand in the CAMPFIRE!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：站進§6§l營火§r§f裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Standing here behind this big desk...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：站在這張大桌子後面……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Standing in that bank all day. Just me and the dwarves. But they are either all business, or drunk. Or both! {roman} need better company!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：整天站在那間銀行裡。只有我和矮人們。但他們不是忙著做生意，就是喝醉了。或兩者都有！我需要更好的同伴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under {0} minutes, {roman}'ll reward you for it! Good luck!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：踩上壓力板就會開始比賽。如果你在 {0} 分鐘內跑完，我會給你獎勵！祝你好運！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under {timer}, you get something!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：踩上壓力板就會開始比賽。如果你在 {timer} 內跑完，就能得到東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Step away from my child, stranger!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：離我的孩子遠一點，陌生人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for {timer}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：站進營火開始試煉，撐過 {timer}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Step on them by mistake, and, well, they can get quite angry.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不小心踩到牠們的話，嗯，牠們會相當生氣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stew? {roman} love stew!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：燉菜？我§d愛§f燉菜！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Still nothing
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：到現在還是什麼都沒有

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Still, if you ever saw one you'd probably want to keep out of its way...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，要是你真的遇到一隻，大概還是會想避開牠……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Still, you can catch some rare materials to craft top-quality fishing nets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，你還是能釣到一些稀有材料，來製作頂級的漁網。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Still, {roman}'ve been playing lots of games to pass the time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，我玩了很多遊戲來打發時間。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stop by once it's done, okay?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等好了就過來一下，好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stop eavesdropping!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別再偷聽了！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stop harassing me and my child!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別再騷擾我和我的孩子了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stop spying on us...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別再偷聽我們了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Storing them in your {area} keeps them safe and allows you to earn interest at the start of every season!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把它們存在你的{area}裡既安全，每個季節開始時還能賺利息！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Strange.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真奇怪。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Strange... {roman} could've sworn you'd met.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：奇怪……我還以為你們見過面。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stronger you stand, bearing the vigor of both this realm and yours.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你變得更強了，同時承載著§5這個領域§f與§a你的世界§f的活力。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Struggling with Frogs? Really?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：抓青蛙有困難？真的假的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Stuck? Go take a look at the Nucleus Vault.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：卡關了？去看看§5核心寶庫§f吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Studies on one side and fun on the other, both are very important
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一邊是學業，一邊是玩樂，兩者都很重要

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Such a villain, surely spawned from the darkest pit, sought to rend asunder our sweet love.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如此惡徒，必定來自最黑暗的深淵，竟妄想拆散我們甜蜜的愛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Such an expensive toy, {roman} am glad you found it for him!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那麼貴的玩具，我很高興你幫他找到了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Such valor is most commendable, truly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如此英勇，著實值得讚揚。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Suddenly the mom cat appeared from the shadows of the night and ran into the house
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：突然，母貓從夜色的陰影中出現，衝進了房子

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sul-phur
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：硫——磺

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sulphurcare is our proposal - no taxes on {collections_res}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：「硫磺照護」是我們的提案——{collections_res}免稅！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sun {mob} pressed against the very limits of mortal endurance, yet today you sculpted a victory from raw chaos.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§e太陽{mob} §f將凡人的耐力逼到了極限，但今天你從純粹的混沌中雕琢出了勝利。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sun {mob}'s intensity thundered across the battlefield, yet your will stood firm, forging a triumph that whispers of greatness yet untold.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§e太陽{mob}§f的猛烈氣勢響徹戰場，但你的意志屹立不搖，鑄就了一場預示著尚未述說之偉大的勝利。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sup, {player}? {roman} am {npc2}, your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading Drills.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你好啊，{player}§f？我是{npc2}§f，幫§a鑽頭§f加燃料和升級，找我就對了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sure thing, little one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒問題，小傢伙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sure {roman} haven't personally figured out the necklace...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，雖然我沒有§o親自§f搞懂這條§d項鍊……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Sure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好啊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Surprisingly easy to use, too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：而且出乎意料地好用！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Survive {timer} in the campfire to earn one!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在§c營火§f中撐過 {timer} §f就能獲得一個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Suuuuuure???
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：確～～定？？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Syphoning is key - it lets you permanently gain the attribute of the creature it came from.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汲取是關鍵——它能讓你永久獲得該生物的§c屬性§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: THAT'S FANTASTIC!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太棒了！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: THE BRIDGE IS COLLAPSING, GET TO THE CENTER!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：橋要塌了，快到中間去！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: THE KUUDRA IS COMING!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：庫德拉來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Tada!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噹噹！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Tadaa
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：噹噹

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take all of the pictures you want of me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想拍多少張我的照片都行！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take good care of this one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好好照顧它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿去吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take my compass to assist you in your journey!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著我的§b羅盤§f幫助你的旅程！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take my vacuum cleaner.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著我的吸塵器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take the {item} as a token of my gratitude, you deserve it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：收下{item}作為我的謝意，這是你應得的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take these Huntaxes, for example. Sturdy, sharp, beautifully balanced.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就拿這些§a狩獵斧§f來說吧。堅固、鋒利，平衡得恰到好處。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take these Silent Pearls, they allow you to teleport without angering Endermen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著這些§5無聲珍珠§f，它們能讓你傳送而不激怒終界使者。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take these {collections_res} x{0} and plant them next to each other in the Greenhouse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著這些{collections_res} §8x{0} §f，把它們並排種在§a溫室§f裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take this as a reward, you've earned it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：收下這個作為獎勵，這是你應得的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take this belt.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著這條腰帶。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take this {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著這個{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take this {item}. It's like a {item2}, but not polished.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著這個{item}。它就像{item2}，只是沒磨亮。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Take this {resource}! You'll hopefully find something nicer than what was in those White Gifts!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著這個{resource}！希望你能在裡面找到比那些白色禮物更好的東西！

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那就是未知之處了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: That’s too bad. Come back when you are sure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真可惜。等你確定了再回來吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Abiphone Flip is now for sale!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§eAbiphone Flip 現已開賣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Abiphone Flip+ is now for sale!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§6Abiphone Flip+ §e現已開賣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Abiphone {roman} is now for sale!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§eAbiphone {roman}§e 現已開賣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Abiphone {roman} is our best model yet.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§6Abiphone {roman} §e是我們有史以來最好的機型。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Academy was great today, learned a lot of important things.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：今天在學院收穫很多，學到了很多重要的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Academy was tough, but {roman} met a few friends there
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：學院很辛苦，但我在那裡交了幾個朋友

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Calamity is the reason why the earth got shattered into many islands
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大災難就是大地被粉碎成許多島嶼的原因

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Crop Analyzer? What does it do?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a作物分析儀§f？它是做什麼的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Dungeon you will enter will be exactly the same difficulty as if you joined with a party.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你進入的地下城難度會§c§n和組隊時完全一樣§r§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Farming Contest is over!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：農耕競賽結束了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Furniture Shop has many different kinds of cool furniture for you to put in your world!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a傢俱店§f有各種很酷的傢俱，可以放在你的世界裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Furniture Shop is downstairs. Purchase cool furniture down there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：傢俱店在樓下。去那裡買很酷的傢俱吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Heart of the {area} can be found in your {item} while on {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在{island}§f時，你可以在{item} §f裡找到§a{area}之心§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Hero was humble, yet they saved us all from doom.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：英雄很謙遜，卻把我們所有人從毀滅中拯救出來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Kalhuiki tribe are a friendly people, but protective.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Kalhuiki 部落是友善的民族，但很有保護欲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Mage Faction is growing, we will soon uncover all the secrets of {stats}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：法師派系正在壯大，我們很快就會揭開{stats}的所有祕密。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The New Starborns were particularly invested, almost as proud mentors observing their wards' milestones.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：新生星裔特別投入，幾乎就像驕傲的導師在看著學生達成一個個里程碑。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Old Starborns seemen indifferent to mortal affairs, transcending earthly desires.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：古老星裔似乎對凡間事務漠不關心，超脫於世俗慾望之上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Precursors built a machine that merges the genetic essence of two creatures.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§5先驅者§f建造了一台能融合兩種生物基因精華的機器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Precursors ended up excelling in both magic and science, eventually blending the two to create wonders.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：先驅者最終在魔法與科學上都表現卓越，最後將兩者融合，創造出種種奇蹟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Precursors harnessed their tools and magic to overpower the Starborns.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：先驅者利用他們的工具與魔法壓制了星裔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Precursors, you inquire?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在問§9先驅者§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Queen is warning me against hasty conclusions, but enough is enough.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：女王警告我不要倉促下結論，但我受夠了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Taika people really like educated individuals.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§cTaika§f 人非常喜歡有學問的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Town Board is filling up and you are late on your Training {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：城鎮公告板快排滿了，而你的訓練遲到了，{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Town Board missions get harder the higher your Reputation gets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你的聲望越高，§c城鎮公告板§f的任務就越難。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The Volcano is everything to us, its {collections_res} made us who we are, so it's only normal that we give everything back to the Volcano.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c火山§f就是我們的一切，是它的{collections_res}§f造就了我們，所以把一切還給§c火山§f是理所當然的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The appearance of that strange disturbance on the nearby island might have nothing to do with time travel.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：附近島嶼上出現的那個奇怪擾動，可能跟時間旅行一點關係也沒有。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The arena is temporarily closed for renovations!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：競技場正在整修，暫時關閉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The barricade is far too sturdy to break through on our own.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這路障太§6堅固§f了，光靠我們打不破。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The bidding will start in {timer}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：出價將在 {timer} 後開始。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The bird decided to sit on the clean egg instead of his
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鳥決定孵那顆乾淨的蛋，而不是自己的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The black-and-white look of most penguins is actually a form of camouflage.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大部分企鵝的黑白外觀其實是一種偽裝。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The bouquet was crafted with love, that much is certain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這束花是用§d愛§f紮成的，這點可以肯定。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The bouquet, yes! That appears to be true, impressive.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：花束，對了！看來確實如此，了不起。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The cake is a lie.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：蛋糕是個謊言。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The campfire deals true damage, which means it ignores your {stats}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：營火造成的是§e真實§f傷害，也就是說它會無視你的{stats}§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The cat was in terrible shape, but the kittens were safe
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那隻貓的狀況很糟，但小貓們都安全了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The closer you get to the top of the mountain, the stronger the distortion gets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你越接近§b山頂§f，§d扭曲§f就越強烈。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The correct box is decided before you even talk to me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：正確的箱子在你跟我說話之前就已經決定了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The creatures deep down this loch are quite scary.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座湖深處的生物可是相當可怕。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The crew and {roman} have been stuck on this islet since we crossed the Rift.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：自從穿越§5隙界§f之後，我和船員們就一直被困在這座小島上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The crew has been stranded here for so long.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：船員們已經困在這裡好久了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：罪魁禍首就在裡面，而且牠既不是人類也不是豬布林。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The culprit is right there, let's interrogate him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：犯人就在那裡，我們去審問他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The deeper you go, the stranger the things you'll find!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你走得越深，就會發現越奇怪的東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The deeper you venture... {#}exhales{#2}... the greater the pressure becomes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你潛得越深……{#}吐氣{#2}……壓力就越大。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The details of our grand project, however, will remain undisclosed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，我們宏大計畫的細節將不予公開。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The developer creating this didn't have time to implement a proper barricade breaking sequence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：製作這段的§d開發者§f沒時間做出像樣的破壞路障流程。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The dragon army attacked our dimension many centuries ago and sent the world into pieces.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：幾個世紀前，龍軍攻擊了我們的維度，把世界打得支離破碎。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The dragon heart corrupts everything, even the people
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：龍之心會腐化一切，連人也是

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The dreams stopped, it'll forever remain a mystery.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：夢停了，這將永遠是個謎。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The economy is booming
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：經濟蓬勃發展

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The egg hatched and the snake ate the bird
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：蛋孵化了，蛇把鳥吃掉了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The elected mayor offers perks for everyone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當選的市長會為所有人提供§a特權§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The end of an era, and the beginning of a much darker one
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一個時代的結束，也是一個更黑暗時代的開始

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The entire stash of {collections_res} of the Piglin Faction has been stolen this morning.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：豬布林派系的所有{collections_res}存貨今天早上被偷了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The entrance to the {island} sits atop a hill to the north.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{island}的入口在北邊的山丘頂上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The evil doesn't defeat itself. You should come to the {island} again when you are free.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：邪惡不會自己消失。你有空的時候應該再來{island}一趟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The exact words {roman} told you last time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：正是我上次跟你說的那些話。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The farm animals here provide a variety or resources.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡的農場動物能提供各種資源。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The farmer is sick for a totally unknown reason.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：農夫生病了，原因§o完全不明§r§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The fates decreed that only one could wield its power.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：命運註定只有一人能駕馭它的力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The fight was going smoothly and just as {roman} was about to land the finishing blow, BAM!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：戰鬥進行得很順利，就在我正要給牠最後一擊的時候，§c砰§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first Glyph can be found by the pond below!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第一個§5符文§f在下面的池塘邊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first bracket is for anyone earning below {0} Motes per revolution.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第一個稅級適用於每個週期收入低於 {0}§d 微粒§f的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first ingredient {roman} need is a {resource}, which is obtained from a {mob}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我需要的第一個材料是{resource}，要從{mob}身上取得。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first one is a Test of Force.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第一堂是§2力量試煉§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first one requires eliminating a {mob}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第一個任務是消滅一個{mob}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first part shows him having fun with his powers and exploring ways to use memories to his advantage.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第一部分描寫他玩弄自己的能力，探索如何利用記憶為自己謀利。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first step is that you pay me {0} Motes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第一步就是你要付我 {0}§d 微粒§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first to align four tokens of their color in a row claims victory!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最先讓自己顏色的§6四顆棋子§f連成一線的人獲勝！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The first to deplete the other's {stats} shall be declared the winner.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：先耗盡對方{stats}的人獲勝。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The friends of the {npc2} are my friends too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}的朋友就是我的朋友！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The fusion process can uncover creatures that haven't been discovered yet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：融合過程可能會發現尚未被發現的生物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The future of Abiphones is TODAY!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§eAbiphone 的未來就是今天！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The game unfolds over {0} to {1} rounds, randomly determined.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：遊戲會進行 {0} 到 {1} 回合，隨機決定。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The giant seemed to speak a foreign language, they screamed "POGGERS!"
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那個巨人好像在說外國話，他大喊「POGGERS！」

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The giant volcano emerged and it kept on growing, over the centuries the whole place changed for the worse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：巨大的火山出現並不斷長大，幾個世紀以來，整個地方變得越來越糟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The gravel on this island seems to magically reappear when you break it. {roman} don't ask questions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座島上的礫石被你打掉後似乎會神奇地重新出現。我不會多問。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The greatest magic comes from the courage to venture into the unknown.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最偉大的§d魔法§f來自於勇於探索未知的勇氣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The guards and {roman} will bring him back to the city, please explain the situation to the {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我和守衛們會把他帶回城裡，請你向{npc2}說明情況。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The heart of that creature is sealed on the End island
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那隻生物的心臟被封印在終界島上

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The highest bidder was {player} with a bid of {0} Coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最高出價者是{player}§f，出價 {0}§6 遊戲幣§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The highest quality of {collections_res} - Perfect - will increase your stats the most!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最高品質的{collections_res}§f——§6完美§f——能讓你的屬性提升最多！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The history between the {0} factions is long and complicated.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這 {0} 個派系之間的歷史又長又複雜。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The house on the other side is also mine, that's what saving money does.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：另一邊的房子也是我的，這就是省錢的成果。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The individual in question is none other than {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個人不是別人，正是{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The inhabitants, Precursors, as they were once called, laid the foundations for the future.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡的居民，曾被稱為§b先驅者§f，為未來奠定了基礎。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The items in my shop may be of help as you descend into the depths of {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當你深入{island}§d的深處時，我商店裡的物品也許能幫上你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to {0} lb!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我收藏裡最大的魚將近一公尺長，重量接近 {0} 磅！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The largest fish in my collection is almost a meter long, and weighs close to {0} lb.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我收藏裡最大的魚將近一公尺長，重量接近 {0} 磅。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The largest, most evil patch of fungus ever!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：史上§c最大§f、最§4邪惡§f的一片真菌！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The last Glyph can be found in a server room, whatever that means...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最後一個§5符文§f在一間伺服器機房裡，不管那是什麼意思……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The last one is a {resource}, and not just any kind.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最後一個是{resource}，而且不是普通的那種。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The lava level is rising inside {pet}! He must have submerged under the lava!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{pet}§f體內的§c岩漿正在上升§f！牠§c一定是潛進岩漿裡了§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The layout of our village is so complex...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們村莊的格局好複雜……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The leaves are so colorful!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：樹葉好繽紛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The legend says that a Hero arrived centuries ago, and helped us in times of need.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：傳說幾個世紀前，一位英雄來到這裡，在我們危難時幫助了我們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The legendary {mob}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：傳說中的{mob}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The love that doth bestow.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那份不吝給予的愛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The main storyline may be fixed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：主線劇情也許是固定的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The master plan.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：總體計畫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The matter at hand is rather complex, but {roman} shall be brief.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這件事相當複雜，但我會長話短說。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The mayor elections are currently closed but come back later and check them out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§b市長選舉§f目前已經關閉，晚點再來看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The mighty Volcano is protecting us, but for how long?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：強大的火山保護著我們，但還能保護多久呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The mines have a way of bringing like-minded souls together.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：礦坑總有辦法讓志同道合的人聚在一起。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The moles must be dealt with, and {roman} am sure you will do so quickly and quietly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：鼴鼠必須被處理，我相信你會迅速又安靜地辦好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The moment has come to meet your destiny.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：面對你命運的時刻到了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The monster had giant tentacles, {roman} have never seen anything like it before in my life!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那隻怪物有巨大的觸手，我這輩子從沒見過那種東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The monstrous wretch who sought his life is no more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那企圖奪他性命的邪惡怪物已不復存在！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The more pure the {collections_res} - the stronger the effect!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{collections_res}越純淨，效果就越強！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The more you syphon an attribute, the more powerful it becomes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你§c汲取§f一種屬性越多次，它就會變得越強大。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The more {roman} look into the fire, the more {roman2} understand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我越是凝視火焰，就越能明白。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The more {roman} squat before a jump, the higher {roman2} jump!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我跳之前蹲得越多下，§6就跳得越高§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The most cutting edge technology around today, this new model comes with the {stats} Dial feature!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e這款新機型搭載當今最尖端的科技，具備{stats}§b撥號§e功能！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The murderer hasn't arrived yet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：兇手還沒到！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The name of my new novel? Hmm...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我新小說的名字？嗯……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The name's {npc2}, and {roman} run the {resource} Shop, where you can trade in {resource2} for useful perks and upgrades!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我叫{npc2}§f，我經營{resource}§b商店§f，你可以在這裡用{resource2}§f換取實用的強化與升級！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The next Shen will provide you with the Celestial Timecharm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下一位 Shen 會給你§c天界時之護符§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The next mission is to kill the {mob}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下一個任務是殺掉{mob}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The next one's gonna nail it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下一次一定能成功。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The note reads: "{0} {1} {2}" Not really sure what these numbers mean yet, but {roman}'m sure {roman2}'ll figure it out soon enough!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：紙條上寫著：「{0} {1} {2}」我還不太確定這些數字是什麼意思，但我相信很快就會搞清楚的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The one of {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}的那一樁。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The one that you would get from me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就是你能從我這裡拿到的那個？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The one we need to eliminate is in the {area}, it's on the outskirts of {area2}, towards the north.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們要消滅的那個在{area}，就在{area2}郊外，往北走。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The other candidates are empty minded, can't you see {roman}'m the only option?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：其他候選人腦袋空空，你看不出我是唯一的選擇嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The other day {roman} met some kind of wizard
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：前幾天我遇到一個巫師之類的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The other day {roman} was chumming with my chums.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：前幾天我在跟我的夥伴們撒餌。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The other faction is on the other side of the island.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：另一個派系在島的另一邊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The other rabbits don't want to eat no Half-eaten Carrots...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：其他兔子§c不想§f吃什麼§6吃了一半的紅蘿蔔§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The other two are empty.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：另外§c兩個§f是空的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The poorest player allowed in had {0} Coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：能進場的最窮玩家也有 {0}§6 遊戲幣§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The power of Sun {mob} is only limited by your own resolve.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§e太陽{mob} §f的力量只受限於你自己的決心。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The pressure down there is... {#}exhales{#2}... unforgiving.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那底下的壓力……{#}吐氣{#2}……毫不留情。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The previous revolution had {0} participants with an average choice of {1}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：上一個週期有 {0} 位參加者，平均選擇為 {1}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The price for reentry remains at {0} Motes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再次入場的價格仍是 {0}§d 微粒§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The problem is that {roman}'m not a fighter, at ALL!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：問題是我根本不是打架的料，完全不是！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The problem is... those who ventured through... never returned.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：問題是……那些冒險穿越的人……從來沒有回來過。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The rarity of your item will be upgraded in {0} trials!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再過 {0} 次試煉，你的物品稀有度就會升級！
