entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The rarity of your item will be upgraded on the next trial!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下一次試煉時，你的物品稀有度就會升級！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The real measure of your wealth is how much you'd be worth if you lost all your coins.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：衡量你財富的真正標準，是你失去所有遊戲幣之後還值多少。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The reason why {roman} need a {resource}? Well...it's hard to explain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼我需要{resource}？嗯……很難解釋。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The regular population just wants to have a calm and happy life.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一般老百姓只想過平靜快樂的生活。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The results from the previous revolution are still being calculated!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：上一個週期的結果還在計算中！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The rules are simple yet profound. Each round, you and your opponent decide whether to split or steal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：規則簡單卻深奧。每一回合，你和對手決定要§a平分§f還是§c偷取§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The rules are straightforward. Once you signal readiness, we race.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：規則很簡單。一旦你示意準備好了，我們就開始賽跑。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The rules here are simple: In this arena, you may fly, like {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：規則很簡單：在這個競技場裡，你可以像{npc2}§f一樣§d§o飛行§r§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The shadows of their return soon loom over us; we must stand prepared.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們歸來的陰影很快就會籠罩我們；我們必須做好準備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The skeleton of Chozon can be seen on the island south of here. He was one of the generals of Jythar.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這裡南邊的島上可以看到§5 Chozon §f的骨骸。他是 Jythar 的將軍之一。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The smartest baby would become a monkey if it wasn't taught anything
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最聰明的嬰兒如果什麼都沒學，也會變成猴子

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The soul campfire isn't quite as strong as a regular campfire. It respects your {stats}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：靈魂營火沒有一般§c營火§f那麼強。它會尊重你的{stats}§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The spiders are hiding some of the relics behind cobwebs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：蜘蛛把一些遺物藏在蜘蛛網後面。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The store was super busy today!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：店裡今天超忙的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The story of these mines is old, older than the End island for sure!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些礦坑的故事很古老，肯定比終界島還古老！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The story takes place in a dystopian {island} where the lava of the Volcano is turning into water.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：故事發生在一個反烏托邦的{island}，火山的岩漿正在變成水。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The strangest part is, Tia really didn't seem phased about it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最奇怪的是，Tia 看起來完全不在意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The supplier?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§b供應商§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The technology is progressing fast, who knows what's coming next!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：科技進步得很快，誰知道接下來會出現什麼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The tension is rising and soon we might have to cross swords with them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：緊張情勢正在升高，我們很快可能就得跟他們刀劍相向了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The thing about classy is, it's a state of mind.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§e優雅§f這回事，是一種心態。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The town may never sleep, but {roman} do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座城鎮也許永不入睡，但我會。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The tragedy of his life isn't very known. He had an idyllic relationship with his wife, up until their daughter was born.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他一生的悲劇鮮為人知。他和妻子的關係原本田園詩般美好，直到他們的女兒出生。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The traps are ready for use; All that remains is to set them up in the right place. Once you find the ideal spots, go ahead and deploy them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§5陷阱§f已經可以用了；剩下的就是把它們設在§a正確的位置§f。找到理想地點後，就去部署吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The trees on this island are even tougher if they are not cut in the proper order.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座島上的樹如果沒照§5正確順序§f砍，會變得更硬。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The twist is that those battle veterans are accustomed to their immortality, which has impacted their views and personalities over time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：轉折在於，那些身經百戰的老將已經習慣了永生，隨著時間過去，這影響了他們的觀點和個性。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The underworld took control of my tavern in the real world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：地底世界接管了我在現實世界的酒館。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The value of anything is in the eyes of the buyers
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：任何東西的價值都在買家的眼中

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The vampires have bestowed their Timecharm upon you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§4吸血鬼們§f把他們的§c時之護符§f給了你？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The view from here is just so bad.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：從這裡看出去的景色真是太糟了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The view from my window is amazing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：從我窗戶看出去的景色好美。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The vile murderer hounds us close, his shadow ever near.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那卑鄙的兇手緊追著我們，他的影子始終如影隨形。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The volcano really seems to bring out more treasure in these walls.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：火山似乎真的讓這些牆裡冒出更多寶藏。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The winner of the tournament becomes immortal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：錦標賽的冠軍會獲得永生。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The wizards believe Shen employed Dante, or perhaps even created him!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：巫師們認為是§6 Shen §f雇用了§c Dante§f，甚至可能是他創造了 Dante！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The wizards managed to take control of this section of the dimension for use in my necklace project.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§d巫師們§f成功控制了這個維度的這一區，用於我的§d項鍊§f計畫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The world doesn't need heroes. It needs workers.
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：這個世界不需要英雄。它需要的是勞動者。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The world is beaming with originality!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個世界充滿了§c創意§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The world is filled with incredibly talented people!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個世界充滿了才華洋溢的人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {0} generals were so huge that their reach could cover the sun and bring shadows upon entire cities.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這 {0} 位將軍巨大到他們的身影能遮蔽太陽，讓整座城市籠罩在陰影中。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {0} of participants who will have a number closest to half of the average will obtain the reward.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：數字最接近平均值§c一半§f的前 {0} §f參加者將獲得獎勵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {0}nd one is between {1} and {2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第 {0} 個稅級介於 {1} 到 {2} 之間。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {0}rd bracket is between {1} and {2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第 {0} 個稅級介於 {1} 到 {2} 之間。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {0}th and final bracket is anything above {1}, at {2} tax rate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第 {0} 個也是最後一個稅級，是超過 {1} 的部分，稅率 {2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {0}th bracket is between {1} and {2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：第 {0} 個稅級介於 {1} 到 {2} 之間。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} got reorganized a while ago, now a large portion of it is used for the Academy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area} §f不久前重新整修過，現在有很大一部分是§2學院§f在使用。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} in the North is close to the Barbarian borders, they are probably hiding the stolen {collections_res} there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：北方的{area}靠近野蠻人的邊界，他們大概把偷來的{collections_res}藏在那裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} is a bit hidden, it is north-west of {area2}, just outside of the city.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area}有點隱密，在{area2}的西北方，就在城外。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} is not a place {roman}'m fond of.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area}不是我喜歡的地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} is on the opposite side of the island, south of {area2}, the Mage city.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area}在島的另一邊，在法師之城{area2}的南邊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} is your one-stop shop for all things enchanting. Enchant items, purchase Enchanted Books, and more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area} §f提供一切附魔相關的服務。附魔物品、購買§a附魔書§f等等，應有盡有！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} was built by Blazes and Wither Skeletons, they are still expanding it slowly, quite fascinating.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area}是由烈焰使者和凋零骷髏建造的，他們還在慢慢擴建，真是有趣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} will be finished soon!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area}很快就會完工！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {area} would reforge your accessories?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area}§f都會幫你重鑄§a飾品§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {collections_res} Defenders drop those Belts rarely, at least that's how {roman} got mine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{collections_res}§c守衛者§f偶爾會掉落那些腰帶，至少我的是這樣拿到的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {island} are full of strange creatures and expensive treasures.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{island}裡滿是奇怪的生物和昂貴的寶藏。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {island} has lots of sheep, plenty to collect enough {item} for me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{island}有很多羊，足夠幫我收集到夠多的{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {item} allows you to play this game with anyone else in {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{item}能讓你在{island}跟任何人玩這個遊戲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {item} is a powerful weapon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{item}是一把強大的武器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {item} is quite majestic, {roman}'ve never seen another tail like it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{item}相當壯觀，我從沒見過其他像這樣的尾巴。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {item} is the best model for beginners.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{item}是最適合新手的機型。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {item} will leave without you...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{item}不會等你的……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {item}! Now, this one is really cool!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{item}！這塊可真的很酷！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {mob} teleported behind me and hit me with a claw attack!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{mob}瞬移到我身後，用爪子攻擊了我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {mob}, Blue-Ringed Octopus, and Wiki-{mob2} can be found here on the Bayou!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{mob}§f、§c藍環章魚§f和§cWiki-{mob2} §f都能在§2沼澤§f這裡找到！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {npc2} has sent me to go shopping for {roman} am his favorite emissary!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}派我去購物，因為我是他最喜歡的使者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {npc2} made me go grocery shopping. Me! Can you believe that? He has a pair of perfectly good legs, and still, here {roman} am.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}叫我去買菜。我！你能相信嗎？他明明有一雙好好的腿，結果我還是在這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {npc2} told you his research got stolen?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}跟你說他的研究被偷了？！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {npc2} will surely punish you for this disrespect!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}一定會懲罰你的無禮！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {npc2}'s favorite emissary is here to request potatoes for the {npc3}'s great feast!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}最喜歡的使者來為{npc3}的盛宴要馬鈴薯了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {npc2}'s least favorite vegetable is carrot, so he sent me, his favorite emissary, to make it better!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}最討厭的蔬菜是胡蘿蔔，所以他派我，他最喜歡的使者，來把它變好吃！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {npc2}'s office? {roman} don't know where it is.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}的辦公室？我不知道在哪裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {pet} actually had a brain twice as large as most other carnivores.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{pet}的大腦其實是其他大多數肉食動物的兩倍大。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {pet} is made fun of for its comparatively small arms, but they were still over three feet long!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{pet}常因為手臂相對短小而被取笑，但牠們的手臂其實還是超過三英尺長！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {pet} was a herbivore, but it lived at the same time as the {pet2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{pet}是草食動物，但牠和{pet2}生活在同一個時代。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: The {pet} was not only a carnivore, but also one of the few dinosaurs to be an adept swimmer.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{pet}不只是肉食動物，也是少數擅長游泳的恐龍之一。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their Abiphone doesn't seem to be working, {roman} am starting to get worried.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他的 Abiphone 好像沒在運作，我開始擔心了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their DNA is quite intriguing, making them a perfect basis for my research!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們的 DNA 相當有趣，是我研究的完美基礎！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their ambition grew boundless.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們的野心變得無邊無際。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their enigmatic presence and otherworldly aura have always captivated me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們神祕的氣息和超凡的氣場一直讓我著迷。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their eyesight is rubbish, they only detect movements. So if you stand still long enough near them, you're golden.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們的視力很差，只看得到動靜。所以只要你在牠們附近站著不動夠久，就穩了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their genetics differ from most other creatures.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們的基因跟大多數其他生物不同。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their icy presence is said to be quite refreshing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：據說牠們冰冷的存在相當提神。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their mysterious aura has always intrigued me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們神祕的氣場一直讓我很好奇。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their name is {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他的名字是{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their perks are much stronger and crazier!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們的§a特權§f更§c強大§f，也更§4瘋狂！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Their words offer permanence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們的文字是永恆的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then all you have to do is escape before the acid kills you, {roman} think there is a way but {roman2}'m not so sure how.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後你只要§2在胃酸殺死你之前逃出來§f，我想是有方法的，但我不太確定是怎麼做。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then collect the Odonata using the {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後用{item}§f收集§9蜻蜓§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then come back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then go away!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那就走開！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then go talk to him, bro.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那就去找他談啊，兄弟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then let our brawl commence!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那就讓我們的混戰開始吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then listen you bring me the filled bucket, ok?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後聽好，你把裝滿的桶子帶來給我，好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then say "Eleanor is the best!"
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後說「§cEleanor is the best!§f」

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then use a fishing rod and throw a line in said water.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後用釣竿把線拋進那片水裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then use your vacuum to catch a {pet} Pest in that plot!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後用你的吸塵器在那塊地塊抓一隻{pet}§6害蟲§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then why don't ya buy one? {roman}'ll do a little discount, just for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那你怎麼不買一支呢？我可以給你一點折扣，就只給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then why is he Prime Minister?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那他當首相幹嘛？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then you have grasped the essence of this game, and truly deserve this {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那你已經掌握了這個遊戲的精髓，確實配得上這個{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then you lied to me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那你就是對我說謊了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then {item} ages into {collections_res}, wise and valuable!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後{item}會老化成{collections_res}，既睿智又有價值！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then {roman} woke up in a sweat.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後我就滿身大汗地醒來了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then, come back to me so we can resolve their issue.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後§b回來找我§f，我們一起解決他們的問題。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then, crouch twice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後，§c蹲下兩次§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then, splash yourself with a potion.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後，§c對自己潑一瓶藥水§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then, you should convert it to a Greenhouse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後，你應該§a把它改建成溫室§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then, {roman} want to see you vanish out of thin air.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然後，我想看你§c憑空消失§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Then...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那麼……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There always seems to be gifts and other items in these walls!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些牆裡好像總是有禮物和其他物品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are Hideonleafs on the island.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：島上有藏葉蟲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are Hotspots here, in the {island}, and in the {island2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡、{island}§f和{island2}§f都有§d熱點§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are Relics {roman} am searching for all around this island!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我正在尋找散布在這座島上各處的§b遺物§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are all sorts of icy creatures within the depths of {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{area}深處有各式各樣的冰霜生物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are also {area} requests, those are my training sessions...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡也有{area}的請求，那些是我的訓練課程……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are currently {0} different federal tax brackets in the Rift.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：隙界目前有 {0} 個不同的聯邦稅級。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are lots of mutations that exist and they are quite interesting to discover, however {roman} really only know how to spread one of them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c突變§f有很多種，發現它們很有趣，不過我真的只知道怎麼繁殖其中一種。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are many ways to find {pet}, you just have to think.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：找到{pet}的方法有很多，你只要動動腦。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are multiple entrances, most of them have guards but this one down there is often unprotected.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡有好幾個入口，大部分都有守衛，但下面那個通常沒人看守。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are multiple types of Fuel, like {collections_res}, {resource} and many more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：燃料有很多種，像是{collections_res}、{resource}等等！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are no miners like the dwarves.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有礦工比得上矮人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are not many constants in the multiverse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：多重宇宙中不變的東西不多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are only {0} ways to get {collections_res}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：取得{collections_res}的方法只有 {0} 種。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are several qualities of {collections_res}, including Rough, Flawed, and Fine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{collections_res}§f有好幾種品質，包括粗糙、§a有瑕§f和§9精良§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are some relics up there hidden on the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{island}上面藏著一些遺物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有些事你最好別知道。至少現在還不行。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are three different beliefs among the Taika.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§aTaika §f人之中有三種不同的信仰。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are two things you can do with those Shards.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些碎片有兩種用法。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are ups and down sometimes but there is always a shinning light
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有時候會有起有落，但總會有一道閃耀的光

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are {0} different Factions on this island with incredible tensions between them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座島上有 {0}§f 個不同的§c派系§f，彼此之間關係非常緊張！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are {0} different Gemstones, all of them having their own unique properties!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：寶石共有 {0} 種，每一種都有自己獨特的特性！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There are {0} {1} stats you need to know about.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你需要了解的{1}屬性有 {0} 種。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There has to be information somewhere that can fill in the blanks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一定有什麼地方有資訊能填補這些空白。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is a darkness in you, {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你的內心有一股黑暗，{player}§7。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is a fine-grained gold substance somewhere in the {island}, {roman}'ll need {0} of that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{island}的某個地方有一種細粒狀的黃金物質，我需要 {0} 個。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is a lot more to know about cutting down trees, so talk to me if you want to learn more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：關於砍樹還有很多要學的，想了解更多就來找我談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is a relic a little below a Fairy Soul in the caves.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：洞穴裡一個仙女之魂的下方一點有個遺物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is a rogue Barbarian going by the name of Duke {roman}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有一個名叫§c Duke {roman}§f的流氓野蠻人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is no sunlight either, it would be quite accommodating for a Vampire.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡也沒有陽光，對吸血鬼來說相當舒適。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is no time...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒時間了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is none. There is no cake.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：根本沒有。沒有蛋糕。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is only one person in the Rift who possesses the strength necessary to break through it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：整個§d混沌隙界§f只有§c一個§f人擁有打破它所需的力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is only one way to obtain Heavy Pearls.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：取得§2沉重珍珠§f只有一個方法。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is plenty {collections_res} for everyone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{collections_res}多到每個人都夠用。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is so much to see!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有好多東西可以看！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is something in it for you if you do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你做到了，會有§6好處§f給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is still so much to learn about {collections_res}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：關於{collections_res}，還有好多東西要學。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There is {npc2}. Let's ask her what she knows.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}在那裡。我們去問問她知道些什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There isn't much going on in our caves at the moment so they don't have much to talk about.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們的洞穴目前沒什麼事，所以他們沒什麼好聊的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There might be some below mushrooms too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：蘑菇底下可能也有一些！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There really is no point talking to me
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跟我說話真的沒什麼意義

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There seems to be {0} key components to the giant that are missing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個巨人似乎缺少了 {0} 個關鍵零件。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There was always a cat around the house, sometimes killing the birds
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：房子附近總是有一隻貓，有時候會殺死那些鳥

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There was once a baby bear, little and cute,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：從前有隻小熊寶寶，又小又可愛，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There was once a powerful necromancer who lived in the Catacombs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：曾經有一位§5強大的死靈法師§f住在§c地下陵墓§f裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There we go, a job well done. {roman}'ll make sure to leave a good review for you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好了，大功告成。我一定會幫你留個好評！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There will be no cake whatsoever!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不會有任何蛋糕！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There you'll find resources only an experienced farmer can handle - cocoa beans, sugar cane, mushrooms, and cactus!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在那裡，你會找到只有經驗豐富的農夫才應付得來的資源——可可豆、甘蔗、蘑菇和仙人掌！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's a Pest out there somewhere, {roman}'m certain of it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：外面某處有隻§6害蟲§f，我很確定。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's a RING hologram right above. Try using that, would you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：正上方有一個§e§lRING§f全像投影。試試用那個，好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's a bunch of a different collections, depending on your tastes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：依照你的品味，有一大堆不同的收藏系列！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's also this guy who's asking me to race him sometimes
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：還有個傢伙有時候會找我跟他賽跑

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's an art to it! The right tools make all the difference.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這可是門藝術！對的工具會帶來天壤之別。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's been enough complaints against him recently.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：最近對他的抱怨已經夠多了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's emerald on everything {roman} like!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我喜歡的東西上都有§a綠寶石§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's even evidence to suggest that they would sometimes eat each other!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：甚至有證據顯示，牠們有時候還會互相吃掉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's lots to do in the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{island}有很多事可以做。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's nothing for you here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡沒有你要的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's nothing like island racing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有什麼比得上島嶼賽跑！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's some stew for {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些燉菜是給{npc2}的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's something strange about this wall. It looks out of place...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這面牆有點奇怪。看起來格格不入……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: There's this guy named {npc2} there - he created the Abiphone. Forgot to patent it, though.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那裡有個叫{npc2} §f的人——是他發明了§aAbiphone§f。不過他忘了申請專利。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These Catacombs hold many riches, powerful items and great experience.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些§c地下陵墓§f裡有許多§e財富§f、強大的§a物品§f和大量的§b經驗。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These Specialized Farming Tools are a game changer! You can level them and upgrade to become even more powerful.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些§e專用農具§f會徹底改變遊戲！你可以讓它們升級、強化，變得更加強大。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These are special edition items that rotate every year!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些是每年輪替的特別版物品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These are trying times, indeed. The {area} is overflowing with monsters! Anyone who comes in is spooked off by the grunts of zombies in the distance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這真是艱難的時期。{area}裡滿是怪物！每個進來的人都被遠處殭屍的低吼聲嚇跑了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These aren't just normal crops. These are mutated... just like the ones we've been finding in the {island}. But why hide all this down here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些不是普通的§a作物§f。它們是§c突變的§f……就跟我們在{island}§f找到的那些一樣。但為什麼要把這些都藏在這下面？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These bones ain't what they used to be.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這副老骨頭已經大不如前了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These don't just sit pretty, they grow stronger the more you use 'em!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些可不只是好看而已，你用得越多，它們就變得越強！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These eggs will help me stomach my pain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些蛋能幫我忍住痛苦。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These flowers are for me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些§c花§f是給我的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These forges have been running at an endermite's pace!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些鍛造爐的速度跟終界蟎一樣慢！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These guys... are scaring me. {roman}'m not quite sure what they are planning in there, but {roman2}'d also rather not want to know.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些傢伙……讓我好害怕。我不太確定他們在裡面策劃什麼，但我也寧願不知道。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These paintings don't paint themselves!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些畫可不會自己畫出來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These reverse murders always have a motive.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這類§c逆向謀殺案§f總是有動機的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: These...these speak to me. There's something about them. You have inspired me once again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些……這些在對我說話。它們有種特別的東西。你又一次啟發了我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They all have a motive
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們都有目的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They also have remarkable hearing. Sneaking will be much harder for them to detect than sprinting.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們的§e聽力§f也非常好。比起§e衝刺§f，§e潛行§f更不容易被他們發現。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They also used them to fight each other over territory and gather food!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們也會用它來爭奪地盤、跟同類打架，還有收集食物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They always vote for the same
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們總是投給同一個人

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They are always right
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們永遠都是對的

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They are full of bountiful treasures but watch out for those Lapis Zombies!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那裡滿是豐富的寶藏，不過要小心那些青金石殭屍！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They are probably hiding the research there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們大概把§2研究§f藏在那裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They are quite interesting.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們相當有趣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They are technically Mages, but not part of the Mage Faction, they constantly cause problems.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們嚴格來說是法師，但不屬於法師派系，經常惹麻煩。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They are the enemies, but if they are motivated by love, maybe we can communicate with them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們是敵人，但如果牠們的動機是愛，也許我們能跟牠們溝通。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They are the souls of my fallen sisters.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些是我逝去姊妹們的靈魂。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They are very small.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們非常小。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They became beautiful and happy cats, their mom would have been proud
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們長成了美麗又快樂的貓，牠們的媽媽一定會很驕傲

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They believe it was the Sky's plan to make us independent through {collections_res}, and that the Sky is good and fair.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們相信是天空的計畫，透過{collections_res}讓我們自立，而天空是善良且公正的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They believe we are working on war engines.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們認為我們在研發戰爭機器。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They can be very hard to find, but they all have unique abilities.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們可能很難找，但每一種都有獨特的能力。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They contain cool loot when mined!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：挖開它們會有很酷的戰利品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They discovered that within every creature lies a power unique to its kind.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們發現，每一種生物體內都蘊藏著其種族獨有的力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They don't call it a consumable for nothing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們可不是平白無故被稱為消耗品的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They don't mind travelers but you have to earn their trust before you can do such things.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們不介意旅行者，但你得先贏得他們的信任，才能做那種事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They don't remember the lyrics!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：因為牠們不記得歌詞！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They emit light without any combustible.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們不需要任何燃料就能發光。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They even got away with it, awful
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們甚至還逃過了制裁，真糟糕

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They even intervened directly at times, teaching essential lessons like substainable living and the imporance of nature's balance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們有時甚至會直接介入，傳授像是永續生活與自然平衡的重要性等基本課題。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They got banned from the Academy during their first year, and even got exiled from the island after a terrible incident.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們在第一年就被§7學院§f開除，甚至在一場可怕的事件後被逐出了這座島。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They have followed the traces of the {collections_res} all the way to the {area} in the North.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們追著{collections_res}的蹤跡，一路追到北方的{area}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They have regenerative properties that allow for them the regenerate their wool faster than normal!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們有再生的特性，羊毛長回來的速度比一般的羊快！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They keep a spare weapon around for new faces.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們會為新面孔準備一把備用的§a武器§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They look super realistic, but no animal was harmed when making them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們看起來超逼真的，但製作過程中沒有任何動物受到傷害！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They probably got cornered by monsters and had to hide here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們大概被怪物逼到角落，只好躲在這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They saw the Starborns' teachings as shackles, hindering their true potential.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們把星裔的教誨視為枷鎖，阻礙了自己真正的潛能。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They seem to pop up when you're breaking crops on your {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在{island}§f上§e採收作物§f的時候，牠們好像就會冒出來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They should be South of the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們應該在{area}§f的§e南邊§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They should be able to equip you with a weapon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們應該能給你一把§a武器§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They should be in their shack up in the trees.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們應該在§a樹上§f的小屋裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They should say so on the cover!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們應該在封面上寫清楚啊！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They sometimes drop important gear like the armor {roman}'m wearing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們有時候會掉落重要的裝備，像是我穿的這套§a盔甲§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They sometimes show up nearby the {event} at night, as far as {roman} know.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：據我所知，他們有時會在晚上出現在{event}附近。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They sought more: longer life, greater strength, boundless energy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們追求更多：更長的壽命、更強的力量、無窮的能量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They were all killed! A long time ago.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：她們全都是被殺的！很久以前。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They were making so much noise, right above my room
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們吵得要命，就在我房間的正上方

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They were right, {roman}'m a successful young man now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們說得對，我現在是個成功的年輕人了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They were too busy to learn and create new spells, and even turned the {area} into an Academy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們忙著學習和創造新的法術，甚至把{area}改成了學院。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They were unable to do so because the time distortion at the summit is too intense, while the woods offered a more manageable environment.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們做不到，因為山頂的時間扭曲太強烈了，而§a森林§f提供了比較容易掌控的環境。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They will know what it means.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們會明白的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They will see when {roman} turn the world upside down!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等我把世界翻過來，他們就知道了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They would've probably tasted bad anyways...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：反正它們大概也不好吃吧……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They'll bribe, lie and DEFAME anybody just to get votes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們為了拉票，會§6收買§f、說謊，還會§c抹黑§f任何人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They'll poof away like magic, but they never go too far.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們會像變魔術一樣消失，但從不會跑太遠。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They'll usually have somewhere from {0}{1}, with an {2} chance to receive a {3}th if they already have {4}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們通常會有 {0}{1}§f 個，如果已經有 {4}§f 個，還有 {2} §f的機率得到第 {3}§a 個§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're a human, dummy. That's why.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們是人類，笨蛋。所以才跳得那麼高。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're a renowned Argofay alchemist!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們是一位知名的 Argofay 煉金術師！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're also known as x, y and z.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們也被稱為 x、y 和 z。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're always sitting at this table. All day, every day...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們總是坐在這張桌子旁。整天、每天……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're always sure to shake things up.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們總是會讓局勢大洗牌。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're always working there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們總是在那裡工作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're just asking to be knocked over. Why not just put them in a drawer, out of the way?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那根本是在等人撞倒。為什麼不把它們收進抽屜，放到旁邊去？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're so precious and cute!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們好珍貴、好可愛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're special enhancements that can be applied to your Foraging Gear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們是可以套用在你§2伐木裝備§f上的特殊強化。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're squishy and disgusting. {roman} don't want to know where you got these from.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們軟爛又噁心。我不想知道你是從哪裡弄來的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're the curious group that trails behind Shrimp, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：就是跟在§d蝦子§f後面的那群好奇的傢伙，你知道吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: They're tough to find, but this old hunter knows a trick or two.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們很難找，但我這個老獵人知道一兩招。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Think about it, they're so rare, a collector will snatch it from you for BIG coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想想看，它們這麼§9稀有§f，§e收藏家§f會用一大筆§6遊戲幣§f跟你搶！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Think, my dear {player}, think.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想想看，親愛的{player}，好好想想。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This Beacon here is incredibly ancient.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座信標非常古老。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This Fig Tree right next to us, has a Toughness of {0}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們旁邊這棵§a無花果樹§f的硬度是 {0}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This Piglin got lost!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這隻§c豬布林§f迷路了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This Scythe will help you clean your plot even faster!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這把鐮刀能幫你更快清理你的地塊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This action has left me unimpressed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e：這個舉動讓我不以為然。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This allows you to call your favorite contact with just a single click!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e只要點一下，就能打給你最喜歡的聯絡人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This apartment is very cozy but it triggers something in me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這間公寓很舒適，但它觸動了我心裡的某種東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This barricade is exceptionally strong.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這道路障異常堅固。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This box is already opened.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個箱子已經打開了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This citadel used to be the epicenter of fructuous engineering.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座堡壘曾經是豐碩工程的中心。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This could quite possible be the dumbest thing {roman}'ve heard in my entire life.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這可能是我這輩子聽過§c最蠢的話§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This creature can be found inside the {area}, south of the island.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這種生物可以在島嶼南邊的{area}裡找到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This creature usually so afraid of the fire, rushed into the infernal flames
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這隻平常那麼怕火的生物，衝進了地獄般的火焰中

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This cult is fire.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個教團真是火熱。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This device right next to me is a {enchantment} Condenser.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我旁邊這台裝置是{enchantment}§d凝聚器§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This dinosaur is actually really controversial, as fossils make it hard to tell how it truly behaved.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這種恐龍其實非常有爭議，因為從化石很難判斷牠真正的行為。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This display case is empty. If you bring me a fossil, {roman}'d be happy to display it and tell you about it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個展示櫃是空的。如果你帶化石來給我，我很樂意把它展示出來，並告訴你它的故事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This event changed me to my very core, everything about me had to change
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這件事徹底改變了我，我的一切都必須改變

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This experiment is close to succeeding, it could be my new Scarlet Prize!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個實驗就快成功了，它可能會成為我的新緋紅獎！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This from {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是{npc2}給的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This future... Impossible...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個未來……不可能……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個巨大觸手怪物的故事是真的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This guy isn't the sharpest hammer in the smithy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這傢伙可不是鍛造坊裡最利的那把錘子！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This increases your chance to find rare loot when killing this mob!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這會提高你擊殺這種怪物時找到稀有戰利品的機率！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is a Bio-{item}. Beep.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是生物{item}。嗶。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is a no cake zone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡是禁止蛋糕區。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is a shocking turn of events!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這真是令人震驚的轉折！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is a wonderful gift!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這真是份§d美好§f的禮物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is a wonderful poem.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一首§d很美§f的詩。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is absurd!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這太荒謬了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is acceptable. {roman} would never eat this myself, but it's good enough for my servants.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這還可以接受。我自己絕對不會吃這個，但給我的僕人吃夠好了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is an alternate dimension.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一個平行§d維度§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is exactly what {roman} need!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這§a正是§f我需要的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is going to be our {area}'s {area2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡將會是我們{area}的{area2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is highly sensitive information.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是高度機密的資訊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is my favorite site, {roman} know everything about the great Dragons.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我最喜歡的景點，我知道所有關於偉大§5巨龍§f的事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is of course Jythar, the Eternal One.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這當然就是§5 Jythar§f，永恆者。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is our Town Board.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是我們的§c城鎮公告板§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is rough to be honest, my potatoes...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說實話這真的很難熬，我的馬鈴薯……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is so boring!!!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好無聊啊！！！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is so strange...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這真是太奇怪了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is the Mage {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡是§c法師{area}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is the Statue of the Hero. {roman} come here every day to pray.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是§9英雄雕像§f。我每天都來這裡祈禱。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is the Tubulator. You will need my lazer pointer.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是管道迷宮。你需要我的雷射筆。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is the kind of lava {roman} need...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這就是我需要的那種岩漿……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is the {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡是{area}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is too magical for my taste.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這對我來說太魔法了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is... this isn't about plushies anymore. {npc2}'s been working on something much bigger.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這……這已經不是絨毛玩偶的問題了。{npc2}一直在進行更大的計畫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This is...magnificent...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這真是……太壯麗了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This isn't good enough {npc2}! Your father would be very annoyed if {roman} told him the score you got!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這還不夠好，{npc2}！如果我把你的分數告訴你父親，他會非常不高興的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This isn't the correct amount of the item {roman} asked for.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這不是我要的物品數量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This isn't the correct amount {roman} asked for.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這不是我要的數量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This isn't the food {roman} wanted, please get me the correct food.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這不是我要的食物，請幫我拿對的食物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This isn't what {roman} need!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這不是我需要的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This item surfaced from the lavapool
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個物品從岩漿池裡浮了上來

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This kid is a handful.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這孩子真難帶。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This land actually used to be a peaceful forest with farmers, a long long time ago.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很久很久以前，這片土地其實是一座有農夫居住的寧靜森林。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This legendary item once vanquished a dire menace to humanity in my home dimension.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這件傳奇物品曾在我的故鄉維度擊敗一個威脅人類的可怕禍害。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This means that it's better to group together to cut down trees around here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這表示在這附近最好§d組隊§f一起砍樹。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This meat is a special blend of well... everything.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這塊肉是特製的綜合……嗯……什麼都有。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This might take some time, so you should come back later.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這可能需要一些時間，所以你應該晚點再來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This monster is something else, trust me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：相信我，這隻怪物非同小可。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This monster probably feeds itself with {collections_res}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這隻怪物大概是以{collections_res}為食。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This one can't be dislodged!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這塊拔不下來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This one here looks a little strange, but is the {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這塊看起來有點奇怪，但它是{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This one is Angry!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這隻很憤怒！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This one is a rare find!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這可是難得的發現！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This one isn't too bad.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這件沒那麼難。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This park deserves better and {roman} want to see it flourish like it used to be.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座公園值得更好的對待，我想看到它像以前一樣繁榮。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This part is crucial for the investigation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這一步對調查至關重要。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This pet {roman}'m looking after is super hungry! You got anything?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我照顧的這隻寵物餓壞了！你有什麼吃的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This place is full of treasures and secrets!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個地方充滿了寶藏和祕密！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This place still gives me chills... but {roman}'m sure there's more to uncover.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這地方還是讓我發毛……但我確定還有更多東西等著被發現。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This rabbit looks a little funny, did you fish it out of the {area}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這隻兔子看起來有點怪，你是從{area}釣上來的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This ring, once forged in love's sweet name, now lies as broken as the vow it bore.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這枚曾以愛之名鑄成的戒指，如今就像它承載的誓言一樣破碎。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This sheep looks a little funny, did you fish it out of the {area}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這隻羊看起來有點怪，你是從{area}釣上來的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This should do it! {roman}'ve got some counting to do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這樣應該就夠了！我還有東西要數。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This should do nicely. {roman}'ll have plenty of pelts by the end of the day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這應該很好用。今天結束前我就會有一大堆毛皮了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This should fill me up for {0} SkyBlock days.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這應該能讓我撐 {0} 個 SkyBlock 日。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This side of the table isn't as valuable as the other side.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：桌子這一邊沒有另一邊那麼有價值。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This simply won't do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這可不行。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This smell... it reminds me of my childhood when {roman} used to pick flowers in the garden. Keep this between you and me, understand?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個味道……讓我想起小時候在花園裡摘花的日子。這件事只有你知我知，懂嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This snow should put a damper on those Magma Cubes! You can thank me later!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這些雪應該能給那些岩漿立方怪潑點冷水！晚點再謝我吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This spider, {mob} - it's way out of my league...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這隻蜘蛛，{mob}——牠完全不是我能對付的……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This strong Cloth will be able to contain the skull and the lumino fibers together.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這塊堅固的布料能把頭骨和光纖一起包住。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This stuff is important because it lets you upgrade Chips, which will give you permanent buffs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這東西很重要，因為它能讓你升級§9晶片§f，而晶片會給你永久的增益。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This temple does not have the treasure you are seeking at this time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座神殿目前沒有你要找的寶藏。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This temple is locked, you will need to bring me a key open the door!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座神殿是鎖著的，你得帶鑰匙來給我開門！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This time {roman}'ll need {0} Redstone - that's {1} stacks! It's quite a lot, but {roman2} know you can do it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這次我需要 {0}§c 個紅石§f——也就是 {1}§f 組！雖然很多，但我知道你辦得到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This time, {roman} will need {0} Redstone. That's {1} stacks, if you didn't know!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這次我需要 {0}§c 個紅石§f。告訴你，那是 {1}§f 組！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This titan next to us is known by many names, some call them the Calamity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們旁邊這個巨獸有很多名字，有些人稱牠們為§5大災難§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This town was built four centuries ago, or more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這座城鎮建於四個世紀以前，甚至更早！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This was a life changing experience.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是一次改變人生的經歷。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This was once attached to the back of the {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它原本長在{pet}的背上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This way, everyone is happy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e這樣一來，大家都開心！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This will also delay my work considerably, how am {roman} going to obtain all those precious materials now...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這也會大大延誤我的研究，我現在要怎麼取得那些珍貴的材料……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This will make for the perfect sacrifice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這會是完美的祭品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This will make me gain even more favor with the {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這會讓我更受{npc2}的寵愛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This {item}, that {roman} found in my pocket.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個{item}，是我在我口袋裡找到的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This {npc2} is such a wise man.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個{npc2}真是個睿智的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This'll be a nice hobby to work on. Thank you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這會是個不錯的嗜好。謝謝你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This'll do nicely! Ciao!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個很好！再見啦！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: This'll work, {roman}'ll let you know if {roman2} catch anything!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個可以，如果我釣到什麼會告訴你的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thormyr only sleeps and eats when he's not at this table. Nothing else.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Thormyr 不在這張桌子旁的時候，就只會睡覺和吃東西。沒別的了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those Dashing Spiders are pretty obnoxious. {roman} find a well-placed arrow can help with that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些衝刺蜘蛛真的很煩人。我發現一支射得準的箭能解決這個問題。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those Fairy Souls scare off the animals.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些§d仙女之魂§f會把動物嚇跑。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those Relics are truly remarkable.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些遺物真的很了不起。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those are my plushies! {roman} preserve them in {resource} so they stay fresh!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些是我的絨毛玩偶！我把它們泡在{resource}裡保鮮！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those boys were bad news - they would take a bite out of anything!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些傢伙可不好惹——什麼東西都會咬一口！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those fairies are so strange.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些仙女真奇怪。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those guys are solitary creatures and quite territorial, so you don't normally see them about.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些傢伙是獨居動物，地盤意識很強，所以平常很少見到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those in his organization have committed questionable acts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他組織裡的人做過一些可疑的事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those little guys actually only live for a few years, which is kinda sad...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些小傢伙其實只能活幾年，有點令人難過……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those ones are going to be tougher to obtain though.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過這些會比較難取得。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those people will say that they believe in knowledge and magic.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些人會說他們相信的是知識和魔法。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those questions keep getting tougher and tougher...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些題目越來越難了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those things are actually insectivores and love digging tunnels.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些傢伙其實是食蟲動物，而且很愛挖隧道。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those things were pretty much walking fortresses - completely covered in bony deposits known as osteoderms that protected them from predators.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些傢伙根本就是會走路的堡壘——全身覆蓋著名為皮內成骨的骨質沉積，保護牠們免受掠食者攻擊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those tiny fish are super cute, that's mostly why {roman} hunt them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些小魚超可愛的，這也是我獵牠們的主要原因。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Those troublesome creatures are ruining everything and must be dealt with. Do you understand?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些麻煩的生物正在毀掉一切，必須好好處理。你明白嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thou art a creature of delight,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝是令人愉悅的生靈，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thou hast delivered me from death's cold grasp, when all seemed lost to cruel fate's design.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當一切似乎都已輸給殘酷命運的安排時，是你將吾從死亡冰冷的掌握中救出。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though Sun {mob}'s power grows more daunting, you have found a way through once again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然§e太陽{mob}§f的力量越來越令人生畏，你又一次找到了突破的方法。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though beware, for your ф {stats} shall deplete twice as fast.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過要小心，你的§aф {stats} §f會以§c兩倍速度§f流逝。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though it's not like that fact makes their tusks any less intimidating...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，這並不會讓牠們的象牙變得比較不嚇人……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though it's unfortunate you may fail like the others.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過很遺憾，你可能會跟其他人一樣§c失敗§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though it's worth noting that this will consume the dye, meaning you won't get it back afterwards.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過要注意，這會消耗染料，也就是說之後就拿不回來了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though they look pretty scary, these guys mostly ate vegetation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然看起來很可怕，但這些傢伙主要吃植物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though they're not very talkative fellows on account of being dead 'n all, you can still have a rummage through their backpacks for some loot!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然他們因為死了之類的原因不太健談，但你還是可以翻翻他們的背包找些戰利品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though this dino was covered in strong plating that would usually make it impervious to predators, it had a soft underbelly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然這種恐龍全身覆蓋著堅固的甲板，通常能讓掠食者無從下手，但牠的肚子很柔軟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though {roman} faltered, perhaps you will prevail.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然我失敗了，但也許你會成功。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Though, if you have to live at the same time as a bloodthirsty predator like the {pet}, it probably would help to have an armored body and bone-shatteringly strong tail.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過，如果你得跟{pet}這種嗜血的掠食者活在同一個時代，擁有裝甲般的身體和能把骨頭打碎的強壯尾巴大概很有幫助。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thousands of Dragons attacked that day and all were defeated, but did they fail?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那天有數千條巨龍來襲，全都被打敗了，但他們真的失敗了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Three crops will be in-season at any given time, harvesting them will help season the stew and earn you exclusive items!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：任何時候都會有三種當季作物，收成它們能幫燉湯調味，還能讓你獲得獨家物品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Through my research, {roman}'ve deducted that the Precursors were this world's first inhabitants.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：根據我的研究，我推斷先驅者是這個世界最早的居民。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Through the {enchantment} of Time {roman} have earned the knowledge and memories of the ancient God of Time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：透過時間的{enchantment}§9§f，我獲得了遠古§9時間之神§f的知識與記憶。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thy beauty doth astound,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝的美令人驚嘆，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thy laughter like the breeze,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝的笑聲似微風，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thy nature is a thing divine,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝的本質神聖無比，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thy presence fills my grateful heart,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝的存在充滿我感恩的心，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thy soul doth glow with inner light,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝的靈魂閃耀著內在之光，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thy voice, a sound that can't be missed,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝的嗓音令人難忘，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Thy wings are like the morning mist,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝的翅膀如晨霧，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time flows differently in this dimension.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在這個§d維度§f裡，§e時間§f的流動方式不同。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time for bed!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：該睡覺了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time is a bit muddy here. {roman} found it when {roman2} first spawned in this farm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這裡的時間有點混亂。我第一次在這個§e農場§f出現時就找到牠了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time is infinite, but you can still run out of it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：時間是無限的，但你還是可能會用完！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time is of the essence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：時間緊迫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time is the only thing {roman} have!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：時間是我唯一擁有的東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time really flies when you work on something you love.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做自己喜歡的事時，時間真的過得好快。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time really flies!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：時間過得真快！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time to focus on myself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是時候專注在自己身上了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time to kick back and put my feet up, at least until tomorrow!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：該放鬆一下、把腳翹起來了，至少到明天為止！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time to make friends.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是時候交些朋友了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Time will tell.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：時間會證明一切。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ting-ting-krzzzph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：叮叮——喀滋滋！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To aid you in our duel, you will need this magical wand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了幫助你在我們的對決中，你需要這根魔杖。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To bake us some bread, {roman} think {roman2} need about {0} {collections_res}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要烤麵包的話，我想我需要大約 {0} 個{collections_res}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To be fair, {roman}'m not supposed to be here either.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說實話，我也不應該在這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To be frank, {roman} can see why you could need another one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：坦白說，我能理解你為什麼會再需要一瓶。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To be honest, we just want to look cool.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：老實說，我們只是想看起來很酷。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To collect Odonatas, you need to fly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要收集§9蜻蜓§f，你需要§b飛§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the opposite side of the island AND come back all the way back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要完成比賽，你得跑到§e島嶼的另一端§f，然後一路跑回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the opposite side of the island and come all the way back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要完成比賽，你得跑到§e島嶼的另一端§f再一路跑回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To craft me a {item}, you will need to reach {collections_res} Collection {roman}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要幫我合成{item}§f，你需要達到{collections_res}§a收藏 {roman}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To each their own. {roman}'m fascinated by these little fellers!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：人各有所好。我就是對這些小傢伙著迷！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To fairy or not to fairy?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：妖精，還是不妖精？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To fast travel or not to fast travel?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：快速移動，還是不快速移動？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To fuse, combine {0} Shards of one creature with {1} Shards of another in the Fusion Machine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要融合，就在融合機裡把一種生物的 {0} 個碎片和另一種生物的 {1} 個碎片結合。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To get a {resource}, you need to let the Matriarch eat you alive.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要取得{resource}§f，你得讓§c女族長§f把你活生生吃掉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To get started, acquire a {item} first in your Greenhouse and then come back to me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：首先，先在你的溫室裡取得一個{item}，然後再回來找我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To get you started, please bring me {0} Oak Logs! You can break the trees just off the trail to get 'em.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：首先，請帶 {0}§a 個橡木原木§f給我！你可以砍小路旁邊的樹來取得。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To help with my research, {roman} need to collect various data samples of special mutated crops.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了幫助我的研究，我需要收集各種特殊突變作物的數據樣本。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To hide in the grass!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了躲在草叢裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To level up your perks you will need {whisper}. These are obtained by cutting trees!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要升級你的強化，你需要{whisper}。砍樹就能獲得！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To one day stand in a field and eat grass?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：有一天能站在草原上吃草？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To receive it, we require {collections_res} x{0}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要取得它，我們需要{collections_res} §8x{0}§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To receive it, we require {resource} x{0}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要取得它，我們需要{resource} §8x{0}§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To satisfy my customers, {roman} am giving everyone {0} off on their new Abiphone purchase!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e為了滿足我的顧客，我給大家購買新 Abiphone 打 {0}§e 的折扣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To satisfy my shareholders, {roman} had to double the price of this new Abiphone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e為了滿足我的股東，我不得不把這支新 Abiphone 的價格翻倍。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To save you a bit of time, you can also use a preset farm at your desk!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了幫你省點時間，你也可以在辦公桌使用預設農場！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To see the moooon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了去看月～哞～亮。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To show my gratitude, please have this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了表達我的謝意，請收下這個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To show my gratitude, {roman} have a special item to sell you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了表達我的謝意，我有一件特別的物品要賣給你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To show you my gratitude, {roman} have a special item to sell you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為了表達我的謝意，我有一件特別的物品要賣給你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To start out {roman}'ll need some generic gold to experiment on, could you get me a stack?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：首先，我需要一些普通的黃金來做實驗，你能幫我拿一組嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: To truly harness their power, collect as many as possible and store them in your Accessory Bag!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要真正駕馭它們的力量，就盡可能收集越多越好，把它們存在你的§a飾品袋§f裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Today, it shall serve us in our brawl.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：今天，它將在我們的混戰中派上用場。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Today, vampires are on the menu.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：今天，菜單上是§4吸血鬼§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Today, you'll see similar armor-like osteoderms on Crocodiles and Armadillos.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如今，你在鱷魚和犰狳身上也能看到類似盔甲的皮內成骨。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Today, {roman} am unveiling the newest technology in Abiphones.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e今天，我要揭曉 Abiphone 的最新科技。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Today... not so much.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如今……就沒那麼多了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Together, one of us will eventually mend the rift and repair the Breach atop the mountain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們之中終究會有一個人修補隙界，修復山頂上的裂縫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Together, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們一起完成它，確保它被負責任地使用。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Told me to kill enemy monsters for him
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：叫我幫他殺敵方的怪物

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Tomorrow you might come back here yesterday.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§b明天§f你可能會在§a昨天§f回到這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Too bad he's using his powers for all the wrong reasons.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜他把力量用在了§c錯誤§f的地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Too bad you didn't put in the effort to collect them yourselves.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜你沒有努力自己去收集。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Too bad, {roman} guess {roman2}'ll have to look for actual metal next time...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真可惜，看來下次我得去找真正的金屬了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Tough love, but maybe you're right. They're only nightmares, right? Not real. Heh.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然嚴厲，但也許你說得對。那些只是惡夢，對吧？不是真的。嘿。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Tree Gifts are rewarded to everyone who helped to cut down a tree.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每個幫忙砍倒樹的人都能獲得§2樹之禮§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Trophy Fishing is my passion, and {npc2} is the local specialist.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：戰利品釣魚是我的熱情，而{npc2}是當地的專家。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: True fisher no tip.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真正的漁夫不要提示。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Truly someone deserving of their title!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是名副其實！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Truly, they instill a newfound sense of safety.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們確實帶來了全新的安全感。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Truthfully, {roman}'ve forgotten how {roman2} ended up down there in the first place.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說實話，我已經忘了自己當初是怎麼跑到下面去的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try again, but this time come back in {0} minute or less!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再試一次，不過這次要在 {0} 分鐘以內回來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try again, but this time come back in {0} minutes or less!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再試一次，不過這次要在 {0} 分鐘以內回來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try and find one of my brothers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試著找找我的§a兄弟們§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try coming back in {timer}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{timer} 後再來試試！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try dropping by when she's in office!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等她上任的時候再來看看吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try harder!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再用力一點！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try imagining it harder
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：再用力想像看看

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try it on this fish right here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對這條魚試試看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try it on this fish right there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對那邊那條魚試試看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try it out and see what you can create!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試試看，看你能創造出什麼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try killing {0} of them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試著殺掉 {0} 隻看看！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try not to break those too.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：別把那些也打破了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try some of my starter gear!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試試我的§a新手裝備§f吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try some of {area}'s finest spirits!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來嚐嚐{area}§5的§f頂級烈酒吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try the Trial of Blue {resource} {0} for a greater challenge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§3挑戰藍色{resource}試煉 {0} §f，迎接更大的挑戰吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try to beat {timer}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試著跑進 {timer}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try to reach the top of the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試著爬到{area}§c的頂端。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try to survive the Trial of Blue {resource} {roman}, and {roman2}'ll give you the Soul Campfire Initiate Badge {roman3}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試著撐過§3藍色{resource}試煉 {roman}§f，我就給你靈魂營火新人徽章 {roman3}§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try to survive the Trial of {item} {roman} and {roman2}'ll give you the Campfire Initiate Badge!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：撐過§6{item}試煉 {roman} §f，我就給你§a營火新人徽章§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try to think outside the box...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試著跳脫框架思考……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try to use the {item} on a crop to understand it better!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：試著對作物使用{item}，更了解它！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Try to watch your step, word around is that there are a lot of old {island} hidden around this place.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：小心腳步，聽說這附近藏著很多古老的{island}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Tunnels in the caves were created to bury victims of the Calamity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：洞穴裡的隧道是為了埋葬大災難的受害者而挖的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Turns out, if you want something done, you have to do it yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來想把事情做好，還是得自己來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Turns out, {roman}'m scared of insects.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：結果發現，我怕昆蟲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ugh
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：唉

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Ugh...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§2唉……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Uh oh! Couldn't figure out how well ya did!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c糟糕！算不出你表現得怎麼樣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Uh oh.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：糟了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Uh...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：呃……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Uh... talk to Bughunter first.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：呃……先去找 Bughunter 談談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Uh... you didn't pick up the example item.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：呃……你沒有拿起範例物品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Uh? {npc2} solved his cube?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯？{npc2}解開他的方塊了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unbelievable!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a不可思議！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Under Dante, you worked for him. Under me, you'll work for each other.
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：在 Dante 底下，你為他工作。在我底下，你們將為彼此工作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Understand this: {npc2} is not merely a person; it is a concept, a legacy handed down through generations, striving towards a singular dream.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：要明白：{npc2}§f不只是一個§5§o人§r§f；它是一個概念，一份代代相傳的遺產，為了一個共同的夢想而努力。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Understandable, have a nice day. Please speak to me again if you ever change your mind.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可以理解，祝你有美好的一天。如果你改變主意，隨時再來找我談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Understandable. History has a way of capturing us when we least expect it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可以理解。歷史總會在我們最意想不到的時候吸引住我們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Understanding is a journey, not a destination.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：理解是一段旅程，而不是終點。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Understood, here it is.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：明白了，拿去吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unfortunate, {roman}'ll see if {roman2} can find some Nether Warts from someone else.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真可惜，我看看能不能從別人那裡找到地獄疙瘩。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unfortunately you didn't beat me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜你沒有打敗我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unfortunately {roman} don't know enough details myself
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜我自己也不知道太多細節

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unfortunately {roman} ran out of dye this morning...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜我今天早上染料用完了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unfortunately, there's always bigger fish. Or, in this case, a bigger spider.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜，人外有人。或者在這裡，是蛛外有蛛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unfortunately, those days are behind me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜，那些日子已經過去了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unfortunately, {roman} couldn't follow him any further as he almost noticed me, so {roman2} backed off for now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜他差點發現我，所以我沒辦法再跟下去，只好先退回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unfortunately, {roman} suffered an injury which restricts me from leaving my house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：可惜，我受了傷，沒辦法離開我的房子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unique way to fish. All trophy fish.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：獨特的釣法。全是戰利品魚。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unless you were guided...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§b§o除非你是被人指引來的……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unlock it through the {collections_res} Collection.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：透過{collections_res}§a收藏§f解鎖它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unraveling the mysteries of the Rift could prove crucial to our survival.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：揭開§d隙界§f的謎團，可能是我們生存的關鍵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Unsay something you shouldn't've, undo a mistake you've made?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：收回不該說的話、彌補自己犯過的錯？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Until that breach is tamed, anything that steps through it becomes a paradox and remains TRAPPED.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在那道§5裂縫§f被§a§o馴服§f之前，任何穿過它的東西都會變成悖論，並且一直§c被困住§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Until then, {roman} can make a boat for you using leftovers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在那之前，我可以用剩下的材料幫你做一艘§a船§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Until then, {roman} cannot grant you {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在那之前，我不能把{item}給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Until then, {roman} suggest leveling up!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在那之前，我建議你先升級！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Up and at 'em! Let's do this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：起床幹活！我們上吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Up-down.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：上下。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Upon my home's floor, grim bloodstains {roman} found.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：吾在家中地板上，發現了可怖的血跡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Us Piglins believe lava fishes are sacred beasts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們§c豬布林§f相信§2岩漿魚§f是神聖的野獸。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Us Taika people love the taste of {resource} so much that we'd go just about anywhere to get some.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們 Taika 人非常喜歡{resource}的味道，為了弄到一些，我們幾乎哪裡都願意去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Us dolphins have to go through heavy training before being sent to space.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們§b海豚§f在被送上太空之前，得經過嚴格的訓練。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use Silkwire to fly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用§e絲線§f來飛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use a {item} to make your Minions automatically sell their work once full!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用{item}讓你的工人在滿了之後自動賣掉產出！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use it to take your hunting skills to the next level!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用它把你的狩獵技巧提升到新的境界吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use it to transfer Rift-Transferable items.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用它來轉移§5可跨隙界轉移§f的物品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use my {item}. Holding it somehow makes me go faster.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用我的{item}吧。不知道為什麼，拿著它我就跑得比較快。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use the breadcrumbs on the yellow particles.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把§e麵包屑§f用在§e黃色粒子§f上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use the larvas to fly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用幼蟲來§b飛§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use the warp to the gallery.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用傳送點去藝廊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use the {collections_res} Grindr next to me to apply Gemstones to items!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：使用我旁邊的{collections_res}§d研磨機§f把寶石鑲嵌到物品上！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use the {item} on the Hay Bales and break {0} of 'em!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對著§e乾草捆§f使用{item}，打掉 {0} 個！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use the {item} on the Silkwire to fly.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在§e絲線§f上使用{item}§f來§b§o飛§r§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use the {item} to enchant an item!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用{item}來附魔物品吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use the {item} to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：使用{item}找出那位不幸受害者下落的線索。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use your Huntaxe on them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用你的§a狩獵斧§f對付牠們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use your fists for now - {roman}'ll give you my previous assistant's axe if you can prove your worth!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在先用拳頭吧——只要你能證明自己的價值，我就把我前任助手的斧頭給你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use your {item} Fishing Rods to pull them closer to the platform and collect them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用你們的{item}§c釣竿§f把它們§c拉近§f平台，然後撿起來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use your {item} to imbue the Glyph on the east side of the house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用你的{item}為房子東邊的§5符文§f注入力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use your {item} to imbue the Glyph on the north side of the house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用你的{item}為房子北邊的§5符文§f注入力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use your {item} to imbue the Glyph on the south side of the house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用你的{item}為房子南邊的§5符文§f注入力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Use your {item} to imbue the Glyph on the west side of the house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：用你的{item}為房子西邊的§5符文§f注入力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Using my amazing power of smell, {roman}'ll track you as you move through the {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我會用我驚人的嗅覺，在你穿越{island}時追蹤你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Usually it takes at least a day before she forgets your scent and eats you again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：通常至少要一天，她才會忘記你的氣味，再吃你一次。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Vacuum more Pests and exchange them with me to gain even more {stats}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：多吸一些害蟲來跟我交換，就能獲得更多{stats}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Vacuum the silverfishes, spiders and flies in the area.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把這一帶的蠹魚、蜘蛛和蒼蠅吸掉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Venture down into the {area} to unlock my Lift Menu!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：深入{area}來解鎖我的升降機選單！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very cool, but regular emeralds will do the trick.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很酷，不過普通的綠寶石就可以了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very few people would harm themselves rather than endanger another.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很少有人寧願傷害自己也不願危及他人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very good {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得很好，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very good, then {roman} don't need to explain what they're used for.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，那我就不用解釋它們的用途了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very good.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：非常好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very impressive!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：非常了不起！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very tasty.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：非常好吃。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very unfortunate, {roman} really needed that paper...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真可惜，我真的很需要那些紙……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very very good.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：非常非常好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very well then, to the {area} we go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，那我們就去{area}吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very well, let's begin then.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，那我們開始吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very well, may you lead a fulfilling life!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好，願你過著充實的人生！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very well, {roman} shall seek help elsewhere!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，那我去找別人幫忙！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very well.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very well. Let's put your wits to the test.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好。讓我們來考驗你的智慧吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Very well. {roman} will not ask you again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很好。我不會再問你了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: View your mob stats, unlock rewards, and more!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：查看你的怪物數據、解鎖獎勵等等！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Visit my shop for {stats} ...{#}inhales{#2}... and {stats2} gear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：來我的店看看{stats}……{#}吸氣{#2}……和{stats2}裝備吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Visitors come from all around the world to visit our {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：遊客從世界各地前來參觀我們的{area}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Volcanic. Volcano.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：火山。火山。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Vote for me if you like fun!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你喜歡好玩的，就投給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Voting for me, you will.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：投票給我，你會的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WE HAVE OUR EYES ON YOU.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們盯著你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE ANIMALS!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們知道你在這裡做什麼，你這個瘋子！你會為你對這些動物做的事付出代價！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WE stole YOUR {collections_res}?! You wizards have some nerves!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是我們偷了你們的{collections_res}？！你們這些巫師還真有膽！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!
entries.value: [NPC] {npc}：好啊，那你就解釋啊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WHAT DO YOU WANT?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你想幹嘛？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WHAT!?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c§l什麼！？！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WHAT?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WHAT? There are animals inside of here?!?! {npc2} is doing horrible experiments with these animals that he catches...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼？這裡面有動物？！？！{npc2}在用他抓來的動物做可怕的實驗……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WHAT? You want to go in alone? {roman} simply cannot allow that to happen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼？你想一個人進去？我絕對不能允許這種事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WHY ARE YOU HERE?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你為什麼在這裡？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WHY SLEEP WHEN YOU CAN JUST STAY AWAKE FOREVER!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：既然可以永遠醒著，為什麼還要睡覺！！！！
