entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WOW!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哇！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WOW!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哇！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: WOW.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a哇。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait a minute. This will work just fine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等一下。這個也行。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait actually, {roman} prefer choosing ignorance.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等，其實我寧願選擇無知。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait no... {0} Motes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等不對……{0}§d 微粒§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait you're not on my my side? Even after all that training? {roman} am so dead...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等，你不站在我這邊？訓練了那麼久之後？我死定了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait, do you have some?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等，你有嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait, is it? {roman}'m not sure; it's always so bright in here...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等，是晚上嗎？我不確定，這裡總是那麼亮……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait, is it? {roman}'m not sure; it's always so dark here...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等，是早上嗎？我不確定，這裡總是那麼暗……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait, there's a lever here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等，這裡有一根§d拉桿§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait, what? How...?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等，什麼？怎麼會……？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait... come look what {roman} found behind the furnace...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等……過來看看§5我在爐子後面找到了什麼§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wait... {roman} think {roman2}'ve hooked onto something!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等等……我好像鉤到什麼東西了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Walk around the edges, you will probably find some cave entrances.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沿著邊緣走，你大概會找到一些洞穴入口。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wanna get pizza after this cult meeting?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這次邪教聚會結束後要去吃披薩嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wanna hear another one?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想再聽一個嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wanna join us?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想加入我們嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Want to give it a shot?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想試試看嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Want to kill some leeches?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想去殺些水蛭嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Want to stand out while you slash and dash?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想在衝鋒陷陣時也§a與眾不同§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wanting to buy something from me? {roman} got some pretty fancy tuxedos for sale, for a price of a small fortune.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想跟我買東西嗎？我有一些非常高級的燕尾服在賣，價格是一筆小財富。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Was the tree there before me, or was {roman} there before the tree?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是樹先在那裡，還是我先在那裡？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Was there anything else you wanted to know about?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還有什麼想知道的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wassup! We're out here on a camping trip!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗨啊！我們在這裡露營！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Watch yourself, traveller. There are creatures about.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：小心點，旅行者。附近有怪物出沒。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Watering a crop inside the Greenhouse is different than normal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在§a溫室§f裡澆水跟平常不一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Way better names.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好太多的名字。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Way too precious.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：太珍貴了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We Dwarves inhabit this area. We love it! It is rich in {collections_res} and even some {resource}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們矮人住在這一帶。我們很愛這裡！這裡有豐富的{collections_res}，甚至還有一些{resource}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We Piglins always dream of water. This book will be about showing that water also brings pain and struggle.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們豬布林總是夢想著水。這本書要表現的是，水同樣會帶來痛苦和掙扎。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We Piglins send our deads in the lava of the Volcano for their final journey.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們§c豬布林§f會把死者送進§c火山§f的岩漿，進行他們最後的旅程。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We all look pretty cool.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們看起來都挺酷的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We are almost at the end of our journey.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們的旅程快到終點了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We are also offering {item}, an upgraded Snow Cannon that shoots much farther!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們也有{item}，這是射程更遠的升級版雪砲！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We are getting there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們快成功了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We are on the right track...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們走在正確的路上……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We are proud to present:
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e我們很驕傲地為您呈現：

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We are still discovering Shards every year!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們每年都還在發現新的碎片！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We are the Cult of the {event}, we mean no harm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們是§d{event}邪教§f，我們沒有惡意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We are united! {pet} SHOW YOURSELF TO US.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們團結了！{pet}，在我們面前現身吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We believe Malak and our ancestors found a new life inside the creatures of the lava.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們相信§c Malak §f和我們的祖先在岩漿生物體內找到了新的生命。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We both became much stronger during the last week, but strength should not be used for violence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：上週我們兩個都變強了很多，但力量不該用在暴力上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We call this process fusion.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們稱這個過程為§5融合§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We came here following the trails of the {collections_res} that YOU robbed!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們是追著被你們搶走的{collections_res}的蹤跡來到這裡的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We can build our very own Greenhouse!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們可以蓋屬於自己的§a溫室§f了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We can escape back out his throat at the top of his stomach!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們可以從牠胃的頂端§c順著喉嚨逃出去§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We can finally free up a plot! Take out the compost when you are ready!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們終於可以清出一塊地了！準備好就把堆肥拿出來吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We can play again some other time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們改天可以再玩。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We can't thank you enough for bringing us together!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們真的非常§a感謝你§f撮合我們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We cannot let the Barbarians trespass our borders without retaliation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們不能讓野蠻人越過我們的邊界而不報復。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們顯然重創了牠，但說不定牠還活著。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We could benefit from his intellect.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他的智慧對我們會很有幫助。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We didn't break the record of {0} hot dogs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們沒能打破 {0}§c 根熱狗§f的紀錄。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We don't eat much.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們吃得不多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We dwarves have tried to setup some outposts there but it is harder than it looks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們矮人試過在那裡設立一些前哨站，但比看起來難多了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We each host contests on our own islands.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們各自在自己的島上舉辦比賽。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We found the {area}, but no sign of {npc2}, let's ask them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們找到了{area}，但沒看到{npc2}的蹤影，去問問他們吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We found this Ferret when cleaning the house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們打掃房子時找到了這隻§5雪貂§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We found {npc2} before the murderer could.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們比兇手先找到了{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We have a range of motives far deeper and more interesting than those terrible fire mages.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們的動機比那些可怕的火焰法師深遠有趣得多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We have found the murder weapon, the victim, and the place where the crime was committed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們已經找到了§4兇器§f、§b受害者§f，以及§c犯罪§f現場。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We have much to offer and explore - but be careful.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們有很多東西可以提供和探索——不過要小心。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We have to defeat him every few weeks to keep it in check, otherwise it can grow out of control.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們每隔幾週就得打敗他一次來控制他，不然他會長到失控。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We hope you have a long stay!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：希望你能待久一點！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We hope you love the {event} as much as we do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們希望你跟我們一樣熱愛{event}§d。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We just came back from our walk and a monster ate his favorite toy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們剛散步回來，一隻怪物吃掉了他最喜歡的玩具。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We know that you are experimenting with animals down here, how do you explain this tank?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們知道你在這下面用動物做實驗，那這個水槽你要怎麼解釋？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We know they are hiding something inside their {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們知道他們在{area}裡藏了什麼東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We know {npc2}'s been hiding things, and {roman} think we're getting closer to the truth.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們知道{npc2}一直在隱瞞什麼，我覺得我們越來越接近真相了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We may never fully comprehend it, but your assistance has been invaluable so far!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們也許永遠無法完全理解它，但你到目前為止的幫助是無價的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We meet across the strands of space and time. {roman} was waiting for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們跨越時空的絲線相遇了。我一直在§5等待§f你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We meet here every seven days at midnight. That's when the star is the brightest, after all.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們每隔§6七天§f的午夜在這裡聚會。畢竟那是星星最亮的時候。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We might find more clues at {npc2}'s house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們也許能在{npc2}§b的家§f找到更多線索。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We must be prepared for whatever comes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：無論發生什麼，我們都必須做好準備。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We must find him at once, {roman} really hope this isn't the Piglin's doing.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們必須馬上找到他，真希望這不是豬布林幹的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We must make haste and locate the florist at once. Time is of the essence in this matter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們必須盡快找到§a花店老闆§f。這件事分秒必爭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We must show {pet} that we stand united for its return.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們必須讓{pet}看到我們團結一致迎接牠的回歸。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We navigated through the infinite ocean to come here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們航行過§3無盡之海§f來到這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need all the help we can muster, and you appear to be quite talented.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們需要所有能找到的幫助，而你看起來相當有天分。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need the perfect amount of squats.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們需要剛剛好的蹲下次數。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need to find fuel for the Ballista, it must be fallen into the lava with the rest of my supplies!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們得找到弩砲的燃料，它§c一定是和我其他的補給品一起掉進岩漿裡了§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need to find the fuel for the Ballista, it must have fallen in the lava with the rest of my supplies!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們得找到弩砲的燃料，它§c一定是和我其他的補給品一起掉進岩漿裡了§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need to get out before we burn in this lava!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們得在被岩漿燒死之前§c逃出去§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need to get out of here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們得離開這裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need to learn more about that monster, where it is from and what it wants.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們需要更了解那隻怪物，牠從哪裡來、想要什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need to secure it to safety.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們需要把它安全地保存起來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We need to set up a stand somewhere...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們得在某個地方擺個攤子……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We offer a special service here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們這裡提供一項特別服務。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We recruit individuals like you into our organization.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e：我們會招募像你這樣的人加入我們的組織。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We shall surely meet again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們一定會再見面的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We should employ a detective scanner to uncover clues as to the whereabouts of the hapless victim.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們應該用偵探掃描器找出那位不幸受害者下落的線索。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We store a great deal of knowledge about the history of this island in this {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們在這座{area}裡保存了大量關於這座島歷史的知識。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We support each other and share a common goal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e：我們互相扶持，有著共同的目標。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We thought and thought and then thought some more before {roman}, and only {roman2}, had an incredible breakthrough.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e我們想了又想，想了又想，直到我，而且只有我，有了§o驚人的突破§r§e。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We were engaged in an important cognitive construction.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們正在進行一項重要的認知建構。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We were to be joined in holy matrimony, and had even captured our love in a portrait.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們本將締結神聖的婚約，甚至已將我們的§d愛§f留在一幅畫像之中。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We were to live happily ever after, until fate intervened.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們本該從此過著幸福快樂的日子，直到§4命運§f橫加干涉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We will be Foraging! As one of SkyBlock's core skills, Foraging involves cutting down lots of different types of trees!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們要來§a伐木§f！伐木是 SkyBlock 的核心技能之一，要砍倒很多不同種類的樹！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We will complete our match one day, little one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們總有一天會下完這盤棋的，小傢伙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We will need a lot of stockpiles to survive through an eternity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們需要大量的存糧才能撐過永恆。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We will summon more of her power and deal a strong blow to her once and for all!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們將召喚她更多的力量，一舉給她沉重的打擊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We'll cross paths again, {roman}'m sure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們會再碰面的，我很確定。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We'll need that before going any further.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在進一步之前，我們需要它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We'll share some of our cool stars with you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們會分一些很酷的星星給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We'll take...very good care of you.
entries.value: §d[NPC] {npc}§f：我們會……好好照顧你的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We're assembling as many Shens as possible to create the ultimate Shen.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們正在聚集盡可能多的 Shen，來創造終極的 Shen。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We're chill, you and {roman}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們很冷靜，你和我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We're cooking up a massive Communal Stew for everyone in SkyBlock and we need your help to season it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們正在為 SkyBlock 的所有人煮一大鍋§e共享燉湯§f，需要你幫忙調味！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We're friends of {npc2}'s, so we only really have stuff to do when she's elected as Mayor, haha.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們是{npc2}§f的朋友，所以只有她當選§6鎮長§f的時候我們才有事做，哈哈。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We're in a separate dimension.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們在一個獨立的維度裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We're making it official!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們要正式在一起了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We're not done yet though; This time {roman}'ll need {0} Redstone - that's {1} stacks! It's quite a lot, but {roman2} know you can do it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過我們還沒結束；這次我需要 {0}§c 個紅石§f——也就是 {1}§f 組！雖然很多，但我知道你辦得到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We're still decorating since the building renovations!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：建築翻修後，我們還在裝潢！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: We've been stuck here forever!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們被困在這裡好久了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Weaken it, but do not kill it! {enchantment} it towards my Black Hole!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§a削弱牠§f，但§c別殺了牠§f！把牠{enchantment}§f向我的§5黑洞§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：財富不在於擁有很多東西，而在於欲望很少。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Wear it in our next meetings!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下次聚會時戴著它！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome back, {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎回來，{player}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome back, {player}. The game awaits your strategic touch.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎回來，{player}。這場遊戲正等著你的策略出手。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome back. Are you here to enter {island} again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎回來。你又要進入{island}了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome fellow member of the Campfire Cult. It is time to embrace the Campfire within and sacrifice something. What that something should be is an interesting question. {roman} am thinking potato. Yes. Yes, a good baked potato does sound very good right now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎，營火邪教的同伴。是時候擁抱內心的營火，獻上祭品了。至於祭品該是什麼，是個有趣的問題。我在想馬鈴薯。對。對，一顆好吃的烤馬鈴薯現在聽起來真不錯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome new Faction Member!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎新的派系成員！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to Abiphones & Co., cashcardinal!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎光臨§3Abiphones & Co.§f，§a金主大人§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to my Den!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到我的巢穴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to my flower shop!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到我的花店！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to my flower shop, may {roman} help you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到我的花店，有什麼能幫你的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to my humble workshop, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到我簡陋的工作坊，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to my keep, my sheep are some of the best in the world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到我的牧場，我的羊是全世界最好的羊之一。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the Bar, friend!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到酒吧，朋友！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the Barbarian Faction, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎加入§d野蠻人派系§f，{player}§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the Fairy Pond, {player}! {roman} am Tia.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到仙女池，{player}！我是 Tia。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the Tourist Office!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到遊客中心！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the Woodlands!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到林地！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the mayor elections!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到市長選舉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到{area}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the {event}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到{event}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the {event}! {roman} hope everyone's ready, the first item's about to start!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到{event}！希望大家都準備好了，第一件拍賣品就要開始了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to the {island}, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到{island}，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到{area}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome to {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎來到{island}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome traveler to our village!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：旅行者，歡迎來到我們的村莊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome! Feel free to browse my fishing wares!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎！隨意看看我的釣魚商品吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome, welcome, welcome!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎，歡迎，歡迎！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welcome, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：歡迎，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well because you already joined that faction in the past, all you have to do is go to their {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，因為你以前加入過那個派系，你只要去他們的{area}就好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well done my dear!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好，親愛的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well done my dear, for deducing as much.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好，親愛的，能推理到這一步。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well done {npc2}, you finished your training for today.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好，{npc2}，你完成了今天的訓練。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well done!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well done! You've proven more formidable than {roman} had anticipated.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好！你比我預期的還要難纏。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well done! {roman}'m sure that even {npc2} will enjoy my revolutionary melon refreshments.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好！我相信就連{npc2}也會喜歡我革命性的西瓜飲品。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well done, my dear, for deducing as much.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好，親愛的，能推理到這一步。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well done, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做得好，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well everyone is talking about them, so you should know, bro!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，大家都在談論它們，所以你應該知道啊，兄弟！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well hmph, {roman} guess the guards are kind of busy right now...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哼，我想守衛們現在有點忙……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well in that case, {roman} will send you the list of items {roman2} need.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那樣的話，我會把我需要的物品清單寄給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well played!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：下得好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well that explains a lot, my {npc2} just awoken from his coma, he described the same creature.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，這就解釋了很多事，我的{npc2}剛從昏迷中醒來，他描述的是同一隻生物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well then go find out!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那就去查清楚啊！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well then, {roman} will even mine in total darkness if {roman2} must!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，必要的話，我在一片漆黑中也照挖！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well then.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well well, plenty where it came from!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哎呀呀，那種多得是！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well you don't look like one, and you don't smell like one either.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，你看起來不像，聞起來也不像。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well {roman}'m going to explain it anyways, otherwise my entire existence lacks purpose!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，我還是要解釋，不然我整個存在就沒有意義了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, a deal's a deal! Come to me any time and {roman}'ll forge you whatever arrows you need for your adventures.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，說話算話！隨時來找我，我會幫你鍛造冒險需要的任何箭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, ancient compared to you, not me, {roman}'m only {0}, after all.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，是跟你比起來古老，不是跟我比，畢竟我才 {0} 歲而已。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, in a way {roman} was, but not anymore.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，某種程度上我曾經是，但現在不是了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, maybe {roman} will be able to understand the burping dwarves if {roman2} try hard enough.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，也許只要我夠努力，就能聽懂那些打嗝的矮人在說什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, most of the Mayors have a total of {0} perks to choose from, the amount they have at once varying.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，大部分的§6市長§f總共有 {0}§a 個特權§f可以選，同時擁有的數量不一定。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, she has to understand that Tax Brackets are part of a progressive tax system.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，她得明白§6稅級§f是累進稅制的一部分。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, there are three special displays behind you...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，你後面有§b三個特別展示台§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, think of it like a video game.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，把它想成一款電子遊戲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, today's your lucky day!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，今天是你的幸運日！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, try to keep track of where you are!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，記得隨時注意自己在哪裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, well! You got yourself a real Farming Tool, huh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哎呀哎呀！你弄到一把真正的§e農具§f了，是吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, well! {roman} coordinate a farming contest every few SkyBlock days, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好啊好啊！我每隔幾個 SkyBlock 日就會舉辦一場§e農耕競賽§f，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, what if {roman} told you this place has FIVE dimensions?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那麼，如果我告訴你，這個§d地方§f有§l五個§r§f維度呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, what's left of it...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，剩下的部分啦……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, works for me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，我沒問題！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, ye've got the spirit of a true miner then.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，那你確實有真正礦工的精神。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, you should probably make yourself available.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，你應該想辦法空出時間。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, {roman} can't do it myself!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，我沒辦法自己做！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, {roman} can't help you do any of that, but {roman2} can increase the amount of Coins paid on Midas weapons so you can harness their maximum {stats} bonus.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，這些我都幫不了你，但我§o能§f提高§6邁達斯§f武器上支付的§6金幣§f數量，讓你發揮它們最大的{stats} §f加成。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, {roman} suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，我想告訴你也無妨。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well, {stats} allows you to cut multiple logs at once.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯，{stats}能讓你一次砍好幾塊原木。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well-
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：呃——

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well...considering some fairies get thrown off towers...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：嗯……考慮到有些妖精會被人從塔上丟下去……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Well? Shall {roman} read your future in the flames?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：怎麼樣？要我在火焰中預言你的未來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welp now you imagined it a bit too much...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，現在你想像得有點太過頭了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welp {roman} guess no free powder for you then.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，看來你拿不到免費的粉末了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welp {roman} was kidding about the coins anyway...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，反正我剛剛說要給遊戲幣是開玩笑的……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welp, no hard feelings, {roman} guess.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧，我想不用放在心上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Welp. Meat is good too, {roman} suppose.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：好吧。我想肉也不錯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a beauty!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是個美人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a coincidence!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真巧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a fantastic choice!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是絕佳的選擇！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a feast!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是一頓盛宴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a fight!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是一場硬仗！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a great offering. {pet} will be pleased.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：多麼豐厚的奉獻。{pet}會很高興的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a match, {roman} truly enjoy sparring with you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是一場好比賽，我真的很享受跟你切磋。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a pity! Enjoy the {npc2}'s terrible and unrefreshing mixins.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真可惜！去享受{npc2}那難喝又不解渴的調酒吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a punt!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：踢得真遠！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a remarkable discovery!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：多麼驚人的發現啊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a strange choice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是個奇怪的選擇。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What a strange thing to say.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說這種話真奇怪。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What am {roman} going to do? My business is finished!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我該怎麼辦？我的生意完了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What am {roman} going to spend my {0} Motes on?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我要拿這 {0}§d 微粒§f來買什麼呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What are they spending the tax money on?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們把稅金花在哪裡？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What are you doing in my room?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在我房間裡做什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What are you doing talking to me without a Drill? Come back when you have one!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你沒帶§a鑽頭§f跟我說什麼話？等你有了再來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What are you talking to me for? Get back in the race!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你跟我說話幹嘛？快回到比賽裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What are you talking to me for? The village needs your help!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你跟我說話幹嘛？村莊需要你的幫忙！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What are you waiting for?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還在等什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What are you waiting for? Christmas? Get in!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還在等什麼？聖誕節嗎？快上去！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What cake? There is no cake.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼蛋糕？沒有蛋糕。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What can {roman} do, this is agony...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我能怎麼辦，好痛苦……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What could {player} be thinking right now?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{player}現在在想什麼呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you call a bear with no teeth?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：沒有牙齒的熊叫什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you call a fish wearing a bowtie?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：打著領結的魚叫什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you call a pig that does karate?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：會空手道的豬叫什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you call a very rich bunny?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：很有錢的兔子叫什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you say to that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you say?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you say? {npc2} said {roman} was a bad fisherman?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你說什麼？{npc2}說我是個爛漁夫？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you think is the moral of the story?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得這個故事的寓意是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you think?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you think? Am {roman} too romantic, or did my explanation make sense?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得呢？是我太浪漫了，還是我的解釋說得通？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What do you think? Do you believe in the Hero too?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得呢？你也相信英雄嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What does a stranger have to do with the Taika people? Speak!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：一個陌生人跟§cTaika §f人有什麼關係？說！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What even was their purpose?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們到底有什麼目的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What fantastic news!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真是太棒的消息了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What happened to those, why not more?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：它們怎麼了，為什麼沒有更多？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What has gravity ever done for me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：重力到底為我做過什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What have you been doing?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你到底在做什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What if everything you knew and loved wasn't real?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你所知道、所愛的一切都不是真的呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What if nothing was real?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果一切都不是真的呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What if our latest model could save you, like, a second, whenever you wanted to call someone?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e如果我們的最新機型能在你每次想打電話時，幫你省下，大概，一秒鐘呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What if you are just inside of a simulation?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你只是活在一個模擬世界裡呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What is going to happen?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：會發生什麼事？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What is this psycho doing with these animals???
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個瘋子到底在對這些動物做什麼？？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What is this? A hidden passage? {roman} knew {npc2} was hiding something from me, but this... this is something different.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是什麼？一條密道？我就知道{npc2}瞞著我什麼，但這……這完全是另一回事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What joy! Another press. {roman} was just hoping you'd ignore the RING again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：真開心！又被按了一下。我正希望你再次無視§e§lRING§f呢。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What just happened? Is this {pet}'s real lair?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：剛剛發生了什麼？這裡才是{pet}真正的巢穴嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What kind of music did the gold nugget listen to?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：金塊都聽什麼音樂？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What kind of people do that?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼樣的人會這樣啊？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What kind of pickle are you in?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你遇到了什麼麻煩？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What made you change your mind?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是什麼讓你改變了想法？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What makes you continue to click me over and over again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是什麼讓你一直點我、一直點我？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What makes you play this game?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：是什麼讓你玩這款遊戲？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What revelations did the {npc2} bestow upon you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}向你透露了什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What say you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你怎麼說？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What say you? Are you in?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你覺得怎麼樣？要加入嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What style of music do rabbits listen to?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：兔子都聽什麼風格的音樂？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What the hell is that noise?! {roman} think we've made him mad!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那是什麼鬼聲音？！我想我們把牠惹火了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What they did to the village a few years ago was great
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他們幾年前對村莊做的改造很棒

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What took you so long?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：怎麼花了這麼久？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What would my program even be?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的政見又會是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What {roman} enjoyed the most was helping you and {roman2} want to stay here to help more people.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我最享受的就是幫助你，我想留在這裡幫助更多人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What {roman} need the most right now is a {resource}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我現在最需要的是一顆{resource}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What {roman} said. Forget. Please.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我剛說的。忘掉。拜託。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What {roman} want is {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我要的是{npc2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What {roman}'m saying is that, no matter where you ran, it would probably follow. Nice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的意思是，不管你逃到哪裡，牠大概都會追上來。讚。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What's a BZT, you ask?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你問§b BZT §f是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What's happening? Why isn't he dying?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：發生什麼事了？牠為什麼還沒死？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What's his problem?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他到底有什麼毛病？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What's taking so long?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：怎麼這麼久？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What's the point!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這有什麼用啊！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What's this?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What's this? ... A blueprint for a Greenhouse?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是什麼？……一張§a溫室§f的§9藍圖§f？！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What's this? A brew?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這是什麼？一杯飲料？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What, did {roman} just say cake?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼，我剛剛是說了蛋糕嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What, when? Oh.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼，什麼時候？喔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What? What is that even supposed to mean?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼？那到底是什麼意思？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What? Yes {roman} am still alive. {roman2} landed in {pet}'s belly here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼？對，我還活著。我掉進了{pet}的肚子裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What? {npc2} said {roman} have a {item}? In my dreams...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼？{npc2}說我有一把{item}？我做夢才有……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What? {roman} didn't say anything!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼？我什麼都沒說！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: What??
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whatever it is, it sure is big! This might be it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不管是什麼，牠真的好大！可能就是牠了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whatever you do, do not call him by his name, that might trigger him to use it on you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不管你做什麼，都別叫他的名字，那可能會讓他對你動武。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whatever {pet} that belonged to was pretty nasty-looking, even for a {pet2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不管它原本屬於哪隻{pet}，就算以{pet2}來說也長得相當醜。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whatever, it doesn't matter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：算了，不重要。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whatever, {roman} think {roman2} like being a sheep anyway.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：算了，反正我覺得我喜歡當羊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whatever. Go talk to {npc2}, she'll tell you what's up.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：隨便啦。去找{npc2}，她會告訴你怎麼回事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When asked that question, {roman} remained silent, but {roman2} knew the answer
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：被問到那個問題時，我沉默了，但我知道答案

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When in doubt, check behind cobwebs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿不定主意的時候，就去蜘蛛網後面找！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When it's young and spry, we call it {item}. Full of energy but doesn't know a thing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當它年輕又有活力的時候，我們叫它{item}。充滿活力，卻什麼都不懂！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When one is stuck in a difficult situation, it is often wise to return to the beginning and re-examine all the evidence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當一個人陷入困境時，回到原點重新檢視所有證據通常是明智之舉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When ready, the game will await your return.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等你準備好了，遊戲會等你回來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When the Emperor {mob} destroyed the world something awakened deep below the surface.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當§c皇帝{mob}§f毀滅世界時，地底深處有什麼東西甦醒了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When they attack, smack their projectiles right back at 'em. That'll teach 'em.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們攻擊的時候，把牠們的投射物直接打回去。給牠們一點教訓。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When they dig, they move their arms in an outward motion, like a human swimming in breaststroke!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們挖土的時候，手臂會向外划，就像人類在游蛙式一樣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When they're swimming, predators looking from above see the black on their backs, which camouflages with the water.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠們游泳時，從上方往下看的掠食者會看到牠們背上的黑色，跟海水融為一體。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When we first met...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們第一次見面的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you believe in the magic of the world around you, anything is possible.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當你相信周遭世界的§d魔法§f，§o任何事§r§f都是可能的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you do encounter him, please direct him to us.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當你遇到他的時候，請叫他來找我們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you find one, simply aim the vacuum, hold down the button, and you can suck them buggers up real quick!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：找到之後，只要把§a吸塵器§f對準牠、按住按鍵，就能很快把那些小混蛋吸進去！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you first explored the {area} Pla-
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你第一次探索{area}§e廣§f——

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you first learned to count to {0}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你第一次學會數到 {0} 的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you first ventured deeper into the {area}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你第一次深入{area}的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you first went to battle with Bacte...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你第一次跟§a Bacte §f戰鬥的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you kill 'em, they'll drop lotsa {powder}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：殺掉牠們的話，會掉落大量{powder}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you murdered the innocent {npc2}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你殺害無辜的{npc2}的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you paste a crop preset onto your Plot, it will plant any specified resource from your inventory. So cool!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當你把作物預設貼到你的地塊上，它會從你的物品欄種下指定的資源。超酷的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you raced around collecting hot dogs for {npc2}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你為{npc2}到處跑著收集熱狗的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you see it...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當你看到它的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you wandered past the {pet} fragments...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你經過{pet}碎片的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you were on the hunt for {npc2} Souls...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在獵捕{npc2}§5之魂§f的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When you've done that, come back and tell me all about how much fun you had!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：做完之後回來，告訴我你玩得有多開心！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When your blood was first drained by the {boss}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你第一次被{boss}吸血的時候……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When {pet} submerges, we will be flushed out of his stomach! We need to get back inside but be careful when he submerges!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：當{pet}§f下潛時，我們會被§c沖出牠的胃§f！我們得§c再回到裡面§f，不過牠下潛時要小心！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When {roman} wake up in the morning, {roman2} jump.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我早上起床的時候會跳。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When {roman} was much younger, {roman2} used to collect so much {collections_res} and {collections_res2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我年輕的時候，常常收集一大堆{collections_res}和{collections_res2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: When {roman}'m older, {roman2}'ll travel the world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：等我長大了，我要去環遊世界。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whenever someone needs something they put a request here and anyone can fulfill it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每當有人需要什麼，就會在這裡張貼請求，任何人都可以完成。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whenever you fish, make sure you're using some type of Bait.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：每次釣魚時，記得一定要用某種§6魚餌§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Where am {roman}? Oh, it's you {player}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在哪？喔，是你啊，{player}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Where did you find it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在哪裡找到的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Where do you think you're going?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你以為你要去哪裡？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Where is that {resource}? My {npc2} is waiting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那顆{resource}呢？我的{npc2}在等著呢！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Where is {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{npc2}在哪裡？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Where {roman} live, vegetables aren't really an option. No sunlight, you see. Could you get me some?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我住的地方種不了蔬菜。你知道的，沒有陽光。你能幫我弄一些嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Where's my {resource}, champ?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的{resource}呢，冠軍？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Where's the {item} we gave you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我們給你的{item}呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whew! {roman} need some coffee!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§c呼！§f我需要咖啡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Which dimension do you originate from?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你來自哪個維度？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Which is more accurately defined as possibilities.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：更準確地說，是§d可能性§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Which means you will not be able to trade it anymore.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這代表你將無法再交易牠。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Which number will you choose?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你會選哪個數字？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Which one do you like more?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你比較喜歡哪一個？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Which piece are you struggling to find?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找不到哪一件？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While he may seem friendly, be cautious.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然他看起來可能很§a友善§f，但要§c小心§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While it's yet unpublished, {roman} believe it would be fitting for you to have its cover.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然還沒出版，但我相信它的封面很適合送給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While moments have passed for you, weeks have slipped by for Sun {mob}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：對你而言只過了片刻，但對§e太陽{mob}§f來說已經過了好幾週。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While on land, a group of penguins is called a waddle.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在陸地上時，一群企鵝被稱為「搖擺隊」。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While people often think Mammoths were huge, they were actually around the size of your average modern-day elephant.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然大家常以為猛瑪象很巨大，但其實牠們跟現代一般的大象差不多大。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While studying the breach at the top of the mountain....
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在研究山頂的§5裂縫§f時……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While this one is pretty small, the largest known fossils of this variety are massive!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然這塊很小，但目前已知這類化石中最大的可是非常巨大！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While very astute.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然你很精明。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While you're busy adventuring {roman} can take care of your pets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在你忙著冒險的時候，我可以幫你照顧寵物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While {roman} can't be sure if the {mob} was there "before" his demise, the resemblance is striking.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然我無法確定{mob} §f是不是在§c他§f死亡「之前」就在那裡，但相似度實在驚人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While {roman} couldn't quite figure out portals, {roman2} did manage to let the mirror dimension interact with the real world and vice versa.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然我沒能完全搞懂§d傳送門§f，但我確實成功讓§l鏡像維度§r§f和現實世界互相影響。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: While {roman} love the cold, {roman2} can no longer feel my fingers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：雖然我愛寒冷，但我的手指已經沒感覺了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Who are you and who gave you the code?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是誰？誰給你密碼的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Who better to trust with your mining needs? Would you buy a sword from a plow?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：採礦需求還有誰比我更值得信賴？你會跟一把犁買劍嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Who's Dr. Hibble? Never heard of them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：Dr. Hibble 是誰？從沒聽過。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whoops! That doesn't usually happen!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哎呀！這通常不會發生的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whoops! {roman} lost my good pickaxe again in the mines. That's why {roman2} always come prepared with a backup!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：糟糕！我又把我的好鎬子弄丟在礦坑裡了。所以我總是會準備一把備用的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whose soul is light and free,
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：汝的靈魂輕盈又自由，

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Whow...WHOW! What's happening!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：哇……哇！發生什麼事了！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why are you looking at me that way? {roman} am not a Vampire, you are!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你為什麼那樣看著我？我不是吸血鬼，你才是！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why aren't you on my side anymore? {roman} don't want to embarrass myself; come back and help me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你為什麼不站在我這邊了？我不想丟臉；回來幫我吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why can't there be peace in the world?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼這個世界就不能和平呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why can't {roman} be successful like everyone else...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼我不能像其他人一樣成功……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why did he keep attacking us until his death?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：他為什麼一直攻擊我們，直到戰死？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why did the cow go to outer space?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：母牛為什麼要去外太空？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why did the dog sit in the shade?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：狗為什麼坐在陰涼處？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why did the elephant quit the circus?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大象為什麼辭掉馬戲團的工作？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why did the elephant wear green sneakers?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：大象為什麼穿綠色球鞋？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why did you decide to keep this time?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這次你為什麼決定保留？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why did {roman} agree to this? {roman2}'ve never fought in my life!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我為什麼要答應？我這輩子從沒打過架！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why did {roman} not think of this...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我怎麼沒想到這個……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why didn't it show itself...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牠為什麼沒有現身……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why do bees hum?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼蜜蜂會哼哼叫？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why do cows have hooves instead of feet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牛為什麼長蹄子而不是腳？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why do you continue to do this? {npc2} is right there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你為什麼要一直這樣？{npc2}就在那裡啊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don't ants get sick?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：螞蟻為什麼不會生病？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don't mining towns have hospitals?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼礦業小鎮沒有醫院？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don't oysters give to charity?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：牡蠣為什麼不捐錢給慈善機構？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don't you ask {npc2} instead of trying to think for yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你何不去問{npc2}，而不是自己想。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don't you do the honor? Here, take this carrot and plant it in the Greenhouse!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：何不由你來種呢？來，拿著這根§6胡蘿蔔§f，把它種在§a溫室§f裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don't you explore the {area} a bit more?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你何不再多探索一下{area}呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don't you try it out on me now?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：何不現在就對我試試看？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don't you try it out right now?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：何不現在就試試看？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why don'tcha come by the fire and sit down anywhere
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：何不來火堆旁隨便坐坐

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why is that? What if {roman} like mining and fishing?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼？如果我既喜歡挖礦又喜歡釣魚呢？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why is there so much hate in the world?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼這個世界上有這麼多仇恨？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why is {item} the Prime Minister?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼{item}是首相？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why not just schedule an extra event??
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼不乾脆多排一場活動？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why should a few have it all when we can share the load?
entries.value: §b[NPC] {npc}§f：既然我們可以分擔重擔，為什麼要讓少數人擁有一切？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why talk? Just slay.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：說什麼話？殺就對了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why the {pet} you ask?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你問為什麼是{pet}？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why them?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：為什麼是他們？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why would you do that???
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你為什麼要那樣做？？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Why would {npc2} be the Prime Minister if he can't even fix my own mistakes?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果{npc2}連我自己犯的錯都沒辦法解決，他為什麼能當首相？！
