entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：什麼事？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yesterday {roman} had a heated argument with a Piglin and we agreed to have a duel in a week.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：昨天我跟一個豬布林大吵一架，我們約好一週後決鬥。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yet fret not, for every challenge is but a prelude to your next triumph.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：不過別擔心，每一次挑戰都只是你下一次勝利的序曲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yet methinks it holds a greater meaning still - one of survival, of hope reborn.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：但吾以為它仍有更深的意義——生存，以及重生的希望。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yet you come back to me and presume that you are.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：結果你又跑回來，以為你夠有名了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yet, something is amiss, as a murder was foretold to occur at his house.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然而事有蹊蹺，因為預言說謀殺會發生在他家。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yet, without aid, {roman} fear my preparations will fall short of time's cruel demand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然而若無援手，吾恐怕準備趕不上時間無情的催逼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yet, {roman} must confess, my investigations have yet to bear fruit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：然而我必須坦承，我的調查至今仍毫無斬獲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yin and yang, one should not go without the other
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：陰與陽，缺一不可

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: Yooooooooooooooo. It's me!! FOXY!!!
[NPC] {npc}: You  were not good enough. Come back when you've trained more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還不夠好。等你多練習了再來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You actually did it, {roman} can't thank you enough!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你真的做到了，我真的不知道該怎麼謝你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You again, what do you want this time?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：又是你，這次又想要什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You again... {#}inhales{#2}... {roman}’m no hero, but {roman2} might need a cape at this rate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：又是你……{#}吸氣{#2}……我不是英雄，但照這樣下去我可能需要一件披風了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You almost gave me a heart attack!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你差點讓我心臟病發作！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You already completed your training with {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你已經完成{npc2}的訓練了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You already have a mob spawned! Hunt that mob first!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你已經有一隻生物生成了！先去獵捕牠！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You already made a ton of progress and {roman}'m excited for the future.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你已經進步了很多，我很期待未來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You alright there, my friend?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還好吧，我的朋友？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are a little bit too close to me, keep your distances.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你離我有點太近了，保持距離。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are a special being.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是個特別的存在。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are almost there, my friend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你就快成功了，我的朋友。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are beating me too easily, this isn't helping with my insecurity...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你打敗我打得太輕鬆了，這對我的不安全感沒有幫助……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are being very rude.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你非常沒禮貌。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are currently missing {0} Fairy Souls. Better get to work!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你目前還差 {0} 個仙女之魂。最好開始動工了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are going to regret this!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你會後悔的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are holding a sword... But how...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你拿著一把劍……但怎麼會……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are imbued with the power of the {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你被注入了{item}的力量。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are intruding.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在打擾我們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are looking for the {npc2}'s {npc3}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在找{npc2}的{npc3}？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are making a big mistake.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你正在犯一個大錯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are new around here, right? Never seen you before.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是新來的吧？我從沒見過你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are no chum of mine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不是我的夥伴。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are no match for the Dwarves of the Deeper Caverns.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你根本不是更深層洞窟矮人的對手。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are not from around here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不是這附近的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are not performing that well today, but {roman}'ll accept that score for today.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你今天表現得不太好，不過今天就接受這個分數吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are not ready for this fight.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還沒準備好迎接這場戰鬥。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are not supposed to be here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不應該在這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are now granted access to {area} Modifiers and the Sun {mob} Essence Shop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在獲准使用{area}§a修飾符§f和§e太陽{mob}§e精華商店§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are one of a kind
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你真是獨一無二

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are only missing one part of the armor to become {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你只差一件盔甲就能成為{npc2}了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are paparazzi, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是狗仔隊，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are pretty much a Greenhouse Expert now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在幾乎算是§a溫室專家§f了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are probably aware but we used to be {pet} farmers but {collections_res} turned our pigs into Piglins.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能知道，我們以前是養{pet}的，但{collections_res}把我們的豬變成了豬布林。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are probably wondering what the heck happened to this place?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你大概在想，這地方到底發生了什麼事？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are proving quite formidable... well played.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你證明了自己相當難纏……打得好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are quite competent, those Mages are usually quite strong, they also think very highly of themselves.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你相當能幹，那些法師通常很強，而且他們自視甚高。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are quite unscrupulous! Maybe we can be friends!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還真是不擇手段！也許我們能當朋友！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are ready for the next badge rarity!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你已經準備好迎接下一個稀有度的徽章了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are right. {roman} shall be there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你說得對。我會到的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are saying {roman} need to combine these items with ice to have a taste? {roman2}'ll believe it when {roman3} see it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是說我要把這些東西跟冰混在一起才吃得出味道？眼見為憑！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are the best teacher {roman} could have hoped for...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是我所能期望的最好的老師……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are the best.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是最棒的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are the chumming expert ok?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是撒餌專家了，好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are the first one of your kind to defeat me and craft this armor.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是同類中第一個打敗我並打造出這套盔甲的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are truly on another level...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你真的是另一個層次……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are what {roman} call a "tourist".
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你就是我所說的「§d觀光客§f」。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You are {player} right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是{player}對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You arrived here through the portal, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是穿過傳送門來到這裡的，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You better run.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你最好快跑。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You better watch out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你最好小心點！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You bought the Murder Weapon and left just a moment ago.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你買了§c兇器§f，剛剛才離開。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You breathing down my neck does NOT help.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在我背後盯著§c一點都沒有§f幫助。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You bring me a delicious meal, one without any armor. {roman}'ll take them out and you get a reward!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你帶給我一頓美味的§c大餐§f，一個沒穿任何盔甲的。我來解決他們，你就能拿到獎勵！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You came down the lift? {roman} never thought you could get this far down! Someone should have called this place the Deeper Caverns!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你是搭升降機下來的？我從沒想過有人能下到這麼深！應該有人把這裡叫做更深層洞窟才對！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can access it through the Fishing Skill menu.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以從§a釣魚技能§f選單打開它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can access the Heart of the {area} from the Mining Skill menu, and unlock loads of powerful upgrades as you continue your journey!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以從挖掘技能選單打開§5{area}之心，在旅程中解鎖大量強大的升級！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can access the Ship Upgrades menu by talking to me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跟我說話就能打開§6船隻升級§f選單。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can also apply Drill Upgrades to Drills, offering various buffs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也可以在鑽頭上加裝§6鑽頭升級§f，提供各種加成！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can also collect them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也可以§e收藏§f它們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can also combine two runes for a chance to create a higher level rune with a better effect!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也可以把兩個符文合成，有機會做出效果更好的更高等級符文！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can also remove them, but that'll cost you some Coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也可以拆掉它們，但那要花你一些金幣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can also throw some axes into the air by right-clicking with them in your hand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著某些斧頭時§a按右鍵§f，還能把它們丟到空中。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can also use {command} as a shortcut if you aren't feeling like paying me a visit!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你不想親自來找我，也可以用{command}當捷徑！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can also vote in the mayor elections by heading through the warp to the left!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也可以從左邊的傳送點過去參加§b市長選舉§f投票！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can always come back and play my game again later.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你隨時可以晚點再回來玩我的遊戲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can always come back and play my game later.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你隨時可以晚點再回來玩我的遊戲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can always view your Bestiary in your Combat Skill menu!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你隨時都可以在§a戰鬥技能§f選單裡查看你的圖鑑！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can apply runes to weapons and armor with the {item} Pedestal behind me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以用我身後的{item}§5底座§f把§5符文§f套用到武器和盔甲上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can apply them in an anvil alongside any piece of armor, and it will recolor it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在鐵砧上把它們和任何一件盔甲放在一起，盔甲就會重新上色！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can ask the {npc2} for a ride to the {island}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以請{npc2}載你去{island}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can attach them to any item unlocked by the Foraging Skill right at an anvil.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在鐵砧上把它們裝到任何由§a伐木技能§f解鎖的物品上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can buy and sell harvested crops with me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以跟我買賣收成的作物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can call me Tal, some people call me TK
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以叫我 Tal，有些人叫我 TK

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can choose a color by clicking it in the palette below the canvas.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：點擊畫布下方調色盤裡的顏色就能選色。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can collect some back in the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在{area}收集一些。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can come to me anytime you need help, but first let's clear out a plot to grow your crops.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你需要幫忙的時候隨時來找我，不過我們先清出一塊地來種你的作物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can do this.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你做得到的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can either cross on your own and experience anger.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以自己穿越，然後體驗§c憤怒§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can either syphon or fuse them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以§c汲取§f或§5融合§f它們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can enchant items by clicking any {item}. Enchanting costs experience levels - the more levels you spend, the better enchantments you will receive.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：點擊任何{item}§f就能附魔物品。附魔要花費§b經驗等級§f——花的等級越多，得到的附魔就越好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can enter here only if you obtained the Supreme Timecharm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只有取得§c至高時之護符§f的人才能進入這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can find all your Shards in your Hunting Box, inside your Hunting Skill Menu!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在§a狩獵技能選單§f裡的§a狩獵箱§f找到你所有的碎片！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can find him just past the bridge in his den.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在橋的另一頭、他的巢穴裡找到他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can find many more types of crops there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在那裡找到更多種類的作物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can find the Bestiary in your Combat Skill menu!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在§a戰鬥技能§f選單裡找到圖鑑！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can find them in the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在{area}找到它們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can find these by ice fishing in the pond - break the ice and cast your rod!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在池塘裡§b冰釣§f找到它們——打破冰層，然後拋竿！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can find {mob}'s Keepers in {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在{area}§f找到{mob}§c的守衛§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can gain certain Fishing stat bonuses by casting your rod in Fishing Hotspots!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在§d釣魚熱點§f拋竿，可以獲得特定的§a釣魚§f屬性加成！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can get access to my house for {0} coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：只要 {0}§6 遊戲幣§f，你就能進我的房子！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can get one from SkyMart.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在§aSkyMart§f買到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can get this North Star currency by giving gifts to others!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以透過送禮給別人來取得這種北極星貨幣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can get {stats} from some Heart of the {area} perks, and from certain items.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以從某些§5{area}之心§f強化和特定物品獲得{stats}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can go in.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以進去了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can jump into the portal now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在可以跳進傳送門了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can learn all of the secrets through the many rooms {roman} built.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以透過我建造的許多房間學到所有的祕密。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can leave at any time and it won't affect anything
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你隨時都可以離開，不會有任何影響

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can now gain Carpentry XP by crafting items. Leveling your Carpentry Skill unlocks new furniture recipes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在可以透過合成物品獲得木工經驗。提升你的§a木工技能§f就能解鎖新的傢俱配方！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can now have as many Chips as you want, just keep upgrading them with Sowdust!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在想要多少§9晶片§f都可以，只要持續用§2耕塵§f升級它們就好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can only damage it using an Huntaxe!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你只能用§a狩獵斧§f對牠造成傷害！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can open your Sea Creature Guide through your Fishing Skill menu, or with {command}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以從§a釣魚技能§f選單，或用{command}§f打開你的§a海洋生物指南§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can place them where monsters tend to show up, or even dunk one underwater if you're feeling bold.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以把它放在怪物常出沒的地方，如果你夠大膽，甚至可以泡到水裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can place your bids now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在可以出價了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can select a spray by left-clicking your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：左鍵點擊你的{item}就能選擇噴漆圖案！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can select sprays by left-clicking with your {item}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：拿著你的{item}按左鍵就能選擇噴漆圖案！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can store Bait in your inventory or Fishing Bag, which is unlocked at Raw Fish Collection {roman}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以把§6魚餌§f放在背包或§9釣魚袋§f裡，釣魚袋在§a生魚收藏 {roman}§f解鎖。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can talk to {npc2} near the lake to gain HOTF Exp.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以去湖邊找{npc2} §f來獲得§a森林之心經驗§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can trade Gifts directly with others or randomly gift players on the island!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以直接和別人交換禮物，或在島上隨機送禮給玩家！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can trade in your old Abiphone {roman} for an even bigger discount!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§c：§e你可以拿舊的 Abiphone {roman}§e 來折抵，享受更大的折扣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can unlock access by leveling up your Farming Skill to Level {roman}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：把你的農耕技能升到 {roman} 級就能解鎖。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can unlock and level up various perks and abilities there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在那裡解鎖並升級各種強化和能力。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can unlock {stats} and {stats2} bonuses, and loot drop information for that Family!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以解鎖該族群的{stats}和{stats2}加成，以及掉落物資訊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can use silk to create wires.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以用絲做成絲線。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can use time around here just as well as you can move in {0}D in your world, as if you can interact with  the space-time continuum itself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：在§d這裡§f，你能運用§a時間§f，就像在你的世界裡能在 {0}§f 維空間中移動一樣，彷彿你能與時空連續體本身互動。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can view it in your Attribute Menu inside the Hunting Skill Menu.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在§a狩獵技能選單§f裡的§c屬性選單§f查看它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can view your Accessory Bag within the {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以在{item}§f裡查看你的§a飾品袋§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can't activate it here...too much magic in the air {roman} guess?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不能在這裡啟動它……大概是空氣中的魔法太多了吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can't catch me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你抓不到我的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can't even afford to bid! Come back when you have at least {0} coins!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你連出價的錢都沒有！等你至少有 {0}§6 遊戲幣§f再來吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can't teleport here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不能傳送到這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You can't tell me that you couldn't find a single cactus...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你別跟我說你連一株仙人掌都找不到……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You collected every single Fairy Soul?!? Amazing!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你收集了每一個仙女之魂？！？§d太厲害了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You collected {0} items!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你收集了 {0} 個物品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You collected {0} items! PERSONAL BEST!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你收集了 {0}§f 個物品！§d個人最佳紀錄§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You committed the deeds yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：那些事都是你自己做的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You completed all my missions, {roman} am very grateful.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你完成了我所有的任務，我非常感激。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You crossed a line when you tried to end {npc2}'s life.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你企圖結束{npc2}§b的§f性命時，就已經§c越界§f了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You dealt with it? Great!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你解決了？太好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You desire this {item}. It symbolizes an enhancement of your cognitive arsenal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你渴望這個{item}。它象徵著你認知武器庫的強化。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You did NOT just do that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你居然真的這麼做了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You did it! Congratulations, {player}. You are now faster than {npc2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你做到了！恭喜你，{player}。你現在比{npc2}還快了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You did not find the {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你沒有找到{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You did that so quickly!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你這麼快就做到了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You didn't have enough coins to make it into the Auction!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你的遊戲幣不夠，進不了拍賣會！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You didn't shear enough sheep!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你剪毛的羊不夠多！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You discover a new species and your first reaction is to kill them?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你發現了一個新物種，第一個反應就是殺了牠們？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You do know the story of the End island right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道終界島的故事吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You do?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想聽？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You do??
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想看？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't have enough coins? Get out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你的遊戲幣不夠？出去！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't have enough money.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你的錢不夠。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't have enough scratch, pal. Get outta here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你錢不夠，老兄。出去！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't look like a Barbarian to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在我看來不像是§d野蠻人§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't look like a Mage to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在我看來不像是§5法師§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你又不需要展示它們。每個人都有盤子，又不是什麼特別的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't need to enter the {event} to complete the {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不需要參加{event}也能完成{pet}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't need to follow me everywhere you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道你不用到哪都跟著我吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't sound very excited...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽起來不太興奮……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't understand, my father is the Chief!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不懂，我爸是§c酋長§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You don't understand, {npc2}! Farming as we know it is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你不懂，{npc2}！我們所知的農耕正在演變。如果我們不適應，就會被拋在後面。世界的需求在增加，挑戰也是。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You either wait for the Volcano to erupt, or you find a Corrupted Monster.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你要嘛等§c火山§f爆發，要嘛找到一隻§2腐化怪物§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You even needed the help of those adventurers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你甚至還需要那些冒險者的幫忙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You ever seen those Goblins? Some say they lay eggs. How weird.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你見過那些哥布林嗎？有人說牠們會下蛋。真奇怪。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You finally retrieved the {collections_res}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你終於奪回{collections_res}了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You find mi crystal ball?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到我的水晶球了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You first have to prove your worth if you want to have a chance at joining their ranks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你想有機會加入他們，得先證明你的價值。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found a new Fish!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到一條新的魚了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found all of the Gifts!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到所有的禮物了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found his toy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到他的玩具了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found my {npc2} and he WHAT?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了我的{npc2}，然後他怎樣？！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the Conclamatus Glyph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了§5 Conclamatus 符文§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the Firmitas Glyph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了§5 Firmitas 符文§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the Fortis Glyph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了§5 Fortis 符文§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the Pernimius Glyph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了§5 Pernimius 符文§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the Potentia Glyph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了§5 Potentia 符文§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the Robur Glyph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了§5 Robur 符文§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the Validus Glyph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了§5 Validus 符文§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the Vis Glyph!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了§5 Vis 符文§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found the {npc2}'s pickaxe!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到了{npc2}的鎬子！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found what? A secret lab hidden inside the cave??? We need to check this out together. {player}, {roman}'ll meet you there!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你發現了什麼？洞穴裡藏著一間祕密實驗室？？？我們得一起去看看。{player}，我們在那裡見！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found who stole our {collections_res}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到偷走我們{collections_res}的人了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到{npc2}了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You found {npc2}? That's weird, {roman} just saw him!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你找到{npc2}了？好奇怪，我剛剛才看到他！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You go on and explore! Come back to the Ship and set sail when you're done!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你去探索吧！結束後回到§6船§f上出航就行了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You go out and slay some mobs and, every time you kill a mob with a new mob type, {roman}'ll add it to my book!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你去外面殺一些生物，每次你殺了一隻§a新類型§f的生物，我就把它加進我的書裡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You got my {resource} back!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你把我的{resource}拿回來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You got the right item?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你拿到對的東西了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You got your very first {category}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你拿到你的第一個{category}了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You had ONE job!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你就只有一件事要做！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You handle yourself well, but it's far from over.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你表現得很好，但還遠遠沒結束。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You handled that quite well.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你處理得相當好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have a rescue with the enemy? {roman} KNEW they were spying on us!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你跟敵人那邊有救援任務？我就知道他們在監視我們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have already delivered that part to me! Bring me a unique robot part!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你已經交過那個零件給我了！帶一個不同的機器人零件來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have been warned. {roman} wish you the best of luck.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我已經警告過你了。祝你好運。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have bested me, a feat none other can claim.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你打敗了我，這是其他人都無法宣稱的壯舉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have bested me, this time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這次你打敗了我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have calmed all of my eyes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你讓我所有的眼睛都冷靜下來了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have chosen to keep the box you originally selected.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你選擇保留你原本選的箱子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have chosen to swap to the other box.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你選擇換到另一個箱子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have completed your goal and the case is now closed.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你已經達成目標，這個案子正式結案了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have no business talking to me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你沒資格跟我說話。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have now absorbed a second measure of the {enchantment} of Time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在已吸收了§a第二份§f時間的{enchantment}§9§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have now received the final {enchantment} of Time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在已獲得最後一份時間的{enchantment}§9§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have reached {island}, though this is only the beginning.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你已經抵達{island}，但這只是開始。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have single-handedly slowed down my research by several years.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你一個人就讓我的研究慢了好幾年。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have single-handedly sped up my research by several years.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你一個人就讓我的研究加快了好幾年。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have solved the case!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你破案了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have solved the case.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你破案了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have successfully gathered all {0} Timecharms.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你成功收集了全部 {0} 個時之護符。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have to complete your training, with Auryon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你得先完成§bAuryon§f那邊的訓練。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have to do this quest!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你得做這個任務！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You have to get the pearls on your first try because the Matriarch won't eat you again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你必須第一次就拿到珍珠，因為§c女族長§f不會再吃你一次。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You haven't got this one yet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還沒拿到這件？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You haven't placed the Sapphire Crystal yet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還沒放置§b藍寶石水晶§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You heard about that weird Cult over in the {area}? {roman}’m considerin' joining them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽說{area}§f那個奇怪的§c邪教§f了嗎？我在考慮要不要加入他們。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You heard what {npc2} said about Mob Types?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你聽到{npc2} §f說的§c生物類型§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You help me like someone would help an insect stuck in a puddle.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你幫我就像有人會幫一隻困在水坑裡的蟲子一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You just roam around all day and eat grass.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你整天就只是到處晃、吃草。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You just saved my business!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你剛剛救了我的生意！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You just wanted to see what {roman} would say, and then ask again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你只是想看看我會說什麼，然後再問一次。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know about the three primary dimensions, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道三個主要的§d維度§f吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know how it is, they never stop eating haha, thank you very much!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道的，牠們吃個不停哈哈，非常謝謝你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know that breakable wall in the caves? Look around it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道洞穴裡那面可以打破的牆嗎？去它附近找找。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know the banker?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道那個銀行家嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know the drill youngster, Bring me the {0} {mob}'s fragments, {1} enchanted spider eyes, and {2} enchanted string, and {roman} will make that crystal for you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道流程的，年輕人，帶 {0} 個{mob}的碎片、{1} 個附魔蜘蛛眼和 {2} 條附魔線給我，我就幫你做那顆水晶。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know the drill, for a small fee {roman} will give you some info on the treasure.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道流程的，付一點小錢，我就給你一些關於寶藏的情報。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know the one {roman}'m talking about?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道我在說哪一個嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know this is gonna go on forever, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道這會一直持續下去吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know what the {island} are, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道{island}是什麼吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know what to do.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道該怎麼做。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know what's good for you? More coins.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道什麼對你好嗎？更多的遊戲幣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know you should live life in moderation. Too much of anything is no good. Balance is key.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道人生應該適可而止。任何東西太多都不好。平衡才是關鍵。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know {roman}'m with {npc2}, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道我已經跟{npc2}在一起了，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know, having dealt with Pests for so long, {roman}'m starting to find them kinda cute!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，跟§6害蟲§f打交道這麼久，我開始覺得牠們有點§d可愛§f了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know, you learn a lot from looking at people's shoes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，看一個人的鞋子能學到很多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You know, you're starting to look kinda tasty...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，你開始看起來有點美味了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You lied to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你騙了我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You like flint? {roman} like flint! {roman2} sell flint!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你喜歡燧石？我喜歡燧石！我賣燧石！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You look dashing today!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你今天看起來真帥氣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You look like someone who could help me with my research!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看起來像是能幫我做研究的人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You look like someone who values fashion as much as fighting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看起來是個把§a時尚§f看得跟戰鬥一樣重要的人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You look smart, you and {roman} can fix this economy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看起來很聰明，你和我可以一起修好這個經濟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You look suspicious. {roman} have my eyes on you...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看起來很可疑。我盯著你……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You managed to complete your Hunting training!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你完成了狩獵訓練！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You managed to get the Supreme Timecharm!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你成功拿到了§c至高時之護符§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You managed to predict a very low average and choose a number over {0} times the average.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你成功預測到非常低的平均值，並選擇了超過平均值 {0} 倍的數字。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may activate it in this room using the hidden wooden button.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以用這個房間裡隱藏的木製按鈕啟動它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may also want to check back here to see what items other players are selling to see if you can get a good deal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也可以常回來看看其他玩家在賣什麼，說不定能撿到便宜。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may have noticed already, but cutting down a tree here will grant you a Tree Gift.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能已經注意到了，在這裡砍倒一棵樹會獲得一份§2樹之禮§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may have noticed some Gifts laying around.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能注意到附近散落著一些§a禮物§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may have noticed some strange orbs laying around the island.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能注意到島上散落著一些奇怪的球體。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may have noticed that this pond is full of unique creatures and treasures!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能已經注意到，這個池塘裡滿是獨特的生物和寶藏！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may have noticed...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能注意到了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may need more reputation to unlock all of my supplies!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能需要更多聲望才能解鎖我所有的補給品！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may not have {0} IQ after all...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：看來你的智商也許終究沒有 {0}……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may only open one of the boxes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你只能打開其中一個箱子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may pass.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可以通過了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You may want to store your Coins in a safe place while you are off adventuring.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你在外面冒險的時候，最好把§6遊戲幣§f存在安全的地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You merely adopted the Dungeons, {roman} was born in them, molded by them.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你只是接受了地下城，而我生於其中，被它塑造。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might be someone worth taking to, but the condition isn't right.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也許是個值得交談的人，但條件不對。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might be someone worth taking to, but the time isn't right.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也許是個值得交談的人，但時機不對。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might be wondering why {roman}'m on top of this bush?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能在想，我為什麼在這叢灌木上面？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might deserve something nice!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也許值得一些好東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might explode in a million pieces if you go through the portal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你穿過傳送門，可能會§c爆炸§f成一百萬片。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might need to hunt a few more creatures first!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能得先多狩獵幾隻生物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might not know me, {npc2}, a moniker that resonates through the echelons of intellect.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也許不認識我，{npc2}，一個響徹智識殿堂的名號。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might think it's expensive...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你可能會覺得很貴……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You might want to talk to {npc2} next.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來你也許該去找{npc2}談談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You missed yesterday's lesson.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你錯過了昨天的課。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must be confused...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你一定是搞錯了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must be wondering what exactly this place is.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你一定在想這個§d地方§f到底是哪裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must bring me some valuable materials that peak my interest.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你必須帶給我一些能引起我興趣的珍貴材料。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must gain control over your coins or the lack of it will forever control you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你必須掌控你的遊戲幣，否則缺錢會永遠掌控你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must hurry! Get to the {pet} Queen before my stench escapes you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你得快點！趁我的臭味還沒散掉，快去找{pet}女王！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must now seek my master, at the end of the road.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：現在你必須去找我的主人，就在道路的盡頭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must prove yourself worthy of Heart of the {area}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你必須證明你配得上§5{area}之心§f……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must repair the breach, for {roman} am to receive and deliver a vision from it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你必須修復裂縫，因為我將從中接收並傳遞一個景象。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You must've made a powerful impression on their Coven.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你一定讓他們的集會留下了深刻的印象。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need Combat Level {roman} before leading a dungeon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：§7§o你需要戰鬥等級 {roman}§7§o 才能帶領地下城。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need Farming {roman} to participate! :)
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你需要§a農耕 {roman} §f才能參加！:)

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need a Dimensional Infusion before hopping in the portal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：跳進傳送門之前，你需要§d一次維度注入。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need an experienced person to handle the situation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你需要一個有經驗的人來處理這個狀況。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need it to join us!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你需要它才能加入我們！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need my foul stench again? Bring me a {resource} of any type!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你又需要我的§a惡臭§f了？帶一顆任何種類的{resource} §f給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need tip?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你要提示？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need to sneak through this area and avoid the guards.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你必須偷偷穿過這個區域，避開守衛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need to stay out of their sight.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你必須避開他們的§e視線§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You need to turn around for this one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：這個你得轉過身去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You never did tell me how you found it...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你一直沒告訴我你是怎麼找到它的……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You now have enough Fragments to assemble my Armor.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在有足夠的碎片可以組裝我的盔甲了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You only delay the inevitable.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你只是在拖延無可避免之事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You ought to speak with her, it could be enlightening!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該去跟她談談，說不定會有所啟發！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You put it in the bucket and someday it's filled.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你把它放進桶子裡，總有一天會裝滿。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You reached the end of the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你抵達了{area}的盡頭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You really are a great listener
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你真的是個很棒的傾聽者

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You really believe that this is from the Moon?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你真的相信這是從月亮上來的？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You really look stunning!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看起來真的太迷人了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You really think {roman}'m going to reward you with something
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你真的以為我會給你什麼獎勵

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You receive a {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你獲得了一個{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You ruined my dream.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你毀了我的夢想。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You said it! {roman} thought {roman2} was going to die!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你說得沒錯！我以為我要死了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You said you never even saw the plates.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你說你根本沒看到那些盤子。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You saved me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你救了我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You saw nothing...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你什麼都沒看到……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see the sun way up there in the sky?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看到天上高高的那個太陽了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see this giant {mob} Skull inside the Barbarian Faction?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看到野蠻人派系裡面那顆巨大的{mob}頭骨了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see this machine here...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看這台機器……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see those Watchers inside the {area}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看到{area}§f裡那些§c監視者§f了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see those purple {collections_res} or {collections_res2} that sometimes appear around here?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看到這附近偶爾會出現的紫色{collections_res}或{collections_res2}了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see, long ago a breach materialized atop the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看，很久以前，{area}§f頂上出現了一道§5裂縫§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see, there is a breach near the portal you entered, in your world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，在你的世界，你進來的那個傳送門附近有一道§5裂縫§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see, while we evolved past the need for crops and cattle, the quality of our food remains low.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，雖然我們已經進化到不需要作物和牲畜，但我們的食物品質仍然很差。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see, {roman} have a penchant for collecting exotic pets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，我很喜歡收集§d奇特的寵物§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see, {roman}'m the best lava fisher in the world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，我是世界上最厲害的岩漿釣客。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You see, {roman}'ve been having quite the struggle with my farm that {roman2} inherited from my father.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你知道嗎，我從父親那裡繼承的農場讓我吃盡了苦頭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You seem like someone of similar interests.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看起來是個興趣相近的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You seem suspicious.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看起來很可疑。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You seem to have quite a talent for growing crops... which is something {roman} couldn't really say about myself...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你看起來很有種作物的天分……這點我可不敢說自己有……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should also talk to {npc2}, they have more information about commissions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你也應該去找{npc2}§f談談，他們有更多關於§e委託§f的資訊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should be able to jump into the portal now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在應該可以跳進傳送門了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should bring that letter to the Queen ASAP. Did you lose the letter?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該盡快把那封信帶去給§c女王§f。你把信弄丟了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should check out the {area} next. Be careful though!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來你應該去看看{area}。不過要小心！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should cut the trunks of the Fig Trees first!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該§a先砍無花果樹的樹幹§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should find it useful if you get lost.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你迷路了，它應該會有用。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should focus on getting all {0} pieces of the Ender Armor now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在應該專心收集全部 {0}§f 件§5終界盔甲§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should give me another and visit in the morning!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該再給我一杯，然後早上來看看！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should go talk to Auryon next!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來你應該去找§bAuryon §f談談！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should go talk to my assistant {npc2}, right next to the Fusion Machine in the back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該去找我的助手{npc2}§f，就在後面的§5融合機§f旁邊。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should go talk to my assistant.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該去找我的助手談談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should go talk to {npc2} next!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來你應該去找{npc2}談談！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should go talk to {npc2} next.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：接下來你該去找{npc2}談談。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should go there someday, even greater adventurers need to learn a few things!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你哪天應該去看看，就算是更偉大的冒險者也需要學點東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should know by now talking to me during the race is only going to hurt your time! Yeesh!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你現在應該知道，比賽中跟我說話只會拖慢你的時間！唉！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should look for {collections_res} or {collections_res2} with purple glows.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該找找發著紫光的{collections_res}或{collections_res2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should talk to {npc2} to learn more about Hunting!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該去找{npc2} §f多了解一下§a狩獵§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You should try to shout "Help {npc2}!"
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你應該試著大喊「§cHelp {npc2}§c!§f」

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You shouldn't be talking to me if you want to beat {0} minutes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：想跑進 {0} 分鐘就不該跟我說話！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You signed up for the Auction!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你報名了拍賣會！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You solved the Prism!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你解開了稜鏡！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You still beat me effortlessly...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你還是輕鬆就打敗我……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You sure you don't want the coins?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你確定不要那些遊戲幣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You talent. Good fisherman.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你有天分。好漁夫。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You think {roman}'m an {npc2} Soul.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：你以為我是{npc2}§5之魂§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: You too {player}, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} A fine addition to my collection!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} A {item}! This is a dream come true!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Abiphones ain't much use down here - you'll seldom get a signal, but {roman} do own one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §3Abiphone §f在這下面沒什麼用——幾乎收不到訊號，不過我確實有一支。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ah, just what {roman} needed!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ah, my Abiphone contact?

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ah, thank you! Look at his little nose - what a cute fella!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ah, that is what {roman} asked for. Thanks.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ain't nothing {roman}'d rather have than that beautiful hunk o' junk!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} All gemstones of the rainbow!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} All of my pet spiders left me to go and worship {mob}.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} All {roman} hear is crackling, the signal is really bad down here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我只聽到劈啪聲，這下面的訊號真的很差。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Alright let me know when you realize the massive skill gap between us.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Alright then! {roman} have to go now, was nice talking to you!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Alright, fair's fair. {roman}'m adding you to my Abiphone.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Alright, maybe next time.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Alright, thanks for your efforts, take my contact.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Alright, you've earned it.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Amazing! Great job!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} An Abiphone? What kind of witchcraft is that?

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} And before you ask... yes, {roman} do try to commercialize all of my friendships.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 還有，先說好……沒錯，我的每段友誼我都想拿來做生意。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} And if {roman} had one, {roman2} would totally add you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 而且如果我有一支，我一定會加你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} And keep in mind, there's no Jasper nor Opal in here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 還有記住，這裡沒有碧玉和貓眼石！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} And yet {npc2} makes me sell addictive garbage!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 可是{npc2}卻要我賣讓人上癮的垃圾！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Anyway, you can have it... for a price.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 不管怎樣，你可以拿去……但有代價。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Anyway, {roman} get bored by this job.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Anyways, as promised, here's my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 總之，就像我承諾的，這是我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Anyways, here's that contact you was after.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Anyways, here, take my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 總之，來，收下我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Anyways, {roman} guess {roman2}'ll add you, but only if you can prove to me that you won't just die like everyone else.
