entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 等你拿到一個再來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Come back once you've got yourself one.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 等你拿到一個再來吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Come back wearing Fairy Armor and {roman} can add a {0}f™ Operator Chip to your Abiphone so you can help us out!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f穿上§d仙女盔甲§f再來，我就能在你的 Abiphone 上加裝 {0}§5f™ 營運商晶片§f，讓你幫我們的忙！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Come back when you have the money.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 等你有錢再來吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Confirm your attendance at a meeting by speaking to me with your {item} equipped.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 裝備你的{item}來跟我說話，就能確認你出席了聚會。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Consider yourself lucky you only had to pay {0} million, {roman} could easily have added a zero.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你只要付 {0} 百萬就算你走運了，我隨時都能多加一個零。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Contanct. For you. Here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 聯絡方式。給你。這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Could definitely use some help, if you are willing to trade.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你願意交易，我確實需要一些幫忙。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Could you come help me out at my Den? And bring a friend. ;)
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f你能來我的巢穴幫我一下嗎？順便帶個朋友來。§a;)

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Could you give me a {item}? No particular reason.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你能給我一個{item}嗎？沒什麼特別的原因。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Could you kill a Runic {pet}? It HAS to be an enderman. Please.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f你能殺一隻§5符文{pet}§f嗎？一定要是終界使者。拜託。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Could you maybe give me a {item}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你能給我一個{item}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Could you maybe give me a {resource}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你能給我一根{resource}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Delusional are we today?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 今天在做白日夢啊？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know some owls like to take baths? Hootie here loves a good splash now and then!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道有些貓頭鷹喜歡洗澡嗎？我們家 Hootie 就很愛偶爾好好潑個水！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know that owls can rotate their heads up to {0} degrees? Hootie's quite the head-turner!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道貓頭鷹的頭最多能轉 {0} 度嗎？Hootie 可是很會轉頭的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know that owls can't chew? That's why they regurgitate pellets with the parts they can't digest!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道貓頭鷹不會咀嚼嗎？所以牠們會把消化不了的部分吐成食繭！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know the fairies helped the mages build the Abiphone's {0}f™ network?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f你知道仙女們幫法師建造了 Abiphone 的 {0}§5f™ §f網路嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know the largest owl is the Blakiston's Fish {pet}? Its wingspan can reach up to {0} feet! Hootie's a bit envious.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道最大的貓頭鷹是毛腿漁{pet}嗎？牠的翼展可以達到 {0} 英尺！Hootie 有點羨慕。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know, {item} only swims at night?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道嗎，{item}只在晚上游泳喔？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know? Most spiders have blue blood.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道嗎？大多數蜘蛛的血是藍色的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know? Most spiders liquify their food! That's how they can eat stuff that's bigger than them!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道嗎？大多數蜘蛛會把食物液化！所以牠們能吃比自己還大的東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know? Spiders are arachnids, not insects!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道嗎？蜘蛛是蛛形綱動物，不是昆蟲！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know? Spiders don't have an internal skeleton.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道嗎？蜘蛛沒有內骨骼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know? Spiders sense their surroundings through vibrations and their sensitive leg hairs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道嗎？蜘蛛透過震動和腿上敏感的毛來感知周遭環境。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you know? Tarantulas can get so big that they can prey on some birds, and even lizards!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道嗎？狼蛛可以長得很大，大到能捕食一些鳥，甚至蜥蜴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did you...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Did {roman} find an Abiphone?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我有沒有撿到 Abiphone？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Do you want me to train your pet?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你想要我訓練你的寵物嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Don't talk so loud.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 說話別那麼大聲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Don't tell my wife {roman} said that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 別告訴我老婆我說了那種話。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Don't waste my time please, {roman} have things to do and places to be.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 請別浪費我的時間，我有事要做，有地方要去。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Don't you know you are supposed to walk all the way here every single time?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你難道不知道你每次都應該一路走過來嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Eh, {roman} still have an Abiflip.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 呃，我還在用 Abiflip。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Err, are you sure?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 呃，你確定嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Fancy some trivia? {island} {pet} has the most extensive range of any owl species. They're world travelers, just like you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 想聽冷知識嗎？{island}{pet}是分布範圍最廣的貓頭鷹。牠們跟你一樣是環遊世界的旅人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Fancy this: The smallest owl in the world is the Elf {pet}, about the size of a sparrow. Hootie here thinks they're adorable!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 想像一下：世界上最小的貓頭鷹是精靈{pet}，大約只有麻雀那麼大。Hootie 覺得牠們超可愛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} First stop is using this here {resource} to tame myself a canine companion.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 第一步，就是用這根{resource}馴服一隻狗狗夥伴。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} For a builder to not have a {item} is quite uncommon.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 建築師沒有{item}可是很少見的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} For a stack of {item}, {roman}'ll give you my personal contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 給我一組{item}，我就給你我的私人聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} For real?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 真的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Friends? Sure!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 朋友？好啊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Get me a stack of {resource}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 給我一組{resource}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Give me a call anytime or drop by in person to check out what {roman}'ve got for sale!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 隨時打給我，或親自過來看看我在賣什麼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Give me a call if you ever need anything from my shop, {roman} can always make time for another redstone enthusiast.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f如果你需要我店裡的任何東西就打給我，我永遠有時間招呼另一位§c紅石§f愛好者。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Give me a call if you ever need to use the Fusion Machine!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f如果你需要使用§5融合機§f，就打電話給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Give me a call if you ever want to vote remotely in a Mayor Election!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f如果你想遠端參加§9市長選舉§f投票，就打給我吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Give me a call whenever you want to access {area}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 想逛{area}的時候隨時打給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Give me a couple of those and {roman}'ll give you my Abiphone contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 給我幾顆，我就給你我的 Abiphone 聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Go back to the {npc2} then, {roman}'m sure this will grant you a lot of reputation!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那就回去找{npc2}吧，我相信這會幫你賺到很多聲望！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Good work. We will come to you at once!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 做得好。我們馬上過去！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Great! Silent Pearls can be pretty useful sometimes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 太好了！無聲珍珠有時候還挺有用的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Great! You are cooler than you look!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 太好了！你比看起來還酷！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} HELP!!!!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 救命啊！！！！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Haha yeah, my favorite animal is a horse.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f哈哈對，我最喜歡的動物是§a馬§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hammer and drilling sounds {#2}
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 錘打和鑽孔的聲音 {#2}

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Have you got the research back or did you chicken out?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你把研究拿回來了嗎，還是你臨陣退縮了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Have you heard of the {item}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你聽說過{item}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Have you heard? The Northern {mob} {pet} can spot prey from up to half a mile away! That's some keen eyesight!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你聽說了嗎？北方{mob}{pet}能從半英里外發現獵物！眼力真好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} He's a clever one, that fish. {roman} can never catch him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那條魚很聰明。我怎麼都抓不到牠。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hello again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 又見面了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hello {player}! {npc2} here! Happy new year!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你好，{player}！我是{npc2}！新年快樂！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hello!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hello, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#}§f 你好，{player}§7！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hello.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hello. This is an automated message being sent to all of my closest contacts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你好。這是一則發送給我所有親近聯絡人的自動訊息。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hello?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喂？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hello? Oh, you are still alive, awesome!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喂？喔，你還活著，太好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Help {npc2}. Then yes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 幫{npc2}。然後可以。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here is my contact, now please leave me be for a while, for {roman} must paint a masterpiece!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f這是我的聯絡方式，現在請讓我獨處一陣子，因為我必須畫出一幅§d傑作§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here is my contact. Give me a call if you wish to take on the one they call '{pet}.'
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這是我的聯絡方式。如果你想挑戰那個被稱為「{pet}」的傢伙，就打給我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here take my contact, and thank you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 來，收下我的聯絡方式，謝謝你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here take my contact, but don't give it to anyone else!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 來，收下我的聯絡方式，但別給其他人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here take my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 來，收下我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's a beak-blowing stat: The Great Gray {pet} can locate prey under two feet of snow and snatch it up without a sound!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 告訴你一個驚人的數據：烏林{pet}能找到埋在兩英尺深雪下的獵物，而且無聲無息地把牠抓起來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's a tidbit: Owls have hollow bones, which helps them stay lightweight for flying. It's like nature's own aviation engineering!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 告訴你一個小知識：貓頭鷹的骨頭是中空的，能讓牠們保持輕盈好飛行。就像大自然自己的航空工程！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's my contact!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這是我的聯絡方式！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's my contact, you can call me whenever you need to access the {resource} Shop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f這是我的聯絡方式，需要使用{resource}§6商店§f時隨時打給我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這是我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's my number!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這是我的號碼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's my number, don't lose it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這是我的號碼，別弄丟了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's something: Owls don't have crops, those pouches some birds have for storing food. They're all about that direct-to-stomach service!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 告訴你：貓頭鷹沒有嗉囊，就是有些鳥用來儲存食物的那種囊袋。牠們走的是直達胃部的服務！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here's the deal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 條件是這樣的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here, let me be one of your first Abiphone Contacts!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f來，讓我成為你最早的§3 Abiphone 聯絡人§f之一！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here, take a look at the candidates!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 來，看看候選人吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here, take my contact anyway.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 來，還是把我的聯絡方式給你吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Here, take my contact!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 來，收下我的聯絡方式！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey adventurer!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嘿，冒險者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey dude.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嘿，老兄。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey it's very nice of you, but {roman} can't take your ONLY Abiphone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嘿，你人真好，但我不能拿走你唯一的 Abiphone！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嘿。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey you! Psst!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嘿，你！噓！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嘿，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey, do you think you could give me a [Lvl {0}] {pet}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f嘿，你覺得你能給我一隻§7[等級 {0}§7] {pet}§f嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey, just the one {roman} needed to hear from!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嘿，正是我想聽到消息的人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hey, let's swap contacts! {roman} think this is the beginning of a great friendship.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嘿，我們交換聯絡方式吧！我想這是一段美好友誼的開始。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hi again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 又見面了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hi dear!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗨，親愛的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hi! Check back later for information on the next {event}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§a：{#} 嗨！晚點再來查看下一次{event}的資訊吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hi! Did your potions run out?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗨！你的藥水用完了嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hi, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗨，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hm, my Abiphone Contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f嗯，我的§9 Abiphone 聯絡方式§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hm, what brings ya to ask?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，你怎麼會這樣問？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hm, you want my Abiphone Contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f嗯，你想要我的§6 Abiphone 聯絡方式§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hm, you'd like my Abiphone Contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f嗯，你想要我的§9 Abiphone 聯絡方式§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hmm, it's quite the conundrum.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，真是個難題。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hmm, you don't seem to have a {reforge.stone}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，你身上好像沒有{reforge.stone}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hmm? My Abiphone Contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f嗯？我的§3 Abiphone 聯絡方式§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hmph. {roman} don't know.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哼。我不知道。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hold onto your feathers! Some owls have a wingspan that's nearly twice their body length. Talk about aerodynamics!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 抓緊你的羽毛！有些貓頭鷹的翼展將近是身長的兩倍。這才叫空氣力學！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hold your phone close to your ear, {roman}'ll throw the potions into my phone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 把手機貼近你的耳朵，我把藥水丟進我的手機裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hoo knew? Owls can actually swim! Though Hootie prefers to keep his feathers dry, thank you very much!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 誰知道呢？貓頭鷹其實會游泳！不過 Hootie 比較喜歡保持羽毛乾燥，真是謝謝喔！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hoo's ready for some owl wisdom? Owls have been symbols of wisdom in various cultures. Makes me wonder what Hootie's pondering!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 誰想聽點貓頭鷹的智慧？在許多文化裡，貓頭鷹都是智慧的象徵。真想知道 Hootie 在想什麼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hoo's up for a flight lesson? Unlike most birds, owls make nearly silent flight possible by the structure of their wing feathers!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 誰想上一堂飛行課？跟大多數鳥類不同，貓頭鷹翅膀羽毛的構造讓牠們幾乎能無聲飛行！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Hope to see ya farming!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 希望看到你在農耕！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} How about a {pet} {item}? {roman}'ve always found them to be positively adorable.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 一隻{pet}{item}怎麼樣？我一直覺得牠們可愛極了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} How about a {reforge.stone}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 一個{reforge.stone}怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} How about it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} How about you bring me a {item}? {roman}'ll trade it for my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 不如你帶一顆{item}來給我？我就用聯絡方式跟你換。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} How about you guess my favorite animal?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你來猜猜我最喜歡的動物怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Howdy!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你好啊！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Howdy, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喲，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} However, it's only a wee little {item}, so it ain't got many contact slots.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 不過，那只是一支小小的{item}，所以聯絡人欄位不多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} However, there's one that {roman}'ve never quite been able to find.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 不過，有一種我一直都找不到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} However, {roman} suppose, while people are a bit much, a pet wouldn't hurt.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 不過我想，雖然人有點太多了，但一隻寵物應該無妨。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Huh? you want to add my contact to your Abiphone?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯？你想把我的聯絡方式加進你的 Abiphone？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If there's really an emergency, come and see me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果真的有緊急狀況，就來找我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If they wanna go worship {mob} when they're all grown up, that's cool with me but, until then, we could be great friends.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果牠們長大後想去崇拜{mob}，我也沒關係，但在那之前，我們可以當好朋友。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you are interested in making a purchase, please begin to make your way over.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你有興趣購買，請開始動身前往。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you bring me {0} of them, {roman}'ll give you my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你帶 {0} 個給我，我就給你我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you call me {roman} probably won't feel like speaking, but {roman2}'ll let you use the {resource} Shop.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f如果你打給我，我大概不會想說話，但我會讓你使用{resource}§2商店§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you can bring me ALL of those, you can have my contact!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你能把牠們全部帶來，就能拿到我的聯絡方式！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you can bring me a {resource}, {roman}'ll give you my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你能帶一顆{resource}來給我，我就給你我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you can bring me one, {roman}'ll give you my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你能帶一隻來給我，我就給你我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you come to enough auctions, you'll find what you're looking for.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 只要你參加夠多場拍賣會，就會找到你要的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you could find me one {roman}'d really appreciate it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你能幫我找到一顆，我會非常感激。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you ever have a spare one, you know where to find me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你有多的，你知道去哪裡找我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you ever need to use the {resource} Shop or just want to hear some spider fun facts, hit me up!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f如果你需要使用{resource}§c商店§f，或只是想聽一些蜘蛛冷知識，就打給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you forgot, {roman}'m after a {resource}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你要是忘了，我要的是{resource}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you give me one {roman}'ll gladly give you my contact!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 只要你給我一把，我很樂意給你我的聯絡方式！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you give me {0} {resource} and {1} {resource2}, {roman} might give you my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你給我 {0} {resource}和 {1} {resource2}，我也許會給你我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you had {0} Max Lvl pets of Legendary tier or better in your pet menu...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#}§f 如果你的寵物選單裡有 {0} 隻§6傳奇§f以上稀有度的§a滿級§f寵物……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you return my {item}, {roman}'ll give you my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你把我的{item}還來，我就給你我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you treat Hootie to a {item}, we might just become fast friends!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你請 Hootie 吃一條{item}，我們說不定很快就會成為好朋友！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you want my contact you'll have to show me you can hit them all in UNDER {0} seconds.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你想要我的聯絡方式，就得證明你能在 {0} 秒內全部射中。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you want my contact, all you have to do is repeat this phrase exactly...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你想要我的聯絡方式，只要一字不差地重複這句話……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If you want my contact, how about you bring me somethin' to keep me occupied, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 想要我的聯絡方式的話，不如帶點東西來讓我打發時間，如何？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If {roman} ever get him, {roman2}'m making a meal out of him - a little payback for all that chocolate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 要是哪天讓我抓到，我就把牠煮來吃——算是報那些巧克力的仇。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If {roman} give you my contact it's strictly business, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果我給你聯絡方式，那純粹是生意，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If {roman} have an Abiphone?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 問我有沒有 Abiphone？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If {roman} have new rabbit arrivals, {roman2}'ll let you know!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果有新的兔子到貨，我會通知你的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} If {roman} need any farming done back home, {roman2}'ll be sure to call ya!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果我家那邊需要人幫忙農耕，我一定會打給你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} In my spare time {roman} like to go swimming down in the {area}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 閒暇時我喜歡到{area}底下游泳。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Inspiration has struck! {roman} should paint him!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 靈感來了！我應該把牠畫下來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Isn't that cheating though?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這不算作弊嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It can get quite lonely up here sometimes, so {roman} do a bunch of stuff to pass the time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這上面有時候挺寂寞的，所以我會做很多事來打發時間。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It has {0} contact slots and {roman} already have {npc2} and {npc3}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 它有 {0} 個聯絡人欄位，我已經有{npc2}和{npc3}了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It may look like {roman}'m always here at my desk, but really {roman2}'m always traveling.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 看起來我好像一直待在辦公桌前，但其實我總是在旅行。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It will work on any Abiphone as long as {roman}'m in your contacts list.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 只要我在你的聯絡人清單裡，它在任何 Abiphone 上都能運作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It's a long story but in short, we believe the Piglins stole it, it's a real problem.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 說來話長，簡單來說，我們認為是豬布林偷走的，這真是個大問題。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It's a really big Abiphone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這是一支非常大的 Abiphone！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It's quite simple - the brew requires Revive Stones!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#}§f 很簡單——釀造需要§a復活石§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It's really as simple as that. {roman}'ll add myself to your Contacts now!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f真的就是這麼簡單。我現在就把自己加進你的§3聯絡人§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It's somewhere in my hut. Place isn't too big so it shouldn't be too hard to find.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 它就在我小屋的某個地方。屋子不大，應該不難找。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} It's such a beautiful gem. Perhaps the most beautiful one of all.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那是多麼美麗的寶石啊。也許是所有寶石中最美的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Just don't call me asking when the tavern is open, okay?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 只是別打來問我酒館什麼時候開，好嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Just don't flood me with calls.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 只是別一直打電話轟炸我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Kill {mob}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 殺了{mob}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Lately {roman}'ve been looking across the universe for {0} specific pets.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 最近我在全宇宙尋找 {0} 隻特定的寵物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Let me guess, you're yet another player who desires my contact...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 讓我猜猜，你又是一個想要我聯絡方式的玩家……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Let's see...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我想想……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Like {roman} said before, {roman2}'m not too good with people.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 就像我之前說的，我不太擅長跟人相處。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Listen buddy it's not because {roman} gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 聽著，老兄，我給了你聯絡方式，可不代表你有權在大白天把我吵醒。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Listen pal, {roman}'ve been nice with you but it's strictly business etiquette.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 聽著，老兄，我對你很客氣，但那純粹是商業禮儀。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Listen to this: Some owls have special feathers for silent flight. Perfect for sneaking up on snacks, or in Hootie's case, a cheeky cuddle!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 聽好了：有些貓頭鷹擁有能讓飛行無聲的特殊羽毛。最適合偷偷接近點心，或者以 Hootie 來說，偷偷撒個嬌！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Listen to this: The Eurasian Eagle-{pet} can live up to {0} years in captivity. Imagine all the wisdom they gather!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 聽好了：歐亞鵰{pet}在人工飼養下最多能活 {0} 年。想想牠們累積了多少智慧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Listen, {roman} don't have a ton of time right now, the object of my current research has just been stolen!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 聽著，我現在沒什麼時間，我目前研究的東西剛剛被偷了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Look at those colors... even holding it feels like it's trying to disappear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 看看那些顏色……就算拿在手上，都感覺它想要消失。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Look! She's looking at me with each of her eight eyes, how cute!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你看！她用她的八隻眼睛看著我，好可愛！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Look... {roman}'ll add you as a contact if you can bring me some good drinks, such as a {item} and a {item2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 聽著……如果你能帶一些好飲料給我，像是{item}和{item2}，我就加你為聯絡人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Looking a little queasy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 看起來有點想吐。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Looks like you don't have the {item} {roman} asked for.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 看來你沒有我要的{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Looks like you've completed the INFERNAL tier of {pet}, so {roman}'ll consider you worthy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f看來你已經完成了{pet}§f的§c§l煉獄 §r§f階級，所以我認為你夠格了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Looks like you've reached {pet} Slayer {0}, so you're as good a choice as any {roman} suppose.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f看來你已經達到{pet}§c獵殺 {0}§f了，所以我想你跟其他人一樣都是不錯的人選。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Looks like {roman} need to get down to the Loch as soon as possible.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f看來我得盡快去§2湖§f底下一趟了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Lucky for you, {roman} have constructed my very own abiphone out of redstone, and it's got infinite contact slots!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 幸好，我用紅石自己打造了一支 Abiphone，而且聯絡人欄位無限多！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} MY CHICKENS... THEY MUTATED!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的雞……牠們突變了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ma' always told me to worry of stuff {roman} don't understand.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我媽總是告訴我，要提防我不懂的東西。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Matter of fact, {roman}'ve got seven siblings alone that would probably want to be in it...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 事實上，光是我的七個兄弟姊妹大概就都想被存進去了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Maybe if you reach enough reputation...but maybe not...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f也許等你的§a聲望§f夠高……但也許不行……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯……你的臉實在不怎麼嚇人……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Mmh... you're missing something to become a Platinum-level donor...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯……你還差一點才能成為白金級贊助者……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Most of the Dwarves are pretty against all of this newer tech, so {roman}'ve got plenty of space in my directory.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 大部分矮人都很排斥這些新科技，所以我的通訊錄還空得很。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My Abiphone Contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f我的§3Abiphone 聯絡方式§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My Abiphone contact, you say?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你說，我的 Abiphone 聯絡方式？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My Abiphone contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的 Abiphone 聯絡方式？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My Axe could do with an upgrade...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的斧頭該升級一下了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My abiphone is for Platinum-level donors of the {npc2} cause only.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的 Abiphone 只給{npc2}事業的白金級贊助者。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My abiphone? You got it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的 Abiphone？沒問題！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的聯絡方式？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My contact?!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的聯絡方式？！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My favorite thing to do at the moment is to collect cool-looking rocks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我現在最喜歡做的事是收集好看的石頭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My frogs are going to love that, thanks a lot!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的青蛙們會愛死這個的，非常感謝！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My great-great grandfather invented Abiphones.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我的曾曾祖父發明了 Abiphone。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My precious, beautiful Pigeon...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我珍貴又美麗的鴿子……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} My red hoodie!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f我的§c紅色連帽衫§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Nice doing business with you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 跟你做生意很愉快。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Nice job!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 做得好！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Nice one bro.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 厲害喔兄弟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Nice to see you again
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 很高興又見到你

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Nice to see you're still alive and kicking.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 很高興看到你還活蹦亂跳的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Nice to see you, {player}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 很高興見到你，{player}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Not just because of the lack of action, but there's nothing to be proud about the drinks {roman} serve.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 不只是因為沒什麼事做，還因為我賣的飲料沒什麼好驕傲的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Not much else to do around here, really.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 說真的，這裡也沒什麼別的事可做。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Now let's see, what should {roman} ask for it...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那我來想想，該跟你要什麼呢……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Now there's both {npc2} AND you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 現在有{npc2}，還有你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Now you're on a {0} seconds timeout as punishment!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#}§c 作為懲罰，你現在要暫停 {0}§c 秒！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Now {roman} can finally add {npc2}, and you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 現在我終於可以加{npc2}和你了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Of all people in the village, you are the first to ask for my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 村子裡所有人當中，你是第一個跟我要聯絡方式的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Of course {roman} can add you as a contact!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我當然可以加你為聯絡人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oh absolutely you can have my contact info.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喔，當然，我的聯絡方式可以給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oh and also, you need to have earned a GOLD medal in his contest if you want to be on MY list!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f喔還有，如果你想上我的清單，你得在他的競賽中拿過§6§l金牌§r§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oh hey, {roman}'ve seen you around.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喔嘿，我在附近見過你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oh {player} is that you again?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喔，{player}，又是你嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oh, by the way, they should all be Lvl {0}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#}§f 喔對了，牠們都必須是§7等級 {0}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oh, it's you! So the Queen welcomed you in our Faction? That's great
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喔，是你！所以女王歡迎你加入我們的派系了？太好了

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oh, my Abiphone Contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f喔，我的§3Abiphone 聯絡方式§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喔？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ohhhh, you did it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喔～你做到了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Okay {roman} added {0}f™ Operator Chip to your Abiphone plan.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f好了，我已經在你的 Abiphone 方案加上 {0}§5f™ 營運商晶片§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} One last thing - not every NPC owns an Abiphone, so you can't add everyone as a Contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f最後一件事——不是每個 NPC 都有§3Abiphone§f，所以你不能把每個人都加為聯絡人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Only call me if you have something urgent to talk about.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 只有在有緊急的事要談時才打給我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Only call me if you've got items to give me, please.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 請只在你有物品要給我的時候才打給我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ooh, and {roman}'ll also call you whenever a new FIRE Sale starts! You wouldn't want to miss that!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f喔，還有每當新的§c§l特賣§r§c活動§f開始時我也會打給你！你可不想錯過的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ooh, you got yourself an Abiphone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f喔，你弄到了一支§3 Abiphone§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Oooh an Abiphone, and a fancy one!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喔～一支 Abiphone，而且還是高級的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Otherwise you'll have to give me {0} coins to get my contact, no less.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 不然你就得給我 {0} 遊戲幣才能拿到我的聯絡方式，一毛都不能少。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Owls have a third eyelid! It's transparent and helps protect their eyes while they hunt.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 貓頭鷹有第三層眼瞼！它是透明的，能在狩獵時保護眼睛。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} People always adding me left and right these days, asking if the ol' tav is open or not.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 最近一直有人加我，問老酒館有沒有開。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Perfect.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 完美。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Please meet me at my house if you have one. {roman} would greatly appreciate it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 如果你有的話，請到我家來找我。我會非常感激的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Please only call me during business hours.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 請只在營業時間打給我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Plus it's a magical object, so it's not that bad.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 而且它是個魔法物品，所以也沒那麼糟。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Potions travel much faster by phone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 藥水透過電話傳得快多了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Pro Drill Maintenance, Jotraeline speaking.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 專業鑽頭維修，我是 Jotraeline。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Prove it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 證明給我看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Quit yer playin' and bring me a {reforge.stone} or you ain't getting my contact!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 別鬧了，帶{reforge.stone}來給我，不然別想拿到我的聯絡方式！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ready for a fun fact? Owls have asymmetrical ears, helping them pinpoint sounds from different directions. Talk about surround sound!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 想聽個冷知識嗎？貓頭鷹的耳朵是不對稱的，能幫牠們精準判斷來自不同方向的聲音。這才叫環繞音效！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Removing them was a real pain.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 一個個刪掉真的很麻煩。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sadly, {npc2} heard of our little deal and asked me to hold the drinks for him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 可惜，{npc2}聽說了我們的小交易，要我把飲料留給他。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Say, do you think you could get me a {resource}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 對了，你覺得你能幫我弄到一顆{resource}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} See ya around, my partner in pesthuntin'!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 回頭見啦，我的害蟲獵人夥伴！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} See you around!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 再見！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Seeing as {roman}'m feeling nice, {roman2}'ll give you my contact for the small sum of one {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 看在我今天心情好的份上，只要一個{item}這點小代價，我就給你我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} She's so seldom seen that many don't even believe she truly exists.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 她太少被看見了，很多人甚至不相信她真的存在。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Shhhh!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 噓～！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Simply bring me an {resource} and {roman}'ll add you right in!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 只要帶一個{resource}給我，我馬上就加你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Since {roman}'m so limited on space, {roman2}'ve got to be quite particular on who {roman3} add.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 因為我的空間有限，我得很挑剔要加誰。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} So my abiphone contacts list is FILLED with TONS of other pet lovers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 所以我的 Abiphone 聯絡人清單裡塞滿了一大堆其他寵物愛好者。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} So, how about it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 所以，怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} So, sometimes {roman} worry, if {roman2} was to stop being lonely, what would happen to the quality of my art?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 所以有時候我會擔心，如果我不再孤獨，我的藝術品質會變成怎樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} So, while {roman}'m here, {roman2} might as well try to make some friends.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 所以，既然我在這裡，不如試著交些朋友。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} So, you want me to add you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 所以，你想要我加你？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sorry for the odd request, but those are very hard to get around here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 抱歉提出這麼奇怪的要求，但那東西在這附近很難取得。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sorry mate, not much space in the old handheld.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 抱歉啦老兄，我這台老手機沒什麼空間了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Such lovely weather in this little ol' cave today, isn't it?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 今天這個小洞穴裡的天氣真好，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Suddenly, life's looking brighter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 突然間，生活看起來更光明了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Superb!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 太棒了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sure {roman} can give you my contact, but first let's play a little game!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我當然可以給你我的聯絡方式，不過我們先來玩個小遊戲！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sure {roman}'d like you in my contacts list, but {roman2} don't want this kind of burden on our relationship.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我當然想把你加進聯絡人，但我不想讓我們的關係有這種負擔。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sure!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 當然！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sure, {roman} guess {roman2} can do that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 當然，我想可以。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sure, {roman} have some space.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 當然，我還有空位。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Sure, {roman}'d be honored!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 當然，我很榮幸！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Survive long enough to collect {0} {resource}, and then bring it to me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 活得夠久，收集到 {0} {resource}，然後帶來給我。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Take my contact and go.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 拿了我的聯絡方式就走吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Tell you what, here's a compromise.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這樣吧，我們各退一步。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thank you for helping with the tentacle monster.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 謝謝你幫忙對付那隻觸手怪物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thank you so much!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 真是太謝謝你了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thank you so much, here is my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 太感謝你了，這是我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thank you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 謝謝你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thank you. {npc2} says.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 謝謝。{npc2}說。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thanks a lot. Call me any time to make your island more vibrant!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#}§f 非常感謝。隨時打給我，讓你的島嶼變得更§c繽§6紛§e多§a彩§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thanks again!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 再次謝謝你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thanks dude!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 謝啦，老兄！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thanks, {roman} appreciate it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 謝謝，我很感激！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thanks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 謝了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That does appear to be aMagma Core.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f那看起來確實是一個§9岩漿核心§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That thing is basically the holy grail to a junk collector like me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那東西對我這種垃圾收藏家來說，簡直就是聖杯。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That thing was like a part of me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那件衣服就像是我的一部分！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That way you'll be able to access my features from anywhere?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這樣你就能在任何地方使用我的功能？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That way, you can call me anytime you'd like to use the Community Shop!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f這樣一來，你想使用§b社區商店§f時隨時都能打給我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That would show me you're a pet lover too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那就能證明你也是個寵物愛好者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's awesome, but now my Abiflip is full.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 太棒了，但現在我的 Abiflip 滿了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's fair, {roman} suppose.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我想這很合理。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's fantastic!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 太棒了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's grandiose!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 太棒了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 就是這樣！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's it. Enjoy your purchase!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 就這樣。好好享受你的新手機吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's not the correct gemstone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那不是正確的寶石！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's not what {roman} asked for!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那不是我要的東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's right! A {item} is what {roman} desire!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 沒錯！我想要的就是一把{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's super cool!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f那真是§d超酷的§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} That's why they can only be made around here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 所以它們只能在這附近製作。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The cheapest Abiphone, {roman} see...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 最便宜的 Abiphone，原來如此……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The controls are really bad, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 操作超爛的，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The folk around here call her {mob}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這附近的人叫她{mob}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The island is safe! For now, at least...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這座島安全了！至少目前是……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The janitor?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 一個清潔工？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The monsters ate his toy again! {roman} don't know what to do!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 怪物又把他的玩具吃掉了！我不知道該怎麼辦！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The next {event} will be taking place very soon. Same time, same place as usual.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 下一場{event}很快就要舉行了。老時間，老地方。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The signal doesn't work too well around here, but suit yourself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這附近的訊號不太好，不過隨你吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The {event} has arrived! Here are my offerings this year:
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§a：{#} {event}來了！這是我今年提供的寵物：

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} The {item} didn't work.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} {item}沒用。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} There ain't many customers around here, so {roman} spend all my time playing Snake on my Abiphone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這裡沒什麼客人，所以我整天都在用 Abiphone 玩貪食蛇。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} There are so many beautiful creatures to see down there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那底下有好多美麗的生物可以看。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} There you go!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 好了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} There's this creature {roman}'ve been dying to track. It shifts colors, blends in, vanishes like mist.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 有種生物我一直很想追蹤。牠會變色、融入環境，像霧一樣消失。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} There's this one Fish that keeps munching on my chocolate stash.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 有一條魚一直在偷吃我藏的巧克力。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} These paintings don't paint themselves!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這些畫可不會自己畫出來！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} They say if you're lucky, you might find one in Tree Gifts... a {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f聽說運氣好的話，你可能會在§2樹之禮§f裡找到一個……{item}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} This ain't no {resource}, mi amigo...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這可不是{resource}，我的朋友……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} This gives me everything {roman} need.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這給了我需要的一切。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} This might just be the cutest {pet} {roman}'ve ever seen!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這可能是我見過最可愛的{pet}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} This place is terrible.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這地方糟透了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} This {item} looks great, perfect condition even!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這個{item}看起來很棒，狀態甚至很完美！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Though you'll still have to outbid everyone else, of course!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 當然，你還是得出價贏過其他所有人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Thought we ourselves are but a blink in th face of eternity, our friendship will be everlasting.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 雖然我們在永恆面前不過是一眨眼，但我們的友誼將永垂不朽。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Time is money, after all.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 畢竟，時間就是金錢。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} To be honest with ya, though, {roman} have no use for this toy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 不過老實跟你說，我根本用不到這個玩具。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} To see who you can add, simply open up your phone and check the Contacts Directory.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f想知道可以加誰，只要打開你的手機查看§3聯絡人目錄§f就行了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Trophy Fish. For {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 戰利品魚。給{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Truthfully, {roman} have been a lonely man for as long as {roman2} can remember.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 老實說，從我有記憶以來，我一直是個孤獨的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Try to stay alive, for both your sake and mine - {roman} don't feel like expending the minimal effort required to remove you from my contacts.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 盡量活下來，為了你也為了我——我可不想花那一點點力氣把你從聯絡人裡刪掉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Turns out {roman} own one too. {roman2} never knew what it was called.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 原來我也有一支。我從來不知道它叫什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Uh, dude, you don't have a [Lvl {0}] {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f呃，老兄，你沒有§7[等級 {0}§7] {pet}§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Uh... do you have any cheaper phone?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 呃……你有更便宜的手機嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Uh... maybe before you dare get my contact, you should prove yourself as a real archer first.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 呃……在你敢跟我要聯絡方式之前，也許你該先證明自己是個真正的弓箭手。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Unfortunately for you, {roman} don't own an abiphone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 可惜，我沒有 Abiphone。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Until {roman} find it, socializing just won't feel the same.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 在我找到它之前，社交的感覺就是不一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Verdants, Azures, {mob}, Joydives, {roman}'ve seen them all.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §a翠鰭§f、§9蔚藍魚§f、{mob}§f、§9樂潛魚§f，我全都見過。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Very funny.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 真好笑。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Waddya call that, a pyramid scheme? Ponzi scheme? {roman} don't know... {roman2} just call it bein' me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這叫什麼來著，老鼠會？龐氏騙局？我不知道……我只管它叫做我的本色。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Wahoo! That's the stuff.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哇呼！就是這個。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Wait..
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 等等……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} We need to upgrade all of the {0}f™ Network Relays spread across SkyBlock.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f我們需要升級散布在 SkyBlock 各地的所有 {0}§5f™ 網路中繼站§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} We owe the Piglins an apology.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我們欠豬布林一個道歉。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} We tried a bunch of things but that's been working the best so far.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我們試了很多東西，但目前這個效果最好。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} We're always open...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我們一直都有開……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Welcome to the Platinum club, high roller!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 歡迎加入白金俱樂部，大戶！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well ain't she a beauty!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哇，真是個美人！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well here's my contact. :
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 好吧，這是我的聯絡方式。:

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well that's not possible, {roman}'m only available at night.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 那是不可能的，我只有晚上才有空。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, as per the terms of our agreement, {roman} suppose you can have my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 好吧，依照我們的協議條款，我想你可以拿到我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, now that {roman} think about it, my little girl got me one for my birthday a few months back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，現在想想，我女兒幾個月前送了我一支當生日禮物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, outside of the fabled Arkenstone, that is.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f嗯，除了傳說中的§d阿肯寶鑽§f以外啦。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, tell you what. Help me out with a little something and {roman}'ll hook you up.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這樣吧。幫我一個小忙，我就給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, today might just be your lucky day - again.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，今天也許又是你的幸運日——再一次。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, what's in it for me?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，那我有什麼好處？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, {roman} suppose it wouldn't do any harm.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 好吧，我想應該也無妨。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, {roman}'ll give you it if you play a game with me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，如果你陪我玩個遊戲，我就給你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, {roman}'m a man of my word. Here's my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 好吧，我說話算話。這是我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, {roman}'m afraid you'll have to get in line with everyone else.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這個嘛，恐怕你得跟其他人一樣排隊了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Well, {roman}'m usually a bit guarded about that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，這方面我通常比較謹慎。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What about some more {item}, hum?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 再來一些{item}如何，嗯？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What an unusual request!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 真是個奇特的請求！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What are you saying, the forge is in the omelette???
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你在說什麼，鍛造爐在煎蛋捲裡？？？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What did you just say? You recovered it? And they didn't even see you?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你剛剛說什麼？你拿回來了？而且他們根本沒看到你？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What do you say, buddy?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 怎麼樣，朋友？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What's all this about, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 這是在幹嘛啊？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What's up, {player}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 怎麼啦，{player}？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} What? You want my Abiphone contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 什麼？你想要我的 Abiphone 聯絡方式？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Whoo's up for some owl trivia? Did you know owls don't have teeth? They swallow their prey whole. A bit gruesome, but efficient!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 誰想聽貓頭鷹小知識？你知道貓頭鷹沒有牙齒嗎？牠們會把獵物整個吞下去。有點噁心，但很有效率！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Why do you need my contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你為什麼需要我的聯絡方式？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Why do you want me on your Abiphone?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你為什麼想把我加進你的 Abiphone？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Woah, you want my contact?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哇，你想要我的聯絡方式？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Would you mind getting me {0} {resource}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你介意幫我拿 {0} {resource}嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Wow!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哇！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Wow! You really found her! What was she like?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哇！你真的找到她了！她是什麼樣子？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Wow, Hootie's absolutely thrilled!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哇，Hootie 超級興奮！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Wow, it's beautiful!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哇，好漂亮！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Wow, you're a true pet lover!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 哇，你是真正的寵物愛好者！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ya sure can add my contact, against {0} {resource}, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你當然可以加我的聯絡方式，用 {0} {resource}來換，怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Ya won't call me too often, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你不會太常打給我吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yeah that didn't work.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 嗯，那沒用。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yep, that's right, {roman}'m the best.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 沒錯，就是這樣，我是最強的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yep, {#2} {resource}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 對，{#2} {resource}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yer know, standing 'ere all day with nothing to do gets pretty borin' at times.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道嗎，整天站在這裡無事可做，有時候還挺無聊的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yes of course we can upgrade your drill.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 當然，我們可以幫你升級鑽頭。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yes of course you can have it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 當然可以，給你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yes, sometimes {roman} do find one lying around.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 有啊，有時候我確實會撿到一支。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yes... {roman} could give you my contact... However, may {roman2} ask a favor in return?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 好啊……我可以給你我的聯絡方式……不過，我能請你幫個忙作為交換嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} Yo bro, how's it going?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 喲，兄弟，最近怎樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You actually found one? You weren't kidding around.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你真的找到了？你不是在開玩笑。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You actually managed to get a {reforge.stone}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你居然真的拿到了{reforge.stone}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You can sometimes find 'em after vacuuming up a {mob}. You can only catch those rare little guys in Pest Traps.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f吸掉{mob}§f之後有時候能找到。那些稀有的小傢伙只能用§9害蟲陷阱§f抓到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You can sometimes find one when killing {mob} in {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 在{island}殺死{mob}時有時候能找到。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You do know {roman} am dead, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你知道我已經死了吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You do not possess a {reforge.stone}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你沒有{reforge.stone}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You doin' alright there mate?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你還好吧，夥伴？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't even have a {item}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你根本沒有{item}……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't even have a {resource}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你根本沒有{resource}……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't have a {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你沒有{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't have a {pet} {item} in your inventory. Are you some sort of scammer?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你的背包裡沒有{pet}{item}。你是哪門子的騙子嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't have both beverages in your inventory!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你的物品欄裡沒有這兩種飲料！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't have what it takes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你還不夠格！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't have what {roman} need! Nice try!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你沒有我要的東西！想得美！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't have what {roman} need, nice try!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你沒有我要的東西，想得美！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You don't seem to have a {resource}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你身上好像沒有{resource}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You doubled my HUGE contacts list too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你也讓我那份超長的聯絡人清單翻倍了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You feel like the eighth sibling {roman} never had.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你就像是我從沒有過的第八個兄弟姊妹。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You found it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你找到了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You found the {npc2}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你找到{npc2}了？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You go and reach {pet} Slayer {0}, and {roman}'ll add you. How's that sound?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} §f你去達到{pet}§c獵殺 {0}§f，我就加你。怎麼樣？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You have an Abiphone!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你有 Abiphone！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You have an Abiphone! {roman}'ve always wanted one!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你有 Abiphone！我一直都想要一支！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You have less warts than {roman} have on my face!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你的疣比我臉上的疣還少！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You have quite the reputation around here!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你在這一帶的聲望相當高！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You have to give me Flawless gemstones in the right order.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你得按照正確的順序給我無瑕寶石。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You hearin' me? Bring me one of those and you can have my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 你有在聽嗎？帶一個來給我，我就給你我的聯絡方式。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You just need {collections_res} Collection {0} and to then donate an {resource}!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You're poor too, huh?

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You've already recieved a gift this year!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} You've been doing well in my contests recently, don't think {roman} haven't noticed!

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} always hear people wanting the {npc2}'s contact, but nobody ever asks for mine...

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} am famished! Bring me a meal and {roman2} will reward you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我餓死了！帶一頓§c大餐§f給我，我就會獎勵你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} am still really stressed out about the long research.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我還在為那份研究的事煩惱不已。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} bet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我就知道！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} can give you my contact but you need to do something for me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我可以給你我的聯絡方式，但你得幫我做件事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} can't believe it! This means the world to me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 真不敢相信！這對我來說意義重大！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} can't believe it, you are truly a hero! {roman2}'m currently near the {area}, please come here and bring the research back.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 真不敢相信，你真是個英雄！我現在在{area}附近，請把研究帶過來。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} can't believe she actually exists... {roman2} was beginning to lose hope.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 真不敢相信她真的存在……我都快要放棄希望了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} can't really hear you right now, the signal is really bad!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我現在聽不太清楚你在說什麼，訊號真的很差！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} cannot add you yet, {roman2} still have to finish my research.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我還不能加你，我得先完成我的研究。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} could tinker with it while {roman2} wait here...

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} didn't give you my contact for this reason.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} don't blame them, it looks pretty exciting down there, but it's got kinda lonely up here as a result, you know?

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} don't know what ya think that is, but it's not a {item}.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} don't tend to give out my contact to those delving into {island}.

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} don't want to sound too gamey but...

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} don't... don't know what to say...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我不……不知道該說什麼……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我最近才給過你藥水！給我一點時間準備新的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} guess we can come to an agreement.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我想我們可以達成協議。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} guess you are worthy of the title of {mob} Slayer after all.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 看來你終究配得上{mob}殺手的稱號。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} guess you want my Abiphone Contact, huh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我猜你想要我的§9 Abiphone 聯絡方式§f，是吧？

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我想我……從來沒收過這樣的禮物。

entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我聽說這附近有人在賣那個。喔——就是我！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} heard the new models are nice, but they're too smart for me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我聽說新機型很不錯，但它們對我來說太聰明了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} hope it wasn't too much of a hassle to get, {roman2}'ve heard stories of {island}...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 希望沒讓你費太多工夫，我聽過{island}的一些故事……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} just ask for it because it gets people buying a bunch of Pest Traps from me in order to go about getting it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我會要這個，只是因為大家為了拿到它，會跟我買一大堆§9害蟲陷阱§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} just got a new Chocolate Rabbit and was wondering if you wanted to buy it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我剛拿到一隻新的巧克力兔，想問你要不要買。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} just wanted to call to let you know that voting for this year's Mayor Election has begun!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我只是想打來告訴你，今年的§9市長選舉§f投票開始了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} just wanted to let you know that {roman2}'ve had a strike of inspiration and have started working on my latest masterpiece!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我只是想告訴你，我突然靈感大發，已經開始創作我最新的傑作了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} like collecting rings. There is one {roman2}'ve been wanting for a while now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我喜歡收集戒指。有一枚我想要好一陣子了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} love pets!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我愛寵物！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} mean, {roman2}'m supposed to ask you for something, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我是說，我應該要跟你要點東西才對，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} mean...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我是說……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} mean...{roman2} don't know, sure, just take my contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我是說……我也不知道，好吧，拿去吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} only sell {0} item?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我只賣 {0} 樣東西耶？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} only share my contact with those who are on {npc2}'s contact list.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我只把聯絡方式給在{npc2}聯絡人清單上的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} really like you!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我真的很喜歡你！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} really want it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我真的很想要它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} see.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 原來如此。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} sent a gift to your inventory! With love, {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我把一份禮物送進你的物品欄了！愛你的{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} simply enjoy a more simple life, ye?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我只是喜歡比較簡單的生活，懂嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} suppose you have more than earned my contact! Here you go!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我想你已經完全有資格拿到我的聯絡方式了！拿去吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} suppose you want my Abiphone Contact.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我想你是想要我的§3 Abiphone 聯絡方式§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} suppose {roman2} could do that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我想我可以這麼做。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} tell 'em every time that it's open every day, but when they put down the phone {roman2} know they'll call 'n ask again tomorrow.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我每次都跟他們說每天都有開，但他們一掛電話，我就知道他們明天又會打來問。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} think {roman2}'ll name her Aragog.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我想我要叫她 Aragog。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} travel a lot and {roman2}'m running quite low on {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我常常旅行，而我的{item}快用完了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} unlocked Target Partice {roman2} for you, good luck kiddo.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我幫你解鎖了§4標靶練習 {roman2}§f，祝你好運，小鬼。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} used to, but remembering who's still alive and who isn't is a nightmare.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我以前會，但要記住誰還活著、誰已經死了，實在是一場惡夢。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} was a little too optimistic.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我有點太樂觀了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} was right, you are indeed destined for great things.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我說得沒錯，你確實注定要成就大事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} will stay in {area} and prepare for the next battle!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 我會留在{area}準備下一場戰鬥！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} wish you the best of luck in {island}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 祝你在{island}好運。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman} wish {roman2} ever had vacations.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{#} 真希望我能有個假期。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {#} {roman}'d gladly supply you with colorful blocks anywhere, but {roman2}'m running out of supplies.
