entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve always wanted a Epic {pet}?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我一直很想要一隻§5史詩{pet}§f？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve always wanted to start a farm but instead {roman2} got sucked into this life of crim...{roman3} mean business!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我一直想開個農場，結果卻被捲進了這種犯罪……我是說，生意人生！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been after that one for ages.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我追那一塊已經追了好久了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been hunting fish all day long, why don't you give it a try?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我已經獵了一整天的魚了，你要不要試試看？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been living on this island for {0} years.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我已經在這座島上住了 {0} 年。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been planning to build a trap for unaware animals so {roman2} can hunt them more efficiently. {roman3} really need some cactus, preferably the ones with the biggest spikes!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我一直在計畫做個陷阱抓那些不注意的動物，這樣我就能更有效率地打獵。我真的很需要一些仙人掌，最好是刺最大的那種！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been racing this island so fast that some bark from the trees snatched right off!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在這座島上跑得太快，連樹上的樹皮都被扯下來了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been so hungry since the {pet} Queen tossed me aside
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：自從{pet}女王把我丟在一邊，我就一直好餓

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been studying the ancient artifacts of {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我一直在研究{pet}的古老遺物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been studying the ancient texts of {pet}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我一直在研究{pet}的古老文獻。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been tracking an animal for the past few days. Got anything {roman2} could use as bait?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我已經追蹤一隻動物好幾天了。有什麼能當誘餌的嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve been watching over you this whole time...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我一直都在看著你……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve competed in numerous sugar cane contests, but {roman2}'ve never actually tried farming other crops.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我參加過無數次甘蔗競賽，但從來沒真正試過種其他作物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve composed a fictional narrative about an adventurer who ventures into the Rift and conquers it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我寫了一個虛構的故事，關於一位冒險者深入隙界並征服它。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve crafted a two-player game of strategy and consequence.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我設計了一個講究策略與後果的雙人遊戲。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve dedicated much of my life to developing a portal that allows safe passage between our world and this mysterious dimension.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我把人生的大半都投入在開發一座§d傳送門§f，讓人能§a安全往返§f我們的世界和這個神祕的維度。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve encountered versions of you before.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我以前遇過不同版本的你。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve even developed a way to attract certain Pests to my plots.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我甚至研發出一種方法，能把特定的害蟲吸引到我的地塊上。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve figured out exactly how this {stats} stuff works!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我已經完全搞懂這個{stats}是怎麼運作的了！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve given you {0} {mob} Shards and {1} {mob2} Shards to fuse in the Fusion Machine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我給了你 {0} 個{mob}§a碎片§f和 {1} 個{mob2}§a碎片§f，讓你在融合機裡融合。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve got a {item} if you're interested!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：如果你有興趣，我這裡有一個{item}！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve got me eyes on the prize - ancient artifacts and the truth behind the lost king, {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我的目標很明確——§e古代文物§f，還有失落之王{npc2}§f背後的真相。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve got the perfect tool to make your island a winter wonderland!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我有能把你的島嶼變成冬季仙境的完美工具！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve got to skedaddle.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我得溜了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve grown so much over the last week thanks to you.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：多虧了你，我這一週成長了好多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve had this pile of unused diplomas for a while.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我有這疊沒用過的文憑好一陣子了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve had to piece together their story through fieldwork and ancient relics.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我只能透過實地考察和古代遺物拼湊出他們的故事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve heard rumors that the breach on top of the {area} was made by a massive {mob}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我聽說有傳聞，{area}§f頂上的§5裂縫§f是一條巨大的{mob}§f造成的。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve heard some people are holding a Cult Meeting there RIGHT NOW!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我聽說有些人§c現在§f正在那裡舉行§c邪教聚會§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve heard that one demands wits, a quality that cannot be gained easily.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我聽說那個需要§b機智§f，那是一種不容易獲得的特質。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve heard {roman2} can find the best mushrooms here, and as the {npc2}'s favorite emissary {roman3} will bring them to him!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我聽說在這裡能找到最好的蘑菇，身為{npc2}最喜歡的使者，我要把它們帶給他！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve identified at least eight Starborns, but {roman2} suspect there were more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我已經確認了至少八位星裔，但我懷疑還有更多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve never seen any members myself but {roman2} heard they were growing in numbers.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我自己從沒見過任何成員，但我聽說他們的人數越來越多。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve never seen one of these before!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我從沒見過這種東西！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve not seen a human down here since... well, nevermind.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：自從……算了，總之我已經很久沒在這底下看到人類了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve noticed how many people have been stopping by.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我注意到有很多人來過這裡。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve now retired to this house to live out the rest of my days.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我現在退休搬到這棟房子，打算在這裡度過餘生。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve planted them around the building.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我把它們種在建築物周圍了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve really got to go now but if you are interested {roman2} suggest you explore the island a bit more.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我真的得走了，不過如果你有興趣，我建議你再多探索一下這座島。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve recently added a {item} to my inventory. Sadly, it's not free! Click me again to open my shop!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e：我最近在商品裡加了{item}。可惜它不是免費的！再點我一次就能打開我的商店！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve recently got into cooking, yesterday {roman2} made pasta carbonara, today {roman3}'m planning on baking a carrot cake.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我最近迷上了下廚，昨天我做了培根蛋麵，今天打算烤個胡蘿蔔蛋糕。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve seen a few, Spikes they are called.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我看過幾隻，牠們被稱為刺刺。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve seen hundreds of iterations of you, all from different dimensions, who have come before me seeking to claim the title of {npc2}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我見過數百個來自不同維度的§c§o你§r§f，都來到我面前，想奪取{npc2}§f的稱號。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve seen it all - every island from here to the edge of the world!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我什麼都見過了——從這裡到世界盡頭的每座島嶼！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve seen it in my flames, you are destined for great things.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在我的火焰中看到了，你注定要成就大事。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve seen worse!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我看過更糟的！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve spent my life outsmarting everyone.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§e：我這輩子都在智取每一個人。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve traveled many islands and this is my favorite to race on. Want to try?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我去過很多島嶼，這裡是我最喜歡的賽跑地點。想試試嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve traveled many uh... dimensions and this is my favorite to race on. Want to try?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我去過很多呃……維度，這裡是我最喜歡的賽跑地點。想試試嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve traveled this far..
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我都走了這麼遠了……

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'ve walked this earth for {0} years, seen every creature, caught every beast... except... anyways.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在這世上走了 {0} 年，看過每一種生物，抓過每一隻野獸……除了……算了。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}'{roman2} UP HERE! ON TOP OF THE MOUNTAIN!!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我在上面這裡！在山頂上！！

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}, Murdohr, son of Murdohr the Third, Commander of the {pet} Forge, and Warden of the Holy Pickaxe, am guarding this wall.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我，Murdohr，Murdohr 三世之子，{pet}鍛造坊指揮官，聖鎬守護者，正在守護這面牆。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}, too, once stood in your shoes, having overthrown the {npc2} before me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我也曾經站在你的位置，推翻了我之前的{npc2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}-
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我——

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}... {roman2} had no idea this was here. What could {npc2} be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我……我完全不知道這裡有這個。{npc2}會在實驗室的這個祕密區域藏什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}’ve been cutting Fig Trees lately to gather more {collections_res}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我最近一直在砍無花果樹，收集更多{collections_res}。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {roman}’ve caught creatures {roman2}’d never be able to snag on my own.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：我抓到過一些靠自己絕對抓不到的生物。

entries.key: [NPC] {npc}: {stats} is a barrier to adventure, but embracing it can lead to magical experiences.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {npc}§f：{stats} §f是冒險的§c障礙§f，但擁抱它能帶來§d魔法般的§f體驗。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: But ask him this...who can hop the highest?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：但問問他這個……誰跳得最高？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Coach is the only rabbit {roman} know whose biceps have biceps.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：§d教練§f是我認識唯一一隻二頭肌上還長著二頭肌的兔子。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Each day {roman} commit to the hard work, the relentless pursuit of my personal goals.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：每一天，我都投入艱苦的工作，不懈地追求我個人的目標。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Get me a job at your factory, bro!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Bro§f：讓我去你的工廠上班啦，兄弟！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: He'll bring it up somehow, even if we are talking about chocolate molds.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：就算我們在聊巧克力模具，他也有辦法把話題扯過去。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Hire me, bro!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Bro§f：雇用我啦，兄弟！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: If you need a rundown of Uncle's high school football stats, just stick around for five minutes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：如果你想聽叔叔高中美式足球的戰績，只要在這裡待五分鐘就好。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: It's in his nature to run circles around us, literally. While we strategize, he's already on his third lap. Just born for the hustle, {roman} guess!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：繞著我們跑圈是牠的天性，字面上的意思。我們還在擬策略，牠已經跑第三圈了。我想牠天生就是為了拚搏而生吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: It's like a shot of espresso, but with more hopping and less coffee.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：就像來一杯濃縮咖啡，只是跳得更多、咖啡更少。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: It's not about being the best among others, but being the best version of myself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：重點不是成為眾人之中最強的，而是成為最好的自己。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: It's not about what the world thinks {roman} should achieve; it's about what {roman2} know {roman3} can accomplish with dedication and effort.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：重點不是世界認為我應該達成什麼，而是我知道只要投入與努力，我能成就什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Just built differently, always fetching, always carrying. Must be nice not needing a coffee break.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：天生就不一樣，永遠在撿東西、永遠在搬東西。不需要咖啡休息時間一定很好吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Let's be honest, {pet2} Dog outpaces us all, but hey, he's a dog and we're just rabbits.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：老實說，{pet2}狗比我們所有人都快，但嘿，牠是狗，我們只是兔子。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: My grindset is my commitment to never settling for less than what {roman} know {roman2} can achieve.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：我的拚搏心態，就是承諾絕不滿足於低於我能力所及的成果。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: My morning routine? A quick hop around the fields, a bit of carrot juice, and then straight to work on the next big chocolate innovation.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：我的晨間習慣？在田野裡跳一圈、喝點紅蘿蔔汁，然後直接投入下一個巧克力大創新。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Rise and grind, as {roman} say. The early rabbit gets the cocoa beans.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：就像我說的，早起拚搏。早起的兔子有可可豆吃。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Sleep is for the weak!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：睡覺是弱者才做的事！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: That dog works harder than any of us, {roman} swear. It's that dogged determination, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：我發誓，那隻狗比我們任何人都還認真。那種狗一般的執著，你懂吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: The Chocolate Factory is opening soon!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Bro§f：§6巧克力工廠§f快要開張了！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: What represents a sigma grindset for me? It's about being powered by my own ambitions, not the expectations laid out by others.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：對我來說，什麼是 sigma 拚搏心態？就是由我自己的抱負驅動，而不是別人設下的期望。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: Working out before dawn has its perks; you get to see {npc}'s 'inspirational' morning pep talks.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：天亮前健身有它的好處；你能看到{npc}§a的§f「勵志」晨間精神喊話。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: You should hire me! {roman} can help you boost your Chocolate Factory production tenfold by next quarter!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Bro§f：你應該雇用我！我能幫你在下一季把§6巧克力工廠§f的產量提升§d十倍§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: {npc} may run the factory, but who do you think inspires the work ethic?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：{npc}或許經營著工廠，但你覺得是誰在激勵大家的工作態度？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: {npc} thinks he's all that with his chocolate empire.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：{npc}以為自己有了巧克力帝國就很了不起。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: {npc}'s living the sweet life now, but who's the one who taught him to dodge those garden gnomes? Bro knows best.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Bro§f：{npc}§a現在§f過著甜蜜的生活，但當初是誰教他閃避那些花園地精的？兄弟最懂了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Bro: {roman} sure hope {roman2} get hired when it opens!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Bro§f：真希望它開張的時候我能被錄用！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: Coach wants us to push to our limits. {roman} asked if that includes pushing the snooze button. He wasn't amused.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：§d教練§f要我們挑戰極限。我問他按貪睡鍵算不算。他一點也不覺得好笑。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: He inspires me to care less about the details, because nothing ever works out in the end.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：他激勵我不要在意細節，反正最後什麼事都不會順利。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: He stinks pretty badly, though.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：不過牠真的很臭。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: My parents have been hounding me to get a job! Please hire me!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Cousin§f：我爸媽一直逼我去找工作！拜託雇用我！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: Remember the carrot crunch debacle?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：還記得那次紅蘿蔔脆片大災難嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: Still him, because it was a terrible idea.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：還是他，因為那真是個爛點子。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: They say genius looks like laziness. Guess {roman}'m living proof.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：人家說天才看起來就像懶惰。看來我就是活生生的證明。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: Uncle is an inspiration, really.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：叔叔真的是個激勵人心的榜樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: When {roman} finally get to it, even Granny's impressed with the flavors {roman2} whip up.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：等我終於開工的時候，連§a奶奶§f都對我調出的口味刮目相看。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: Working hard or hardly working? With chocolate, it's both. {roman} might drift in past noon, but when {roman2}'m on, {roman3}'m on fire.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：認真工作還是認真偷懶？做巧克力的話兩者皆是。我可能過了中午才晃進來，但只要我開工，就是火力全開。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: {npc} knows the score.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：{npc}心裡有數。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: {pet2} Dog is so youthful and full of energy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：{pet2}狗好年輕，充滿活力。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: {roman} need a job soon, or my parents will kick me out of the warren.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Cousin§f：我得趕快找份工作，不然我爸媽會把我趕出兔窩。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: {roman} suggested chocolate-covered carrots to {npc} once. He laughed until he tried it. Now, who's laughing?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：我曾經向{npc}提議做巧克力裹紅蘿蔔。他一直笑，直到他嚐了一口。現在是誰在笑？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Cousin: {roman} tell ya, family gatherings got a lot more interesting when {npc} started bringing those experimental chocolates.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Cousin§f：跟你說，自從{npc}開始帶那些實驗性巧克力來，家庭聚會就變得有趣多了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Between Bro's grindset, Cousin's relaxed approach, and Granny's wisdom, we've got all the ingredients for success.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：有哥哥的拚搏心態、表哥的悠哉作風，加上奶奶的智慧，我們成功的配方一應俱全。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Bro's dedication is what this company needs more of. And Cousin, well, he brings...creativity.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：這家公司最需要的就是哥哥的那份投入。至於表哥嘛，他帶來的是……§d創意§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Coach could motivate a snail to enter a sprint. It's exhausting, but you've got to admire that kind of energy.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：§d教練§f有辦法激勵一隻蝸牛去參加短跑。很累人，但你不得不佩服那種活力。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Every day, it's a new challenge. If it's not the market, it's Sis with her picket signs.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：每天都是新的挑戰。不是市場，就是妹妹舉著她的抗議牌。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Every family has its ups and downs, but ours?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：每個家庭都有起起落落，但我們家？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Granny? She's the glue holding us all together.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：奶奶？她是把我們凝聚在一起的黏著劑。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: He might just be fetching tools or delivering messages, but {pet2} Dog's got a work ethic we could all learn from.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：牠可能只是在撿工具或送訊息，但{pet2}狗的工作態度值得我們所有人學習。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Heir to the chocolate throne, they say.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：人家說，我是§6巧克力王座§f的繼承人。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Impossible, but you never stop hoping.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：不可能，但你永遠不會放棄希望。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: In life there are sharks and there are sheep.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Daddy§f：人生中有§c鯊魚§f，也有§a綿羊§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: More like heir to a bunch of headaches, courtesy of my own daughter's protests.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：倒不如說是一堆頭痛問題的繼承人，全拜我自己女兒的抗議所賜。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Now, if only Sis would see that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：現在，要是妹妹也能明白就好了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Pure, unthinking, relentless energy. Guess that's just how dogs are wired.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：純粹、不經思考、永不停歇的活力。我想狗天生就是這樣吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Sold out in a week. Shows what {roman} know.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：一週內就賣光了。看來我懂什麼。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Still, we're making the world sweeter, one chocolate bar at a time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：儘管如此，我們還是一次一條巧克力，讓世界變得更甜。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: The only thing in my way? You. Please hire me, boss.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Daddy§f：唯一擋在我面前的是什麼？你。拜託雇用我，老闆。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Trying to get through a meal without Uncle mentioning the semifinals is like trying to find a needle in a haystack.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：要吃完一頓飯而叔叔不提準決賽，就像大海撈針。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Uncle's advice for any problem: 'Think like it's the final game, down to the last second.'
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：叔叔對任何問題的建議都是：「把它當成決賽，拚到最後一秒。」

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Useful? Sometimes. Relevant? Rarely.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：有用嗎？有時候。相關嗎？很少。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: We've got a whole soap opera thanks to Sis.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：多虧了妹妹，我們家簡直是一整部肥皂劇。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: Well, {roman}'m a rabbit. But you get the idea.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Daddy§f：嗯，我是隻兔子。但你懂我的意思。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: {npc} wants us to 'think outside the box.' Last time {roman} did that, we ended up with chocolate-covered grass.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Daddy§f：{npc}要我們「跳脫框架思考」。上次我這麼做，結果做出了巧克力裹青草。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: {roman} am the heir to the chocolate throne.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Daddy§f：我是§6巧克力王座§f的繼承人。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Daddy: {roman}'m a shark.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Daddy§f：我是§c鯊魚§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Ah, {pet2} Bro, tirelessly toiling from the break of dawn, clinging to his routines with the desperation of a shipwreck survivor to a life raft.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：啊，{pet2}哥，從破曉起就不辭辛勞地工作，像船難倖存者抓著救生筏般死命抓著他的例行公事。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Ah-woo!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Dog§f：嗷嗚～！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: And there strides {pet2} Sis, torchbearer of tumult, whose fervent protests might one day change the world, if they don't first incite her to single-handedly dismantle it, piece by bureaucratic piece.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：而那邊大步走來的是{pet2}妹，混亂的火炬手，她熱切的抗議也許有一天能改變世界，前提是她沒有先被煽動到一手把世界拆掉，一塊一塊地拆解官僚體系。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Arf!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Dog§f：嗷！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Bark!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Dog§f：汪汪！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Bork.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Dog§f：汪。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Consider the possibility that limitations are merely figments of our imagination, crafted by our fears and insecurities.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：想想看，也許限制只是我們想像出來的，是由恐懼與不安所打造。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Each story a subtle reminder that history repeats itself, especially at family gatherings.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：每個故事都在委婉地提醒，歷史總會重演，尤其是在家庭聚會上。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Empathy is the silent language of the soul, spoken through actions rather than words.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：同理心是靈魂無聲的語言，以行動而非言語來表達。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Ever observant {pet2} Daddy, guardian of the gold, manages finances with a paranoia that would make a conspiracy theorist blush.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：永遠警覺的{pet2}爸爸，黃金的守護者，管理財務時的偏執程度連陰謀論者都會臉紅。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Granny, with anecdotes as endless as eternity, dispenses wisdom like a vending machine stuck on dispense, whether you requested it or not.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：奶奶的軼事多如永恆，分享智慧就像一台卡在出貨模式的販賣機，不管你有沒有要。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Grr...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Dog§f：吼……

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: His ledger is tighter than a drum, his brow perpetually furrowed in fiscal fear.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：他的帳本繃得比鼓還緊，眉頭因財務恐懼而永遠緊鎖。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: In every moment of decision, we stand at the crossroads of countless possibilities.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：在每個抉擇的時刻，我們都站在無數可能性的十字路口。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: In the pursuit of excellence, one must remember that the journey is as significant as the destination.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：在追求卓越的路上，必須記住，旅程與目的地同樣重要。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: It teaches us that every voice, no matter how small, has something of value to say.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：它教導我們，每一個聲音，不論多微小，都有值得一聽的話。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Observe the tranquil {pet2} Cuz, philosopher of sloth, whose profound punctuality issues suggest a man deeply at peace with life's ephemeral nature, or perhaps just deeply asleep.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：看看那悠哉的{pet2}表哥，怠惰哲學家，他深刻的守時問題顯示出他對生命的短暫本質深感平靜，又或者只是睡得很沉。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: One imagines his dreams fly similarly, unburdened by the gravity of reality.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：可以想見他的夢也是這樣飛翔，不受現實的重力束縛。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: One wonders if he runs from failure or merely jogs alongside it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：讓人不禁好奇，他是在逃離失敗，還是只是陪著失敗慢跑。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Solitude is not the absence of company, but the moment when our soul is free to speak to us, unencumbered by the chaos of the world.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：孤獨不是沒有陪伴，而是我們的靈魂得以自由對我們說話、不受世間紛擾束縛的時刻。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: The greatest paradox of life is that in seeking control, we often surrender it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：人生最大的矛盾是，在追求掌控的同時，我們往往放棄了它。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: The paths we choose not only define our destiny but also reflect the essence of our being.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：我們選擇的道路不只決定我們的命運，也反映出我們存在的本質。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: To break free, one must first believe in the boundlessness of their own potential.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：要掙脫束縛，必須先相信自己的潛能無窮無盡。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: To truly understand another, one must listen not only with ears but with the heart.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：要真正理解他人，不只要用耳朵聽，更要用心聽。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: True power comes not from dominion over others, but from mastery over oneself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：真正的力量並非來自支配他人，而是來自駕馭自己。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: True success lies not in the accolades, but in the lessons learned along the way.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：真正的成功不在於榮譽，而在於一路上學到的教訓。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: Woof!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Dog§f：汪！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: {#}pants{#2}
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Dog§f：{#}喘氣{#2}

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: {#}whines{#2}
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Dog§f：{#}嗚咽{#2}

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: {enchantment} often comes to us in whispers, through the leaves of the trees or the ripple of the waters.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：{enchantment}常常以低語的方式來到我們身邊，透過樹葉的沙沙聲或水面的漣漪。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: {pet2} Coach, the relentless fountain of fervor, whose motivational speeches soar so high they often escape the grasp of practical application.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：{pet2}教練，永不枯竭的熱情泉源，他的激勵演說飛得如此之高，常常脫離了實際應用的範圍。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Dog: {pet2} Uncle, our nostalgic knight, battles valiantly against the inexorable march of time, jousting with memories of glory days that the rest of us suspect were rather less glorious than recounted.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Dog§f：{pet2}叔叔，我們懷舊的騎士，英勇地對抗無情流逝的時光，與那些輝煌歲月的回憶比武，而我們其他人懷疑那些日子其實遠沒有他說的那麼輝煌。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Fan: Long live {pet2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§e Fan§f：{pet2}萬歲！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Fan: This is a beautiful rendition of such a perfect {pet2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§e Fan§f：這真是對完美的{pet2}一次美麗的詮釋！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Fan: {pet2} Best!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§e Fan§f：{pet2}最棒！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Fan: {pet2} is so beautiful!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§e Fan§f：{pet2}好美！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Fan: {roman} hope {roman2} get to meet {pet2} some day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§e Fan§f：希望我有一天能見到{pet2}。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Fan: {roman} love {pet2}!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§e Fan§f：我愛{pet2}！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Fan: {roman} want to be like {pet2} some day...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§e Fan§f：我希望有一天能像{pet2}一樣……

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Gatekeeper: {#} You don't have what {roman} need! Nice try!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Gatekeeper§f：{#} 你沒有我要的東西！想得美！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: But it's just his nature, always wanting to please, always ready to help. Bless his loyal heart.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：但那只是牠的天性，總是想討人喜歡，總是樂於幫忙。願主保佑牠那顆忠誠的心。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: Each bar we produce carries that legacy. Makes an old bunny proud.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：我們生產的每一條巧克力都承載著這份傳承。讓我這隻老兔子很驕傲。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: Every time {npc} talks about 'expanding the business', {roman} remind him: 'Don't forget to expand your heart too.'
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：每次{npc}說要「擴展事業」，我都會提醒他：「也別忘了擴展你的心胸。」

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: From {npc} {item} to chocolate empire, we've come a long way.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：從{npc} {item}到巧克力帝國，我們走了好長一段路。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: He gave me a computerized knitting machine.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：結果他送了我一台電腦編織機。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: He says that it 'sets the tone'. It's charming until it's you tenth listen for the week.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：他說那能「定調」。挺可愛的，直到你這週第十次聽到。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: He's a good boy, he listens.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：他是個好孩子，他會聽的。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: In my day, we made sweets from whatever was in the garden. {npc} just added cocoa.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：在我那個年代，我們用菜園裡有的東西做甜點。{npc}只是加了可可而已。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: In my days, we settled disputes over a hot cup of cocoa.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：在我那個年代，我們都是喝杯熱可可來解決紛爭的。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: Kids these days think they've invented sugar.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：現在的小孩以為糖是他們發明的。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: Maybe that's what Sis and my son need - a reminder of what binds us.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：也許妹妹和我兒子需要的就是這個——提醒他們是什麼把我們連在一起。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: Plus, {roman} decided {roman2} don't think {roman3} could ever give up chocolate.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Granny§f：而且，我認定我這輩子都戒不掉巧克力。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: That coach could talk a carrot into growing faster. It's a talent, but sometimes {roman} just want him to turn the volume down.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：那個教練有本事說服一根紅蘿蔔長快一點。這是種天賦，但有時候我只希望他把音量調小。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: That dog of ours, always bustling about. You'd think he understands the stakes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：我們家那隻狗總是忙進忙出。你會以為牠懂得事情有多重要。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: The Chocolate Factory used to be different before {npc} arrived.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Granny§f：在{npc} §f來之前，§6巧克力工廠§f可不是這個樣子。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: They say you can't choose your family. But if {roman} could, {roman2}'d choose this chocolate-crazed bunch every time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：人家說家人是不能選的。但如果我能選，我每次都會選這群巧克力狂。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: Uncle insists on playing the high school fight song during our morning stretches.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：叔叔堅持在我們晨間伸展時播放高中加油歌。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: You never know that you're in the glory days until it's too late.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Granny§f：身處黃金歲月的時候，你永遠不會察覺，直到為時已晚。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: {npc} wants to automate the chocolate wrapping. {roman} told him, 'Nothing beats the personal touch.'
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：{npc}想把巧克力包裝自動化。我跟他說：「什麼都比不上親手的溫度。」

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: {roman}'m looking to come out of retirement for one last job.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Granny§f：我想從退休生活復出，做§d最後一份工作§f。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Granny: {roman}'ve watched this family business grow from a single carrot patch to rows of cocoa trees.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Granny§f：我看著這家族事業從一小塊紅蘿蔔田，成長到一排排的可可樹。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Security: Don't be snootin' around here now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Security§f：別在這裡東張西望。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Security: Get back to finding them eggs!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Security§f：回去找那些蛋！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Security: Move along here, please.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Security§f：請繼續往前走。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: 'What would coach have done?' He mutters to himself.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：「教練會怎麼做？」他自言自語。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: A protest a day keeps the unethical practices away.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：一天一抗議，不道德的行為遠離你。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Apparently 'anticipating your opponent's moves' applies to everything from dating to business deals.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：顯然「預判對手的動作」適用於所有事情，從約會到商業交易都是。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Bro's always talking about his 'sigma grindset'. Tried to get me to read a book on it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：哥哥老是在講他的「sigma 拚搏心態」。還想叫我讀一本相關的書。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Chocolate is love, chocolate is life. But at what cost?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：巧克力就是愛，巧克力就是生命。但代價是什麼？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Close the yearbook, pal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：把畢業紀念冊闔上吧，老兄。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Cousin might be the laziest bunny {roman} know, but he's onto something.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：表哥也許是我認識最懶的兔子，但他確實有點道理。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Dad might not see it now, but {roman}'m doing this for the future of all chocolate bunnies.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：爸爸現在也許看不出來，但我這麼做是為了所有巧克力兔的未來。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Down with Big Chocolate!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Sis§f：打倒巧克力大財團！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: He asked if green food coloring counted.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：他問綠色食用色素算不算。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: He is as loyal as they come, and doesn't look at me funny when {roman} am speaking like everyone else.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：牠無比忠誠，而且我說話時，牠不會像其他人一樣用奇怪的眼神看我。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: It's like sacred sports hour, but it's just him yelling at the players on screen to 'watch the defense!'
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：就像神聖的運動時間，只不過就是他一個人對著螢幕上的球員大吼「注意防守！」

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: It's time this family faces the music and listens to the cocoa beans' side of the story!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：是時候讓這個家族面對現實，聽聽可可豆那一方的說法了！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Regulate! Regulate! Regulate!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Sis§f：管制！管制！管制！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: The factory needs a new recipe...for justice.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：工廠需要一份新配方……正義的配方。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: They call me a troublemaker, a rebel. {roman} say, {roman2}'m the only one talking sense!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：他們說我是麻煩製造者、叛逆分子。我說，我是唯一一個說話有道理的人！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: They say {roman}'m disrupting the peace, but {roman2}'m just trying to sprinkle a little truth on our chocolate-covered lies.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：他們說我破壞和平，但我只是想在我們裹著巧克力的謊言上撒一點真相。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Together we can abolish the patriarchy, and ensure clean chocolate for all rabbits!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Sis§f：我們一起就能廢除父權，並確保所有兔子都吃得到乾淨的巧克力！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Uncle has this ritual of watching old high school games every weekend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：叔叔每個週末都有看老高中比賽的習慣。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Uncle treats every little decision around here like it's the state championship game.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：叔叔把這裡的每個小決定都當成州冠軍賽在處理。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Wake up and smell the exploitation, family!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：醒醒吧，聞聞剝削的味道，家人們！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: We're...working on it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：我們……還在努力。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Well, more like he can't avoid them since {roman} do it in the lobby. But it's a start, right?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：嗯，比較像是因為我在大廳抗議，他躲都躲不掉。但這也算是個開始，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: Why protest when you can just 'be the change'? By napping, apparently.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：既然可以直接「成為改變」，何必抗議呢？顯然是靠睡午覺。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: {npc} actually listens to my protests.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：{npc}其實有在聽我的抗議。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: {pet2} Dog is my best friend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：{pet2}狗是我最好的朋友。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: {roman} asked Uncle for some life advice, but all {roman2} got were football {roman3}'s and O's.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：我向叔叔請教人生建議，結果只得到一堆足球戰術的 X 和 O。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: {roman} think Coach is all brawn and no brains.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：我覺得§d教練§f只有肌肉沒有腦袋。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: {roman} told him {roman2}'d start my own movement: the 'chocolate mindfulness mindset'.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：我跟他說我要發起自己的運動：「巧克力正念心態」。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Sis: {roman} told {npc} we should have a line of eco-friendly chocolates.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Sis§f：我跟{npc}說我們應該推出一系列環保巧克力。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Always rallying the troops for her cause, much like a good quarterback does in the fourth quarter.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：總是為了她的理念號召大家，就像一個好四分衛在第四節會做的那樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Back in high school, {roman} was just one play away from that state championship.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：高中時，我離州冠軍只差一次進攻。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Cuz might not have the typical athlete's discipline, but he's clutch.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：表哥也許沒有一般運動員的自律，但他是關鍵時刻的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Cuz showing up to work is like a trick play.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：表哥來上班就像一記假動作戰術。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Even the Dog's got team spirit.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：就連狗都有團隊精神。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Every team needs a loyal supporter like that.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：每支隊伍都需要那樣忠實的支持者。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Every time {roman} see a football, {roman2} can't help but wonder 'What if?'
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：每次看到美式足球，我都忍不住想「如果當初……」

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: He reminds me of our mascot back in the day. Always on the sidelines, ready to cheer us on.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：牠讓我想起我們以前的吉祥物。總是在場邊，隨時準備為我們加油。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: He's got that championship mindset, just like {roman} had.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：他有那種冠軍心態，就像我當年一樣。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: If only {roman} had zigged instead of zagged...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：要是我當時往左切而不是往右切就好了……

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Instead, {roman} am here. Please, hire me.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Uncle§f：結果我卻在這裡。拜託，雇用我。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Just like my old teammate who didn't show up to every practice, but could score tuddies when it mattered most.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：就像我以前那個不是每次練習都出席、卻能在最關鍵時刻達陣的隊友。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Man.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：唉。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: My knee has never been the same since, man.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：從那之後，我的膝蓋就再也不一樣了，唉。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: She doesn't just play - she changes the game.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：她不只是參與比賽——她改變比賽。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: She was wrong.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Uncle§f：她錯了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Sis has that fire, like the team captains back in my day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：妹妹有那股火，就像我那個年代的隊長們。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Sometimes, late at night, {roman} replay that final drive in my head.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：有時候深夜，我會在腦中重播那最後一波推進。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Sometimes, {roman} give tours. You know, just to keep the legacy going.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：有時候我還會帶人參觀。你知道的，只是為了讓傳統延續下去。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Still got some of those moves, you know.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：你知道的，我那些招式還沒忘光。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Sure, {pet2} Bro's up at dawn doing push-ups and planning his day.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：當然，{pet2}哥天一亮就起來做伏地挺身、規劃他的一天。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: Was so close to grabbing that championship ring.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：差一點就拿到那枚冠軍戒指了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: You never see it coming, and when it happens, you can't help but wonder if it was a fluke.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：你永遠料不到，而當它發生時，你忍不住懷疑那是不是運氣。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {npc} always said {roman} could be somebody if {roman2} put my mind to it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Uncle§f：{npc}總是說，只要我下定決心，就能成為了不起的人。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {npc}'s like the star quarterback of this chocolate game. Always looking for that next big play.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：{npc}§a就§f像這場巧克力比賽的明星四分衛。總是在尋找下一個大進攻。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {player}...you have to hire me. Please.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Uncle§f：{player}……你一定要雇用我。拜託。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {roman} could have been a legend, you know?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：我本來可以成為傳奇的，你知道嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {roman} like Coach's style. My family could learn a thing or two from him.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：我喜歡§d教練的§f作風。我的家人可以從他身上學到一兩招。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {roman} should be in the Hall of Fame by now.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§c Uncle§f：我現在早該進名人堂了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {roman} used to be like him, then {roman2} tore my ACL.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：我以前也跟他一樣，後來我的前十字韌帶撕裂了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {roman} used to chuck that ball like nobody's business. Those were the days, eh?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：我以前丟那顆球可是無人能比。那段日子真好啊，對吧？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet} Uncle: {roman}'ve got the entire high school trophy case memorized.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§7 Uncle§f：我把整個高中獎盃櫃都背得滾瓜爛熟。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: ... it's best not to ask too many questions and just accept reality as you see it.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：……最好別問太多問題，就接受你所看到的現實吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: ....
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：……

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Brrrrrrrrrrrrrr!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：§b呼嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: But are you rich enough?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：但你夠有錢嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Come back when you've reached Bestiary Milestone {roman} to upgrade it to Epic!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：等你達到§6圖鑑里程碑 {roman}§f再來，我就把它升級成§5史詩§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Come back when you've reached Bestiary Milestone {roman} to upgrade it to Legendary!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：等你達到§6圖鑑里程碑 {roman}§f再來，我就把它升級成§6傳奇§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Come back when you've reached Bestiary Milestone {roman} to upgrade it to Rare!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：等你達到§6圖鑑里程碑 {roman}§f再來，我就把它升級成§9稀有§f！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Did you know Slimes can spawn near the void?
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：你知道§a史萊姆§f會在虛空附近生成嗎？

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Do not think {roman} am sleeping, thief.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：別以為我在睡覺，小偷。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Full circle.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：繞了一圈。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Go ahead.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：去吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Good luck this week. And remember...haaaaave fun with it!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：這週祝你好運。還有記得……好～好～享受吧！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Guess things tend to go full circle over time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：看來事情總會隨著時間繞一圈回到原點。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Halt, fledgling mortal.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：站住，羽翼未豐的凡人。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Hello {player}. Glad to meet you here. {roman} need some {item}.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：你好，{player}。很高興在這裡見到你。我需要一些{item}。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: If you reach high enough Bestiary Milestones, {roman} will increase the rarity of this pet!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：如果你達到夠高的§6圖鑑里程碑§f，我就會提升這隻寵物的稀有度！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: If you want your mind intact when you get out of here...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：如果你想離開這裡時§d心智§f完好無缺……

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: If {roman} can see it, you can too!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：如果我看得到，你也看得到！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: In my opinion, Magma Cubes are just fiery slimes.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：依我看，§c岩漿立方怪§f不過就是著火的史萊姆。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: It's always good to have a friend.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：有個朋友總是好的。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: It's not every century we meet players down here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：可不是每個世紀都能在這底下遇到玩家的。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: It's so cold down here, even the Snakes go slower.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：這底下冷到連§9蛇§f都變慢了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: It's the holiday season in SkyBlock and that can only mean one thing...
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：SkyBlock 的節日季節到了，這只代表一件事……

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Jump down to the pillar down there.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：跳到下面那根柱子上。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Jump on the pillar!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：跳到柱子上！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Know that they come at a price, measured in emeralds and treasures beyond imagining.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：要知道，它們是有代價的，得用綠寶石和超乎想像的寶藏來衡量。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Leave me alone, guest!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：別煩我，訪客！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Listen here.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：聽好了。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: My expertise doesn't come for free!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：我的專業可不是免費的！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: My life goal is to kill two birds.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：我的人生目標是一石二鳥。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: My little child, you don't look so good. You should eat something. {roman} have an idea, give me some ingredients and {roman2}'ll make you a nice soup.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：我的小乖乖，你氣色不太好。你該吃點東西。我有個主意，給我一些材料，我幫你煮一碗好湯。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Off you go! Thanks for the help!
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：去吧！謝謝你的幫忙！

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Oh, {player}! {roman}'m having a conundrum! There's so much to kill, yet so little time.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：喔，{player}！我遇到難題了！要殺的東西這麼多，時間卻這麼少。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Pigmen are great at hoarding wealth.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：§6豬布林§f很擅長囤積財富。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Progress as far as you can by killing mobs, gaining collection, and using minions.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：透過擊殺怪物、累積收藏和使用工人，盡可能地往前推進吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Prove your worth.
entries.value: §e[NPC] {pet}§f：證明你的價值吧。

entries.key: [NPC] {pet}: Quit clicking me!
